Along with the usual Daksina, he should offer twenty sweet fried cakes to Brahmanas with the mantra, “O Lord of the Universe, О Lord of Devas, О Supreme Lord, be pleased. Accepting this present, be the bestower of what is desired by me.” In accordance with his capacity, he should feed the Brahmanas. He should himself take food observing restraint in speech. He who thus performs the great holy observance pertaining to Trivikrama, shall be devoid of sins and shall attain the benefit of eight Naramedhas (human sacrifices).

## \|\| 1.17.58 \|\|

*āṣāḍhaśukladvādaśyāmupavāsī jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*vāmanaṃ pūrvamānena snāpayetpayasā vratī \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. On the Dvadasi day in the bright half of the month of Asadha, one should observe fast and keep all sense organs under control. The observer of the holy vow should bathe Vamana in milk, of the same quantity as mentioned before.

## \|\| 1.17.59 \|\|

*namaste vāmanāyeti dūrvājyāṣṭottaraṃ śatam \|*  
*hutvā ca jāgaraṃ kuryādvāmanaṃ cārcayetpunaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. He should worship by saying, “Obeisance to you, to Vamana”. After offering hundred and eight oblations with ghee and the Durva grass, he should keep awake during the night. He should worship Vamana again.

## \|\| 1.17.60 \|\|

*sadākṣiṇaṃ ca dadhyannaṃ nālikeraphalānvitam \|*  
*bhaktyā pradadyādviprāya vāmanārcanaśīline \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. With great piety, he should offer cooked rice with curds, to a Brahmana regularly worshipping Vamana, along with the usual Daksinas and a coconut fruit.

## \|\| 1.17.61 \|\|

*vāmano vuddhido hotā dravyastho vāmanaḥ sadā \|*  
*vāmanastārako 'smācca vāmanāya namo namaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. “Vamana is the bestower of intellect. He is the sacrificial priest. Vamana is always present in the materials (of worship). Vamana is the redeemer from this (worldly existence). Obeisance, obeisance, to Vamana.”

## \|\| 1.17.62 \|\|

*anena dattvā dadhyannaṃ śaktito bhojayeddijān \|*  
*kṛtvai vamagriṣṭomānāṃ śatasya phalamāpnuyāt \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. With this Mantra, he should offer the cooked rice with curds. In accordance with his capacity, he should feed the Brahmanas. By doing thus, the devotee shall attain the benefit of a hundred Agnistomas.

## \|\| 1.17.63 \|\|

*śrāvaṇasya site pakṣe dvādaśyāmupavāsakṛt \|*  
*kṣīreṇa madhumiśreṇa snāpayecchrīdharaṃ vratī \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. On the Dvadasi day in the bright half of the month of Sravana, the observer of the holy vow should observe fast and bathe god Sridhara in milk mixed with honey.

## \|\| 1.17.64 \|\|

*namo 'stu śrīdharāyeti gandhādyaiḥ pūjayetkramāt \|*  
*juhuyātpṛṣadājyena śatamaṣṭottaraṃ mune \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. He should worship him saying, “Obeisance be to Sridhara”, and offering scents, etc. in due order. О sage, he should offer one hundred and eight oblations of Prsadajya (ghee mixed with coagulated milk).

## \|\| 1.17.65-67 \|\|

*kṛtvā ca jāgaraṃ rātrau punaḥ pūjāṃ prakalpayet \|*  
*dātavyaṃ caiva viprāya kṣīrāḍhakamanuttamam \|\| 65 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇāṃ ca savastrāṃ vai pradadyāddhemakuṇḍale \|*  
*mantreṇānena viprendru sarvakāmāśrasiddhaye \|\| 66 \|\|*

*kṣīrābdhiśāyindeveśa ramākānta jagatpate \|*  
*kṣīradānena suprīto bhava sarvasukhapradaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

65-67. After keeping awake at night, he should perform the worship again. Excellent milk measuring an Adhoka must be given to a Brahmana along with a cloth and the usual religious fee, together with two golden earrings: О leading Brahmana, in order to realize all the cherished desires, he should repeat the following Mantra: “O Lord Rama, О Lord of Devas, reposing in the milk ocean, О Lord of the Universe, be delighted with this gift of milk. Be the bestower of all happiness.”

## \|\| 1.17.68 \|\|

*sukhapradattvādviprāṃśca bhojayecchaktito vratī \|*  
*eva kṛtvā śvamedhānāṃ sahasrasya phalaṃ labhet \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. In view of its being pleasure-bestowing, the performer of the holy rite should feed the Brahmanas in accordance with his capacity. By performing thus, the devotee attains the benefit of. a thousand horse sacrifices.

## \|\| 1.17.69 \|\|

*māsi bhādrapade śukle dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ \|*  
*snāpayeddroṇapayasā hṛṣīkeśaṃ jagadgurum \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. On the Dvadasi day in the bright half of the month of Bhadrapada, the devotee should observe fast, duly bathe Hrsikesa, the preceptor of the universe, in milk measuring a drona.

## \|\| 1.17.70 \|\|

*hṛṣīkeśa namastubhyamiti saṃpūjayennaraḥ \|*  
*caruṇā madhuyuktena śatamaṣṭottaraṃ hunet \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. The man should worship saying, “O Hrsikesa, obeisance to you.” He should perform the Ноma with Caru (a preparation of boiled rice, barley and pulse) mixed with honey offering oblations one hundred and eight times.

## \|\| 1.17.71 \|\|

*jāgarādīnini nirvartya dadyādātmavide tataḥ \|*  
*sārdhāḍhakaṃ ca godhūmāndakṣiṇāṃ hema śaktitaḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. After completing the rites of keeping awake, etc., he should give to a knower of the Atman one and a half Adhakas of wheat with Daksina and gold according to one’s capacity.

## \|\| 1.17.72 \|\|

*hṛṣīkeśa namastubhyaṃ sarvalokaikahetave \|*  
*mahyaṃ sarvasukhaṃ dehi godhūmasya pradānataḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. With the Mantra, “O Hrsikesa, obeisance to you, the sole cause of all worlds. Grant all happiness unto me, in view of this gift of wheat.”

## \|\| 1.17.73 \|\|

*bhojayedvrāhmāñśaktyā svayaṃ cāśrītavāgyataḥ \|*  
*sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmamedhaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. According to his capacity he should feed the Brahmanas, and should himself take food with restrained speech. He shall be absolved of all sins and shall attain the benefit of Brahma- medha.

## \|\| 1.17.74 \|\|

*āśvine māsiśuklāyāṃ dvādaśyāṃsamupoṣitaḥ \|*  
*padmanābhaṃ capayasā snāpayedbhaktitaḥ śuciḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. On the Dvadasi day in the bright half of the month of Asvina, the devotee should observe fast. With great devotion and purity, he should bathe Padmanabha with milk.

## \|\| 1.17.75 \|\|

*namaste padmanābhāya homaṃ kuyārtsvaśaktitaḥ \|*  
*tilabrīhiyavājyaiśca pūjayecca vidhānataḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. He should perform Ноmа in accordance with his capacity saying, “Obeisance to you, to Padmanabha. In accordance with the injunctions, he should perform worship with sesamum seeds, cereals, barley and ghee.

## \|\| 1.17.76 \|\|

*jāmaraṃ niśi nirvartya punaḥ pūjāṃ samācaret \|*  
*dadyādviprāya kuḍavaṃ madhunastu sadakṣiṇam \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. After keeping awake during the night, he should perform worship again. He should give a Kudava (measure) of honey along with the usual Daksina to a Brahmana.

## \|\| 1.17.77 \|\|

*padmanābhagha namastubhyaṃ sarvalokapitāmaha \|*  
*madhudānena suprīto bhavasarvasukhapradaḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. (The mantra shall be) — “O Padmanabha, obeisance to you, О grandfather of all worlds, be delighted with the gift of honey. Be the bestower of all happiness.”

## \|\| 1.17.78 \|\|

*evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā padmanābhavrataṃ sudhīḥ \|*  
*brahmamedhasahasrasya phalamānpoti niścitam \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. He who intelligently and devoutly performs the holy vow pertaining to Padmanabha certainly attains the benefit of a thousand Brahmamedhas.

## \|\| 1.17.79-85 \|\|

*dvādaśyāṃ kārtike śukle upavāsī jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*kṣīreṇākaḍhakamānena dandhā vājyena tāvatā \|\| 79 \|\|*

*namo dāmodarāyeti snāpayedbhaktibhāvataḥ \|*  
*aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā maghvājyāktatilāhutīḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

*jāgaraṃ niyataḥ kuryāttrikālārcanatatparaḥ \|*  
*prātaḥ saṃpūjayeddevaṃ padmapuṣpairmanoramaiḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

*punaraṣṭottaraśataṃ juhuyātsaghṛtai stilaiḥ \|*  
*pañcabhakṣyayutaṃ cānnaṃ dadyādviprāya bhaktitaḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

*dāmodara jagannātha sarvakāraṇakāraṇa \|*  
*trāhimāṃ kṛpayā deva śāraṇāgatapālakaḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

*anena dattvā dānaṃ ca śrotriyāya kuṭumbine \|*  
*dakṣiṇāñca yathāśaktyā brāhmaṇāṃśvāpi bhojayet \|\| 84 \|\|*

*evaṅkṛtvā vrataṃ samyagaśrīyādvūndhubhiḥ saha \|*  
*aśvamegha sahasrāṇāṃ dviguṇaṃ phalamaśnute \|\| 85 \|\|*

79-82a. On the Dvadasi day in the bright half of the month of Kirttika, the devotee should observe fast. He should control all his sense-organs. Saying ‘‘Obeisance to Damodara” with devotional feelings, he should bathe Damodara with milk, curds or ghee measuring an Adhaka. He should perform a hundred and eight Ahutis with sesamum seeds soaked in honey and ghee. He should invariably observe the vow of keeping awake (during the night), and should be devoted to the performance of worship thrice a day. In the morning he should worship the Lord with charming lotus flowers. Again, he should perform Homa with one hundred and eight oblations of sesamum seeds and ghee.

82b-85. With great devotion he should give to a Brahmana, cooked rice along with five Bhaksyas (side dishes of edible things). (The mantra) “O Damodara, О Lord of the universe, О cause of all causes, save me compassionately. О Lord, О protector of those who seek refuge.” With this Mantra he should give the charitable gift to a Brahmana, well-versed in the Vedas but burdened with a large family. In accordance with his capacity, he must give Daksina and feed the Brahmanas. After performing the holy rites duly, the devotee should take food along with his kinsmen. He attains twice the benefit of a thousand horse-sacrifices.

## \|\| 1.17.86 \|\|

*evaṃ kuryādvratī yastu dvādaśīvratamuttamam \|*  
*saṃvatsaraṃ muniśreṣṭha sa yāti parama padam \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. О excellent sage, he who performs these excellent Dvadasi vratas for a year, attains the highest region.

## \|\| 1.17.87 \|\|

*ekamāse dvimāse vāyaḥ kuryādbhaktitatparaḥ \|*  
*tattatphalamavānpoti prānpoti ca hareḥ padam \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. He who devotedly performs these rites for one or two months, attains their respective benefits as well as Hari’s region.

## \|\| 1.17.88-90 \|\|

*pūrṇaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā kuryādudyāpanaṃ vratī \|*  
*mārgaśīrṣāsite pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ ca munīśvara \|\| 88 \|\|*

*snātvā prātaryathācāraṃ dantadhāvanapūrvakam \|*  
*śuklamālyāmbaradharaḥ śuklagandhānulepanaḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

*maṇḍapaṃ kārayeddivyaṃ caturastraṃ suśībhanam \|*  
*ghaṇṭācāmarasaṃyuktaṃ kiṅkiṇīravaśobhitam \|\| 90 \|\|*

88-90. After performing the observance of the vow for one full year, the devotee should perform the Udyapana rite (formally concluding it), О leading sage, on the Dvadasi day in the dark half of Margasirsa. He should take his bath early in the morning in accordance with his prescribed course of duties, after duly cleaning the teeth. He should wear white garments and garlands with white unguents and scents. He should erect an exquisite pandal, splendid in form and square in shape. It should be fitted with bells, chowries, etc. and embellished with tinkling bells.

## \|\| 1.17.91-92 \|\|

*alaṅkṛtaṃ puṣpamālyairvitānaghvajarājitān \|*  
*chāditaṃ śuklavastreṇa dīpamālāvibhūṣitam \|\| 91 \|\|*

*tanmadhye sarvatobhadraṃ kuryātsamyagalaṅkṛtam \|*  
*tasyoparinyasetkumbhāndvādaśāmbuprapūritān \|\| 92 \|\|*

91-92. It must be bedecked in flowers and garlands. Canopy and banners shall add to its splendour. It should be screened with a white cloth. Rows of lamps would beautify it. In its middle a Sarvatobhadra (an auspicious design or ‘Mandala’ in five colours) should be made. It should be duly beautified. The devotee should place twelve jars filled with water on that platform.

## \|\| 1.17.93 \|\|

*ekena śulkavanastreṇa samyaksaṃśodhitena ca \|*  
*sarvānācchādayetkumbhānpañcaratnasamanvitān \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. Five kinds of precious stones must be put inside the jars and all of the jars with five kinds of precious stones deposited in them, should be covered with a well-washed white cloth.

## \|\| 1.17.94 \|\|

*lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ kārayedbhaktimānvratī \|*  
*henmā vā rājatenāpi tathā tāmreṇa vā dvijā \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. О Brahmana, the performer of the holy rites should devoutly make the image of Lakshminarayana in gold, silver or copper.

## \|\| 1.17.95 \|\|

*sthāpayetpratimāṃ tāṃ ca kumbhopari susaṃyamī \|*  
*tanmūlyaṃ vā dvijaśreṣṭha kāñcanaṃ ca svaśaktitaḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. The devotee with good control over his sense-organs, should place the image on the jars. Or its price or gold according to his capacity may be placed (on the jars), О excellent Brahmana.

## \|\| 1.17.96 \|\|

*sarvavrateṣu matimānvittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarja yet \|*  
*yadi kuryātkṣayaṃ yānti tasyāyurddhanasaṃpadaḥ \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. In all holy rites the sensible devotee should avoid dishonesty or perfidy in money. If he commits it, his span of life, wealth and riches will dwindle down.

## \|\| 1.17.97 \|\|

*anantaśāyinaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayaṭam \|*  
*pañcāmṛtena prathamaṃ snāpayedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. At the outset, the devotee endowed with piety should bathe Lord Narayana who, free from all ailments, is lying on (the serpent) Ananta, with Pancamrta (the mixture of five sweet things, viz. milk, curds, ghee, honey and sugar).

## \|\| 1.17.98 \|\|

*nāṃmabhiḥ keśavādyaiśca hyupacārānmakalpayet \|*  
*rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātpurāṇaśravaṇādibhaghiḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. The services rendered (prostration, etc.) should be based on Kesava and other names (of Visnu). He should keep awake during the night, by listening to Puranas, etc.

## \|\| 1.17.99 \|\|

*jitanidro bhavetsamyaksopavāso jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*trikālamarcayeddevaṃ yathāvibhavavistaram \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. He should bring under control slumber. Observing fasts, he should subdue his sense organs. In accordance with his capacity and wealth, he should worship the Lord, thrice in a day.

## \|\| 1.17.100 \|\|

*tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya prātaḥ kṛtyaṃ samāpya ca \|*  
*tilahomānvyāhṛtibhiḥ sahasraṃra kāvyeddvijaiḥ \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. Getting up early in the morning and finishing the routine duties of the morning, he should, through Brahmanae, get offered a thousand oblations of sesamum seed while repeating the Vyahrti mantras.

## \|\| 1.17.101 \|\|

*tataḥ saṃpūjayeddevaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt \|*  
*devasya purataḥ kuryātpurāṇaśravaṇaṃ tataḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. Thereafter, he should worship the Lord with scents, flowers, etc. in the prescribed order. In front of the Lords he should listen to the Puranas.

## \|\| 1.17.102 \|\|

*dadyāddvādaśaviprebhyo dadhyannaṃ pāyasaṃ pāyasaṃ tathā \|*  
*apūpairdaśa bhiryuktaṃ saghṛtaṃ ca sadakṣiṇam \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. He should give cooked rice mixed with curds, milk pudding, ten Apupas (sweet pies or sweet round cakes) with ghee, to twelve Brahmanas along with the usual Daksina.

## \|\| 1.17.103 \|\|

*devadevajagannātha bhaktānugrahavigraha \|*  
*gṛhāṇopāyanaṃ kṛṣṇa sarvābhīṣṭaprado bhava \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. “O Lord of gods, О Lord of the universe, О lord whose person is for the purpose of blessing the devotees, О Krsna, accept the present. Be the bestower of all desired objects"

## \|\| 1.17.104 \|\|

*anenopāyanaṃ dattvā prārthaye māñjaliḥ sthitaḥ \|*  
*ādhāya jānunī bhūmau vinayāvananato vratī \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. With this Mantra, he should offer gifts. With palms joined in reverence, he should pray. The performer of the Vrata should kneel on the ground humbly.

## \|\| 1.17.105 \|\|

*namo namaste surarājarāja namo 'stute devaṃ jagannivāsa \|*  
*kuruṣva saṃpṛrṇaphalaṃ mamādya namo 'stu tubhyaṃ puruṣottamāya \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. (Prayer) — “Obeisance, obeisance to you, О king of the kings of Devas. Obeisance be to you, О Lord, О receptacle of the worlds, render the fruit of my vow complete today. Obeisance be to you, О Supreme Person.

## \|\| 1.17.106 \|\|

*iti saṃprārthayedviprāndevaṃ ca puruṣottamam \|*  
*dadyādarghyaṃ ca devāya mahālakṣmīyutāya vai \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. Thus, he should pray to the Brahmanas and to Lord Purusottama. He should offer Arghya to the Lord accompanied by Mahalaksmi.

## \|\| 1.17.107 \|\|

*lakṣmīpate namastubhyaṃ kṣīrārṇavanivāsine \|*  
*arghyaṃ gṛhāṇa deveśa lakṣmyā ca sahitaḥ prakṣo \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. “O Lord of Laksmi, obeisance to you, to the resident of the milk ocean. О Lord of Devas, accompanied by Laksmi, accept the Arghya.

## \|\| 1.17.108 \|\|

*yasya smṛtyā ca nāmoktyā tapoyajñakriyādiṣu \|*  
*nyūnaṃ saṃpūrṇatāṃ yāti sadyo vande tamacyutam \|\| 108 \|\|*

108\. I salute Acyuta whose remembrance and the utterance of whose name makes whatever is deficient in penance, performance of sacrifice and other rites compensated immediately and made perfect and complete.”

## \|\| 1.17.109 \|\|

*iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ tatsarvaṃ saṃyamī vrate \|*  
*pratimāṃ dakṣiṇāyuktāmācāryāya nivedayet \|\| 109 \|\|*

109\. After having prayed thus to the Lord of Devas, the devotee should offer the image to the preceptor along with Daksina.

## \|\| 1.17.110 \|\|

*brāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścīcchaktyā dadyāja dakṣiṇām \|*  
*bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ paścātsvayaṃ bevṛjanairvṛtaḥ \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. Thereafter, he should feed the Brahmanas according to his capacity. He should give them Daksinas also. Afterwards, restrained in speech, he should himself take food surrounded by his kinsmen.

## \|\| 1.17.111-113 \|\|

*āsāyaṃ śṛduyādviṣṇoḥ kathāṃ vidvajjanaiḥ saha \|*  
*ityevaṃ kurute yastu manujo dvādaśīvratam \|\| 111 \|\|*

*sarvānkāmānsa ānpoti paraghatreha ca nārada \|*  
*trisatakulasaṃyuktaḥ sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ \|*  
*tapāti viṣṇubhavanaṃ yatra yattvā na śocati \|\| 112 \|\|*

*ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādvipra dvādaśīvratamuttamam \|*  
*vācayedvāpi sa naro vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 113 \|\|*

111-113. In the company of learned men, he should listen to the story of Visnu till evening. The man who thus observes the Dvadasi vow, О Narada, attains all desires both here and hereafter. Absolved of all sins, accompanied by twenty- one generations of his family, he goes to Visnus abode after reaching which none feels grieved. О Brahmana, the man who listens to this excellent Dvadasi Vrata, or reads it, attains the benefit of Vajapeya sacrifice.

## Chapter 18. The Holy Observance Pertaining to Laksmi-Narayana

## \|\| 1.18.1 \|\|

*sanaka uvāca*  
*anyadvratavaraṃ vakṣya śṛṇuṣva munisattama \|*  
*sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaduḥkhanibarhaṇam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*Sanaka said:*

1\. О excellent sage, listen. I shall tell you another holy observance that removes all sins, destroys all miseries and is very sacred and meritorious.

## \|\| 1.18.2 \|\|

*brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā \|*  
*samastakāmaphaladaṃ sarvavratamyaphalapradam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. It bestows all desired objects to the Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas, Sudras and the women folk. It yields the benefits of all other holy rites.

## \|\| 1.18.3 \|\|

*duḥsvanpanāśane dharmyaṃ duṣṭagrahanivāraṇam \|*  
*sarvalokeṣu vikhyātaṃ pūrṇimāvratamam \|*  
*yena cīrṇena pāpānāṃ rāśikoṭiḥra praśāmyati \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. It is conducive to righteousness; it destroys bad effects of evil dreams; it wards off (the influence of) evil planets. It is the excellent Purnima Vrata (observance of the full Moon day), well-known in all worlds. If it is performed, a ten million heaps of accumulated sins perish.

## \|\| 1.18.4 \|\|

*mārgaśīrṣe sitepakṣe pūrṇāyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*snānaṃ kuryādyathācāraṃ dantadhāvanapūrvakam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. On the full moon day, in the bright half of the month of Margasirsa, the devotee should, after duly washing the teeth, perform the rite of ablution according to the prescribed procedure, and be self-restrained and pure.

## \|\| 1.18.5-6 \|\|

*śuklāmbaradharaḥ śuddho gṛhamāgagatya vāgyataḥ \|*  
*prakṣālya pādāvācamya smaratrārāyaṇaṃ prabhum \|\| 5 \|\|*

*nityaṃ devārcanaṃ kṛtvā paśvātsaṃkalpapūrvakam \|*  
*lakṣmī nārāyaṇaṃ devamarcayedbhaktibhāvataḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. He should return home and wear pure and white garments. With restrained speech (i.e. silence), he should wash the feet and sip water as Acamana. Remembering Lord Narayana, he should perform his usual daily worship of gods. He should, thereupon, worship Lord Laksmi-Narayana devoutly with the solemn vow.

## \|\| 1.18.7 \|\|

*āvāhanāsanādyaiśca gandhapuṣpādibhirvratī \|*  
*namo nārāyaṇāyeti pūjayedbhaktitatparaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The performer of this Vrata (observance) should devoutly worship saying, “Obeisance to Narayana”. After invoking the deity and offering him a seat, etc., he should worship the Lord with scents, fragrant flowers, etc. with full concentrated mind.

## \|\| 1.18.8 \|\|

*gītairvādyaiśca nṛtyaiśca purāṇapaṭhanādibhiḥ \|*  
*stotrairvārādhayeddevaṃ vratakṛtsusamāhitaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The observer of the holy rite should propitiate the Lord with songs, musical instruments, dances, hymns, readings of Puranas, etc, also.

## \|\| 1.18.9 \|\|

*devasya purataḥ kṛtvā sthaṇḍilaṃ caturastrakam \|*  
*aratnimātraṃ tatrāngiṃ sthāpayedgṛhyamārgataḥ \|*  
*ājyabhāgāntarpayantaṃ kṛtvā puruṣasūktataḥ \|*  
*caraṇā ca tilaiśvāpi ghṛtena juhuyāttathā \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The devotee should make a raised platfonn of an Aratni (about 45 cms.) square, in front of the Lord and place fire thereon, in accordance with the rules laid down in Grhya Sutras. Repeating the Рurusa sukta upto Ajya hymns he should propitiate the Lord by performing the Ноmа with ghee, *Caru* and sesamum seeds.

## \|\| 1.18.10 \|\|

*ekavāraṃ dvivāraṃ vātrivāraṃ vāpi śaktitaḥ \|*  
*homaṃ kuryātprayatnena sarvapāpanivṛttaye \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. In order to dispel all sins he should assiduously perform the Ноmа once, twice or thrice, according to his capacity.

## \|\| 1.18.11 \|\|

*prāyaścittā dikaṃ sarvaṃ svagṛhyoktavidhānataḥ \|*  
*samāpya homaṃ vidhivacchāntisūktaṃ japedrudhaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. After completing the Ноmа duly, in accordance with the injunctions laid down in one’s own Grhya sutra including all expiatory rites and other rites, the intelligent person should mutter the Santi sukta.

## \|\| 1.18.12 \|\|

*paścāddevaṃ samāgatya punaḥ pūjāṃ prakalpayet \|*  
*tathopavāsaṃ devāya hyarpayedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Afterwards he should approach the deity and perform the worship again. With piety, he should dedicate the observance of the fast unto the Lord.

## \|\| 1.18.13 \|\|

*paurṇamāsyāṃ nirāhāraḥ sthitvā deva tavājñayā \|*  
*bhokṣyāmi puṇḍarīkākṣa pare 'hli śaraṇaṃ bhava \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Observing fast on the full moon day, he should pray “O Lotus-eyed God, I shall partake of food, the next day. Be pleased to be my refuge.”

## \|\| 1.18.14 \|\|

*iti vijñāpya devāyahyarghyaṃ dadyāttathaindave \|*  
*jānubhyāmavanīṃ gagatvā śuklapuṣpākṣatānvitaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. After submitting thus to the Lord, the devotee should take white flowers and raw rice grains in his hand, kneel on the ground and offer Arghya to the Moon.

## \|\| 1.18.15-16 \|\|

*kṣīrodārṇavasaṃbhūta aghatrigotrasamudbhaghava \|*  
*grahāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ rohiṇīnāyaka prabho \|*  
*evamarghyaṃ pradāyendoḥ prārthayetprāñjalistataḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*tiṣṭanpūrvamukho bhūtvā paśyanninduṃ ca nārada \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. “O lord of Rohini, born in the family of Atri, and in the milk ocean (as well), (kindly) accept the Arghya offered by me, О Lord.” After offering Arghya thus to the moon, he should stand facing the east. Looking at the moon with palms joined in reverence, he should pray thus.

## \|\| 1.18.17 \|\|

*namaḥ śuklāṃśave tubhyaṃ dvijarājāya te namaḥ \|*  
*rohiṇīpataye tubhyaṃ lakṣmībhrātre namo 'stu te \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. “Obeisance to you, of white rays; salutations to you to the lord of the stars, and to the lord of Rohini; obeisance be to you, to the brother of Laksmi.”

## \|\| 1.18.18 \|\|

*tataśca jāgaraṃ kuryātpurāṇaśravaṇādibhiḥ \|*  
*jitendriyaśca saṃśuddhaḥ pāṣaṇḍālokavarjitaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Thereafter, he should keep awake during the night by listening to the Puranas and other pious activities. He should control his sense-organs and be pure. He should avoid the very sight of heretics.

## \|\| 1.18.19 \|\|

*tataḥ prātaḥ prakurvīta svācāraṃ ca yathāvidhi \|*  
*punaḥ saṃpūjayeddevaṃ yathāvibhavavistaram \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Thereafter, he should perform the routine and conventional duties in the morning, in accordance with the prescribed injunctions. Again he should perform the worship of the Lord befitting the extent of his riches.

## \|\| 1.18.20 \|\|

*brāhmaṇānbhojayecchaktyā tataśca prayato naraḥ \|*  
*bandhubhṛtyādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. He should feed the Brahmanas according to his capacity. With purity and restrained speech (silence), the man should take food along with kinsmen and servants as well as others.

## \|\| 1.18.21 \|\|

*evaṃ pauṣādimāseṣu pūrṇamāsyāmupoṣitaḥ \|*  
*arcayedbhaktisaṃyukto nārāyaṇamanāyamam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. In the same manner, he should observe fast on the full moon days of Pausa and other months and with due devotion should worship the infallible Lord Narayana.

## \|\| 1.18.22 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā kārtikyāṃ pūrṇimādine \|*  
*udyāpanaṃ prakurvīta tadvidhānaṃ vadāmi te \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Performing thus for one year, he should perform the ritualistic concluding ceremony on the full moon day in the month of Karttika. I shall tell you the procedure for the same.

## \|\| 1.18.23 \|\|

*maṇḍapaṃ kārayeddivyaṃ caturastraṃ sumaṅgalam \|*  
*śobhitaṃ puṣpamālābhirvitānadhvajarājitam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. He should construct an exquisite pavilion (Mandapa) extremely auspicious in nature and square in shape, beautified with flower garlands and shining with a canopy and a row of banners.

## \|\| 1.18.24 \|\|

*bahudāpasamākīrṇaṃ kiṅkiṇījālaśobhitam \|*  
*darpaṃṇaiścāmaraiścaiva kalaśaiśca samāvṛtam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Many lamps and tinkling bells should brighten its splendour. It should be decorated on all sides with mirrors, chowries and water-pots all round.

## \|\| 1.18.25 \|\|

*tanmadhye sarvatobhadraṃ pañcavarṇavirājitam \|*  
*jalapūrṇaṃ tataḥ kumbhaṃ nyasettasyopari dvija \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. О Brahmana, in the middle, there should be a Sarvato-Bhadra shining with five colours. Thereon the devotee should place a jar full of water.

## \|\| 1.18.26 \|\|

*pidhāya kumbhaṃ vastreṇa susūkṣmeṇāti śobhitam \|*  
*henmā vā rajatenāpi tathā tānmeṇa vā dvija \|*  
*lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ kṛtvā tasyopari nyaset \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The jar should be covered with a cloth of very fine texture. О Brahmana, an image of lord Laksmi-Narayana should be made in gold, silver or copper and placed over it.

## \|\| 1.18.27-28 \|\|

*pañcāmṛtena saṃsnāpyābhyarcyagandhādibhiḥ kramāt \|*  
*bhakṣmairbhojyādinaivedyairbhaktitaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*jāgaraṃ ca tathā kuryārtsamyakchraraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|*  
*pare 'hni prātarvidhiva tpūrvavadviṣṇumarcayet \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. The image should be bathed in Panchamrta and worshipped in the serial order, by scents, etc., and food offerings of various kinds. With due devotion and restraint over the sense- organs, he should keep awake during the night with due faith. On the morning of the next day, he should worship Visnu as per procedure prescribed for it.

## \|\| 1.18.29 \|\|

*ācāryāya pradātavyā pratimā dakṣaghiṇānvitā \|*  
*brāhmaṇānbhojayecchaktyā vibhave satyavāritam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The image should be presented to the preceptor accompanied by the usual Daksina. He should feed the Brahmanas in accordance with his capacity. If one is affluent enough one should feed the Brahmanas unobstructedly without any restriction on their number.

## \|\| 1.18.30 \|\|

*tiladānaṃ prakurvīta yathāśaktyā samāhitaḥ \|*  
*kuryādrangau ca vidhivatilahomaṃ vicakṣiṇaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. With proper attention and purity of mind, he should perform the Dana of sesamum seeds befitting his capacity. The clever devotee should perform Ноmа rites in the fire duly, with sesamum seeds.

## \|\| 1.18.31-32 \|\|

*evaṃ kṛtvā naraḥ samyak lakṣmīnārāyaṇavratam \|*  
*iha bhuktvā mahābhogānputraghapautraghasamanvitaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ kulāyutasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*prayāti viṣṇubhavanaṃ yogināmapi durlabham \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. If a man performs this holy vow — vrata properly, he will enjoy all pleasures here in the company of his sons, and grandsons. He will be liberated from his sins. Accompanied by ten thousand members of his family, he will go to Visnu’s abode, difficult of access even to the Yogins.

## Chapter 19. The Vrata of Installation of the Banner

## \|\| 1.19.1 \|\|

*sanaka uvāca*  
*anyadvūtaṃ pravakṣyāmi dhvajāropaṇasaṃjñitam \|*  
*sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ viṣṇuprīṇanakāraṇam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*Sanaka said:*

1\. “I shall expound to you another holy Vrata which dispels all sins and causes delight to Visnu. It is named Dhvajaropana (installation of the banner).

## \|\| 1.19.2 \|\|

*yaḥ kuryādviṣṇubhavane dhvajāropaṇamuttamam \|*  
*saṃpūjyate vigniñcyādyaiḥ kimanyairbahubhāṣitaiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. He who installs an excellent banner on the temple of Visnu is honoured by Brahma and others. What more need be spoken (in praise of it)?

## \|\| 1.19.3 \|\|

*hemabhārasahasraṃ tu yo dadāti kuṭumbine \|*  
*tatphalaṃ tulyamātraṃ syāddhūjāropaṇakarmaṇaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The gift of a thousand Bharas of gold to a man burdened with a large family is but equal in benefit to the rite of installation of the banner.

## \|\| 1.19.4 \|\|

*dhvajāropaṇatulyaṃ syādgaṅgāsnānamanuttamam \|*  
*athavā tulasūsevā śivaliṅgaprapūjanam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The excellent ablution in the Ganga or the service unto the Tulasi plant or the adoration of Siva-Linga is on a par with the installation of the banner.

## \|\| 1.19.5 \|\|

*aho 'pūrvamaho 'pūrvamaho 'pūrvamidaṃ dvija \|*  
*sarvapāpa haraṃ karma dhvajāgopaṇasaṃjñitam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. О Brahmana, unprecedented it is! Rare and unequalled it is! It is unprecedented! It is a rite that dispels all sins, the rite called Dhvajaropana.

## \|\| 1.19.6 \|\|

*santi vai yāni kāryāṇi dhvajāropaṇakarmaṇi \|*  
*tāni sarvāṇi vakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva gadato mama \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. I shall describe all those rites ancillary to the installation of the banner. Even as I recount it, listen.

## \|\| 1.19.7 \|\|

*kārtikasya site pakṣaghe daśamyāṃ prayato naraḥ \|*  
*snānaṃ kuryātprayatnena dantadhāvanapūrvakam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. On the Dasami (tenth) day in the bright half of the month of Karttika, a man in complete self-restraint, should assiduously perform the rite of ablution beginning with the cleaning of his teeth.

## \|\| 1.19.8 \|\|

*ekāśī brahmacārī ca svapennārāyaṇaṃ smaran \|*  
*dhautāmbaradharaḥ śuddho vipro nārāyaṇāgrataḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The Brahmana devotee should take food only once. He should observe the vow of celibacy. Remembering the lord Narayana, he shall sleep in front of the deity. He should be pure and be clad in white robes.

## \|\| 1.19.9 \|\|

*tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya snātvācamya yathāvidhi \|*  
*nityakarmāṇi nirvartya paścādviṣṇuṃ samarcayet \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. He should get up early in the morning and perform the rites of Acamana and ablution duly. After finishing the daily routine of prescribed duties, he should worship Visnu.

## \|\| 1.19.10 \|\|

*caturbhirbrāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhdaṃ kṛtvā ca svastivācanam \|*  
*nāndīśrāddhaṃ prakurvīta dhvajāropaṇakarmaṇi \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Causing the Svastivacana (the utterance of benediction) along with four Brahmanas, the devotee should perform the Nandi Sraddha (Sraddha, preliminary to Samskaras and festive occasions) in the holy rite of the installation of the banner.

## \|\| 1.19.11 \|\|

*dhvajastambho ca gāyatryā prokṣaghayedvastrasaṃyutau \|*  
*sūryaṃ ca vainateyaṃ ca himāṃśuṃ tatparor'cayet \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Repeating the Gayatri, he should sprinkle the banner and the flag-staff along with the cloth. Devoted to them, he should worship the sun, moon and Vainateya (Garuda).

## \|\| 1.19.12 \|\|

*dhātāraṃ ca vidhātāraṃ pūjayeddhajadaṇḍake \|*  
*haridrākṣaghatagandhādyaiḥ śuklapuṣpairviśeṣataḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. He should worship Dhatr and Vidhatr (gods Visnu arid Brahma) on the staff of the flag, with turmeric, raw rice grains, scents and other things and particularly with white flowers.

## \|\| 1.19.13 \|\|

*tato gocarmamātraghaṃ tu sthaṇḍilaṃ copalipya vai \|*  
*ādhāyāngiṃ svagṛhyottyā hyājyabhāgādikaṃ kramāt \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Thereafter, he should get a small plot measuring a Gocarman (scrubbed, cleaned and smeared well. The sacrificial fire should be placed there. One should oblate ghee and other things in the prescribed order in accordance with the injunctions in one’s own Grhya Sutra.

## \|\| 1.19.14-15 \|\|

*juhuyātpāyasaṃ caiva sājyamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam \|*  
*prathamaṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ viṣṇornukamirāvatīm \|\| 14 \|\|*

*tataśca vainateyāya svāhe tyaṣṭāhutīstathā \|*  
*somo dhenumudutyaṃ ca juhuyācca tato dvija \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. He should offer a hundred and eight oblations of milk pudding and ghee in the homa. At the outset, the Рurusа Sukta (RV.X.90) is repeated, then the Sukta Visnornu kam (RV.1.154) etc. and then The Iravati (RV.VII.99) (should be repeated). Thereafter, he should give eight Ahutis (in the fire) saying Vainateyaya svahd. Thereafter, О Brahmana the Suktas Somo Dhenum (RV.I.91.20) and U du tyam (RV.I.50.1) should be repeated and oblations be offered.

## \|\| 1.19.16 \|\|

*sauramantrāñjapettaghatra śāntisūtkāni śaktitaḥ \|*  
*rātraghau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādupakaṇṭhaṃ hareḥ śucuḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. There, he should repeat the sukta pertaining to the Sun (viz. RV.I.50) and the Santi Suktas in accordance with one’s capacity. With purity, he should keep awake during the night in the vicinity of Hari.

## \|\| 1.19.17 \|\|

*tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya nityakarma samāpya ca \|*  
*gandhapuṣpādibhirdevamarcayetpūrvavatkramāt \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Thereafter, he should get up early in the morning and complete the daily routine activities. As before, he should worship the Lord with scents, sweet smelling flowers and other things in due order.

## \|\| 1.19.18 \|\|

*tato maṅgalavādyaiśca sūktapāṭhaiśca śaubhanam \|*  
*nṛtyaiśca ratotraghapaṭhanairnayedviṣṇavālaye dhvajam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Thereafter, the splendid auspicious flag should be taken to the shrine of Visnu, to the accompaniment of auspicious musical instruments, chanting of the Suktas, dances and singing of hymns.

## \|\| 1.19.19 \|\|

*devasya dvāradeśe vā śikhare vā mudānvitaḥ \|*  
*susthuraḥ sthāpayedvipra dhvajaṃ sastambhasaṃyutam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. О Brahmana, the joyous devotee should firmly plant the flagstaff (with the hoisted flag) either at the entrance to the shrine of the Lord or on the top of it.

## \|\| 1.19.20 \|\|

*gandhapuṣpāghakṣatairddevaṃ dhūpadīparmanoharaiḥ \|*  
*bhakṣaghyabhojyādisaṃyuktairnaivedyaiśca hariṃ yajet \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Then, he should worship Lord Hari with scents, flowers, raw rice grains, charming incense and lamps and Naivedya offerings consisting of various dishes.

## \|\| 1.19.21 \|\|

*evaṃ devālaye sthāpya śobhanaṃ dhvajamuttamam \|*  
*pradakṣaghiṇamanuvrajya stotraghametadudūrayet \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. After installing the excellent and splendid banner in the temple, he should circumambulate it and chant this song of prayer.

## \|\| 1.19.22 \|\|

*namaste puṇḍarīkākṣa namaste viśvabhāvana \|*  
*namaste 'stu hṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣa pūrvaja \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. “Obeisance to you, О Lotus-eyed Lord, the Conceiver and creator of the Universe; О Hrsikesa, salutations to you, О earliest-born great Purusa.

## \|\| 1.19.23 \|\|

*yenedamakhilaṃ jātaṃ yatra sarvaṃ pratiṣṭitam \|*  
*layameṣyati yatraivaṃ taṃ prapanno 'smi keśavam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. I resort to Kesava by whom all this universe has been created, in whom everything is established and in whom the universe will get dissolved.

## \|\| 1.19.24 \|\|

*na jānanti paraṃ bhāvaṃ yasya brahmādayaḥ surāḥ \|*  
*yoginoyaṃ na paśyanti taṃ vandaṃ jñānarupuṇam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. I salute that Lord, the embodiment of perfect knowledge, whose supreme nature even Brahma and other gods do not know and whom even the Yogins do not perceive.

## \|\| 1.19.25 \|\|

*antarikṣantu yannābhirdyairmūrddhā yasya caiva hi \|*  
*pādo 'bhūdyasya pṛthivī taṃ vande viśvarupiṇam \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. I salute that Lord whose form consists of the entire universe, whose umbilical region is the firmament, whose head is the heaven and whose feet are the Earth.

## \|\| 1.19.26 \|\|

*yasya śrotre diśaḥ sarvā yaccakṣurdinakṛcajchaśī \|*  
*ṛksāmayajupī yena taṃ vande brahrarupiṇam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. I salute that Lord who is Brahma incarnate whose ears are all the quarters, whose eyes are the sun and the moon, and by whom the mantras of Rk, Saman and Yajus have been uttered.

## \|\| 1.19.27 \|\|

*yanmukhādvāhmaṇā jātā yadvāhorabhavannṛpāḥ \|*  
*vaiśyā yasyo ruto jātāḥ padbhaghyāṃ śūdro vyajāyata \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. I salute that Lord from whose mouth the Brahmanas originated, from whose arms the kings came forth, from whose thighs the Vaisyas were born and from whose feet were born the audras.

## \|\| 1.19.28 \|\|

*māyāsaṅgamamātragheṇa vadanti puruṣaṃ tvajam \|*  
*svabhāvavimalaṃ śuddhaṃ nirvikāraṃ nirañjanam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. I salute that unborn Lord whom they call Purusa only on account of the contact with Maya, but who is naturally free from impurities, who is pure, who is free from modifications or change and is unsullied.

## \|\| 1.19.29 \|\|

*kṣīrabdhi śāyinaṃ devamanantamaparājitam \|*  
*sadbhaktavatsalaṃ viṣṇuṃ bhaktigamyaṃ namāmyaham \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. I salute that god Visnu who reposes in the milk-ocean, who is the infinite and unvanquished Lord, and is favourably disposed towards good devotees and who is attainable only through devotion.

## \|\| 1.19.30 \|\|

*pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni tanmātrāṇīṃndriyāṇi ca \|*  
*sūkṣmāsūkṣyāṇi yenāsaṃstaṃ vande sarvatomukham \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. I salute that omnifaced Lord from whom originated the earth and other elements, the Tanmatras, the sense-organs and both the subtle and gross substances.

## \|\| 1.19.31 \|\|

*yadvahya paramaṃ dhāma sarvalokottamottamam \|*  
*nirguṇaṃ paramaṃ sūkṣmaṃ praṇato 'sti punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Again and again I bow unto that attributeless, subtle supreme being which is the Brahman, the highest resort that is the supreme-most and the most excellent in all the worlds.

## \|\| 1.19.32 \|\|

*avikāramajaṃ śuddhaṃ sarvatobāhumīśvaram \|.*  
*yamāmananti yogāndrāḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. I bow down to that unborn pure Lord who is not subject to modification or change and who has arms all round and whom the leading Yogins consider the cause of the cause of all.

## \|\| 1.19.33 \|\|

*yo devaḥ sarvabhūtānāmantarātmā jaganmayaḥ \|*  
*nirguṇaḥ paramātmā ca sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. May that Visnu be propitiated unto me — Lord Visnu who is the immanent soul in all living beings, who is identical with the universe, and who is the attributeless great Atman.

## \|\| 1.19.34 \|\|

*hṛdayastho 'pi dūrastho māyayā mohitātmanām \|*  
*jñānināṃ sarvago yastu sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. May that Visnu be pleased with me — the Lord who though stationed within the heart, is yet staying far off to those whose Atmans had been deluded by Maya but who is omnipresent to persons endowed with spiritual knowledge.

## \|\| 1.19.35 \|\|

*caturbhiśca caturbhiśca dvābhyāṃ pañcabhireva ca \|*  
*hūyate ca punardvātārthaṃbhyāṃ sa me viṣṇuḥ pratīdatu \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. May that Visnu be pleased with me, Visnu, the Lord whose homa is performed by set of four, set of four, with a set of two, set of five and again by a set of two.

## \|\| 1.19.36 \|\|

*jñānināṃ karmiṇāṃ caiva tathā bhaktimatāṃ nṛṇām \|*  
*gatidātā viśvamṛgyaḥ sa me viṣṇuḥ prasūdatu \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. May that Visnu be pleased with me, the lord who is the bestower of salvation to those men possessing perfect knowledge (i.e. followers of Jnana-yoga), meritorious deeds (performers of Karmas or followers of *karma-marga*) and devotional feelings (followers of the path of devotion) and who is sought by the whole universe.

## \|\| 1.19.37 \|\|

*jagaddhitārthaṃ ye dehā dhriyante līlayā hareḥ \|*  
*tānarcayanti vibudhāḥ sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. May that Visnu be gracious unto me — Lord Visnu whose persons assumed sportively for the well-being of the world, are worshipped by gods.

## \|\| 1.19.38 \|\|

*yamāmanantive santaḥ saccidānandavigraham \|*  
*nirguṇaṃ ca guṇādhāraṃ sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. May that Visnu be propitious unto me — the Lord whom the saintly persons consider to be the embodiment of existence, knowledge and bliss, the attributeless support of the attributes.”

## \|\| 1.19.39 \|\|

*iti stutvā namedviṣṇuṃ brāhmaṇāṃśca prapūjayet \|*  
*ācāryaṃ pūjayetpaścāddakṣiṇācchādanādibhiḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. After eulogising thus, he should bow down to Visnu and worship the Brahmanas richly. Afterwards, he should adore the preceptor with the offerings of religious fees, raiments, etc.

## \|\| 1.19.40-41 \|\|

*brāhmaṇānbhojayecchaktyā bhakti bhāvasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*putramatrikalatrādyaiḥ svayaṃ ca saha bandhubhiḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*kurvīta pāraṇaṃ vipra nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*yastvetatkarma kurvīta dhvajāropaṇamuttamam \|*  
*tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva susamāhitaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. In accordance with his capacity, he should feed the Brahmanas, with devotional feelings. О Brahmana, devoted to Narayana he should perform Parana — the ritualistic break of the fast — along with his sons, friends, wives and other kinsmen. I shall mention the meritorious benefits to the person who performs this excellent rite of Dhvajaropana. Listen with attention.

## \|\| 1.19.42 \|\|

*paṭo dhvajasya viprendra yāvaccalati vāyunā \|*  
*tāvanti pāpajālāni naśyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Undoubtedly, as many accumulations of his sins perish, О leading Brahmana, as thereare flutters in the banner cloth due to the wind.

## \|\| 1.19.43 \|\|

*mahāpātakayukto vā yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ \|*  
*dhvajaṃ viṣṇugṛhe kṛtvā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Whether one is vitiated by great sins or by all kinds of sins, one is absolved of them all by installing a banner in the shrine of Visnu.

## \|\| 1.19.44 \|\|

*yāvaddināni tiṣṭeta dhvajo viṣṇugṛhe dvija \|*  
*tāvadyugasahasrāṇi harisārupyamaśnute \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. О Brahmana, he enjoys Sarupya (similarity of form) with Hari for as many thousands of Yugas as the number of days that the banner stands aloft in Visnu’s abode.

## \|\| 1.19.45 \|\|

*āropitaṃ dhvajaṃ dṛṣṭvā ye 'bhinandanti dhārmikāḥ \|*  
*te 'pi sarve pramucyante mahāpātakakoṭibhiḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. If righteous men take delight and praise on seeing the banner installed, all of them are liberated from crores of great sins.

## \|\| 1.19.46 \|\|

*āropito dhvajo viṣṇugṛhe dhunvanpaṭaṃ svakam \|*  
*kartuḥ sarvāṇi pāpāni dhunoti nimiṣārddhataḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The banner installed in Visnu’s abode shakes off within half wink of eye, the sins of the man who had installed it, even as it flutters its cloth.

## \|\| 1.19.47 \|\|

*yastvā ropya gṛhe viṣṇordhvajaṃ nityamupācaret \|*  
*sa devayānena divaṃ yātīva sumatirnṛpaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. He who installs a banner in the abode of Visnu and looks after it every day, goes to heaven by means of Devayana (the divine path) like king Sumati of good intellect.”

## Chapter 20. The Legend of King Sumati

## \|\| 1.20.1 \|\|

*nārada uvāca*  
*bhagavansarvadharmajña sarvaśāstrārthapāraga \|*  
*sarvakarmavariṣṭaṃ ca tvayoktaṃ dhvajadhāraṇam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*Narada said:*

1\. О holy sir, the knower of all *Dharmas*, the master of all scriptural topics, the most excellent of all holy rites (or observances), the installation of the banner (on Visnu shrines) has been recounted by you.

## \|\| 1.20.2 \|\|

*yastu vai sumatirnāma dhvajāropaparo mune \|*  
*tvayoktastasya caritaṃ vistareṇa mamādiśa \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. О sage, narrate to me in detail, the anecdote of Sumati who is mentioned by you as one devoted to the installation of banners.

## \|\| 1.20.3 \|\|

*sanaka uvāca*  
*śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ puṇyamitihāsaṃ purātanamam \|*  
*brahmaṇā kathitaṃ mahyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*Sanaka said:*

3\. Listen with single-minded attention to this ancient meritorious mythological anecdote that is destructive of all sins. It has been narrated to me by god Brahma.

## \|\| 1.20.4 \|\|

*āsītpurā kṛtayuge sumatirnāma bhūpatiḥ \|*  
*somavaṃśodbhavaḥ śrīmānsatpadvīpaikanāyakaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Formerly, there was a king named Sumati, in the Krta yuga. He was born of the lunar race. He was (then the sole) glorious sovereign ruler of all the seven continents.

## \|\| 1.20.5 \|\|

*dharmātmā satyasaṃpannaḥ śucivaṃśyo 'tithipriyaḥ \|*  
*sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaḥ sarvasaṃpadvibhūṣitaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. A scion of the Lunar race, he was pious-souled, truthful and fond of guests. Endowed with all auspicious characteristics, he was embellished with all kinds of wealth.

## \|\| 1.20.6 \|\|

*sadā harikathāsevī haripūjāparāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*haribhaktiparāṇāṃ ca śuśrūṣurnirahṝṅkṛtiḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. He always resorted to (listening to) the stories of Hari, and was always absorbed in the worship of Hari. Devoid of arrogance, he was eager to render service to those who were absolutely absorbed in devotion to Hari.

## \|\| 1.20.7 \|\|

*pūjyapūjārato nityaṃ samadarśī guṇānvitaḥ \|*  
*sarvabhūtahitaḥ śāntaḥ kṛtajñaḥ kīrtimāṃstathā \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. He was devoted to the worship of those who are worthy of adoration. He was impartial in outlook. He was endowed with all good qualities. He was a benefactor of all living beings, quiescent, grateful and glorious.

## \|\| 1.20.8 \|\|

*tasya bhāryā mahābhāgā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā \|*  
*pativratā patiprāṇā nāmrā satyamatirmune \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. О sage, his wife was a highly blessed lady named Satyamati. She was richly endowed with all auspicious characteristics. She was chaste, and to her, her husband was her very vital breath.

## \|\| 1.20.9 \|\|

*tādubhau dampatū nityaṃ haripūjāparāyaṇau \|*  
*jātismarau mahābhāgau satyajñau satparāyaṇau \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. That couple were always engaged in the adoration of Hari. Those highly blessed persons could remember their previous births. Knowers of the truth as they were, they were absorbed in what was Reality.

## \|\| 1.20.10 \|\|

*annadānaratau nityaṃ jaladānaparāyaṇau \|*  
*taḍāgārāmavaprādau nasaṃkhyātānvitenatuḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. They were always engaged in offering charitable gift of food and cool water. They built and dug innumerable bunds, tanks and parks.

## \|\| 1.20.11 \|\|

*sā tu satyamatirnityaṃ śucirviṣṇugṛhe satī \|*  
*nṛtyatyatyantasantuṣṭā manojñā sañjuvādinī \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The pure and chaste lady Satyamati, the charming, sweet-voiced queen used to dance delightedly in the temple of Visnu.

## \|\| 1.20.12 \|\|

*so 'pi rājā mahābhāgo dvādaśīddhādaśīdine \|*  
*dhvajamāropayatyeva manojñaṃ bahuvistaram \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. On every Dvadasi day, the highly blessed king also used to instal a wide and charming banner (on the shrine of Visnu).

## \|\| 1.20.13 \|\|

*evaṃ hariparaṃ nityaṃ rājānaṃ dharmakovidam \|*  
*primāṃ matyamatiṃ cāmya devā api sadāstuvan \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Even the Devas always eulogised the king who was perpetually devoted to Hari, and was an expert in Dharmas, and his beloved queen Satyamati.

## \|\| 1.20.14 \|\|

*triloke viśrutau jñātvā dampatī dharmako vidau \|*  
*āyayau bahubhiḥ śipyairdraṣṭukāmo vibhāṇḍakaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. On coming to know that the couple were well-known in the three worlds as adepts in Dharmas, sage Vibhandaka who was desirous of seeing them, came there along with a number of disciples.

## \|\| 1.20.15 \|\|

*tamāyāntaṃ muniṃ śrutvā sa tu rājā vibhāṇḍakam \|*  
*pratyudyayau sapatnīkaḥ prajā bhirbahuvistaram \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. On hearing that the sage was coming, the king accompanied by his wife, went out to greet the sage Vibhandaka with extensive material of honouring the guru.

## \|\| 1.20.16 \|\|

*kṛtātithyakriyaṃ śāntaṃ kṛtāsanaparigraham \|*  
*nīcāsanasthito bhūyaḥ prāñjalirmunimabravīt \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. When the rites of hospitable reception had been completed and when the sage had taken his seat, the king, seated on a lower seat, spoke to the quiescent sage with palms joined in reverence.

## \|\| 1.20.17 \|\|

*rājovāca*  
*bhagavankṛtakṛtyo 'smiṃ tvadabhyāgamanena veṃ \|*  
*satāmāyamanaṃ santaṃ praśaṃsanti suravāvaham \|\| 17 \|\|*

*The King said:*

17\. О holy sir, I feel satisfied by your visit. Good men praise the arrival of saintly persons as pleasing.

## \|\| 1.20.18 \|\|

*yatra syānmahatāṃ prema tatra syuḥ sarvasampadaḥ \|*  
*tejaḥ kīrtirdhanaṃ putrā iti prahurvipaścitaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Learned men say that all riches are where great men offer their affection. Brilliance, renown, wealth and progeny also do abide there.

## \|\| 1.20.19 \|\|

*tatra vṛddhimupāyānti theyāṃsyanudinaṃ mune \|*  
*yatra santaḥ prakurvanti mahatīṃ karuṇāṃ prabho \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. О holy lord, О sage, all good fortunes and welfare flourish day by day where good men bestow their great mercy.

## \|\| 1.20.20 \|\|

*yo mṛrdhni dhāgyedūhyanmahatpādajalaṃ rajaḥ \|*  
*sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu puṇyātmā nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. There is no doubt in this that he who wears on his head the dust and the water that has washed the feet of great men is a meritorious soul. He has the benefit of having bathed in all sacred rivers, О Brahmana.

## \|\| 1.20.21 \|\|

*mama putrāśca dārāśca saṃpattvayi samarpitāḥ \|*  
*māmājñāpaya viprendra kiṃ priyaṃ karavāṇi te \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. О leading Brahmana, my sons, my wife, my riches — all these are dedicated to you. Kindly command me what shall I do, by way of pleasing you?

## \|\| 1.20.22 \|\|

*vinañcavanataṃ bhūpaṃ sa nirīkṣya munīśaavaraḥ \|*  
*spṛśaṣankareṇa taṃ prītyuvācātiharṣitaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. On seeing the king full of modesty, the leading sage was much delighted. Lovingly he stroked him with his hand and said as follows:

## \|\| 1.20.23 \|\|

*ṛṣiruvāca*  
*gajanyaduktaṃ bhavatā tatsarvaṃ tvatkulocitam \|*  
*vinayāvanataḥ sarvo bahuśreyo labhediha \|\| 23 \|\|*

*The sage said:*

23\. О king, what has been said by you is fully befitting your family. Eveiy one who bows down with humility, attains great wealth.

## \|\| 1.20.24 \|\|

*dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca mokṣaśca nṛpasattama \|*  
*vinayāllabhate martyo durlabhaṃ kiṃ mahātmanām \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. О excellent king, it is due to humility, that a man obtains virtue, wealth, love and liberation (i.e. all the four Purusarthas). What is it that is difficult to attain in the case of a noble-souled person?

## \|\| 1.20.25 \|\|

*prīto 'smi tava bhāpāla sanmārgaparivarttinaḥ \|*  
*svasti te satataṃ bhūyādyatpṛcchāmi taducyatām \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. О protector of the Earth, I am pleased with you inasmuch as you follow the path of the good. May welfare bless you perpetually. May what I ask you, be very kindly related.

## \|\| 1.20.26 \|\|

*pūjā bahuvidhāḥ santi hastuṣṭividhāyikāḥ \|*  
*tāsu nityaṃ dhvajārope varttse tvaṃ sadodyataḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. There are various types of worship causing satisfaction to Hari. But among them, you abide always by the installation of banners. You are always attempting that alone.

## \|\| 1.20.27 \|\|

*bhāryāpi tava sādhvīyaṃ nityaṃ nṛtyaparāyaṇā \|*  
*kimarthametadvṛttāntaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. This chaste lady, your wife, is always engaged in dancing before the deity. How has this come about? It behoves you to relate it to me precisely.

## \|\| 1.20.28 \|\|

*rājovāca*  
*śṛṇuṣva bhagavansarvaṃ yatpṛcchasi vadāmi tat \|*  
*āścaryabhūtaṃ lokānāmāvayoścaritaṃ tviha \|\| 28 \|\|*

*The king said:*

28\. Listen, О holy sir, I shall tell you everything that you ask. The conduct of life of both of us is surprising and astonishing to all worlds.

## \|\| 1.20.29 \|\|

*ahamāsaṃ purā śūdro mālinirnāma sattama \|*  
*kumārgaganirato nityaṃ sarvalokāhike rataḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. О excellent one, formerly I was a Sudra named Malini. I was always engaged in evil ways. I was absorbed in the acts of injury to all worlds.

## \|\| 1.20.30 \|\|

*piśuno dharmavidveṣī devadravyāpahārakaḥ \|*  
*godhnaśca brahmahā cauraḥ sarvaprāṇivadhe rataḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. I was a slander-monger, a hater of righteousness. I used to plunder the wealth of deities (in shrines), and to kill cows and Brahmanas — nay — all living beings. I was a thief (also).

## \|\| 1.20.31 \|\|

*nityaṃ niṣṭhuravaktā ca pāpī veśyāparāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ sthitaḥ kiyatkālamanāhatyaṃ mahadṛcaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. I was always harsh in speech and a sinner devoted to the dalliance with prostitutes. Thus I continued for sometime, disregarding the words of the great.

## \|\| 1.20.32 \|\|

*sarvabandhuparityakto duḥkhī vanamupāgataḥ \|*  
*mṛgamāṃsāśano nityaṃ tathā pānthāvillampakaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Later on, I was abandoned by my kinsmen. In misery I went to a forest subsisting myself on the perpetual diet of venison and other flesh. I used to rob the way-farers.

## \|\| 1.20.33 \|\|

*ekākī duḥkhabahulo nyavasannirjane vane \|*  
*ekadā kṣutpariśrānto nidāghārttaḥ pipāsitaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Isolated and extremely miserable, I stayed there in the tenantless forest. Once I was extremely oppressed by the heat of the summer. I was utterly famished with hunger. I was thirsty.

## \|\| 1.20.34 \|\|

*jīrṇaṃ devālayaṃ viṣṇorapaśyaṃ vijane vane \|*  
*haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaṃ tatsamīpe mahatsaraḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. In the lonely forest, I saw a ruined dilapidated temple of Visnu. There was a great lake near it, teeming with swans and ducks called Karandava.

## \|\| 1.20.35 \|\|

*paryantavanapuṣpaughacchāditaṃ tanmunīśvara \|*  
*apibaṃ tatra pānīyaṃ tattīre vigataśramaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. О prominent sage, it was covered with clusters of flowers from the surrounding forest. I drank water therefrom. On its banks, I alleviated my tedium.

## \|\| 1.20.36 \|\|

*phalāni jagdhvā śīrṇāni svayaṃ kṣucca nivāritā \|*  
*tasmiñjīrṇīlaye viṣṇonarnivāsaṃ kṛtakavānaham \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. By eating fruits scattered here and there, my hunger was satiated. I resided in that dilapidated temple of Visnu.

## \|\| 1.20.37 \|\|

*jīrṇasphuṭitasaṃdhānaṃ tasya nityamakāriṣam \|*  
*parṇaistṛṇaiśca kāṣṭhaighair gṛhaṃ samyak prakalpitam \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Every day, I repaired the decaying ruined place, join- ing together the broken parts. With leaves, grasses and assemblages of twigs and wood, an abode (a shrine of the god) was duly erected.

## \|\| 1.20.38-39 \|\|

*svasurārāthaṃ tu tadbhamirmayā litpā munīśvara \|*  
*tatrāhaṃ vyādhavṛttistho hatvā bahuvidhānmṛgān \|\| 38 \|\|*

*ājīvaṃ vartaya nnityaṃ varṣāṇāṃ viṃśatiḥ sthitaḥ \|*  
*atheyamāgatā sādhvī vindhyadeśasamudbhavā \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. О leading sage, to increase my own happiness and comfort, the whole area was scrubbed and smeared well by me. Killing various kinds of animals and maintaining the practice of hunters, I maintained my livelihood, for full twenty years there. Then came this chaste lady hailing from the lands adjoining the Vindhya mountains.

## \|\| 1.20.40 \|\|

*niṣādakulajā viprā nānmā khyātā/ñavakokilā \|*  
*bandhuvargaparityaktā duḥkhitā jīrṇavigrahā \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. О Brahmana, she was born of the family of Nisadas (hunters). She was known by the name Avakokila. She too had been abandoned by her kinsmen. She was very miserable with shattered body.

## \|\| 1.20.41 \|\|

*kṣuttṛḍgharmapariśrāntā śocantī svakṛtaṃ hyagham \|*  
*daivayogākatsamāyātābhramantī vijane vane \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. She was overwhelmed with fatigue. She repented for the sins committed by herself. Wandering in the lonely forest, it was only by chance that she came there.

## \|\| 1.20.42 \|\|

*grīṣmatāpārdditā bāhye svānte cādhinipūḍitā \|*  
*imāṃ duḥkhārditāṃ dṛṣṭvā jātā me vipulā dayā \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Externally she had been oppressed by the summer heat. Internally she was afflicted with worries and anxieties. On seeing her affected by miseries, great sympathy surged in me.

## \|\| 1.20.43 \|\|

*dattaṃ mayā jalaṃ cāsyai māṃsaṃ vanyaphalāni ca \|*  
*gataśramātviyaṃ brahmanmayā pṛṣṭā yathā tayam \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Water, wild fruits and raw flesh were given to her by me. О Brahmana, when her exhaustion subsided, she was asked by me as to the real state of affairs.

## \|\| 1.20.44 \|\|

*avedayatsvavṛttāntaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva mahāmune \|*  
*nānmāvakokilā cāhaṃ niṣādakulasabhbhavā \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. She told me about her history. О great sage, listen to that; (She said:) “I am born of a Nisada family and (am known) by the name Avakokila.

## \|\| 1.20.45-46 \|\|

*dārukasya sutā cāhaṃ vindhyaparvatavāsinī \|*  
*parasvahāriṇī nityaṃ sadā paiśunyavādinī \|\| 45 \|\|*

*puṃścalūtyevamuktvā tu bandhuvargaiḥ samujjhitā \|*  
*kiyatkālaṃ tataḥ patyā bhṛtāhaṃ lokaninditā \|\| 46 \|\|*

45-46. I am the daughter of Daruka. I was a resident of the Vindliya mountains. I was forsaken by my kinsmen condemning me — “She is an unchaste woman. She always loots wealth and assets of others. She is a perpetual back-biter.”. Though censured by the world, I was maintained by my husband for some time.

## \|\| 1.20.47 \|\|

*daivātso 'pi gato lokaṃ yamasyātra vihāya mām \|*  
*kāntāre vijane caikā bhramantī duḥkhapīḍitā \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Unfortunately, he too went to the world of Yama, leaving me here. In the lonely forest, I am roaming about alone and am afflicted by misery.

## \|\| 1.20.48 \|\|

*daivāttvatsavidhaṃ prātpā jīvitāhaṃ tvayādhunā \|*  
*ityevaṃ svakṛtaṃ karma mahyaṃ sarvaṃ nyavedayat \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. By chance, I have come near you. I have been brought back to life by you now. Thus, she recounted to me all of her activities.

## \|\| 1.20.49 \|\|

*tato devālaye tasmindamapatībhāvamāśritau \|*  
*sthitau varṣāṇi daśa ca āvāṃ māṃsaphalāśinau \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Thereafter, for ten years, we two stayed in that temple as husband and wife, with flesh and fruits constituting our diet.

## \|\| 1.20.50-51 \|\|

*ekadā madyapānena pramattau nirbharaimune \|*  
*tatra devālaye rāghatrau muditau māṃsabhojanāt \|\| 50 \|\|*

*tanuvastrāparijñānau nṛtyaṃ cakṛva mohitau \|*  
*prārabdhakarma bhogāntamāvāṃ yugapadāgatau \|\| 51 \|\|*

50-51. Once, О sage, we became much intoxicated due to the drinking of wine. At night, there in the temple, we were so overjoyed by eating meat that we began to dance, utterly deluded and (blissfully) unconscious of our bodies and garments. At that time, the last stage of our experiencing the fruits of our past acts, the activities that had begun to bear fruits, befell us both at the same time.

## \|\| 1.20.52 \|\|

*yamadūtāstadāyātāḥ pāśahastā bhayaṅkarāḥ \|*  
*netumāvāṃ nṛtyaratau sudhorāṃ yamayātanām \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Even as we were absorbed in our dance, the terrible emissaries of Yama came there, armed with their nooses in order to take us to the terrible torturesome hell of Yama.

## \|\| 1.20.53-57 \|\|

*tataḥ prasanno bhagavānkarmaṇā mama mānada \|*  
*devāvasathasaṃskārasaṃjñitena kṛtena naḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*svadūtānprepayāmāsa svabhaktāvanatatparaḥ \|*  
*te dūtā devadevasya śaṅkhacakra gadādharāḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*sahasrasūryāsaṃkāśāḥ sarve cārucaturbhujāḥ \|*  
*kirīṭakuṇḍaladharā hāriṇo vanamālinaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

*diśo vitimirā vipra kurvantaḥ svena tejasā \|*  
*bhayaṅkarānyāśahastāndaṃṣṭriṇo yamakiṅkarān \|\| 56 \|\|*

*āvayogrāhaṇe yattānṛcuḥ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇāḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

53-54a. О bestower of honour, thereafter, the Lord who was pleased with our services, namely the scrubbing and cleaning of the lord’s abode, and who was always interested in protecting his own devotees, sent his angels.

54b-56a. Each of those emissaries of the Lord of Devas wielded a conch, a discus and a mace (in their hands). All of them resembled a thousand suns in refulgence. All of them had four splendid arms. Wearing crowns, ear-rings necklaces and garlands of sylvan flowers, they made all the quarters free from darkness by means of their lustre, О Brahmana.

56b-57. The followers of Krsna spoke to the servants of Yama who were terrible with their curved fangs, had nooses in their arms and were attempting to capture us.

## \|\| 1.20.58 \|\|

*viṣṇudūtā ūcuḥ*  
*bho bho krūrā dūrācārā vivekaparivarjitāḥ \|*  
*muñcadhvametau niṣpāpau dampatī harivallabhau \|\| 58 \|\|*

*Visnu's Emissaries said:*

58\. О ruthless ones, О wicked ones devoid of discrimination, leave off the sinless couple who are beloved of Hari.

## \|\| 1.20.59-60 \|\|

*vivekastriṣu lokeṣu saṃpadāmādikāraṇam \|*  
*apāpe pāpadhīryastu taṃ vidyātpuruṣādhamam \|\| 59 \|\|*

*pāpe tvapāpadhīryastu taṃ vidyādadhamādhamam \|\| 60 \|\|*

59-60. In the three worlds, it is discrimination that is the first cause of riches and prosperity. Know him to be the meanest of person, who regards a non-sinner to be sinner. Know that person to be the meanest of the mean, that person who considers a sinner to be a non-sinner.

## \|\| 1.20.61 \|\|

*yamadūtā ūcuḥ*  
*yuṣmābhiḥ satyamevoktaṃ kiṃ tvetau pāpisattamau \|*  
*yamena pāpino daṇḍyāstanneṣyāmo vayaṃ tvimau \|\| 61 \|\|*

*Yama's Emissaries replied:*

61\. Truth has been mentioned by you all. But these two are the most notorious among sinners. Sinners must be punished by Yama. Hence, we shall take them away.

## \|\| 1.20.62 \|\|

*śrutipraṇihito dharmo hyadharmastadviparyayaḥ \|*  
*dharmādharmaviveko 'yaṃ tanneṣyāmo yamāntikam \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. That which has been enjoined in the Srutis is the Dharma. Adharma is the opposite of the same. This is the way to distinguish between Dharma and Adharma. Hence, we will take them to Yama’s presence.

## \|\| 1.20.63 \|\|

*etactchuvātikupitā viṣṇudūtā mahaujasaḥ \|*  
*pratyūcūstānyamabhaṭānadharme dharmamāninaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. On hearing this, the exceedingly powerful emissaries of Visnu became infuriated. They spoke in reply to the soldiers of Yama who were considering Adharma to be Dharma.

## \|\| 1.20.64 \|\|

*viṣṇadūtā ūcuḥ*  
*aho kaṣṭaṃ dharmadṛśāmadharmaḥ spṛśate sabhām \|*  
*samyagvivekaśūnyānāṃ nidānaṃ hyāpadāṃ mahat \|\| 64 \|\|*

*Visnu's Emissaries said:*

64\. Alas! It is pitiable that Adharma affects the assembly of the seers of Dharma. The diagnosis of those lacking in discrimination is a great calamity.

## \|\| 1.20.65 \|\|

*tarkāṇādyaviśeṣeṇa narakādhyakṣatāṃ gatāḥ \|*  
*yūyaṃ kimarthamadyāpi karttuṃ pāpāni sodyamāḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. Why do you, who have been reduced to preside over hells, still exert to commit more sins by means of a special argument today?

## \|\| 1.20.66 \|\|

*svakarmakṣayaparyantaṃ mahāpātakino 'pi ca \|*  
*tiṣṭanti narake ghore yāvaccandrārkatārakam \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Even the great sinners remain in the terrible hell till their sins have been exhausted as long as the sun, the moon and the stars shine.

## \|\| 1.20.67 \|\|

*pūrvasaṃcitapāpānāmadṛṣṭvā niṣkṛtiṃ vṛthā \|*  
*kimarthaṃ pāpakarmāṇi kariṣye 'tha punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Without seeing the expiation of sins accumulated before, why do you commit sins again and again?

## \|\| 1.20.68 \|\|

*śrutipraṇihito dharmaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*kintvābhyāṃ caritāndharmānpravakṣyāmo yathātatham \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. What is enjoined in the Srutis is the Dharma. True. Undoubtedly it is true. But we will relate precisely the virtuous acts performed by these two.

## \|\| 1.20.69 \|\|

*etau pāpavinirmuktau hariśuśrūṣaṇe ratau \|*  
*hariṇā trāyamāṇau ca muñcadhvamavilambitam \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. These two are absolved from sins because they were engaged in serving Hari. They are being protected by Hari. Hence, without any more delay leave them off.

## \|\| 1.20.70 \|\|

*eṣā ca nartanaṃ cakre tathaiva dhvajaroṣaṇam \|*  
*antakāle viṣṇugṛhe tena niṣpāpatāṃ gatau \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. At the time of death, she performed a dance (before Lord Visnu) and he installed the banner in the abode of Visnu. Hence, they have attained freedom from sins.

## \|\| 1.20.71 \|\|

*antakāle tu yannāma śrutvoktvāpi ca vai sakṛt \|*  
*labhate paramaṃ sthānaṃ kimu śūśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. Either by bearing or by uttering his name even for once, at the time of death, one attains the greatest abode. What then if one is engaged in service of that Lord?

## \|\| 1.20.72 \|\|

*mahāpātakayukto vā yukto vāpyupapātakaiḥ \|./*  
*kṛṣṇasevī naro 'nte 'pi labhate paramāṃ gatim \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Though he be vitiated with great sins or minor sins, a man who serves Krsna, attains the greatest goal at the end.

## \|\| 1.20.73 \|\|

*yatīnāṃ viṣṇubhaktānāṃ paricaryā parāyaṇāḥ \|*  
*te dūtāḥ sahasā yānti pāpino 'pi parāṃ gatim \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. О messengers, those who are engrossed in the service of ascetics or the devotees of Visnu instantaneously attain the supreme goal, even though they be sinners.

## \|\| 1.20.74 \|\|

*muhurtaṃ vā muhurtārddhaṃ yastiṣṭoddharimandire \|*  
*so 'pi yāti paraṃ sthānaṃ kimudvātraghiṃśavatsarān \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. He who stays in the temple of Hari even for a Muhurta (48 minutes) or half that time, goes to the geatest abode (Vaikuntha). What then of a person who has stayed for thirty-two years?

## \|\| 1.20.75 \|\|

*upalepanakarttārau saṃmārjanaparāyaṇau \|*  
*etau harigṛhe nityaṃ jīrṇaśīrṇādhiropakau \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. These two had been engaged in sweeping and cleaning and smearing in the abode of Hari. They had been looking after its maintenance by repairing the decay and the ruins.

## \|\| 1.20.76 \|\|

*jalasecanakarttārau dīpadau harimandire \|*  
*kathametau mahābhāgau yātanābhogamarhatha \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. They had been sprinkling water and they had lighted lamps in Hari’s abode. How can these blessed ones deserve the experience of tortures in the hell?

## \|\| 1.20.77 \|\|

*ityuktā viṣṇudūtāste cchitvā pāśāṃstadaiva hi \|*  
*āropyāvāṃ vimānāgrayaṃ yayurviṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. After saying this and cutting off our bonds, the emissaries of Visnu took us in an excellent aerial chariot and went to the greatest region of Visnu.

## \|\| 1.20.78 \|\|

*tatra sāmīpyamāpannau devadevasya cakriṇaḥ \|*  
*divyānbhogānbhuktavantau tāvatkālaṃ munīśvara \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. О leading sage, there we attained the Samipya (nearness) of the discus-bearing Lord of Devas. We enjoyed the exquisite divine pleasures throughout that period.

## \|\| 1.20.79 \|\|

*divyānbhogāṃstu tatrāpi bhuktvā yātau mahīmimām \|*  
*atrāpi saṃpadatulā harisevāprasādataḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. After enjoying the divine pleasures there, we came back to this earth. Here also, our wealth is incomparable due to the grace of service to Hari.

## \|\| 1.20.80 \|\|

*anicchayā kṛtenāpi sevanena harermune \|*  
*prātpamīdṛk phalaṃ vipra devānāmapi durlabham \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. О sage through services rendered to Hari without entertaining any special desire for return, such a fruit has been attained which is difficult to access even to Devas, О Brahmana.

## \|\| 1.20.81 \|\|

*icchayārādhya viśveśaṃ bhaktibhāvena mādhavam \|*  
*prāpsyāvaḥ paramaṃ śreya iti heturnirupitaḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. We shall attain the greatest elegance and welfare by propitiating Mahadeva the Lord of the Universe (by offering service for some object) willingly and with devotional feelings. For this purpose, the cause (of our prosperity etc.) is explained.

## \|\| 1.20.82 \|\|

*avaśenāpi yatkarma kṛtaṃ syātsumahatphalam \|*  
*jāyate bhūmidevendra kiṃ punaḥ śraddhayā kṛtam \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. If any holy rite, performed by one due to helplessness, bears great fruit, О leading Brahmana, what doubt is there that a rite performed with faith becomes so?

## \|\| 1.20.83 \|\|

*etaduktaṃ niśamyāsau sa munīndro vibhaṇḍakaḥ \|*  
*praśasya dampatī tau tu prayayau svatapevanam \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. On hearing what has been thus narrated, the leading sage Vibhandaka praised the couple and went back to his penance grove.

## \|\| 1.20.84 \|\|

*tasmājjānīhi devarṣe devadevasya cakriṇaḥ \|*  
*paricaryā tu sarveṣāṃ kāmadhenūpamā smṛtā \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. Hence, О celestial sage, know that the service of the discusbearing lord of Devas is remembered as something comparable to the wish-yielding cow.

## \|\| 1.20.85 \|\|

*haripūjāparāṇāṃ tu harireva sanātanaḥ \|*  
*dadāti paramaṃ śreyaḥ sarvakāmaphalamapradaḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. To those who are devoted to the worship of Hari, it is eternal Hari himself who grants the highest beatitude. He is the bestower of all desired benefits.

## \|\| 1.20.86 \|\|

*ya idaṃ puṇyamākhyānaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam \|*  
*paṭhecca śṛṇuyādvāpi so 'pi yāti parāṃ rātim \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. He who reads or listens to this meritorious narrative that is destructive of all sins, attains the greatest goal.

## Chapter 21. The Panca-ratri-Vrata. The Holy Rite of Five Nights

## \|\| 1.21.1 \|\|

*sanaka uvāca*  
*anyadvūtaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada tattvataḥ \|*  
*durlabhaṃ sarvalokeṣu vikhyātaṃ haripañcakam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*Sanaka said:*

1\. I shall tell you another Vrata which is the excellent- most in all worlds. It is well known as Hari-Panchami. Listen accurately to its essential nature.

## \|\| 1.21.2 \|\|

*nārīṇāṃ ca narāṇāṃ ca sarvaduḥkhanivāraṇam \|*  
*dharmakāmārthamokṣāṇāṃ nidānaṃ munisattama \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. О excellent sage, it is conducive to the removal of all miseries of men and women. It is the primary cause of righteousness, wealth, love and liberation.

## \|\| 1.21.3-4 \|\|

*sarvābhīṣṭapradaṃ caiva sarvavrataphalapradam \|*  
*mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe daśamyāṃ niyatendriyaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*kuryātsnānādikaṃ karma dantadhāvanapūrvakama \|*  
*kṛtvā devārcanaṃ samyaktathā pañca mahādhvarān \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. It is the bestower of all desires and it grants the benefit of all Vratas. On the Dasami (tenth) day in the bright half of the month of Margasirsa, the devotee, keeping under control his sense-organs, should take his bath after brushing his teeth. After performing the worship of the Lord duly, he should perform the five great *Yajnas*.

## \|\| 1.21.5-6 \|\|

*ekāśī ca bhavettasmin dine niyamamāsthitāḥ \|*  
*tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya hyekādaśyāṃ munīśvaraḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*snānaṃ kṛtvā yathācāraṃ hariṃ caivāryadṛhe \|*  
*snāpayeddevadeveśaṃ pañcāmṛtavidhānataḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. On that day he should observe all the rules (of religious discipline) and take food only once. О leading sage, on the Ekadasi (eleventh) day, he should get up early in the morning and take his bath. According to the prescribed manner, he should worship Hari in his abode. He should bathe the Lord the chiefs of Devas, in Pahcamrta duly.

## \|\| 1.21.7 \|\|

*arcayetparayā bhaktyā gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ ṛmāt \|*  
*dhūpairdīpeśca naivaidyaistāmbūlaiśca pradakṣiṇaiḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. With great devotion he should worship him, according to the prescribed order, with scents, fragrant flowers and other things, incense and lamps, food offerings, betel leaves and circumambulations.

## \|\| 1.21.8-13 \|\|

*saṃpūjya devadeveśamimaṃ mantramudīrayet \|.*  
*namaste ghajñānarupāya jñānadāya namo 'stute \|\| 8 \|\|*

*namaste sravaparupāya sarvasiddhipradāyine \|*  
*evaṃ praṇamya deveśaṃ vāsudevaṃ janārjanam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*vakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa hyupavāsaṃ samarpayet \|*  
*pañcarātraṃ nirāhāro hyadyaprabhṛti keśava \|\| 10 \|\|*

*tvadajñayā jagatsvāminmamābhīṣṭaprado bhava \|*  
*evaṃ samapya devasya upavāsaṃ jitendriyaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādekādaśyāmatho dvija \|*  
*dvādaśyāṃ ca trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ jitendriyaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*paurṇanamāsyāṃ ca karttavyamevaṃ viṣṇvarcanaṃ mune \|*  
*ekādaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ karttavyaṃ jāgaraṃ tathā \|\| 13 \|\|*

8-9a. After worshipping the Lord of the chiefs of Devas, he should utter the following Mantra: “Obeisance to you, the embodiment of perfect knowledge. Salutations be to you, the bestower of knowledge. Bow to you, abiding in all forms, to one who bestows all Siddhis. (Super-human powers).

9b-11a. After bowing thus to Vasudeva, Janardana, the Lord of Devas, he should dedicate the fast to the Lord with the following Mantra, “At thy behest, О Kesava, I shall observe fast for five days beginning from today. О Lord of the universe, be the bestower of my desires.”

11b-12a. After dedicating the fast thus, he should control his sense-organs. О Brahmana, on the night of the Ekadasi day, he should remain awake.

12b-13. О sage, the worship of Visnu must be conducted thus, on the Twelfth, Thirteenth, Fourteenth and on the full- moon days. He must keep awake during the nights of Ekadasi and the full moon day.

## \|\| 1.21.14 \|\|

*pañcāmṛtādipūjā tu sāmānyā dinapañcasu \|*  
*kṣīreṇa snāpayedviṣṇuṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ tu śaktitaḥ \|*  
*tilahomaśca karttavyastiladānaṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The worship by means of Panchamrta, etc. is common to all five days. On the full moon day, he should bathe Visnu in milk according to his capacity. Ноmа should be performed with sesamum seeds. Gift of the sesamum seeds should also be made.

## \|\| 1.21.15 \|\|

*tataḥ ṣaṣṭe dine prātpe nirvatyaṃ svāśramakriyām \|*  
*saṃprāśya pañcagavyaṃ ca pūjayedvidhibaddharim \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. On the sixth day, he should perform all rites befitting his stage in life (i.e. householders’), take in Pancagavya and duly perform the worship of Hari.

## \|\| 1.21.16 \|\|

*brāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścādvibhave satyavāritam \|*  
*tataḥ svabandhubhiḥ sārddhaṃ svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. He should then feed the Brahmanas without any restriction, if he has the means. Thereafter, restrained in speech, he should take his food along with his kinsmen.

## \|\| 1.21.17 \|\|

*evaṃ paupādimāseṣu kārttikānteṣu nārada \|*  
*śuklapakṣe vrataṃ kuryātpūrvamivavidhinā naraḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. О Narada, men should thus perform the holy Vrata in accordance with the injunctions mentioned before, in the bright halves of the months from Pausa to Karttika.

## \|\| 1.21.18 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kāryaṃ vrataṃ pāpapraṇāśanam \|*  
*punaḥ prātpe mārgaśīrṣe kuryādudyapanaṃ vratī \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Thus the Vrata which is destructive of sins, should be performed for one full year. When the month of Margashirsa comes again, the performer of the Vrata should perform the Udyapana (concluding) rites.

## \|\| 1.21.19 \|\|

*dvija ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāro bhavetpūrvamiva dvija \|*  
*dvādaśyāṃ pañcagavyaṃ ca prāśayetsusamāhitaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. On the Ekadasi day, he should fully abstain from taking food as before. О Brahmana, with due reverence and attention, he should take in Pancagavya on the Dvadasi day.

## \|\| 1.21.20 \|\|

*gandhapuṣpā dibhiḥ samyagdevadevaṃ janārdanam \|*  
*abhyarcyopāyanaṃ dadyādrūhyaṇāya jitendriyaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. After duly worshipping the Lord of Devas with scents, fragrant flowers and other things, the devotee who has conquered his sense organs should offer the following present to a Brahmana.

## \|\| 1.21.21-22 \|\|

*pāyasaṃ madhusaṃmiśraṃ ghṛtayuktaṃ phalānvitam \|*  
*sugandhaja lasaṃyuktaṃ pūrṇakumbhaṃ sadakṣiṇam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*vastreṇācchāditaṃ kumbhaṃ pañcarantasamanvitam \|*  
*dadyādadhyātmaviduṣe brāhmaṇāya munīśvara \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. (The present is:) Milk-pudding mixed with honey and ghee. It should be accompanied with fruits, О leading sage, to a Brahmana who is a learned scholar in spiritual topics; he should offer a jar filled with scented water along with the usual Daksina. The water-jar should contain five precious stones within it and be covered with a cloth.

## \|\| 1.21.23 \|\|

*sarvātman sarvabhūteśa sarvavyāpinsanātana \|*  
*paramānnapradānena suprīto bhava mādhava \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. (Mantra) “O Atman of everything, О Lord of all living beings, О Omnipresent and eternal deity Madhava, be pleased with this gift of Paramarma (rice boiled in milk).”

## \|\| 1.21.24 \|\|

*anena pāyasaṃ dattvā brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥ \|*  
*śaktito bandhubhiḥ sārddhaṃ svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Repeating this Mantra, he should present the milk pudding. Thereafter, according to his capacity, he should feed the Brahmanas. Restrained in speech, he should himself take food in the company of his kinsmen.

## \|\| 1.21.25 \|\|

*vratametattu yaḥ kuryāddharipañcakasaṃjñitam \|*  
*na tasya punarāvṛttirbrahmalokātkadācana \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. He who performs this Vrata called Hari Panchaka never returns rrom Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 1.21.26 \|\|

*vratametatprakarttavya micchadbhirmokṣamuttam \|*  
*samastapāpakāntāradāvānalasamaṃ dvija \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. О Brahmana, this excellent Vrata must be performed by those who wish for salvation. It is like the conflagration unto the forest of all sins.

## \|\| 1.21.27 \|\|

*gavāṃ koṭisahasrāṇi dattvā yatphalamāpnuyāt \|*  
*tatphalaṃ labhyate pumbhiretasmā dupavāsataḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. From this Vrata of fasts, men obtain that benefit which one attains after giving thousands and crores of cows.

## \|\| 1.21.28 \|\|

*yastvetacchṛṇuyādbhaktyā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*sa mucyate mahāghoraiḥ tāpakānāṃ ca koṭibhiḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. He who is devoted to Narayana and listens to this narrative, is liberated from millions of extremely terrific

## Chapter 22. The Masopavasa Vrata (Fast for a month)

## \|\| 1.22.1 \|\|

*sanaka uvāca*  
*anyad vratavaraṃ vakṣye tacchṛṇuṣva samāhitaḥ \|*  
*sarvāpāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvalokopakārakam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*Sanaka said:*

1\. I shall describe another excellent Vrata which is destructive of all sins, meritorious and rendering benefitial service to all worlds. Listen to it, attentively.

## \|\| 1.22.2 \|\|

*āṣāḍhre śrāvaṇe vāpi tathā bhādrapade 'pi ca \|*  
*tathaivāśvinake māse kuryādetadvataṃ dvija \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. О Brahmana, one should perform this holy observance in the month of Asadha or Sravana or Bhadrapada or Asvina.

## \|\| 1.22.3 \|\|

*eteṣvanyatame māse śulkapakṣe jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*prāśayetpañcagavyaṃ ca svapedviṣṇusamīpataḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. In one of these months, during the bright half, the devotee who has subdued his sense-organs, should take in Раnсаgavya and sleep in the vicinity of Visnu.

## \|\| 1.22.4 \|\|

*tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya nityakarma samāpya ca \|*  
*śraddhayā pūjayedviṣṇuṃ vaśī krodhavivārjitaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Getting up early in the morning and finishing the daily routine tasks, he should worship Visnu with due faith and full control of his sense-organs, eschewing all forms of anger.

## \|\| 1.22.5 \|\|

*vidvadbhiḥ sahito viṣṇumarcayitvā yathocitam \|*  
*saṃkalpaṃ tu tataḥ kuryāstvasti vācanapūrvakam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. In the company of learned man, he should worship Visnu in the proper manner. Thereafter, after invoking the blessings by the recital of Svasti-sukta (RV.V.51.11-15), in the specific religious rite, he should perform the rite of Samkalpa (revelation of intention).

## \|\| 1.22.6 \|\|

*māsamekaṃ nirāhāro hyadyaprabhṛti keśava \|*  
*māsāntaṃ pāraṇaṃ kurve devadeva tavājñayā \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. О Kesava, from this day onwards, I shall observe fast for a month. I shall perform Pdrand (breaking the fast) rite at the end of the month, О Lord of Devas, at thy behast.

## \|\| 1.22.7 \|\|

*taporupa namastubhyaṃ tapasāṃ phala dāyaka \|*  
*mamābhūṣṭapradaṃ dehi sarvavinghānnivāraya \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Obeisance to thee, О embodiment of penance, О bestower of the benefit of austerities. Bestow what fulfils my desires. Ward off all obstacles.

## \|\| 1.22.8 \|\|

*evaṃ samarpya devasya viṣṇormāsavrataṃ śubham \|*  
*tataḥ prabhṛti māsāntaṃ nivaseddharimandire \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. After dedicating thus, the splendid Masa Vrata (i.e. Masopavasa) to Lord Visnu, he should stay in the shrine of Hari, till the end of the month.

## \|\| 1.22.9 \|\|

*pratyahaṃ snāpayeddevaṃ pañcāmṛtavidhānataḥ \|*  
*dīpaṃ nirantaraṃ kuryāttasminmāse harergṛhe \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Everyday he should bathe the Lord in Pancdmrta in accordance with the injunctions. During that month he should continuously retain the light of the lamps in the shrine of Hari.

## \|\| 1.22.10 \|\|

*pratyahaṃ khādayetkāṣṭhaṃ hyapāmārga samudbhavam \|*  
*tataḥ snāyīta vidhinnārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*
