*pātālage dharmage 'bje śubhadṛṣṭe yute mune \|\| 180 \|\|*

180\. О Sage, when Venus occupies the 4th house identical with his own RaSi, and the Moon the 9th house, cither joined or aspccted by benches, and the rest the 3rd, 1st (61h?) and 11th houses, one becomes a ruler.66

## \|\| 1.55.181 \|\|

*trilagnabhavagaiḥśeṣairdharādhīśaḥ prajāyate \|*  
*saumye vīryayuteṃ'gasthe balāḍhyeśubhage śubhe \|\| 181 \|\|*

181\. A virtuous king is born, if Mercury occupies the Lagna in strength, a benefic (Jupiter) possessed of strength an auspicious house (or 9th?) and the rest the 9th, 2nd and the Upacaya houses (3, 6, 10 and 11).

## \|\| 1.55.182 \|\|

*dharmārthopacayasthaiścaśeṣairdharmayutonṛpaḥ \|*  
*meṣūraṇāyatanugāḥ śaśisūryajasūrayaḥ \|\| 182 \|\|*

182\. One becomes a king with the Moon, Saturn and Jupiter occupying the 10th, 11th and the ascendant respectively, Mars and Mercury the 2nd house, and Venus and the Sun the 4th house, at one’s birth.

## \|\| 1.55.183 \|\|

*jñārau dhaneśitaravā hibuke bhūpatistadā \|*  
*vṛṣeṃ'ge 'bjodhanāristho jīvārkī lāṃbhagāḥ pare \|\| 183 \|\|*

183\. When the Moon occupies the ascendant identical with Vrsabha, Jupiter and Saturn the 2nd and 6th respectively, and the rest the 11 th house, the person concerned becomes a ruler.

## \|\| 1.55.184 \|\|

*sukhe guruḥ kheravīndūyamo lagne bhave karai \|*  
*lagne vakrāsitau candrejyasitārkabudhāḥ kramāt \|\| 184 \|\|*

184\. Jupiter in the 4th house, the Sun and the Moon in the 10th house, Saturn in the Lagna and the rest is in the 11th house, produce kings. Similarly, Mars and Saturn in the Lagna, the Moon, Jupiter, Venus, the Sun and Mercury in the 4th, 7,th, 9th, 10th and 11th respectively usher kings into the world.70

## \|\| 1.55.185 \|\|

*sukhāstu śubhakhāptisthānareśaṃ janayantyapi \|*  
*karmalagnagaraveṭasya daśāyāṃ rājyasaṃgatiḥ \|\| 185 \|\|*

185\. One attains kingship or a kingdom during the major period (Dasa) of the planet posited in the ascendant or the 10th house, or of one that is very strong; whereas that of such planets as are posited in inimical houses, in debilitation etc. is productive of great troubles.

## \|\| 1.55.186-187 \|\|

*prabalasya daśāyāṃ vā śatrunīcā digārtidāḥ \|*  
*āsannakendradvayagairvargadākhyaḥ sakalagrahaiḥ \|\| 186 \|\|*

*tanvastagaiśca sakaṭaṃ vihago rājyabandhugaiḥ \|*  
*śṛṅgāṭakaṃ dhigaugasthairlagnāyasthairhalaṃ matam \|\| 187 \|\|*

186-187. If at a birth all the planets are posited in any two contiguous quadrants (Kendras) (i.e. 1 and 4, 4 and 7, 7 and 10 or 10 and 1), the yoga named Gadaov Mace is generated. If all the planets occupy only the 1st and 7th houses, it will be called Sakata (carriage). The Yoga called Vihaga (Bird) is caused by the planets occupying the 4th and 10th houses. SrAgdfaka is brought into effect by all the planets being posited in the 5th, 9th and 1st houses. The Hala yoga is brought about by all the planets being posited in mutual trines beginning with any house other than the ascendant.71

## \|\| 1.55.188 \|\|

*varjjoṅgesthe satsvasatsu turyakhasthairyavonyathā \|*  
*vimiśraiḥ kamalaṃ prāhurvāyākaṇṭakabāhyagaiḥ \|\| 188 \|\|*

188\. The yoga termed Vajra (Diamond or Thunderbolt} is caused by benefics being posited in the 1st and 7th houses, and by malcfics in the 4th and 10th houses. Yavayoga \[Barley) is the result of the benches and malcfics exchanging the positions mentioned in the previous yoga (i.e. benefics should be in 4th and 10th and malcfics in the 1st and 7th houses). Th ' A'amala \[Lotus) yoga is the effect of all the planets occupying the Kendras in any manner. The Vapi \[Well) yoga is the result of the planets occupying houses other than the Kendras (i.e. in Panapharas or Apoklimas).72

## \|\| 1.55.189 \|\|

*lagnāccaturbhugairyūpaḥśarastūryāccaturbhugaiḥ \|*  
*dyūnādvedakṣagaiḥ śaktirṃ da'khādicaturbhagaiḥ \|\| 189 \|\|*

189\. The Yupayoga \[Plough) is the effect of all the planets occupying the four houses beginning with the Lagna. The baroyoga \[Arrow) is caused by their staying in the four contiguous houses from the 4th house. The bakli yoga is caused, if they occupy the 7th, 8th, 9th and 10th houses. Dan (la \[Rod) is caused by their occupying the 10th, 11th, 12th and 1st houses.73

## \|\| 1.55.190 \|\|

*lagnātkramātsaptabhagairnokākūṭastu nuryataḥ \|*  
*chatramastātsvabhādyāyonyasmādarddhendunāmakaḥ \|\| 190 \|\|*

190\. When all the planets occupy the seven contiguous houses beginning with the Lagna, the yoga is called Nau \[Boat); while the Кй(а yoga \[Fraud) is caused by the planets being in the 7 houses beginning with the 4th house. The Chatra (umbrella) yoga results from the planets occupying the 7 houses beginning with the 7th house. The Capa (Bow) yoga is caused by the planets occupying the 7 houses beginning with the 10th house. The Ardhendu (Crescent) yoga results from their occupying seven houses other than the above, i.e. beginning with any Panaphara or Apoklima house.74

## \|\| 1.55.191-192 \|\|

*lagnādekāntaragataiścakramarthātsaritpatiḥ \|*  
*ṣahyusthāneṣu vīṇādyāḥ samasaptarkṣagaiḥ \|\| 191 \|\|*

*vīṇādāmapāśakedārabhūśūlayugagolakāḥ \|*  
*grahaiḥścarabhagai rājayogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 192 \|\|*

191-192. Cakra (Wheel) yoga is formed by all the planets occupying all the odd houses; and Samudra (Ocean), the even houses. Seven yogas called \[Vind (Lute), Daman (Garland), Pafa (Noose), Kedfaa (Field), SUla (Spike), Yuga (Yoke) and Golaka (Sphere) are caused when all the seven planets are posited in 7 Rashis, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2 and 1 respectively. When all the planets arc in movable Rasis, the yoga called Rajju (Rope) is formed.76

## \|\| 1.55.193 \|\|

*sthirasthairyamusalaṃ nāma dviśarīṇatairnalaḥ \|*  
*bhālā kendrasthitaiḥ saumyaiḥ pāpaiḥsarpa udāhṛtaḥ \|\| 193 \|\|*

193\. When the planets are only in fixed Rasis, Musala (Stave) yoga is formed; in dual Rashis, Nala (Reed) yoga. The Mdla yoga (Wreath) is formed by the benefics (Jupiter, Mercury and Venus) occupying the Kendras; by malefics (the Sun, Mars and Saturn) therein, Sarpa (Serpent) yoga is formed.

## \|\| 1.55.194 \|\|

*īryyuradhvarucī rajjvāṃ musale dhanamānayuk \|*  
*vyaṅgā sthirā lonalajo monīsragjohijordditaḥ \|\| 194 \|\|*

194\. One born under the Rajju Yoga becomes envious and fond of wandering; one of Musala yoga is blessed with wealth and honour; one born under the Nalayoga becomes deficient in a limb and full of prominent veins; under the Mild, or Srak yoga, commands pleasures; and under Sarpayoga, gets afflicted or becomes miserable.76

## \|\| 1.55.195 \|\|

*vīṇodbhavotinipuṇāgītanṛtyarucirbhṛśam \|*  
*dātā samṛddho dāmāsthaḥ pāśajo dhanaśīlayuk \|\| 195 \|\|*

195\. A person born under Vindyoga is very clever and very much interested in music and dancing; one under Ddmayoga becomes wealthy and munificent; and under Pdfayoga, possessed of wealth and character.7651

## \|\| 1.55.196 \|\|

*kedārotthaḥ kṛṣikaraḥ śūle śūrokṣato dhanaḥ \|*  
*yugaṃ pāṣaṇḍayurgole vidhano malinastathā \|\| 196 \|\|*

196\. One having Kedara yoga become an agriculturist; one with Sulayoga, brave unharmed and poor; with yuga yoga, with Gola yoga, and slovenly.

## \|\| 1.55.197 \|\|

*bhūpavandyapadaścakre samudre nṛpabhogayuk \|*  
*subhagāṅgorddhacaṃpātsukhīśūraśca cāmaraḥ \|\| 197 \|\|*

197\. In Cakrayoga one becomes great that his feet are worshipped even by kings; in Samudrayoga, one enjoys the pleasures of royalty; in Ardhacandra, possesses a charming body; and in Cdmara, becomes happy and heroic.77

## \|\| 1.55.198 \|\|

*mitro pakārakṛcchatre kūṭe cānṛtabandharāṭ \|*  
*taujaḥ sakīrtiḥ sukhabhāk mānavo bhavati dhruvam \|\| 198 \|\|*

198\. Under Chairayoga one helps one’s friends; under Knfayoga, suffers imprisonment, and becomes a liar; under Kamalayoga, becomes famous and happy without doubt.78

## \|\| 1.55.199 \|\|

*tyāgī yajvātmavān yūthe hiṃsro guhyādhipaḥ śaraiḥ \|*  
*śaktau nīco 'laso niḥsvo daṇḍe priyaviyogabhāk \|\| 199 \|\|*

199\. Under TUpayoga one becomes charitable, performs sacrifices and controls his senses; under Sara yoga, becomes murderous and a leader of hunters; under Sakti low, mean, lethargic and poor; and under Dania yoga, suffers from separation from his beloved.

## \|\| 1.55.200 \|\|

*vyarkaiḥ svāntyobhayagataiḥ kheṭaiḥ syātsunaphaānaphaā \|*  
*durudharā caiva vidhau jñeyaḥ kemudrumo 'nyathā \|\| 200 \|\|*

200\. The yogas termed Sunaphd, Anaphd and Duradhard are formed when there is any planet, other than the Sun, in the 2nd, 12th and both the houses respectively. In the absence of any of these three yogas, Kemadruma yoga is formed.

## \|\| 1.55.201 \|\|

*svopārjitārthabhugdātā sunaphaāyāṃ dhanī sukhī \|*  
*nīrogaḥ śīlavān khyātaḥ suveṣaścānaphaābhavaḥ \|\| 201 \|\|*

201\. A person born with the Sunaphd yoga at birth will enjoy the wealth earned by his own efforts, be charitable, wealthy and happy; and with Anaphd yoga, one becomes healthy, famous, dressed attractively and of good character.

## \|\| 1.55.202 \|\|

*bhogī sukhī dhanīdānītyāgī durudhurodbhavaḥ \|*  
*kemudrume 'timalino duḥkhī nīco 'tha nirdhanaḥ \|\| 202 \|\|*

202\. Under Durdhara-yoga one enjoys pleasures, becomes happy, wealthy, munificent and charitable; while under Kemadrumayoga\> one becomes very dirty, miserable, mean and penniless.

## \|\| 1.55.203-204 \|\|

*yantryāśmakāraṃśājoko bhaumapuṣkarurte dhvagaḥ sujñaḥ \|*  
*sukīrtirnipuṇaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ dhaninaṃ tathā \|\| 203 \|\|*

*senyonyakāryanirataṃ sāsphujicchasrajīvinam \|*  
*samando dhātukuśalaṃ tathā bhāḍaṃvidaṃ mune \|\| 204 \|\|*

203-204. О Sage, if the Sun is conjoined with the Moon, the native will become a mechanic or mason; with Mars, a wanderer; with Mercury, famours, clever, learned and wealthy; with Jupiter, engaged in helping others; with Venus, earning one’s livelihood by means of weapons; and with Saturn, clever in metallurgy and pottery.79

## \|\| 1.55.205-206 \|\|

*kūṭasnyāśavapaṇyāṭhaṃ nasāsṛgindgaḥ prasūdviṣam \|*  
*kuryātsajñorthanipuṇaṃ namraṃ satkīrtisaṃyutam \|\| 205 \|\|*

*sajyo 'sthiravayaṃ vaṃśyaṃ vikrāntaṃ ca samarthinam \|*  
*sasitosukavettāraṃ sārkiponabhavaṃ mune \|\| 206 \|\|*

205-206. О Sage, the Moon combined with Mars makes one a dealer in hammers, liquor and such other commodities, and hater of his mother; with Mercury, clever in economics, polite and famous; with Jupiter of unsteady mind, leader of his family, valiant (heroic) and rich; with Venus, seeker of pleasures (?); and with Saturn, the son of a remarried woman.80

## \|\| 1.55.207 \|\|

*āre sajñe vāhuyodhī purādhyakṣaḥ sagīṣpatau \|*  
*saśukre dyūtakrarheyo nṛtī dyūti samandake \|\| 207 \|\|*

207\. Mars combined with Mercury makes one a singlecombatant; with Jupiter, mayor of a city; with Venus, a gambler and fighter; and with Saturn, a liar and gambler.

## \|\| 1.55.208 \|\|

*sejyejñe nṛtyagītāḍhyo māyādakṣaḥ \|*  
*sabhārgavesamande lubdhakaḥ krūro naro bhavati nārada \|\| 208 \|\|*

208\. О Narada, Mercury combined with Jupiter makes one proficient in dance and music; with Venus, clever in magic; and with Saturn, greedy and cruel.

## \|\| 1.55.209 \|\|

*saśukre vākpatau vidvānsāsite 'nnaghaṭaṅkaraḥ \|*  
*kavau sa mandamandākṣā va vaniśrayavittavān \|\| 209 \|\|*

209\. Jupiter combined with Venus makes one learned; and with Saturn, a cook or potter. Venus conjoined with Saturn makes one have poor eye-sight, and earn wealth through his association with a woman.81

## \|\| 1.55.210-211 \|\|

*ekasthaiścaturādyaistu khavārthaiḥ khacaraiḥ pṛthak \|*  
*kujajñejyājaśukrārkisūryaḥ parivrajennaraḥ \|\| 210 \|\|*

*śākyājīvakavṛddhārthica rakākhaphalāśanaḥ \|*  
*tatsvāmibhiḥ paridajitaiḥ pravrajyāpracyutirbhavet \|\| 211 \|\|*

210-211. Among the planets Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, the Moon, Venus, Saturn and the Sun, if any four planets should combine in the 10th or 2nd house (?), a Buddhist monk, an Ajivaka monk, an aged mendicant, a wandering recluse,, and an ascetic living on rain-water respectively are brought into existence. In case the planets owning the concerned houses are defeated in a planetary war, there will be a fall from asceticism.

## \|\| 1.55.212-213 \|\|

*adīkṣitālpastagataiḥ sabalaistatsthabhaktayaḥ \|*  
*janmaponyairyadyadṛṣṭo mandaṃ paśyati nārada \|\| 212 \|\|*

*mando vā janmapaṃ naṣṭaṃ tathā ca mandakāgaṇe \|*  
*bhaumārkāṃśe sauradṛṣṭe candre vā dīkṣito bhavet \|\| 213 \|\|*

212-213. Should the planets be tiny or eclipsed, one would not actually don the ochre robes; on the other hand, should they be powerful, persons would be strongly attached to their respective ascetic orders. О Narada, one will become an ascetic, when the lord of the Lagna, being unaspected by any planet, aspects Saturn; or when Saturn aspects the lord of the ascendant, that is eclipsed; or when Saturn, the Sun and the lord of Lagna occupy the Arhsa of Mars or the Sun; or when the Moon is aspectcd by Saturn.82

## \|\| 1.55.214-215 \|\|

*surūpo bhūṣitago 'śinyāṃ dakṣaḥ satyavacā yame \|*  
*bahūbhugpadāragnau sthiradhīḥ priyavāktathā \|\| 214 \|\|*

*brāhmo dhanīmṛge bhogī raudre hiṃstraḥ śaṭho 'ghakṛt \|*  
*dānto rogī śubho 'dityāṃ puṣyaryajanmā kaviḥ sukhī \|\| 215 \|\|*

214-215. One born under Afvini constellation becomes handsome, and endowed with ornaments; under Bkarani, efficient and truthful; under Krtiika, gluttonous and addicted to others’ wives; under Rohini, of stable mind and sweet-tongued; under MrgaSirsa, wealthy and enjoyer of pleasures; under Ardra, cruel, roguish and sinful; under Punarvasu, Self-controlled, sickly and auspicious; and under Pufjra, happy and a poet.

## \|\| 1.55.216 \|\|

*dhūrtaḥ śaṭhaḥ kṛtaghno 'hau pāpaḥ sarvāśano bhavet \|*  
*patre bhogī dhanī bhakto dātā priyavacā bhage \|\| 216 \|\|*

216\. One bora under АШsha will be a villain, rogue and ungrateful; under Maghd, sinful and eater of all and sundry (gluttonous); under PHrvaphalguni, enjoys luxuries, becomes wealthy, a devotee, donor and sweet-tongued.83

## \|\| 1.55.217 \|\|

*dhanī bhogīnaroryamarkṣe steno dhṛṣṭo ghṛṇī kare \|*  
*citrāṃbaraḥ sudṛktvāṣṭre na ca dharmadayāparaḥ \|\| 217 \|\|*

217\. One born under Ullaraphaiguni becomes rich and commands luxuries; under Hasta, a thief, stubborn and merciless; under Citra, possessed of colourful clothes, and fine eyes; under Svati, without piety or kindness.

## \|\| 1.55.218 \|\|

*dvīśe lubdhaḥ paṭuḥ krodhī maḍhaiyo āṭhanovideśagaḥ \|*  
*śākre dharmaparastuṣṭo mūle mānī dhanī sukhī \|\| 218 \|\|*

218\. One born under Vifakhd becomes avaricious, clever and irascible; under Anuradha, a wanderer and one who goes abroad; under Jyetfha, devoted to Dharma and content; and under Mftla, proud, rich and happy.84

## \|\| 1.55.219 \|\|

*āpye mānī dṛṣṭo vaiśve namraśca dhārmikaḥ \|*  
*karṇe dhanī sukhī khyāto dātā śūro dhanī vasau \|\| 219 \|\|*

219\. Under PUrvdsdtfhd one becomes proud, happy and content; under Uttardfdtfha, humble and pious; under Sravana, wealthy, happy and famous; under Dhani^fha, charitable, heroic and rich.

## \|\| 1.55.220 \|\|

*śeta'rihṝntā vyasanī srījito jāhibhedinī \|*  
*budhne vaktā sukhī kāntaḥ pauṣṇe śūro dhanī śuciḥ \|\| 220 \|\|*

220\. One born under Satabhifak, destroys one’s enemies and gets addicted to some vice; under Purva-bhadrapada, comes under the influence of women and becomes rich; under Uttard bhadrapaddy eloquent, happy, and attractive; and under Revati, heroic, wealthy and pure.

## \|\| 1.55.221 \|\|

*kāmī śūraḥ kṛtajño 'je kāntastyāgī kṣamī vṛṣe \|*  
*yugme srīdyūtaśāsrajñaḥ sraiṇo hrasvaḥ svabhe vidhau \|\| 221 \|\|*

221\. If a persons’ natal sign (Janma-rasi — the one occupied by the Moon) happens to be Me fa (Aries), he becomes lustful, heroic and grateful; if Vrshabha (Taurus), attractive, charitable and forgiving; if Mithuna (Gemini), proficient in gambling, Sastras (scriptures) and pleasing women; if Karkafa (Cancer), effeminate and short.

## \|\| 1.55.222 \|\|

*srīdviṭ krodhī harau mānī vikrāntaḥ sthiradhīḥ sukhī \|*  
*dharmī ślakṣṇaḥ sudhīḥ ṣaṣṭe prājñaḥ prāṃśurdhanī ghaṭe \|\| 222 \|\|*

222\. If the natal sign is Sitnha (Leo), one hates women, becomes short-tempered, proud, valiant, happy and of steady, pious, tender and wise; if Tula (Libra), learned, tall and rich.

## \|\| 1.55.223 \|\|

*rogī pūjyaḥ kṣatī kārairpye kaviḥ śilpījyabhe dhanī \|*  
*mṛge 'laso 'ṭanaḥ svakṣaḥ paradārārthahṛddhaṭe \|\| 223 \|\|*

223\. If it is Vricika (Scorpio), one becomes sickly, respectable and receives wounds; if Dhanus (Sagittarius), a poet, artist and wealthy; if Makara (Capricorn), lazy, wanderer and possessing beautiful eyes; if Kumbha, stealer of others5 wealth and wives.85

## \|\| 1.55.224 \|\|

*sabalebhaibhayevāpisa valejeśilaphalam \|*  
*anyathā viparītaṃ tatpalaṃmevaṃ pare 'pi na \|*  
*khyātaḥ srīdviṭ dhanī tīkṣṇojñaḥ kaviḥ śaiṇḍiko dhanī \|*  
*pūjyo lubdho 'dhanasakho meṣādau bhāskare janau \|\| 224 \|\|*

224\. When the natal Sign and its lord arc strong, and when the Moon also is possessed of strength, all good results will accrue to the native; otherwise they will be the opposite of what has been given above. The effects of the Sun’s occupying the 12 Signs beginning with Mesa are in order (1) fame, (2) hatred for women, (3) wealth, (4) cruelty or sharpness, (5) wisdom or learning, (6) poetic gift, (7) keeping a liquor shop, (8) riches, (9) respectability, (10) avarice, (11) penury, and (12) being without friends.

## \|\| 1.55.225 \|\|

*niḥsvor'kabhe bhūmiputre bhūmiputre dhanī cāndre svabhedanaḥ \|*  
*baudhe kṛtajño jaive tu khyātaḥ śaukre 'nyadārikaḥ \|\| 225 \|\|*

225\. Mars occupying Sirfiha at birth makes one pool-; Karka\\a, wealthy; his own house, gluttonous; Mithuna or Kanya, grateful; Dhanus or Mina, famous; Vrsa or Tula, having illicit connection with other women; Makara, blessed with many sons and affluence; and Kumbha, grief-stricken, wicked and a liar.

## \|\| 1.55.226-227 \|\|

*mṛge bahvātmajadhanaḥ kuṃbhe duḥkhyanṛtī khalaḥ \|*  
*srīdveṣyaḥ svajanadveṣīniyaratyaḥ sadhīyanaḥ \|\| 226 \|\|*

*samānārthaḥ saputrasrīsarṇaḥ sūryādibhe budhe \|*  
*senānīḥ stryarthaputrāḍhyaḥ dakṣamaiśyaḥ paricchadī \|\| 227 \|\|*

226- 227. Mercury occupying the houses of the seven planets beginning with the Sun makes one (1) hateful in the eyes of W'omen, (2) hater of one’s ow n kinsmen, (3) observing vows (?) (4) blessed with intelligence and wealth, (5) having honour and riches, (6) blessed with sons, and (7) gcttinggold from women (?) respectively. In the case of Jupiter the above results arc: (1) commander of an army, (2) blessed with wife, wealth and children, (3) having efficient friends (?), (4) commanding a vast following or good clothes, (5) governor of a province, (6) having wealth and happiness, and owner of much gold (?)\>

## \|\| 1.55.228 \|\|

*maṇḍaleśaḥ sārthasukhaḥ sarṇasvāmyarkabhādgurau \|*  
*stryāptārtho mandaśokāḍhyo bandhudveṣī dhanāghavān \|\| 228 \|\|*

228\. The effects of Venus occupying the houses of the planets are in order (1) acquiring wealth through women, (2) riches and freedom from grief, (3) hating one’s kith and kin, (4) wealth and sin, (5) wealth and intelligence, (6) uniform famsh, and (7) defeat at the hands of woman.87

## \|\| 1.55.229 \|\|

*sārthaḥ prājñaḥ samaḥ khyātiḥ srīji'torkādibhe mṛgau \|*  
*vyaṅgajārtho khaprasūko vidhimitro sukhatrayaḥ \|\| 229 \|\|*

229\. The effects of Saturn occupying the Rasis owned by the seven planets are in order: (1) Deficient in limbs (or with deformed limbs) and poor, (2) motherless, (3) having many friends (?) (4) afflicted by the three-fold calamities, (5) blessed with children, wife and wealth and (6) a king and (7) leader of a village or town.88

## \|\| 1.55.230-231 \|\|

*satputrastrīdhano rājā grāme śokādibherkaje \|*  
*bhūpajñaguṇipaurāsvādṛṣṭebjejesṛgādibhiḥ \|\| 230 \|\|*

*niḥ svastena nṛpāḥ prajñapreṣyāmavinṛyugmage \|*  
*dhātvājīvī nṛpajñābhītantuvāyādhanāḥ svabhe \|\| 231 \|\|*

230-231. The Moon occupying Мод when aspected by Mars and five other planets, produces the following effects in order: (1) kingship, (2) learning, (3) virtues, (4) mayor- ship of a city, (5) penury and (6) poverty; in Vrjabha, (1) poverty, (2) thievish propensities, (3) kingship, (4) learning (5) messengership and (6) sickness; in Mithuna, (1) living by working on metals, (2) kingship, (3) scholarship, (4) fearless, (5) weaver, and (6) penniless.

## \|\| 1.55.232 \|\|

*yuyutsukavisūrījyadhātujīvidṛgāmayāḥ \|*  
*jyotirjñāḍhyejyanu khalu nṛpejñādikarharau \|\| 232 \|\|*

232\. The Moon occupying her own house, produces the following effects in order, when aspected by the six planets, Mars and others: (1) a warrior, (2) poet, (3) learned man, (4) a respected teacher (or king?), (5) metallurgist, and (6) suffering from eye-disease; and sign Simha, (1) astrologer, (2) wealthy, (3) respected teacher or king, (4) king, (5) barber, and (6) a great king.89

## \|\| 1.55.233 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭe śubhairnṛpacamūpanaipuṇyavatitāśayāḥ \|*  
*jūke bhūpasvarṇakāravaṇijaḥ śeṣadṛgyute \|\| 233 \|\|*

233\. The Moon tenanting Kanyd and being aspected by the above planets, produces the following effects in order: (1) a pure and virtuous person, (2) a king, (3) an army- commander, (4) a skilful person, (5) a landlord and (6) a king; Tulay (1) a king, (2) a goldsmith, (3) a merchant, (4) a king, (5) a goldsmith, and (6) merchant.90

## \|\| 1.55.234 \|\|

*dvipaitṛkābdhidhvajino vyaṅgā svakṣitipā alau \|*  
*jñātikṣmājanayāścāye sadbhirdarmī śaṭhastathā \|\| 234 \|\|*

234\. The effects of the Moon’s stay in Vrkika under the aspects of the six planets are — (1) father of twins, (2) fond of water (?), (3) a king, (4) of defective limbs, (5)wcalthy, and (6) a king; in Dhanus, they are: (1) protector of kinsmen, (2) a king, (3) leader of men, (4) of virtuous mind, (5) showy person, and (6) a cheat.®1

## \|\| 1.55.235 \|\|

*bhūpamaṇḍitasakhejyāmṛge bhūyānyadārikau \|*  
*kuṃbhe śeṣaiśca hāsyajñanṛpajñāḥ sadbhirantyabhe \|\| 235 \|\|*

235\. In Makara the effects are — (1) king, (2) scholar (or ornamented?) (3) a friendly person, (4) a sacrificer (or teacher), (5) a king, and (6) taking a boy in adoption (?); in Kumbha and Mina they are — (1) humorous, (2) learned, (3) a king, (4) learned, (5) a virtuous person, and (6) intelligent person.

## \|\| 1.55.236 \|\|

*hāreśarkṣadalasthaistu dṛṣṭo yuktaḥ śaśī śubhaḥ \|*  
*tryaṃśe tatpatimitrarkṣagateryuktekṣitastathā \|\| 236 \|\|*

236\. The Moon confers beneficial results, when she is joined or aspected by planets that are posited in the Raii or Amsa of the lord of the Lagna. The same result will follow, if she is combined with or aspected by those that arc posited in a Rashi that is owned by a friend of the lord of the Lagna- decanate.

## \|\| 1.55.237-238 \|\|

*dvādaśāṃśe phalaṃ proktaṃ navāṃśe 'pyatha kīrtyate \|*  
*ārakṣeko vadharucirniyuddhakuśalor'thavān \|\| 237 \|\|*

*kalahaḥ kṣitijāṃsthe śaukre mūrkho 'nyadāradaḥ \|*  
*kaviḥ sukhī budhāṃśe tu naṭacaurajñaśilpinaḥ \|\| 238 \|\|*

237-238. The results of the Moon’s being placed in the various DvddaSaitifas (1/12 of a Sign) have already been enunciated. Those of her Navarhfa placements will now be explained: When the Moon is posited in the Navarhta Rashi owned by Mars (i.e. Mesha or Vficika), the native becomes a policeman (or watchman), interested in killing, single combat, and quarrels, and wealthy; when in one of Venus (Vrjabha or Tula), foolish and addicted to others’ spouses; when in one of Mercury (Mithuna or Kanyd), a poet, happy, dancer (actor), thief, learned and an artist (or artisan).3

## \|\| 1.55.239 \|\|

*svāṃśe tvalpatanuḥ sakhastapasvī lobhatatparaḥ \|*  
*krodhī nidhīśo mātyo vā nṛpo hiṃsro suto hareḥ \|\| 239 \|\|*

239\. When the Moon is in her own Amsa i.e. Karkay one becomes short in stature, wealthy, ascetic and greedy; when in that of the Sun, i.e. Simha, hot-tempered, owner of treasures, a minister, king, cruel and childless.4

## \|\| 1.55.240 \|\|

*jīvāṃśe hāsyavidyodhā balī mantrī ca dhārmikaḥ \|*  
*alpāpatyo duḥkhito kho duṣṭastrīsauribhāgage \|\| 240 \|\|*

240\. When the Moon is in an Amsa of Jupiter (Dhanus or Mina) the person concerned becomes an expert in comics, endowed with a strong physique, a minister and religious- minded (or virtuous); when she is in one of Saturn (i.e. Makar a or Kumbha), he will have very few children, be wretched (distressed), indigent and associated with a wicked woman.4

## \|\| 1.55.241-242 \|\|

*bhānārvidvādidṛṣṭe nu tadvadeva phalaṃ vadet \|*  
*vargottame khe parabhe pala muktaṃ śubhaṃ kramāt \|\| 241 \|\|*

*puṣṭaṃ madhyaṃ laghu jñeyaṃ yadi cāṃśapatirbalī \|*  
*rāśīkṣaṇaphalaṃ ruddhvā dadātyaṃśapalaṃ spuṭam \|\| 242 \|\|*

241-242. When the Sun is aspected by the Moon and other planets, the results are the same as for the Moon being aspected by others (vide alokas 230-235). When a planet is posited in VargottamdrhSa, own house or in another’s house, the good results enumerated will be full-fledged, middling or very meagre, as the case may be: If the owner of the Amsa (occupied by a planet) is strong, he bestows very good results, according to the effects of the (Rasi occupied and the aspects he receives from others.

## \|\| 1.55.243 \|\|

*śūrastabdho vikaladṛgnighṛṇor'ke tanusthite \|*  
*meṣe dhanī taimirakaḥ siṃhe rātryandha eva ca \|\| 243 \|\|*

243\. If the Sun should occupy the Lagna at birth the native would become a hero, stubborn, of defective eyes and merciless; if the Lagna is Mesa, he will suffer from cataract in the eye and be wealthy; if it be Sirhha, night-blind.

## \|\| 1.55.244 \|\|

*nīcodhosvaḥ karkager'ke udbudākṣastanusthite \|*  
*dvitīyer'ke bahudhano nṛpadaṇḍyo mukhāmayī \|\| 244 \|\|*

244\. If the Sun occupies the ascendant identical with Катка (Cancer), the native will be mean, poor and blear-eyed; if the second house, very wealthy, punished by the ruler and suffering from some facial disease.96

## \|\| 1.55.245 \|\|

*trige budho vikramī ca vimukhaḥ pīḍito bhuvi \|*  
*dhanāpatyoktito dhīsthe balī śatrujitorige \|\| 245 \|\|*

245\. The Sun in the 3rd house makes one learned and full of prowess; in the 4th house, depressed (or unhappy) and afflicted; in the 5th, bereft of wealth and issue; and in the 6th house, powerful and victorious over his foes.97

## \|\| 1.55.246 \|\|

*strī jito dyūnasaṃsthe ca nidhanelpātmajolpadṛk \|*  
*sutārthasukhabhā bhāraye daśame śrutaśauryavāt \|\| 246 \|\|*

246\. The Sun in the 7th house makes one under the thumb of a woman; in the 8th, have few children and poor eye-sight; in the 9th, blessed with children, wealth and happiness; in the 10th, full of heroism and learning; in the 11th, endowed with wealth and honour; and in the 12th, fallen from position, and poor.98

## \|\| 1.55.247-249 \|\|

*lābhe bahudhano mānī patito kho 'vyaye ravau \|.*  
*mūkodho badhiraḥ preṣyo jege khāñcājage dhanī \|\| 247 \|\|*

*buṭurvā dhanavānadhe hiṃsro vikramage bhavet \|*  
*sādhubhāvaḥ sukhagate dhīsthe kanyāprajolasaḥ \|\| 248 \|\|*

*alpāgnikāmastīkṣṇorauīṣyustatrimadojñarave \|*  
*vyādhipūḍānvito mṛtyau bhānurddhanage mitradhanānvitaḥ \|\| 249 \|\|*

247-249. 'Ibe Moon occupying the Lagna makes one dumb, deaf, blind and a servant; but if the ascendant is Cancer, Aries or Taurus, one becomes rich; in the second house, a religious student or rich; in the third, cruel; in the fourth, endowed with a virtuous disposition, in the fifth, father of girls and indolent; in the sixth, of poor digestion and sexual urge, and cruel, and envious; in the seventh, an administrator (?), and learned; in the eighth, afflicted with diseases; and in the ninth, endowed with friends and riches.99

## \|\| 1.55.250 \|\|

*dharmadhīdhanayugrājye khyātadhīdhanayugbhavet \|*  
*kṣudrāeṃ'gahīno vyayage candre proktaṃ phalaṃ budhaiḥ \|\| 250 \|\|*

250\. The Moon in the tenth house confers virtues or piety, intelligence and riches; in the eleventh, fame, intelligence and wealth; and in the twelfth, meanness and loss of limbs. These are the results mentioned by the wise for the Moon’s stay in the various houses at a person’s birth.

## \|\| 1.55.251 \|\|

*lagne kuje kṣatatanurddhanage tu kadannabhuk \|*  
*dharmapāpasamācāro 'nyatra sūryasamo mataḥ \|\| 251 \|\|*

251\. Mars occupying the Lagna at birth causes wounds in the body; the second house, makes one cat forbidden or rotten food; the third house, perform virtuous deeds; the fourth house, sinful activities; and the remaining houses, as in the case of the Sun.

## \|\| 1.55.252 \|\|

*vidvān dhanī ca pravaraḥ paṇḍitaḥ sacivoriyuk \|*  
*dharmajño vistṛtaguṇo gādhojñeyarator'kavat \|\| 252 \|\|*

252\. Mercury gives the following effects in the first eight houses beginning with the ascendant: (1) Learned; (2) Wealthy; (3) Leader of men; (4) Scholar; (5) Minister; (6) Having Enemies; (7) Appreciator of virtues; and (8) a paragon of virtues. In the remaining four houses the effects are similar to those of the Sun.100

## \|\| 1.55.253 \|\|

*vidvānsa vācyaḥ kṛpaṇī sukhākṣo ripugṛddhimān \|*  
*nīcastapasvī caṣṇavanī lobhīduṣṭastanorguro \|\| 253 \|\|*

253\. Jupiter produces the following effects in the 12 houses: — (1) Learned; (2) of pleasant speech; (3) Miserly; (4) Happy; (5) Wise; (6) Vanquisher of foes; (7) Intelligent; (8) Mean; (9) Ascetic; (10) Blessed and Wealthy; (11) Greedy, and (12) Wicked.101

## \|\| 1.55.254 \|\|

*smarī mukhī vilagnasthe kalahī suratotsukaḥ \|*  
*sukhitastanapasye ca bhṛgau jīvavadanyataḥ \|\| 254 \|\|*

254\. Venus causes the following effects in the first five houses: (1) Passionate and Happy; (2) Quarrelsome; (3) Anxious for sexual pleasure; (4) Happy; and (5) Having many daughters; and in other houses he gives the same results as Jupiter.102

## \|\| 1.55.255 \|\|

*niḥśvo rogī kāmavaśo malinaḥ śaiśavārtiyuk \|*  
*alaso lagnage mande dharmātsvoñcagate nṛpaḥ \|\| 255 \|\|*

255\. Saturn occupying the ascendant at birth makes one penniless, sickly, voluptuous, slovenly, sickly during childhood and indolent; but if it is his exaltation, one becomes virtuously disposed, a king or administrator of a village, learned and of attractive physique. In other places lie is similar to the Sun.

## \|\| 1.55.256-257 \|\|

*grāmādhipaḥ sa vidvāṃśca cārvaṅgo 'nyatra sūryavat \|*  
*pūrṇamuccetha pādonaphalaṃ mūlatrikoṇage \|\| 256 \|\|*

*śubhagrahedalaṃ svarkṣe mitrabheṃ'ghrimitaṃ phalam \|*  
*śatrubhe 'lpaṃ tathā nīcāstaṅgate phalaśūnyatā \|\| 257 \|\|*

256- 257. A planet in exaltation yields its results in full \\ in MUlatrikona, three-fourth.; in the house of a bencfic as well a? in its own house, a half; in the house of a friendly planet, onefourth\\ in an enemy’s house, very little; and in its debilitation and when it is eclipsed, the result is nil.

## \|\| 1.55.258-259 \|\|

*khabharākādike kheṭe kulatulyaḥ kulādhikaḥ \|*  
*bandhupūjyo 'thadhanavānsukhī bhogī nṛpaḥ kramāt \|\| 258 \|\|*

*parivittasuhṛdvandhupoṣyāgaṇabalādhipau \|*  
*nṛpaśca mitrabhāstheṣu kheṭe vrekādiṣu kramāt \|\| 259 \|\|*

258-259. When one or more planets are posited in their own houses, MQlatrikona, exaltation or friendly houses the person becomes a worthy scion of his family, leader of the family and respected by his kinsmen; wealthy, happy, enjoyer of pleasures and a king; or enjoyer of others’ wealth, protector of friends and relatives (or protected by friends and kinsmen), leader of a group:; commander or king, as the case may be.103

## \|\| 1.55.260-261 \|\|

*viṣamarkṣer'kahorāyāṃ sasthite śubhabheṣu ca \|*  
*khyāto mahodyamī cātitejā dhīmāndhanī balī \|\| 260 \|\|*

*śubheṣu candrahorāyāṃ sthiteṣu samarāśiṣu \|*  
*kāntimārddavasaubhāgyabhogadhīmānbhavennaraḥ \|\| 261 \|\|*

260-261. When bcncfic planets are posited in odd houses and in the Sun’s Нога the native becomes famous, very enterprising, brilliant or valiant, intelligent, wealthy and strong; and when the benefics are posited in even Signs and in the Moon’s Нога, he becomes lustrous, tender, attractive, enjoyer of luxuries, and wise.104

## \|\| 1.55.262 \|\|

*sūryahorāgataḥ pāpaḥ samabheṣu tu madhyamāḥ \|*  
*viṣamarkṣeṣu bhāskaryā saumyā noktaphalapradāḥ \|\| 262 \|\|*

262\. Malefics occupying even houses and the Нога of the Sun, will produce moderate results, while benefics occupymg odd Rashis and the Sun’s Нога, will not yield the results expected of them (i.e. mentioned above).106

## \|\| 1.55.263 \|\|

*svamitratryaṃśagaścandraḥ surūpaṃ guṇinaṃ naram \|*  
*karotyannagatastadvattattulyaguṇarūpiṇam \|\| 263 \|\|*

263\. If the Moon at a birth occupies a decanate (Drek- капа) owned by a friendly planet, the native becomes hand some, and virtuous while in any other decanate, he gets the qualities and form appropriate to the owner of the decanate.

## \|\| 1.55.264-265 \|\|

*vyālāyudhe catuṣpādāṃ'jeṣu ca tryaṃśake ca \|*  
*tīkṣṇe 'tihiṃsraśca bhavedgurutalpagatoṭanaḥ \|\| 264 \|\|*

*steno bhoktā sadhanadhīrnṛpaḥ klībaśca śatruhā \|*  
*viṣṭikṛddāsavṛttiśca pāpo hiṃsno 'matirbhavet \|\| 265 \|\|*

264-265. When the planets are posited in decanates that are designated as (1) Serpent, (2) Weapon, (3) Quadruped, and (4) Aquatic, the native becomes in order: (1) Cruel, murderous, cohabiting with revered women and wanderer; (2) thief, gluttonous, wealthy, intelligent, a king, impotent and destroyer of enemies; (3) a slave and one labouring under somebody without payment; and sinful, murderous and foolish.10fi

## \|\| 1.55.266-267 \|\|

*meṣādikottamāṃśeṣu dvādaśāṃśeṣu rāśivat \|*  
*jāyābalavibhūṣāḍhyaḥ sattvayukto 'tisāhasī \|\| 266 \|\|*

*tejasvī ca naraḥ khāye triṃśāṃse sṛjisaṃsthite \|*  
*āmayī vā svabhāryāyāṃ viṣamaḥ pāradārikaḥ \|\| 267 \|\|*

266-267. The effects of Vargottama Dvadaldthlas in the Signs, Me fa etc. are the same as for the Rasis themselves. When Mars occupies his own Trirtildrhlay the native will have wife, strength, ornaments, prowess, daring spirit, and brilliance, or will be hostile to his wife and attached to other women.100

## \|\| 1.55.268 \|\|

*duḥkhī paricchadayuto malinaścārkaje svake \|*  
*sukhadhīdhanakīrtyālastejasvī lokapūjitaḥ \|\| 268 \|\|*

268\. When Saturn occupies his own Trimidmla, the person becomes miserable, untidy and endowed with followers. When Jupiter occupies his own Trirhlarhla, one gets happiness, intelligence, wealth, fame, brilliance, respect of the people, enjoyments, horses and elephants (?).107

## \|\| 1.55.269-270 \|\|

*nīraguhyabhavānbhogī jīve khatriṃśabhāgage \|*  
*medhākalākāvyaśilpavivādakapaṭāñcitaḥ \|\| 269 \|\|*

*śāstrārthasāhasayuto budhe svatriṃśabhāgage \|*  
*bahvapatsukhāraugyarogarūpārthasaṃyutaḥ \|\| 270 \|\|*

269-270. When Mercury occupies his own Trirhlamla, one will be blessed with a highly developed intelligence, proficiency in fine arts, poetry, architecture and disputations; he will also be deceitful and well-versed in the Sastras and be clever in adventurous deeds. When Venus occupies his own Trim SdrhSat one will have many children, happiness, health, enjoyments, an attractive personality and riches; he will have a tender body and uncontrolled senses.108

## \|\| 1.55.271 \|\|

*lalitāṅgo viprakīṇandriyaḥ syādbhārgave svake \|*  
*śūrastabdhau ca viṣamavadhakau sadguṇānvitau \|\| 271 \|\|*

271\. When the luminaries are conjoined with Mars and other planets, the following effects are produced:(1) Heroic and obdurate; (2) Abnormal and a killer; (3) virtuous; (4) Happy and Learned; and (5) Attractive in action and body.

## \|\| 1.55.272-273 \|\|

*sukhejño cāru ceṣṭāṅgau candrārkkaucetkujādigau mūlatrikoṇasvarkṣocce kaṇṭhasthāstu ca ye grahāḥ \|\| 272 \|\|*

*anyonyakārakāste syuḥ karmagastu viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*śubhaṃ vargottame janma vesisthāne vasadgṛhaiḥ \|\| 273 \|\|*

272-273. Planets that are posited in Kendras identical with their own house, MUlatrikona or Exaltationy are considered to be Mutual Kdrakas (Significators), especially the one that is in the 10th house. A birth is highly auspicious, if the ascendant is in VargottamamSa and if there are planets in the Veti house (2nd house from the Sun).10

## \|\| 1.55.274 \|\|

*aśūnyeṣu ca kendreṣu kārakākhyagṛheṣu ca \|*  
*gurujanmeśalagneśāḥ kendrasthā madhyasaukhyādāḥ \|\| 274 \|\|*

274\. When Kendras (Quadrants) as well as the houses of the Kdrakas (Signifiestors) are not vacant, Jupiter and the lords of the ascendant and the lunar Sign, posited in kendras, confer beneficial results in the middle of their periods.

## \|\| 1.55.275 \|\|

*pṛṣṭobhavakodaparkṣasthitāstvantyāntarāduṣu \|*  
*praveśe bhāskarakujau bhṛgvījyo madhyagau tathā \|\| 275 \|\|*

275\. Planets posited in Rasis that rise with their hind part foremost, in those that rise both ways — and in those that rise with their head first produce effects at the end and in the middle and in the beginning of their periods respectively. The Sun and Mars confer their results at the beginning, while Jupiter and Venus in the middle. The Sun and the Moon yield their results at the end, while Mercury does it always.

## \|\| 1.55.276 \|\|

*candrārkī phala dāvantye sadā jñaḥ phaladāyakaḥ \|*  
*lagnātputre kalatre vābjācchubheśayutekṣite \|\| 276 \|\|*

276\. If the 5th and the 7th houses counted from the ascendant or the Moon, be aspected or joined by their own lords or by benefics, there would be all-round progress and prosperity for the two Bhavas (i.e. issue and wife or husband); otherwise their progress would be hindered.111

## \|\| 1.55.277-278 \|\|

*syāttayoḥ saṃpadaḥ svatvamanyathāthāṅgatodayaḥ \|*  
*ravau bhīner'kajaḥ srīghnaḥ putrasthastu tathā kujaḥ \|\| 277 \|\|*

*simāturyāṣṭagaiḥ krūrairyadvā krūrāntare sitaḥ \|*  
*sadgrahāyutadṛṣṭaścedagnipātānmṛtiḥ striyāḥ \|\| 278 \|\|*

277-278. If the Sun be posited in Mina, Saturn in the 7th therefrom would destroy the wife; while Mars in the 5th from the Sun would kill the issue. Malcfics in the 12th and 2nd houses or in the 4th and 8th houses from Venus would destroy the wife with fire, provided he is neither conjoined with nor aspected by benefics.112

## \|\| 1.55.279-280 \|\|

*lagnadya pāṇigatayoḥ śaśiravyoḥ saha striyā \|*  
*ekena yasya janmāhuratha saptamasaṃsthayoḥ \|\| 279 \|\|*

*navadhīgatayorvāpi vikalasrīsitārkayoḥ \|*  
*koṇodaye 'stāṃ tyasandhau bhṛgau bandhyāpaterjaniḥ \|\| 280 \|\|*

279-280. \[ In addition to the yoga mentioned in the previous verse \], if the Moon and the Sun occupy the 12th and 8th houses (or 6th?), the man too will die along with his wife. The nature of the wife is determined from the planets occupying the 7th house. When the luminaries are situated in the 7th or 9th or 5th house, the wife would be a handicapped person. When the Sun and Venus are together in Kona or in the Lagna, or when Venus is in Sandhi either in the 7th or 12th house, the native’s wife would be barren.118

## \|\| 1.55.281 \|\|

*sutabhaṃ cenna saumyāḍhyamathāntyāstodayarkṣagaiḥ \|*  
*pāpe dhīsthe vidhau kṣīṇajanmā sutakalatriṇaḥ \|\| 281 \|\|*

281\. If the 5th house is not occupied by benefics, if the ascendant, 7th and 12th houses are occupied by malefics, and if the weak Moon be in the 5th house, the native will have neither wife nor children.114

## \|\| 1.55.282 \|\|

*śanau khage 'ste saśukre tadṛṣṭe pāradārikaḥ \|*  
*tau cetseṃdusriyā sārddhaṃ puṃścalo jāyate naraḥ \|\| 282 \|\|*

282\. If Saturn be in the 10th house and aspects Venus posited in the 7th house, the person would be committing adultery. Should the two viz. Venus and Saturn, be combined with the Moon, the man would be adulterous along with his wife.

## \|\| 1.55.283 \|\|

*bhūgvabjayorastagayornaro bhāryā suto 'pi vā \|*  
*nṛsriyo stu śubhairdṛṣṭau tau dvau pariṇatāṅgakau \|\| 283 \|\|*

283\. When the Moon and Venus are in the 7th house, the man, his wife or at least his son will have undeveloped organs. This defect will not arise, if they are aspected by bcnefics.

## \|\| 1.55.284 \|\|

*ravāstāṃbugairinduśukrapāpairvaṃśavināśakaḥ \|*  
*śilpī tryeśe budhayute kendrasaṃsthārkivīkṣite \|\| 284 \|\|*

284\. One becomes the destroyer of one’s family (lineage), if the Moon, Venus and a malefic occupy the 10th, 7th and 4th house respectively. One will become an artist (artisan or architect), if the rising decanate is occupied by Mercury and aspected by Saturn occupying a kendra.116

## \|\| 1.55.285 \|\|

*dāsyāṃ jātaḥ sauribhāge riḥphage bhṛgunandane \|*  
*nīcer'kendorastagayordṛṣṭayoḥ sūryajena vā \|\| 285 \|\|*

285\. One should be said to be born of a slave woman, if the decanate be owned by Saturn, and if Venus be in the 12th house, being debilitated. The result would follow, if both the luminaries be in the 7th house and be aspected by Saturn.116

## \|\| 1.55.286 \|\|

*pāpadṛṣṭau śanikujāvastagau vātarukpradau \|*  
*karkālyaṃ śagate kendre pāpayukte tu guhyaruk \|\| 286 \|\|*

286\. Mars and Saturn occupying the 7tli house and being aspected by another malefic, produce rheumatism; while a malefic occupying the Amsha of Karka or VrScika in a kendra, would cause venereal disease.

## \|\| 1.55.287 \|\|

*pāpātaragateṃ'gebje ravau dyūne tu kuṣṭayuk \|*  
*candre khe 'stāṅgate bhaume vikalo veśiger'kaje \|\| 287 \|\|*

287\. One is afflicted with leprosy, if the Lagna and the Moon are hemmed in between malcfics, and the Sun is posited in the 7th house. One would be of defective limbs, if the Moon be in the 10th house, Mars in the 7th, and Saturn in the 2nd house from the Sun.

## \|\| 1.55.288-289 \|\|

*mitho bhāṃśagayoḥ śūlī ravīndvoryutayoḥ kṛśaḥ \|*  
*nidhanāridhanāntyasthā ravīndvārayamā yadā \|\| 288 \|\|*

*caladgraheṇa doṣeṇa kurvantyanayanaṃ naram \|*  
*saumyā dṛṣṭā na vāyatridhīgatāḥ pāpakhecarāḥ \|\| 289 \|\|*

288-289. If the Sun and Moon are posited in mutual RaSis or Amsas, one will suffer from colic; and if the luminaries are combined, one will be lean in body. If the Sun, Moon, Mars and Saturn are posited in the 8th, 6th, 2nd and 12th house respectively, one is deprived of one’s eye-sight by the affliction caused by a wandering spirit known. as Balagraha (which attacks children). Malefics in the 5th house, unaspect- ed by benefics, make one deaf; while the same in the 7th house cause bad (ugly) teeth.117

## \|\| 1.55.290-291 \|\|

*karṇopaghātakā dyūne radavaikṛtyakārakāḥ \|*  
*lagne gurau dyune mande vātarogādito bhavet \|\| 290 \|\|*

*sukhe 'ste vā kuje jīve lagne vārkiyutodaye \|*  
*kujena vātmaje dyūne saṃjñeṃ'tye 'bje ca sonmadaḥ \|\| 291 \|\|*

290-291. When the ascendant is occupied by Jupiter and the 7th house by Saturn, the native will be afflicted by rheumatism. One becomes mad, if Mars occupies the 4th or 7th house and Jupiter or Saturn, the ascendant; or if Mars occupies the 5th house, Mercury the 7th and the Moon, the 12th house.11®

## \|\| 1.55.292 \|\|

*dhīdharmārthāntyagaiḥ pāpairbhasamasyānnibandhanam \|*  
*sarpaśṛṅkhalayā śāṭhyairdṛkkairbalyaśubhekṣitaiḥ \|\| 292 \|\|*

292\. Malefics occupying the 2nd, 5th, 9th and 12th houses cause bondage corresponding to the type of decanate occupied by them. When the decanates happen to be Serpent, Fetters and Noose and are aspected by strong inalefics, a person suffers bondage.119

## \|\| 1.55.293 \|\|

*samande 'bje vakradṛṣṭe pasmārī durvacāḥ kṣayī \|*  
*ravimandakujaiḥ ravasthaiḥ saumyadṛṣṭaiḥ samaṇḍalaiḥ \|\| 293 \|\|*

293\. When the Moon and Saturn are together and aspected by Mars, the native will be afflicted with epilepsy, be foul-mouthed and consumptive. When the Sun, Mars and Saturn occupy the 10th house, are aspected by benches and are of bright orbs, natives become servants of the highest, moderate and low order, according to the strength of the planets.

## \|\| 1.55.294-295 \|\|

*bhṛtakāḥ pūrvamuditairvaramadhyādhamā narāḥ \|*  
*puñjanau tu phalaṃ puṇyasrīṇāṃ yogyaṃ vadecca tat \|\| 294 \|\|*

*tatsvāmiṣvakhilaṃ kāryaṃ tadbhartṛmaraṇaṃ mṛtau \|*  
*lagnendugaṃ vapuścaiva yādayūpapītadyune \|\| 295 \|\|*

294-295. Whatever effects have been declared for male births should be applied to female births, as far as they are applicable to them; and such effects should be declared in the case of their husbands; and in the case of death, it should be taken to apply to their husbands. Their physical features should be read from the Moon and ascendant; and paramours from the malefics occupying the 7th house.120

## \|\| 1.55.296 \|\|

*yugmeṣu lagnaśaśinorvanitā prakṛtisthitā \|*  
*sacchīlabhūṣaṇayutā śubhasaṃdṛṣṭayostayoḥ \|\| 296 \|\|*

296\. If both the ascendant and the Moon occupy even houses, the woman concerned will be of normal conduct; and if they are aspected by benefics, she will be of excellent character and will possess many ornaments (or will be charming).

## \|\| 1.55.297 \|\|

*puruṣākṛti śīlāḍhyā tayorojasthayormatā \|*  
*atha pāpā guṇonāśca pāpavīkṣitathostayoḥ \|\| 297 \|\|*

297\. If the two (Lagna and the Moon) be in Odd Signs, the woman would be masculine in physical features and mental disposition. If the two be aspected by malefics, they would be wicked (sinful) and devoid of all virtues.

## \|\| 1.55.298 \|\|

*kujārkījyajñaśukrāṇāṃ kujarkṣe kramaśo 'ṅganā \|*  
*bālyaduṣṭā tathā dāsī sādhvī māyāvatī tvarā \|\| 298 \|\|*

298\. When Mars, Saturn, Jupiter, Mercury and Venus are posited in a Sign belonging to Mars in a girl’s horoscope, she will be in order (1) spoiled in girlhood, (2) a slave, (3) virtuous, (4) cunning, and (5) immoral.

## \|\| 1.55.299 \|\|

*dṛṣṭā vākṛtiśīlā syāttayorojasthayormatā \|*  
*atha pāpā guṇonāśca pāpavīkṣitayostayoḥ \|\| 299 \|\|*

299\. When the Lagna and the Moon are in odd Signs, the girl will have the character and physical features corresponding to those of the planet owning the Sign, or be wicked. She will be sinful and devoid of virtues, when these two are aspected by malefics.191

## \|\| 1.55.300 \|\|

*duṣṇavāk punarbhūḥ saguṇā vijñā khyātā sphujidgrṛhe \|*  
*baudhe samā yā klīvā ca satī guṇavatī calā \|\| 300 \|\|*

300\. When the five planets mentioned above (viz. Mars, Saturn, Jupiter, Mercury and Venus) are posited in a Rashi owned by Venus, the respective effects would be (1) foul-tongued, (2) one remarried, (3) virtuous, (4) a scholar and (5) famous. In a house owned by Mercury the effects are: (1) deceitful, (2) impotent, (3) a devout wife, (4) virtuous, and (5) of wandering habit or fickle-minded.122

## \|\| 1.55.301 \|\|

*dvandvabhe svairiṇīśadhnī guṇāḍhyā śilpikādhamā \|*  
*vācāṭā kulaṭā siṃhe rāgī pundhīragamyatā \|\| 301 \|\|*

301\. When these planets are in Gemini (Mithuna), she will be (1) a harlot, (2) killer of her husband, (3) virtuous, (4) artisan (artiste) and (5)ignoble. In Sirhha the effects are: (1) talkative, (2) a concubine, (3) passionate, (4) of masculine disposition, and (5) ugly? (or unapproachable?).128

## \|\| 1.55.302 \|\|

*jaive guṇāḍhyālparatirguṇajñā jñāninī satī \|*  
*dāsī nīcaratā sādhvī mānde duṣṭā napatyakā \|\| 302 \|\|*

302\. In a house of Jupiter they are: (1) very virtuous, (2) having very little Sex life, (3) appreciator of merits, (4) learned, and (5) devout wife. In a house of Saturn the effects are: (1) a slave, (2) attached to a low-born person, (3) virtuous or devoted wife, (4) wicked, and (5) barren.

## \|\| 1.55.303-304 \|\|

*lagnenduyuktaisriṃśāṃśaiḥ phalametadvalānugam \|*  
*dṛggaiḥ mithoṃśe śukrārkī śaukre cedvā ghaṭāṃśake \|\| 303 \|\|*

*strībhiḥ strī maithunaṃ yāti madanānaladīpitā \|*  
*śūnye kāpuruṣo dyūne bale klīvo na sadṛśi \|\| 304 \|\|*

303-304. The above-mentioned effects for the Signs of the five planets are also applicable to the Trimtarhfas or de- canate of the stronger of the two viz. Lagna and the Moon, happening to be that of one of the five planets viz. Mars, Saturn, Jupiter, Mercury and Saturn. It Venus and Saturn should occupy each other’s NavarhSa or if Venus be in Kumbha NavdihSa, the woman concerned would get highly inflamed by sexual passion and have sexual congress with members of her own sex. If the 7th house be vacant and weak, the husband would be a despicable person; and if Mercury and Saturn,without receiving any benefic aspect, be posited there, he would be a eunuch. If the 7th house be a movable Sign (and its lord in a movable Sign), the husband would always be in a foreign country.

## \|\| 1.55.305-306 \|\|

*budhārkyoścarabhe nityaṃ paradeśaparāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*tatsṛṣṭā madage sūrye strībālavidhavā kuje \|\| 305 \|\|*

*pāpadṛṣṭe śanau dyūne kanyaivāpadyate jarām \|*  
*āgneyairvidhavāstasthaiḥ punarbhūmiśrakairbhaghavet \|\| 306 \|\|*

305-306. If Sun be in the 7th house, she would be deserted by her husband; if Mars, a virgin widow; if Saturn, aspected by a malefic, she remains a spinster throughout her life; if powerful malefics, a widow; and if both malefics and benefics, a widow who is remarried.124

## \|\| 1.55.307 \|\|

*krūre hīnabale 'stasthe patityaktā na sadṛśi \|*  
*mithoṃśagaiḥ sitārau tu kuruto 'nyaratāṃ striyam \|\| 307 \|\|*

307\. When a weak malefic occupies the 7th house, the woman is abandoned by her husband, unless the malefic is aspected by benefics. When Venus and Mars occupy each other’s Amshas, the woman becomes another’s mistress.125

## \|\| 1.55.308-309 \|\|

*śītaraśmiryadā dyūne tadā bharturanusayā \|*  
*saurārarkṣe lagnagate seṃduśukre tu vandhakī \|\| 308 \|\|*

*mātrā sārddhamasaddṛṣṭe tathā kaujeṃśake 'stage \|*  
*mandadṛṣṭe vyādhiyoniḥ sadgrahāṃśe patipriyā \|\| 309 \|\|*

308-309. When the Moon (also) is in the 7th house (in addition to Mars and Venus), she goes astray with the approval of her husband. If the Lagna be a Sign owned by Saturn or Mars and be occupied by the Moon and Venus, she would be a harlot. If in this yoga there is also malefic aspect on the Lagna, she goes astray along with her mother. If the Amsa of the 7th house is owned by Mars and aspected by Saturn, her genital organ will be diseased. On the other hand, if the Amsha belongs to a benefic, she would be loved by her husband.126

## \|\| 1.55.310-311 \|\|

*mandarkṣe vāṃśake dyūne vṛddhau mūrkhaḥ patiḥ striyāḥ \|*  
*strīlolaḥ krodhanaḥ kauje baudhe vidvāṃśca naipuṇaḥ \|\| 310 \|\|*

*jitendriyo gṛṇījaive cāndre kāmī mṛdustathā \|*  
*śaukre saubhāgyayukkāntaḥ saureti mṛdukarmakṛt \|\| 311 \|\|*

310-311. If the 7th house or its Amsha is owned by Saturn, the husband will be a foolish old fellow; if by Mars, he will be hot-tempered and libidinous; if by Mercury, learned and skilful; if by Jupiter, virtuous and self-controlled; if by the Moon, lustful and tender; if by Venus, attractive and charming;and if by the Sun, one doing very gentle deeds.137

## \|\| 1.55.312 \|\|

*śukrābjayorlagnagayoḥ sukhinīrṣyāsamanvitā \|*  
*jñedvoḥ kalāsu nipuṇā sukhitā ca guṇānvitā \|\| 312 \|\|*

312\. When Venus and the Moon occupy the Lagna, she becomes happy but envious; and when Mercury and the Moon, proficient in fine arts, happy and virtuous.

## \|\| 1.55.313 \|\|

*śukrajñayostu śubhagā kalājñā rucirāṅganā \|*  
*anekasaukhyārthaguṇālagne saumyatraye sthite \|\| 313 \|\|*

313\. If Venus and Mercury should occupy the ascendant, the woman would be exceedingly charming, attractive and skilled in fine arts. When there are three benefics in the Lagna, she will command immense wealth and happiness as well as virtues.

## \|\| 1.55.314 \|\|

*krūre 'ṣṭame 'ṣṭameśāṃśe yasya syāttadvayaḥ same \|*  
*vaidhavyaṃ ca mṛtistasyā svayaṃsatsvarthageṣu tu \|\| 314 \|\|*

314\. A woman would be widowed during the Dasa (major period) of the malefic planet occupying the 8th house or of the planet occupying the Amsa of the lord of the 8th house. Still she herself will predecease her husband, in case there are benefics in the second house.

## \|\| 1.55.315-317 \|\|

*alpāpatyatvamabje 'syāḥ kanyāliharigoṣu tu \|*  
*saure madhyabale candraśukrajñairbalavarjitaiḥ \|\| 315 \|\|*

*śeṣaiḥ savīryairojarkṣe lagne kurūpiṇī bhavet \|*  
*jīvārakaviśaumyeṣu baliṣu samabhe tanau \|\| 316 \|\|*

*vikhyātānaikaśāstrajñā vanitā brahmavādinī \|*  
*pāpe 'ste navamasthasya pravrajyāmeti bhāminī \|\| 317 \|\|*

315-317. A woman will have few children, if at her birth the Moon occupies Капуй\> Vrshcika\> Sirfiha or Vrshabha identical with the 5th house. A woman becomes ugly, if the Lagna is an odd Rashi, Saturn moderately strong, the Moon, Mercury and Venus weak, and the rest strong. She becomes famous, learned in many Sastras and a philosopher, when the Lagna is an even Sign and Jupiter, Mars, Venus and Mercury strong. She takes to asceticism of the type corresponding to the planet posited in the house, when there is a malefic in the 7th house.

## \|\| 1.55.318-319 \|\|

*udvāhe varaṇe praśne sarvametadvicintayet \|*  
*mṛtyusthānaṃ paśyatāṃ syādvalinā dhātukopataḥ \|\| 318 \|\|*

*nṛṇāṃ mṛtyuhitaṃ yuktaṃ bhagātrosthopathabhūribhiḥ \|*  
*savīryairbahujo 'gnyakṣatajvararugudbhavaḥ \|\| 319 \|\|*

318-319. All these things (mentioned above regarding a girl’s horoscope) should be considered before marriage or electing a partner or at a query regarding the same. (Now about the cause of death of a person), death should be declared to be caused by the vitiation of the paticular physical constituents belonging to the strongest of the planets aspecting the 8th house. If the seven planets beginning with the Sim are posited in strength in the 8th house, the causes of death are in order: (1) Fire, (2) Water, (3) Wound caused by a weapon, (4) Fever, (5) Disease, (6) Excessive thirst and (7) Inordinate hunger.18

## \|\| 1.55.320-321 \|\|

*tṛṭkṣudbhavaścāṣṭamasthaiḥ sūryādyaiśca varādiṣu \|*  
*parasvādhvapradeśeṣu mṛtyuḥ sūryamahījayoḥ \|\| 320 \|\|*

*svabandhusthitayoḥ puṃsaḥ śailāgnābhirutasya ca \|*  
*bandhvastakarmagairmandabhūjaiḥ prahau mṛtiḥ \|\| 321 \|\|*

320-321. If the 8th house (as well as its lord) be in a movable, fixed or dual house, the end occurs in a far-off place from one’s own house, or on the way, as the case may be. When the Sun and Mars occupy the 2nd and 4th house respectively, the death is caused by a fall from the top of a mountain, and when Saturn, the Moon and Mars are in the 4th, 7th and 10th houses in order, by a fall into a well.12®

## \|\| 1.55.322 \|\|

*striyāṃ himoṣaaṇakarayoḥ svajanātpāpadṛktayoḥ \|*  
*toyamṛto ravīdṛtusyātāṃyā dyubhayodaye \|\| 322 \|\|*

322\. One dies at the hands of one’s own kinsmen, if the two luminaries occupy Virgo (Kanyd) and receive malefic aspect. A person gets a watery grave, if the luminaries occupy the ascendant that is a dual Sign.130

## \|\| 1.55.323 \|\|

*śastrāgnijośubhāntasthe candre bhaumagṛhagasthite \|*  
*mṛtyuścātha mṛge candre karke mande jalodarāt \|\| 323 \|\|*

323\. If the Moon occupying a Sign owned by Mars is hemmed in between malefics, death is by fire or weapon; and if she be in Makara and Saturn in Катка, by dropsy.

## \|\| 1.55.324 \|\|

*striyāmindau raktaśauthātsaure vājvagnipātajaḥ \|*  
*putradharmasthasyorvandhātpāpayoḥ sadadṛṣṭayoḥ \|\| 324 \|\|*

324\. If the Moon be in Kanya under the above mentioned condition, death would be through vitiation of blood or swelling in the body; and if it be Saturn, it is due to fire, hanging or a fall. If there be malefics both in the 5th and 9th houses without receiving any benefic aspect, death would take place in captivity.111

## \|\| 1.55.325-327 \|\|

*sathāsaśaṃyanigaḍairdṛkairmṛtyau tu bandhanaiḥ \|*  
*striyāṃ sapāpe 'bje dyūne site meṣe ravau tanau \|\| 325 \|\|*

*maraṇaṃ strīkṛte gehe hyatha turye kuje ravau \|*  
*yame kheṃ'gatrikoṇarstheḥ kṣīṇacandrāṃśubhaiḥ sakṛt \|\| 326 \|\|*

*turyer'ke khe kujekṣīṇa candradṛṣṭe samiddhataḥ \|*  
*randhrakhāṅgajalaiḥ kṣīṇendvārārkiravisaṃyutaiḥ \|\| 327 \|\|*

325-327. If the decanate of the 8th house happens to be Noose, Serpent or Fetters, death will be in prison. If the Moon along with malefics be in Virgo (Kanyd) which is the 7th house, Venus in Mesa and the Sun in the ascendant, death would take place at home as a result of womens’ intrigues. If the Sun or Mars be in the 4th house, Saturn in the 10th and the weak Moon conjoined with malefics in the Lagna, 5th or 9th house, death would be through impalement (?). Death would be in the battle-field, if the Sun be in the 4th and Mars in the 10th aspect- ed by the weak Moon. One will be beaten to death with clubs, if the 1st, 10th, 8th and 4th arc occupied by the weak Moon, Mars, Saturn and the Sun respectively.182

## \|\| 1.55.328 \|\|

*lakuṭenātha taireva khāṅkāṅgatanayasthitaiḥ \|*  
*dhūmānibandhanaiḥ kāryaḥ kudanairmaraṇaṃ bhavet \|\| 328 \|\|*

328\. If the above four planets viz. weak Moon, Mars, Saturn and the Sun be posited in the 10th, 9th, 1st and 5th house, death is due to suffocation by smoke, fire, imprisonment or beating183.

## \|\| 1.55.329 \|\|

*bandhvastakhasthairbhauṃmārkarmadaiḥ śastrāgniṃrājabhiḥ \|*  
*sauredvāraiḥ svāṃburavasthaiḥ kṣatakremyaṅgayā tataḥ \|\| 329 \|\|*

329\. When the 4th, 7th and 10th houses are occupied by Mars, the Sun and Saturn respectively, death is due to weapons, fire or king’s displeasure. When Saturn, the Moon and Mars are in the 2nd, 4th and 10th houses respectively, it is due to wounds or worms or a fall from a tree.134

## \|\| 1.55.330 \|\|

*sver'ke turye kuje yānapātādatha kuje 'stage \|*  
*yantrosīdunataḥ kṣīṇacandrayukte mṛtirbhavet \|\| 330 \|\|*

330\. If the Sun be in the 2nd house and Mars in the 4th, death is due to a fall from a vehicle; if, in the above yoga, Mars be in the 7th house along with the weak Moon, it is by the destruction of a machine.136

## \|\| 1.55.331 \|\|

*bhaumārkiśītakiraṇairjūkājaśanibhasthiteḥ \|*  
*kṣīṇendvarkakujaiḥ khāstāṃbusthairvārakare mṛtiḥ \|\| 331 \|\|*

331\. When Mars, Saturn and the Moon are in Libra, Aries and a sign belonging to Saturn respectively, or when the weak Moon, the Sun and Mars are in the 10th, 7th and 4th house respectively, it is in the midst of filth and night-soil.

## \|\| 1.55.332 \|\|

*balyāradṛṣṭe kṣīṇendau mande nidhaṃnasaṃsthite \|*  
*guhyarukkṛmiśastrāgnidārujo mṛtyuraṅgirāḥ \|\| 332 \|\|*

332\. If the weak Moon be aspectcd by the powerful Mars, and Saturn be in the 8th house, the cause of death will be some disease of the privities, worms (basilli), weapons, fire or wood.

## \|\| 1.55.333 \|\|

*saurer'ke 'ste mṛto mande kṣīṇendau bhuvyasaṃyute \|*  
*lagnadhyāyāsta paḥkhārkabhaumacandraniśākaraiḥ \|\| 333 \|\|*

333\. When Saturn is in the 7th, the Sun in the 8th, and the weak Moon conjoined with Mars in a house of Saturn; or when the Sun, Mars, Saturn, and the Moon arc posited in the 1st, 5th, 11th, and 7th respectively, the native will die as a result of a fall from the top of a mountain or tree.130

## \|\| 1.55.334-335 \|\|

*śailaśṛṅgasvarugrapātaunurnidhanaṃ bhavet \|*  
*dṛkkonttare turddhāviṃśastatpatirmṛtyupopi vā \|\| 334 \|\|*

*svaguṇairnidha na kuryādbalavānyo dvayorbhavet \|*  
*lagnāṃśeśasadṛksthāne mṛtyuryogekṣaṇādibhiḥ \|\| 335 \|\|*

334-335. Death will be caused by the stronger of the two planets viz. the lord of the 22nd decanate and the lord of the 8th house, through, his characteristic disease or agency. Death of a person will take place in a place corresponding to the lord of the Am fa occupied by the ascendant, this being influenced by the aspect and conjunction of other planets.187

## \|\| 1.55.336 \|\|

*modāentenuditāṃśasya tulyo dvighnaḥ svapekṣite \|*  
*śubhekṣite tu triguṇaḥ kalpyamanyatsvabuddhitaḥ \|\| 336 \|\|*

336\. The period of unconsciousness of the dying person will correspond to the Am fas of the Lagna that have not yet risen. If it (Lagna) is aspected by its lord, the period in to be doubled; if by a benefic, to be trebled; and ifbymorebenefics, it should be increased proportionately through one’s intelligence.188

## \|\| 1.55.337 \|\|

*vahnyaṃpabubhasmasakledaśoṣavyālairmṛtisthitaiḥ \|*  
*bindutaścintanīyaśca yathokto matyuraṅginaḥ \|\| 337 \|\|*

337\. If the decanate of the 8th house be Fiery, the dead body would be burnt to ashes; if Aquatic, thrown to the waters, and if Serpent, dried by being exposed to the Sun and wind. These results are to be read from the 8th house counted from the Moon as well.189

## \|\| 1.55.338 \|\|

*guruḥ śaśāṅkaśukrau ca sūryabhaumau yamendujau \|*  
*devapitratiraktotha nārakānkuryuraṣṭame \|\| 338 \|\|*

338\. If Jupiter be in the 8th house, the departed soul would go to the world of Gods; if the Moon or Venus, to the world of the Manes; if the Sun or Mars, to that of mortals (?); and if Saturn or Mercury, to the infernal regions.140

## \|\| 1.55.339 \|\|

*ravīndubalavaśraṃśanāthācchreṣṭasamādhamāḥ \|*  
*tuṅgagaḥ sāṃdanūkenugatiḥ ṣaḍrandhradṛkkapaḥ \|\| 339 \|\|*

339\. The previous world of a soul can be read from the lord of the decanate occupied by the stronger of the two viz. the Sun and the Moon. The world must have been very high or exalted, if the concerned luminary is in its exaltation; moderate, if in its own house; and tow, if in debilitation.141

## \|\| 1.55.340 \|\|

*dyūnasthito gururvāpi ripukendravināśagaḥ \|*  
*svoccasthoṃ'ge vyaye saumyabhāge mokṣo balānyataḥ \|\| 340 \|\|*

340\. If the lord of the decanate of the 6th or 8th house occupies the 7th house, or if Jupiter occupies the 6th, a kendra or 8th house, or if he is in his exaltation, identical with the Lagna or the 12th house or in a benefic Amsha, possessed of strength, the soul attains emancipation.142

## \|\| 1.55.341 \|\|

*ādhāne janmā jñāne tu vṛkṣatāṃ lagnato vadet \|*  
*pūrvāparārddhairlagnasya saumye vācyapanejaniḥ \|\| 341 \|\|*

341\. When neither the time of impregnation nor that of birth is known, the life of querists has to be predicted from the ascendant at the query. The solstices of birth has to be deduced from the two halves or Horas of the ascendant, the first standing for the winter solstice, and the second for the summer one.148

## \|\| 1.55.342 \|\|

*lagnatrikoṇe dhījyatryaṃśairvikalpāvayavāḥ samāḥ \|*  
*grīṣmoger'ke parai ramyāpanatāṃpṛturarkabhāt \|\| 342 \|\|*

342\. The age of the person (who asks for a Naftajataka as a result of his not knowing his date and time of birth) should be read from the ages of the lords of the Trines counted from the Lagna, or from the (lord of) Ariisa (or decanate) occupied by Jupiter. The. season of birth would be summer, if the Sun be in the Lagna. Similarly, the presence of other planets in it would indicate other seasons. Or it may be read from the Sign occupied by the Sun.144

## \|\| 1.55.343 \|\|

*candrajñajīvāvṛtyasyāḥ śukrārārkibhiranyathā \|*  
*dṛkkairādyaiḥ pūrvamāsastithistatrānupātataḥ \|\| 343 \|\|*

343\. The Moon, Mercury and Jupiter are to be interchanged with Venus, Mars and Saturn respectively, if necessary. If the decanate of the planet concerned that determines the season is the initial one of the Sign, the month of the season (Rpi) should be the first. The lunar day should be found out proportionately.146

## \|\| 1.55.344 \|\|

*vilomajanma bhāgaiśca velā rātridyusaṃjñake \|*  
*trikoṇottamavārthantilagnaṃ vā labhanābhane \|\| 344 \|\|*

344\. If the Lagna of query be a nocturnal Sign, the ascendant at birth must be a diurnal one, and vice versa: and the time elapsed from sunrise or sunset should be read from the degrees elapsed. If the lord of the Lagna be in a Trikona or be possessed of great strength, the Lagna of birth would correspond to the star ruling at the time of query (?).148

## \|\| 1.55.345-347 \|\|

*yāvadūno vidhurlagnāttāvaccandrācca janmabhe \|*  
*goharī yugmavasubhe kriyajuke mṛgāṅgane \|\| 345 \|\|*

*daśāṣṭasaptaviṣaye guṇyāḥ śeṣāḥ khasaṃkhyayā \|*  
*jīvabhaumakavijñāḥ syu rāghavādyāyarejñavat \|\| 346 \|\|*

*bhānāṃ nityo vidhiḥ kheṭavaśāvaddhargaṇāstathā \|*  
*saptarghnaṃ bhahṛtaṃ śeṣamṛkṣaṃ navadhanarṇataḥ \|\| 347 \|\|*

345-347. Subtract the longitude of the Moon from the position of the ascendant at query. The natal ascendant would be so far removed from the Moon at query as is represented by the balance. Multiply Vrshabha and Sirfiha by 10; Mithuna and Vrkika by 8; Mesa and Tula by 7; Makara and Капуй by 5; and the remaining Rasis viz. Karka, Dhanus, Kumbha and Mina by their respective numbers. Jupiter, Mars, Venus and Mercury are to be increased (?) by 3, 1, 11 and 11 respectively. The calculation of the lunar mansion (Nitya- naksaira) as well as of the Ahargana (the total number of days elapsed), is done by multiplying it by 7 and dividing by 27. The remainder will give the Nakshatra in question.147

## \|\| 1.55.348 \|\|

*dvighne samartumāsāḥ syuḥ pakṣatithyau gajāhate \|*  
*saptaghnaṃ honiśārkṣāṇīṣughneṅgāṃśeṣṭahorikā \|\| 348 \|\|*

348\. By adding to or subtracting from the above shown result, 9, double the figure. You get the year, season and month. The fortnight and lunar day are got by multiplying it by 8. The same being multiplied by 7 will yield the day, night and asterism; and being multiplied by 5, the degree of the ascendant as well as the time of birth in Ghafis.14й

## \|\| 1.55.349 \|\|

*pumānparaśudhṛkkṛṣṇo raktadṛgrakṣituṃ kṣamaḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭartikapadāśvāsyā raktavastrā ghaṭākṛtiḥ \|\| 349 \|\|*

349\. The following are the characteristics of the first, second and third decanates of Mesha (Aries): (1) It is a man holding an axe, dark in complexion, with red eyes, and capable of protecting others. (2) It is a woman wearing red garments, pot-like in shape, with canine face, ugly feet and sore (?) eyes. (3) It is a man, of brown complexion, blind, cruel, wearing red cloths, and who has broken his vow or promise.149

## \|\| 1.55.350-351 \|\|

*kapilo hyandhadṛkrūro raktavastraḥ kṣatavrataḥ \|*  
*kṣuttṛṣārtodugdhapaṭo lūnakuñcitamūrdhajaḥ \|\| 350 \|\|*

*malinaḥ kṣutparojāsyo dakṣaḥ kṛṣyādikarmaṇi \|*  
*dvipakāyaḥ sarabhayātpiṃpagalo vyākulāntaraḥ \|\| 351 \|\|*

350-351. Those of the decanates of Taurus (Vrshabha) are: (1) A man oppressed by hunger and thirst, wearing singed clothes, and with his trimmed hair hanging. (2) Man, hungry, dirty, with a goat-like face, but clever in agriculture etc. (3) Man with an elephantine body, impatient (hurrying), pink in complexion, and with a perplexed mind,150

## \|\| 1.55.352 \|\|

*śaucikīrūpiṇī sādhvī hyaprajocchritapāṇikā \|*  
*udyāne kavacī dhanvī krīḍecchargaruḍānanaḥ \|\| 352 \|\|*

352\. Those of the decanates of Gemini (Mithuna), are: (1) A woman engaged in needle-work, beautiful, chaste, issueless and with raised hands. (2) A man in a garden wearing armour, holding a bow, intent on sport, and with an aquiline face. (3) A man well-versed in dance and other fine arts, holding a bow, and possessing a vast treasure of gems like Varuna.

## \|\| 1.55.353-354 \|\|

*nṛtyādividvaruṇavadbahuratnodhanurdharaḥ \|*  
*dvipāsyakaṇṭhaḥ kroḍāsyaḥ kānaneśaramāhikaḥ \|\| 353 \|\|*

*ātavyaśākhāṃ pālāśī rauti mūrddhāhikarkaśā \|*  
*cipiṭāsyo hi saṃvīto nausthaḥ ratryarthaṃvrajañjale \|\| 354 \|\|*

353-354. The characteristics of the decanates of Cancer (Катка) are: (1) A man with an elephantine face and neck, or with hog’s face, standing in a forest and shooting arrows (or hunting Sarabhas and snakes). (2) A woman, who is very coarse from head downwards (or who is coarse and has a snake on her head), and who shrieks holding the branch of a Palasa tree. (3) A man with a flat face, having a serpent coiling round his body, and sailing in a boat for the sake of a woman.161

## \|\| 1.55.355 \|\|

*śvā naro jaṃbukaṃ gṛdhraṃ gṛhītvā rauti śālmalau \|*  
*dhanvī kṛṣṇājinī siṃhavāśvonnatamāturaḥ \|\| 355 \|\|*

355\. The characteristics of the decanates of Leo (Sirfiha) are: (1) A monkey (or a man with a dog) who has caught an eagle and jackal, cries aloud on (or near) a silk- cotton tree. (2) A man, holding a bow, wearing the skin of an antelope, roars aloud like a lion, and is sickly. (3) A man with a beard, with a bear’s face, acting like a monkey, and destroying (for) fruits and meat.152

## \|\| 1.55.356-357 \|\|

*phalāmiṣaghnaḥ kūrjīnā bhallāsyaḥ kapiceṣṭitaḥ \|*  
*puṣpapūrṇacchaṭākanyāvidyellā malināṃvarā \|\| 356 \|\|*

*dhanvī vyayāpakṛcchyāmo lipikṛdrāmaśonaraḥ \|*  
*gaurīdhautāṃśukātsuccākuṃbhadṛstāsurālaye \|\| 357 \|\|*

356-357. Those of the decanates of Virgo (Konya) are: (1) A girl in unclean clothes, wearing lots of flowers on her locks, (2) A bowman, harming and causing loss to others, dark, a writer, and hairy. (3) A very tall woman of golden complexion, wearing clean, washed clothes, holding a pot in her hand, in a temple.153

## \|\| 1.55.358 \|\|

*mānonmānpāpasotaulībhāṇḍamutpavicintakaḥ \|*  
*kṣuttṛṅyuto naraḥ kuṃbhīgṛdhnasya strīsutopagaḥ \|\| 358 \|\|*

358\. The characteristics of the decanates of Libra (Tula) are: (1) A man engaged in weighing with a balance and measuring commodities in a shop, thinking of the prices of articles (or costly things); (2) A man oppressed by hunger and thirst, holding a pot, with an aquiline face, and accompanied by wife and children. (3) An archer, wearing a golden armour, behaving like a Kinnara (a semidivine being with a horse’s face), and pursuing an animal (or deer).

## \|\| 1.55.359-360 \|\|

*dhanvīkintaraceṣṭastuhaimavarmāmṛgānugaḥ \|*  
*siṃdhekūjaṃvrajantīstrīnānāsarpasita hikā \|\| 359 \|\|*

*saukhyaspṛhāhyāvṛttāṅgībhatrarthakacchapākṛtiḥ \|*  
*kūrmāsyo malaye siṃhaḥ śvakroṇḍamṛgabhīṣakaḥ \|\| 360 \|\|*

359-360. The decanates of Scorpio (VfSeiko) are represented by (1) a woman seated on a lion (?) going to a well, with many snakes curling round her legs; (2) a woman, having husband and wealth (or for the sake of her husband), with the form of a tortoise, with her body covered with serpents, and yearning for happiness; and (3) a man having the face of a tortoise and hunting lions, dogs, hogs and deer.164

## \|\| 1.55.361 \|\|

*vāsyaḥ śvakāyo dhānuṣko raṅkṣastāpasayajñiye \|*  
*caṃpakābhāsane madhyā siṃdhuratravivarddhinī \|\| 361 \|\|*

361\. Those of Sagittarius (.Dhanus) are represented by (1) a boy with the body of a dog (or a man with a tail and horse’s body), holding a bow, and protecting ascetics and sacrificial performances; (2) a middle-aged woman seated on a seat bedecked with Campaka-flowers, and opening a lion’s mouth (or, looking after elephants); and (3) a man with the complexion of Campaka, seated on a straw seat, holding a rod in a forest of KuSa grass (or, having a piece of silk over his face).166

## \|\| 1.55.362-363 \|\|

*kūrmāsane caṃpakābho daṇḍī kauśeyakāninī \|*  
*paramo 'tho gṛdhramukhaḥ snehamadyāśanaspṛhaḥ \|\| 362 \|\|*

*dagdhānasthā lohadharā sabhūṣābhāñjakaccarā \|*  
*bhāṇḍī romaścavāḥ śyāmaḥ kirīṭī phalayantradhṛk \|\| 363 \|\|*

362-363. The decanates of Capricorn (Makara) are the following: — (1) A man with an aquiline face, holding an axe (?), and eager for oils, wine and food. (2) A woman who has been burnt (?), holding iron, and having ornaments, valuable things or pots and dirty things. (3) A man full of treasures or pots, with hairy ears, dark in complexion, wearing a crown, and holding fruits and machines in his hands.166

## \|\| 1.55.364-365 \|\|

*nausthodhvosaṃvibhūṣārntha nānāratnakarāeñcitaḥ \|*  
*nausthabdheḥ kūlamāyāntī sayūthāṃ campakānanā \|\| 364 \|\|*

*garte sarpāvṛto nagno rudaṃścaurānalārditaḥ \|*  
*etādṛśāṅkriyāṃśāḥ stu ṣatriṃśadudītāḥ kramāt \|\| 365 \|\|*

364-365. The decanates of Aquarius (Kumbha) are the following: — (I) A man seated in boat, with his hands adorned with all kinds of gems, who is anxious for collecting ornaments and decorative articles; (2) a woman sailing in a boat towards the shore, whose face is like the Campaka flower (in colour), and who is followed by her retinue; and (3)a naked man coiled by a serpent sitting in a cavern and weeping, as he is troubled by robbers and fire. These are the 36 decanates that have been delineated in proper sequence.167

## \|\| 1.55.366 \|\|

*etatsaṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ jātakaṃ munisattama \|*  
*nibodha saṃhitāskandhaṃ lokakṛtyupayoginam \|\| 366 \|\|*

366\. О great Sage, in this manner horoscopy has been expounded to you succinctly. Now you will know the branch of astrology known as Samhita-Skandha (a compilation of ail useful thinking which is highly beneficial for worldly activities.

## Chapter 56. Natural Astrology

## \|\| 1.56.1-3 \|\|

*sanandana uvāca*  
*kramāñcaitrādimāseṣu meṣādyāḥ saṃkramā matāḥ \|*  
*caitraśuklapratipadi yo vāraḥ sa nṛpaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*meṣapraveśe senānīḥ karkaṭe sasyayo bhavet \|*  
*samodyadhīśvaraḥ sūryo madhyamaścottamovidhuḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*neṣṭaḥ kujo budho jīvo bhṛgustvatiśubhaṅkaraḥ \|*  
*adhamo ravijo vācyo jñātvā caiṣāṃ balābalam \|\| 3 \|\|*

Sanandana said:

1-2a. Lord of the year etc. (In one year), the Sun transits into (the twelve) rdHs (or signs of the Zodiac) Aries (Mesha) etc.1 during the (twelve) months beginning with Chaitra etc.2 The King of the year is (the lord of) the week-day of the first day of the bright fortnight of the month of Chaitra. The Commander of the year is (the lord of the week-day on which) the Sun transits into the sign of Aries and the Lord of Vegetation is (the lord of the week-day) on which the Sun transits into the sign Cancer, Казака.

2b-3. As the Lord of the year, the Sun is of middling benefit while the Moon would be extremely beneficial. Mars is not beneficial but Mercury, Jupiter and Venus are highly beneficial. Saturn is least beneficial of all. In due consideration of the strength or otherwise of these (planets) should be indicated the general benefice of the year. SUN: RAVICARA

## \|\| 1.56.4 \|\|

*daṇḍākāre kabandhe vā dhvāṅkṣākāre 'tha kīlake \|*  
*dṛṣṭer'kamaṇḍale vyādhirbhrāntiścorārthanāśanam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Significance of snn-spots. Spots on the Sun of the shapes of a rod, corpse, crow and pillar, respectively, portend, (to the king), disease, turbulance, (trouble from) thieves and loss of wealth.

## \|\| 1.56.5 \|\|

*chatradhvajapatākādyasannibhastimitairdhvanaiḥ \|*  
*varimaṇḍalagairdhūmraiḥ sasphuliṅgairjagatkṣayaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. (Sun-spots of the shape of) the umbrella, chaurie, banner, rain-cloud, smoke and sparks, portend the destruction of the land.

## \|\| 1.56.6 \|\|

*sitaraktaiḥ pītakṛṣṇairvaṇairviprādipīḍanam \|*  
*ghnanti dvitricaturvarṇairbhuvi rājajanānmune \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Osage: If these spots are, respectively, white, red, yellow or black in colour they will afflict the four castes Brah- mins, Kfotriyas, Vaifyas and Sudras. If they appear in two or three of these colours, they will afflict the royalty.

## \|\| 1.56.7 \|\|

*ūrddhairbhānukaraistāmrairnāśa yāti camūpatiḥ \|*  
*pītairnṛpasutaḥ śvetaiḥ purodhāścitritairjanāḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Significance of the Sun's beams. If the (upward) beams emanating from the top of the Sun’s disc are reddish, the commander of the army will die, if the beams be yellow, the prince, if white, the chief priest, and if variegated the people.

## \|\| 1.56.8-9 \|\|

*dhūmrairnṛpapiśaṅgaistu jaladādhomukhairjagat \|*  
*śubhor'kaḥ śiśire tāmraḥ kuṅkumābhā vasaṃtike \|\| 8 \|\|*

*grīṣmaścāpāṇḍuraścaiva vicitro jaladāgame \|*  
*padmodarābhaḥ śaradi hemante lohitacchaviḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

8a. If the downward beams are dark, they foretell disaster to the king and if reddish yellow, to the clouds (indicating rainlessness).

8b-9. The Sun's hue. The Sun is auspicious in fitira, the cool season, if copper-red, in spring if saffron-hued, in summer if greyish, in the rainy season if variegated, in autumn if lotus- red, and in winter if crimson-coloured.

## \|\| 1.56.10 \|\|

*pītaḥ śīte vṛṣṭau grīṣme lohitabhāraviḥ \|*  
*rogānāvṛṣṭibhayakṛt kramādukto munīśvara \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. If the Sun be yellowish, bright-white and crimson, respectively, in winter, rainy season and summer, it portends, О sage: diseases, drought and calamities.

## \|\| 1.56.11 \|\|

*indracāpārddhamūrtistu bhānurbhūpavirodhakṛt \|*  
*śaśaraktanibhe bhānau saṃgrāmo na cirādbhuvi \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. A sun appearing in a rainbow causes a fight between kings. And, if the Sun appears with hue of the hare’s blood, there will ensue shortly a world war.

## \|\| 1.56.12 \|\|

*mayūrapatra saṃkāśo dvādaśābdaṃ na varṣati \|*  
*candramāsadṛśo bhānuḥ kuryādbhūpāntaraṃ kṣitau \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. If the Sun appears with the hue of the peacock’s feather, there will be no rains for twelve years. A moon-like Sun will cause the replacement of the king of the land.

## \|\| 1.56.13 \|\|

*arke śyāme kīṭabhayaṃ bhasmābhe rāṣṭrajaṃ tathā \|*  
*chidrer'kamaṇḍale dṛṣṭaṃ mahārājavināśanam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. If the Sun is darkish, there would be fear from locusts and, if greyish like ash, there would be contrywide distress. When a hole is seen in the Sun’s disc an emperor will die.

## \|\| 1.56.14 \|\|

*ghaṭākṛtiḥ kṣudbhayakṛtpurahā toraṇākṛtiḥ \|*  
*chatrākṛte deśahatiḥ khaṇḍabhānunṛpāntakṛt \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Orb of the Sun. (The Sun’s orb) appearing like a pot will cause famine (in the country); if like an arch it will cause the destruction of the capital; and, if like an umbrella, the destruction of the country. A split Sun will cause the death of the monarch.

## \|\| 1.56.15 \|\|

*udayāstamaye kāle vidyudulkāśaniryadi \|*  
*tadā nṛpavadho jñeyastvathavā rājavigrahaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. If at sunrise or at sunset, there occur (against the sun’s disc) lightning, meteor and thunder, then, one can fortell the death of the king or fight between kings.

## \|\| 1.56.16 \|\|

*pakṣaṃ pakṣārddhamarkendupariviṣṭāvaharniśam \|*  
*rājānamanyaṃ kuruto lohitāmbudayāstagau \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. If for a fortnight or half a fortnight, the Sun and the Moon appear with a halo around (fiariwa), both day and night, it will cause the replacement of the king, which will happen, also if they appear crimson at rising and setting (during the said period).

## \|\| 1.56.17 \|\|

*udayāstamaye bhānurācchinnaḥ śastrasannibheḥ \|*  
*ghanairyuddhaṃ kharoṣṭrādyaiḥ pāparūpairbhayapradam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. If the Sun is obscured at sunrise and at sunset by clouds having the shape of weapons, there will be war; and, (if those clouds have the shape of) sinful animals like the camel, the war would be terrible. THE MOON: CANDRACARA

## \|\| 1.56.18 \|\|

*yāmyaśṛṅgonnattaścandraḥ śubhadī mīnameṣayoḥ \|*  
*saumyaśṛṅgonnataḥ śreṣṭho nṛyuṅmakarayostathā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. In the signs Pisces and Aries, the crescent Moon with the southern horn higher (than the northern horn) is beneficent, while in the signs Gemini and Capricorn, the Moon with the northern horn higher is auspicious.

## \|\| 1.56.19-44 \|\|

*ghaṭokṣṇastu samaḥ karkacāpayoḥ śarasannibhaḥ \|*  
*cāpavatkaurmahṝrṃyośca śūlabattulakarkayoḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*viparītoditaścandro durbhikṣakalahapradaḥ \|*  
*āṣāḍhadvayamūlendradhiṣṇyānāṃ yāmyagaḥ śaśī \|\| 20 \|\|*

*viśākhā mitrayoryāmyapārśvagaḥ pāpagaḥ śaśī \|\| 21 \|\|*

*madhyamaḥ pitṛdaivatye dvidaive saimyagaḥ śaśī \|*  
*aprāpyapauṣṇabhādrāmadukṣāviśaśī śubhaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*madhyagodvāradakṣāṇi atītya navavāsavāt \|*  
*yamendrāhīśanoyeśamarutaścārddhatārakāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*dhruvāditidvidaivāḥ syuradhyarddhāṃścāparāḥ samāḥ \|*

*subhikṣakṛdviśālenduraviśāloghanāśanaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*kujādyairnihate śṛṅge maṇḍale vā yathākramam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*satyāṣṭanavamarkṣeṣu sodayādvikrime kuje \|\| 27 \|\|*

*tadvakramuṣṇaṃsaṃjñaṃ syātprajāpīḍāgnisaṃbhavaḥ \|*
