247-248a. Some destructive Yogas. Bharani on Sunday, Citra on Monday, Uttarasatfha (Visvabha) on Tuesday, Sravisfha on Wednesday, UttaraphalgunI (Aryamabha) on Thursday, Jyestha on Friday and Revatl on Saturday are destructive to one born in the respective asterisms.

248b-249a. Vishakha, Aslesa (Ahi) and Caturvarga are declared as the three asiddhi-yogas, Utpdta, Mrtyu and Kdna, in order, for the days beginning from Sunday.

249b-250a. In other lands like Huna, Vanga aud Khasa, the Yogas calculated on the basis of the lunar day cum week-day are not to be applied, but those calculated on the basis of weekday cum asterisms are auspicious. SAftKRANTI (SUN’S TRANSIT INTO A SIGN)

250b-251a. Week-days and Sahkranti The Sun’s transits (Sad- krdntis) on the several week-days commencing from Sunday are called, respectively, Ghora\> Dhuanksi, Afahodari, Mandd, Mandd- kiniy Miira and Rdkfasikd.

251b-252a. These transits will bring happiness, respectively, to the Sudra, thief, vaisya, brahmana, king, cow and all the beings not included above.

252b-254a. Time of the transits. The Sun’s transit occurring during the forenoon is harmful to the kings, to the brahmanas at noon, to the Vaisyas in the afternoon, to the sudras at sunset, to the ghosts, at dusk, the demons in the night, the actors after midnight, the cowherds at sunrise and the religious students at dawn.

254b-255a. Effects of the Sun's transit into Aries. Meshasankrdnti (Sun’s tratsit into Aries, and, so, the beginning of the year), occurring during day-time is productive of calamity and quarrel; if it occurs during night, there would be sumptuous plenitude; and if it occurs during the twilights, rains will be ruined.

255b-258a. Personification of the Sankrdntis. The personification of the Sankrdntis when they fall in one or the other of the eleven karanasy from Bavay are endowed with the following mounts: Lion, tiger, bear, ass, elephant, buffalo, horse, dog, goat, ox and cock. Weapons carried in their hands are Bhusundi» mace, sword, rod, bow, javelin, pike, rope, hook, missile and arrow, respectively. The food offerings prescribed for them are, respectively, rice, rice cooked in milk, rice obtained by begging, cake, milk, curd, sweet rice, molasses, wine, ghee and sugar.

258b-260a. State of the personifications while in the Karanas. The Sun’s personification is deemed to be ‘sitting’ if the transit occurs in Vanij, Balava, and Gara; it is said to be ‘erect’ (i.e.9 standing) in Kaulava, Sakuna and Kimstuglma; the Sun is supposed to make the transit ‘sleeping’ if it occurs during Catu- spada,Taitila and Naga. (The effect of the said three states) in the matter of the performance of ordained duties, longevity and rains would be medium, excellent and depletion, respectively.

260b-261a. The above-said weapons, mounts and food if adopted by the people will also be beneficial to them, as also their condition as sleeping, sitting or standing (at the time of sankrdnti).

261b-262a. Classification of the asterisms. The asterisms are also classified into four types, designated, respectively, as Andhaka Manda, Madhya and Sulocanay as counted from Rohini.

262b. Vifiiupada. The transit of the Sun into the ‘firm’ astcrisms, (viz., Uttaraphalgunl, Uttarasfujha and Ultarabhadra- pada and RohinI, is called Vifnupada.

## \|\| 1.56.263 \|\|

*ṣaḍaśītimukhā jñeyā dvisvabhāveṣu rāśiṣu \|*  
*tulāghaṭājayorjñeyo viṣuvatsūryasaṃkramaḥ \|\| 263 \|\|*

263\. Sadasitimukha and Vipuvat. The transit of the Sun into the double-natured signs,21 (viz., Mithuna, Konya, Dhanu and Mina) is called Sadasitimukha, while the transit into the signs Tula and Me fa is called Visuvai (Equinox).

## \|\| 1.56.264-265 \|\|

*yāmyāyane sthire tvādyāḥ parāḥ saumyendumūrtibhaiḥ \|*  
*medhyā viṣuvati proktāḥ puṇyanāḍyastu ṣoḍaśa \|\| 264 \|\|*

*saṃdhyā trināḍī pramitārkabiṃborddhodayāstataḥ \|*  
*prākpaścādyāmyasaumye cetpuṇyaṃ pūrvāṃpare 'hani \|\| 265 \|\|*

264a. During the southward course of the Sun (Yamya- yana) the former, (viz., the double natured signs) are firm (sthira in relation to the Moon and the astcrisms, and Cara (‘moving’) in the northward course of the Sun (saumye).

264b-265. Holy time at equinox (Pwjyakala). At the Equinoxes, sixteen ndtfikas (before it and 16 after it, making a total of 32 nadikas are said to be holy nidikas, suitable for meritorious rites. Dusk (sandhya) extends through three nadikds before the rising of the centre of the Sun’s orb (in the moining) and after the setting thereof, in the evening. If (the Sankranti, i.e. Sun’s transit, occurs) before or after midnight, the holy lime, (one half of which is of 15 nadikds), extends through (the afternoon of)the previous day and (the forenoon of) the next day.

## \|\| 1.56.266 \|\|

*yādṛśenendunā bhānoḥ saṃkrāntistādṛśaṃ phalam \|*  
*naraḥ prāpnoti tadrāśau śītāṃśoḥ sādhvasādhu ca \|\| 266 \|\|*

266\. (By performing meritorious rites at the time of sankranti) one reaps results corresponding to the nature of the Sun and the Moon in the relevant sign, according as the Sun or the Moon is benevolent or otherwise.

## \|\| 1.56.267 \|\|

*saṃkrānteḥ parato bhānurbhuktvā yāvadbhiraṃśakaiḥ \|*  
*raverayanasaṃkrāntistadā tadrāśisaṃkramāt \|\| 267 \|\|*

267\. Expiation for Unholy time at Sankrama. Take the degrees that the Sun, after making a transit (into Mesa or Tuld)\> has to go to reach the transit into the ayana; if at one’s birth asterism occurs within that period on eitKshr-jide of the transit into the sign, the two are not auspicious for fasts and marriages. In order to counteract the evil, spread out sesame and draw on it a circle, trident and a triangle, place a bit of gold on it and gift it away.

## \|\| 1.56.268-270 \|\|

*sakrāntigrahagarkṣaṃvā janmanyubhayapārśvayoḥ \|*  
*vratodvāhādikeṣveva dvayaṃ neṣṭaṃ tu tatkramāt \|\| 268 \|\|*

*tiloparilikheccakraṃ tritriśūlaṃ trikoṇakam \|*  
*tatra hema vinikṣipya dadyāddoṣāpavṛttayeḥ \|\| 269 \|\|*

*tārābalena śītāṃśurbalavāṃstadvaśādraviḥ \|*  
*balī saṃkramamāṇastu tadvatkheṭā balādhikāḥ \|\| 270 \|\|*

268-270. Power of Sankrama. The Moon is strong on account of the strength of the asterisms and the Sun at transit is strong on account of the Moon. In the same manner, the planets are also strong (at the time of the Sun’s transit). GOCARA (CURRENT MOTION OF THE PLANETS)

## \|\| 1.56.271 \|\|

*śubhor'ke janmatastryāyadaśaṣaṭsu munīśvara \|*  
*navapañcāṃburiṣphasthairvyarkibhirvidhyate na cet \|\| 271 \|\|*

271\. Effect of the planets occupying the different signs.2 О sage! the Sun is benefic when it occupies the 3rd, 11th, 10tH or 6th sign counted from the birth-sign (of the person under consideration), if it is not affected23 by planets other than Saturn24 occupying the 9th 5th, 4th, (ambu) 12th (rippha).

## \|\| 1.56.272 \|\|

*śubho janmarkṣataścandro dyūnāṅgāyārisvatriṣu \|*  
*yatheṣṭāntyāṃbudharmasthaivibudhairvidhyate na cet \|\| 272 \|\|*

272\. The Moon is benefic if it occupies the 7th (dytitui) 1st, 11th, 6th (ari) 10th or 3rd sign from the birth-sign, if it is not affected by planets other than Mercury in the 5th, 8th, 12th, 4th and 9th (dharrna) signs.

## \|\| 1.56.273 \|\|

*tryāyāriṣu kujaḥ śreṣṭho janmanā cenna vidhyate \|*  
*vyayeṣvaṅkasthitaiḥ saurisaumyasūryaiḥ śubhauṣadhāt \|\| 273 \|\|*

273\. Mars is benefic if it occupies the 3rd, 11th or 6th sign from the birth-sign if it is not affected by Saturn, Mercury or Sun occupying, respectively, the 12th (vyaya), 5th and 9th signs.

## \|\| 1.56.274 \|\|

*jñaḥ svāyāryaṣṭaravayiṣu janmataścenna vidhaayate \|*  
*dhītryakādigajāntasthaiḥ śaśāṅkarahitaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|\| 274 \|\|*

274\. Mercury is benefic if it occupies the 4th, 6th, 8th 10th or 11th sign from the birth-sign if it is not affected by planets other than the Moon in the 5th (dhi)\> 3rd, 9th, 1st, 8th and 12th signs.

## \|\| 1.56.275 \|\|

*janmarāśerguruḥ śreṣṭhaḥ svāyago 'dhyastago na cet \|*  
*vidhyatentyāṣṭaravāṃbutrigataiḥ ravaiṭairmunīśvarā \|\| 275 \|\|*

275\. О great sage! Jupiter is benefic in the 11th, 9th 4th or 7th sign from the birth-sign, if it is not affected by the planets in the 12th, 8th, 10th, 4th and 3rd signs.

## \|\| 1.56.276 \|\|

*janmabhādāsutāṣṭāṅkāntyāyeṣviṣṭo bhṛgoḥsutaḥ \|*  
*cenna viddho 'ṣṭasaptāṅgam ravāṅkādyāyārirāmagaiḥ \|\| 276 \|\|*

276\. Venus is benefic in the 1st to 5th (aSuta), 8th, 9th 12th or 11th signs from the birth-sign, if it is not affected by planets in the 8th, 7th, 1st, 10th, 5th, 11th, 6th and 3rd signs.

## \|\| 1.56.277 \|\|

*na dadāti śubhaṃ kiñcidgocare vedhasaṃyute \|*  
*tasmādvedhaṃ vicāryātha kathanīyaṃ śubhāśubham \|\| 277 \|\|*

277\. No planet will be benefic if its current position is affected (by another planet). Hence good and bad results shall be predicted only after duly considering planetary affectation.

## \|\| 1.56.278 \|\|

*vāmabhedavidhānena duṣṭo 'pi syācchubhaṅkaraḥ \|*  
*saumyekṣito 'niṣṭaphalaḥ śubhadaḥ pāpavīkṣitaḥ \|\| 278 \|\|*

278\. A planet which has turned malefic on account of being adversely affected (by a planet) can still be benefic if as- pected by a beneficent planet, while even a beneficent planet might be productive of evil effects if aspectcd by an evil planet.

## \|\| 1.56.279-282 \|\|

*niṣphalau tau grahau svena śatruṇā ca vilokitau \|*  
*nīcarāśigataḥ svasya śatroḥ kṣetragato 'pi vā \|\| 279 \|\|*

*śubhāśubhaphalaṃ naiva dadyādastamitopi vā \|*  
*graheṣu viṣamastheṣu śāntiṃ kuryātprayatnataḥ \|\| 280 \|\|*

*hānirvṛddhirgrahādhīnā tasmātpūjyatamā grahāḥ \|*  
*maṇirmuktāphalaṃ vidrumākhyaṃ maraka taṃ tathā \|\| 281 \|\|*

*puṣparāgaṃ tathā vajraṃ nīlaṃ gomedasaṃjñitam \|*  
*dūryyaṃ bhāskarādīnāṃ tuṣṭya dhāryaṃ yathākramam \|\| 282 \|\|*

279a. Two (inimical) planets will not produce their individual effects if they aspect one another.

279b-280a. A planet occupying the sign of an evil planet or the house of an enemy planet, or if it has already set will not produce its good or bad effects.

280b-281a. When planets occupy malefic places, one should take steps to perform propitiatory rites, for one’s progress and regress are dependent upon the planets, for which reason they are worthy of worship.

281b-282. Precious Stones. Towards the propitiation of the planets Sun etc., one should wear, in order, the precious stones: (Sun) pearl, (Moon) coral, (Mars) emereld, (Mercury) Topaz (Jupiter) diamond, (Venus) Sapphire and (Saturn) Opal. (CANDRA-TArABALA: STRENGTH OF THE MOON AND PLANETS)

## \|\| 1.56.283 \|\|

*śuklapakṣādidivase candro yasya śubhapradaḥ \|*  
*sa pakṣastasya śubhadaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣonyathāśubhaḥ \|\| 283 \|\|*

283\. Nature of the Moou. One to whom the moon is benefic on the first day of the bright fortnight, to him it will be beneficent throughout that fortnight; on the contrary, in the dark fortnight it would be malefic.

## \|\| 1.56.284 \|\|

*śuklapakṣe śubhaścandro dvitīyanavapañcame \|*  
*riḥpharandhrāṃbusaṃsthaiścainna viddho gagane caraiḥ \|\| 284 \|\|*

284\. In the bright fortnight, the Moon is benefic on the second, ninth and fifth days. It would be benefic also on the 12th, 9th and 4th days if it is not affected by other planets.

## \|\| 1.56.285 \|\|

*janma saṃpadvipat kṣema pratyariḥ sādhako vadhaḥ \|*  
*mitraṃ paramamitraṃ ca janmabhāttu punaḥ puna \|\| 285 \|\|*

285\. Birth asterisms. Birth, wealth, danger, welfare enemy, benefactor, death, friend and intimate companion have always to be ascertained from the birth asterism.

## \|\| 1.56.286-287 \|\|

*janmatripañcasaptākhyāstārā neṣṭa phalapradāḥ \|*  
*śākaṃ guḍaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ satilaṃ kāñcanaṃ kramāt \|\| 286 \|\|*

*aniṣṭaphalanāśāya dadyādetaddvijātaye \|*  
*kṛṣṇe balavatī tārā śuklapakṣe balū śaśī \|*  
*candrasya dvādaśāvasthā rāśaurāśau yathākramam \|\| 287 \|\|*

286-287a. The birth-asterisrn and the 3rd, 5th and 7th therefrom do not yield benefits. In order to ward off the evil effects (of these four), one should gift to brahmins (the four objects) vegetables, molasses, salt, and gold with sesame, in that order.

287b. The asterisms are particularly potent during the dark fortnight and the Moon is similarly potent during the bright fortnight.

## \|\| 1.56.287 \|\|

*aniṣṭaphalanāśāya dadyādetaddvijātaye \|*  
*kṛṣṇe balavatī tārā śuklapakṣe balū śaśī \|*  
*candrasya dvādaśāvasthā rāśaurāśau yathākramam \|\| 287 \|\|*

287c-288a. States of the Moon. The Moon has twelve states (avastkds) in the (twelve) signs. And, these states will have effects in accordance with their nomenclatures, (given below, in verse 289), with regard to pilgrimage, marriage etc. undertaken at those times.

## \|\| 1.56.288 \|\|

*yātrodvāhādikāryeṣu nāmatulyaphalapradāḥ \|*  
*ṣaṣṭighnaṃ gatacandrarkṣaṃ tatkālaghaṭikānvitam \|*  
*vedaghnamiṣuvedāntyamavasthā bhānubhāgataḥ \|\| 288 \|\|*

288b. (In order to calculate the state of the Moon at any time), multiply the number of the current asterism (reckoned from Asvini) by 60, add the number of ndtfikds elapsed at the desired time (in the current asterism), multiply the result by 4 and divide by 45 (ifu-veda). Divide the quotient by 12 (Bhanu). (The result would be the current state of the Moon).

## \|\| 1.56.289 \|\|

*pravāsanaṣṭākhyamṛtā jayo hāsyaṃ ratimudā \|*  
*śinibhuktirjvaraḥ kaṃpaḥ susthitirnāmasannibhāḥṛ \|\| 289 \|\|*

289\. The (twelve avasthds are Pravdsa (exile), Naffa (loss), Mrta (death), fay a (victory), Hasya (laughter), Rati (pleasure), Muda (joy), Supti (sleep), Bhukti (feast), Jvara (fever), Kampa (tremour) and Susthiti (firm establishment). Their effect is in consonace with their nomenclatures. (SARVALAGNA: RISING OF THE SIGNS)

## \|\| 1.56.290 \|\|

*paṭṭabandhanayānograsaṃdhivigrahabhūṣaṇam \|*  
*dhātvākaraṃ yuddhakarma meṣalagne prasiddhyati \|\| 290 \|\|*

290\. Rise of Aries (Meja-lagna). When the sign of Aries is rising (the undermentioned acts) will be successful: Royal coronation, marching of the army, peace, war, making of ornaments, extraction of minerals from mines and wars.

## \|\| 1.56.291 \|\|

*maṅgalāni sthirāṇyaṃvuveśmakarmapravartanam \|*  
*kṛṣivāṇijyapaśvādiduṣṭalagne prasiddhyati \|\| 291 \|\|*

291\. Rise of Taurus (Vr^abha-lagna). When the signTaurus is rising, will be successful: Auspicious rites, firm actions, digging of wells for water, construction of houses agriculture, trade, raising of cattle, etc.

## \|\| 1.56.292 \|\|

*kalāvijñānaśilpāni bhūṣaṇāhavasaṃśravam \|*  
*gajodvāhābhiṣekādyaṃ karttavyaṃ mithunodaye \|\| 292 \|\|*

292\. Rise of Gemini (Mithuna-lagna), When the sign Gemini is rising should be done: Engagement in art and architecture, acceptance of ornaments, invitation, for sacrifice, dealings relating to elephants, marriage and consecration.

## \|\| 1.56.293 \|\|

*vāpīkūpataḍāgādi vāribandhanamokṣaṇam \|*  
*pauṣṭikaṃ lipilekhādi kartavyaṃ karkaṭodaye \|\| 293 \|\|*

293\. Rise of Cancer (Катка(a-lagna). When the sign Cancer is rising, should be performed: Work relating to the collection and release of water in tanks, wells and lakes, physical nourishment and writing and literary activities.

## \|\| 1.56.294 \|\|

*ikṣudhānyavaṇikpaṇyakṛṣisevādayaḥsthire \|*  
*sāhasāhavabhūpādyaṃ siṃhalagne prasiddhyati \|\| 294 \|\|*

294\. Rise of Leo (Simha-lagna). When the sign Leo is rising will be successful the following: work relating to the cultivation of sugarcane and grains, trade and adventurous onslaughts by kings, etc.

## \|\| 1.56.295 \|\|

*vidyāśilpauṣadhaṃ kṛtyaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ ca carasthiram \|*  
*kanyā lagne vidheyaṃ ca pauṣṭikākhilamaṅgalam \|\| 295 \|\|*

295\. Rise of Virgo (Kanyd-lagna). When the sign Virgo is rising, should be performed acts relating to: Study, architecture, medicine, ornaments, middling matters which are both firm and otherwise, physical nourishment and all auspicious acts.

## \|\| 1.56.296 \|\|

*kṛṣivāṇijyayānaṃ ca paśūdvāhavratādikam \|*  
*tulāyāmakhilaṃ karma tulābhārāśrite ca yat \|\| 296 \|\|*

296\. Rise of Libra (Tula-lagna). When the sign Libra is rising, should be done acts pertaining to agriculture, trade, travel, cattle, marriage, fasts and tulabhUra (religious weighing of oneself in a balance).

## \|\| 1.56.297 \|\|

*sthirakarmākhilaṃ kāryaṃ rājasevābhiṣecanam \|*  
*cauryakarmasthirāraṃbhāḥ kartavyā vṛścikodaye \|\| 297 \|\|*

297\. Rise of Scorpio (VrScika-lagna). When the sign Scorpio is rising, should be taken action on all matters which are of a firm, permanent (sthira) nature as also service to the royalty, consecration and burglary.

## \|\| 1.56.298 \|\|

*vratodvāhaprayāṇāśvagajaśilpakalādikam \|*  
*carasthiravimiśraṃ ca kartavyaṃ kārmukodaye \|\| 298 \|\|*

298\. Rise of Sagittarius (Dhanu-lagna). When the sine sagittarious is rising, should be performed the following: Religious fasts, marriage, travel, matters relating to horses and elephants, arts, and actions relating to matters which are of a miscellaneous and quasi-permanent nature.

## \|\| 1.56.299 \|\|

*cāpabandhanamokṣāstrakṛṣigośvādikam yat \|*  
*prasthānaṃ paśudāsādi kartavyaṃ makarodaye \|\| 299 \|\|*

299\. Rise of Capricorn (Makara-lagna). When the sign Capricorn is rising should be performed: Stringing of bows and shooting of arrows, cultivation, matters relating to cattle and horses, setting out on a journey, tending of cows, servitude etc.

## \|\| 1.56.300 \|\|

*kṛṣivāṇijyapaśvaṃbuśilpaṅkarmakalādikam \|*  
*jalapātrāstrāśastrādi kartavyaṃ kalaśodaye \|\| 300 \|\|*

300\. Rising of Aquarius \[Kunibha-lagna). When the sign Aquarius is rising should one engage himself in agriculture, trade rearing of cattle, digging foi water, architecture, the fine arts, voyage, practice of missiles and weapons, etc.

## \|\| 1.56.301 \|\|

*vratodvāhābhiṣekāṃbusthāpanaṃ sanniveśanam \|*  
*bhūṣaṇaṃ jalapātrāśvakarma mīnodaye śubham \|\| 301 \|\|*

301\. Rising of Pisces (Mina-lagna), When the sign Pisces is rising, are auspicious acts relating to religious fasts, marriages, consecration, inauguration of water reservoirs and housing colonies, wearing of ornaments and using of water vessels.

## \|\| 1.56.302 \|\|

*meṣādiṣu kligneṣu śuddheṣvevaṃ prasiddhyati \|*  
*krūragrahekṣiteṣūgrasaṃyuteṣūgrameva hi \|\| 302 \|\|*

302\. Potency of the rising signs. Success in actions, as stated above, would accrue in respect of the rising of the signs which are clear i.e., vacant (or occupied by beneficent planets). However, if the signs are aspectedby malefic planets or occupied by terrible planets, the results will also be terrible.

## \|\| 1.56.303 \|\|

*goyugmakarkakanyāntyatulācāpadharāḥ śubhāḥ \|*  
*śubharkṣatvāśubhāsatya itarā pāparāśayaḥ \|\| 303 \|\|*

303\. The Seven signs, viz., Aries, Taurus, Cancer, Virgo, Pisces, Libra and Sagittarius are beneficent (by nature) since they are occupied by beneficent asterisms; the other signs are evil-natured.

## \|\| 1.56.304 \|\|

*grahayogāvalokābhyāṃ rāśirdhatte grahodbhavam \|*  
*phalaṃ tābhyāṃ vihīno 'sau svabhāvamupasarpati \|\| 304 \|\|*

304\. (Over and above this), the signs attain their (ultimate) strength from the combination of planets occupying them and by the aspecting of other planets on them. If neither of the above is applicable, the signs will exhibit only their primary nature.

## \|\| 1.56.305 \|\|

*ādau saṃpūrṇaphaladaṃ madhye madhyaphalapradam \|*  
*ante tucchaphale lagne sarvasminnevameva hi \|\| 305 \|\|*

305\. Towards the beginning (of their rise) all the signs will have their full strength, in the midd’e medium strength and towards the end little strength.

## \|\| 1.56.306 \|\|

*sarvatra prathamaṃ lagnaṃ kartuścandrabalaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*kalpyāmadindau balini saptame balino grahāḥ \|\| 306 \|\|*

306\. First determine the rising sign (at the desired time) and then the strength of the Moon. If the Moon is strong, the planets in the seventh sign will also be strong.

## \|\| 1.56.307 \|\|

*candrasya valimādhāramādheya cānyakheṭakam \|*  
*ādhārabhūtenādheyaṃ dhīyate paridhiṣṭinam \|\| 307 \|\|*

307\. The strength of the Moon is the base, \\ as the sustainer, and supporter), and that of the other planets is only secondary (contained, supported). It is obvious that the supported is held by the snpporter.

## \|\| 1.56.308 \|\|

*cendinduḥ śubhadaḥ sarve grahāḥ śubhaphalapradāḥ \|*  
*aśubhaścedaśubhadā varjayitvā dhanādhipam \|\| 308 \|\|*

308\. If Moon is benefic, all the other planets will also be benefic and if Moon is malefic, (all the others) would also be rendered malefic, except the Sun.

## \|\| 1.56.309 \|\|

*lagnasyābhyuditā yeṃśāsteṣvaṃśeṣu sthito grahaḥ \|*  
*lagnodbhavaṃ phalaṃ dhatte dhanātīto dvitīyakam \|\| 309 \|\|*

309\. The planet occupying those degrees of a sign which have risen, gets the strength of the first part of the sign and the one coming after, that of the second part.

## \|\| 1.56.310 \|\|

*evaṃ sthāneṣu śeṣeṣu caivamevaṃ prakalpayet \|*  
*lagnaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ labhyate 'lpairdinairno \|\| 310 \|\|*

310\. The strengths of the planets in the other sections arc also to be reckoned in this same manner. By this procedure one can select a rising sign endowed with all qualities.

## \|\| 1.56.311-314 \|\|

*doṣālpatvaṃ guṇādhikyaṃ bahu saṃtatamiṣyate \|*  
*doṣādduṣṭo hi kālastamapi mārṣṭuṃ pitāmahaḥ \|\| 311 \|\|*

*apyaśaucatuṇādhikyaṃ doṣānyatte tato hi te \|*  
*amāriktāṣṭamīṣaṣṭīdvādaśīpratipatsvapi \|\| 312 \|\|*

*parighasya ca pūrvārddhaṃ vyatīpāte savaidhṛtau \|*  
*saṃdhyāsūpaplave viṣṭyāmaśubhaṃ prathamārttavam \|\| 313 \|\|*

*rugṇā patipriyā duḥkhī putriṇī bhogamī tathā \|*  
*pativratā keśayuktā sūryavārādiṣu kramāt \|\| 314 \|\|*

311-312a. All men always wish for the minimum of bad effects and the maximum of good effects. Bad cfleets arc inherent in time and even the creator is incapable of eradicating them completely. Hence it is necessary to look for the minimum of bad effects and the maximum of good effects. PRATHAMA-ARTAVA (FIRST MENSTRUATION)

312b-313a. Inauspicious days of prathamartava — Prathamarlava is inauspicious on new moon, the rikta25 lunar days (viz., 4th, 9th aud 14th), 8th, 6th, 12th, 1st, the first half ol (the yoga called) Parigha,26 VyatipCita, Vaidhrla, the (three) sandhyas (of dawn, noon and dusk), invasion by an enemy and (the Karana called) Visfi.27

314\. Prathamartava on the week-days. The result of Prathamartava occurring on the week-days from Sunday arc: (Sunday:) Ill-health;(Monday:) Dear to the spouse;(Tuesday:) Unhappiness, (Wednesday:) Much-daughtered; (Thursday:). Sensuous: (Friday:) Chaste, and (Saturday) Having Heavy tresses.

## \|\| 1.56.315 \|\|

*yāmāgniraudrabhāgyayāhidvīśendrādihyupadviṣāḥ \|*  
*tārakā na hitā māsā madhūrjaśucipauṣakāḥ \|\| 315 \|\|*

315\. Inauspicious astensms and months — The following asterism are inauspicious (in prathamartava): Bharanl. Krttika, Ardra, Purvaphalguni, Aslesa, Vi sakha, Jyestha Magha and Purvasadha. The following months, too, arc not auspicious: Chaitra (Madhu), Karttika (Orja), Asadha (Suci) and Pausa.

## \|\| 1.56.316-317 \|\|

*bhadrā ca saṃkramonidrā rātriścandrārkayorgrahaḥ \|*  
*kulaṭā pāpabhogeṣu nindyarkṣe nindyavāsare \|\| 316 \|\|*

*tilājyadūrvā juhuyādgāyatryāṣṭaśataṃ budhaḥ \|*  
*suvarṇagotilāndadyātsarvadoṣāpanuttaye \|\| 317 \|\|*

316a. One having prathamartava on the bhadra lunar days, (viz., 2nd, 7th and 12th), the transit of the Sun into a sign, sleep, and the lunar and solar eclipses would be unchaste.

316b-317. To ward off all evil the effects of prathamartava on malignant occupation and undesirable asterisms and week-days, the wise should offer oblations of sesame, ghee and diirvtL grass, repeat the gayatri mantra a hundred times and gift away gold, cows and sesame. ADHANA (CONCEPTION)

## \|\| 1.56.318-319 \|\|

*ādyā niśaścatasrastu tyājyā hyapi samāḥ paraiḥ \|*  
*ojarāśyaṃśage candre lagne puṅgrahavīkṣite \|\| 318 \|\|*

*upavītī yugmatithāvanagnaḥ kāmayetstriyam \|*  
*putrārthī puruṣaśastyaktvā pauṣṇamūlāhipitryabham \|\| 319 \|\|*

318a. For conception, the first four nights (of menstruation) are to be avoided; the further days are permissible.

318b-319. One who had been endowed with the sacred thread, if he desires for a male issue should resort to a woman when the Moon occupies an odd sign, the then rising sign aspecting a male planet28, the lunar day being even, the asterisms being not one of Revati (Ращпа), Mula, Visakha (Ahi) and Magha (Pitrya); and the sacrificial fire having not been fed by him (that day). PUMSAVANA: RITE FOR THE BIRTH OF A MALE CHILD

## \|\| 1.56.320-321 \|\|

*prasiddhe prathame garbhe tṛtīye vā dvitīyake \|*  
*māse puṃsavanaṃ kāryaṃ sīmantaṃ ca yathā tathā \|\| 320 \|\|*

*caturthe māsi ṣaṣṭe vāpyaṣṭame vā tadīśvare \|*  
*balopapanne daṃpatyoścandratārābalānvite \|\| 321 \|\|*

320a. Pumsavana™ When conception has been confirmed, in the first third or second month, the Pumsavana ceremony has to be performed.

320b-321. Simantonnayana (Parting of the hair). The Simanta ceremony should be performed in the fourth, sixth or eighth month (of pregnancy) when the lord (of the month is strong,80 (the other conditions being that) the Moon and the asterisms relating to the couple are strong;

## \|\| 1.56.322 \|\|

*ariktāparvadivase kujajīvārkavāsare \|*  
*tīkṣṇamiśrārkavarjyeṣu puṃbhāṃśerātrināyake \|\| 322 \|\|*

322\. The lunar day not being rikta (viz., 4th, 9th, 14th), new moon or full moon; the week-day being Tuesday, Thursday and Sunday, (being the ‘male’ days); the asterism being male, but omitting the tikshna (sharp) one’s (viz. Mula, Ardra, Jyestha, and Aslesa), the misra (mixed) ones, (viz., Krttika and Visakha) and the ugra (violent) ones, (viz., Purvaphalguni, Purvasatfha and Purvabhadrapada, Bharani and Magha); the Moon being in a male asterism;31

## \|\| 1.56.323 \|\|

*śuddhe 'ṣṭame janmalagnāttayorlagne na naidhane \|*  
*śubhagrahayute dṛṣṭe pāpadṛṣṭivivarjite \|\| 323 \|\|*

323\. The 8th house (indicating death) from the birthhouse being clear, the rising signs of the couples being not the eighth being aspected by beneficent planets and not aspected by malefic planets;

## \|\| 1.56.324 \|\|

*śubhagraheṣu dhīdharmakendreṣvaribhave triṣu \|*  
*pāpeṣu satsu candretyanidhanādyarivarjite \|\| 324 \|\|*

324\. Beneficent planets occupying the 3rd (dhi), 9th dharma), and Kendra and malefic planets occupying the three evil houses, the Moon being not in the 12th (antya, loss) or 6th

## \|\| 1.56.325 \|\|

*krūragrahāṇāmekopi lagnādantyātmajāṣṭagaḥ \|*  
*sīmantinīṃ vā tadgarbhaṃ balī hṝnti na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 325 \|\|*

325\. If any of the cruel planets which is strong, occupies the 12th, 5th (dtmaja) or the 8th place, assuredly it will kill the pregnant lady, whose simanta is being performed or the child in the womb. JATAKARMA AND NAMAKARANA (BIRTH RITE AND NAMING CEREMONY)

## \|\| 1.56.326 \|\|

*tasmiñjanmamuhūrte 'pi sūtakāntepi vā śiśoḥ \|*  
*jātakarma prakartavyaṃ pitṛpūjanapūrvakam \|\| 326 \|\|*

326\. The birth rite (jatakarma) of the child should be performed on the muhdrta of birth or at the end of the birth- pollution and should be preceded by the worship of the manes.

## \|\| 1.56.327 \|\|

*sūtakānte nāmakarma vidheyaṃ tatkulocitam \|*  
*nāmapūrvaṃ praśastaṃ syānmaṅgalaiḥ susamīkṣitaiḥ \|\| 327 \|\|*

327\. When the birth-pollution has ended, the naming ceremony should be performed according to family practices. The name given shall be ancient, renowned and composed in auspicious syllables.

## \|\| 1.56.328-334 \|\|

*deśakālopaghātādyaiḥ kālātikramaṇaṃ yadā \|*  
*anastage bhṛgāvījye tatkārye cottarāyaṇe \|\| 328 \|\|*

*carasthiramṛdukṣipranakṣatre śubhavāsare \|*  
*candrātārābalopete divase ca śiśoḥ pituḥ \|\| 329 \|\|*

*śubhalagne śubhāṃśe ca nidhane śuddhisaṃyute \|*  
*ṣaṣṭe māsyaṣṭame vāpi puṃsāṃ strīṇāṃ tu pañcame \|\| 330 \|\|*

*saptame māsi vā kāryaṃ navānnapraśanaṃ śubham \|*  
*riktāṃ dinakṣayaṃ nandāṃ dvādaśīmaṣṭamīmatha \|\| 331 \|\|*

*tyaktvānyatithiṣu proktaṃ praśanaṃ śubhavāsare \|*  
*carasthiramṛdukṣipranakṣatre śubhanaidhane \|\| 332 \|\|*

*daśame śuddhisaṃyukte śubhalagne śubhāṃśake \|*  
*pūrvārddhe saumyakheṭena saṃyukte vīkṣitepi vā \|\| 333 \|\|*

*triṣaṣṭalābhagaiḥ krūraiḥ kendradhīdharmagaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|*  
*vyayārinidhanasthe ca candre 'nnaprāśanaṃ śubham \|\| 334 \|\|*

328-330a. If due to the exigencies of place, time, invasion etc., there had been delay, the father of the child should perform the above two ceremonies when the planets Jupiter and Venus have not set, in the asterism Pusya, during the northward course of the Sun, in an asterism belonging to the groups cara, sthira, mrdu or kfipra,32 in an auspicious week-day, the day being endowed with potency in consideration both of the Moon and the asterisms, during the rising of an auspicious sign and in an auspicious division thereof, and when the 8th house (indicating death) is clear. ANNAPRASANA (THE FIRST FEEDING)

330b-331a. It is auspicious to perform the First feeding ceremony of male children in the sixth or eighth month, and of female children in the fifth or the seventh month (after birth).

331b-332a. It is ordained to be performed oh an auspicious week-day, on any lunar day except rikta (4th, 9th and 14th), the omitted lunar day,33mmrfa (1st, 6th and 11th) and 12th and 8th.

332b-334. The first feeding ceremony would be auspicious in the asterisms of the car a, sthira, mrdu and kfipra classes, the eighth house (indicating death) being vacant, the 10th house also being vacant, during the rise of an auspicious sign and in an auspicious division thereof, in the forenoon, when (the rising sign is) occupied or aspected by beneficent planets, when the 3rd, 6th and 11th (labha) houses arc occupied by evil planets while the kendra, 3rd (dhi) and 9th (dharma) are occupied by beneficent planets, and the Moon is in the 12th (vyaya), 6th (ari), or the 8th (nidhana). CAULA (TONSURE)

## \|\| 1.56.335 \|\|

*tṛtīye pañcame cābde svakulācārato 'pi vā \|*  
*bālānāṃ janmataścaulaṃ svagṛhyoktavidhānataḥ \|\| 335 \|\|*

335\. The tonsure of boys should be performed in the third or the fifth year, in accordance with the family practice and as ordained by the Grhya-sutra. which one follows.34

## \|\| 1.56.336 \|\|

*saumyāyane nāstagayoḥ surārisuramantriṇoḥ \|*  
*aparvariktātithiṣu śukrejyajñenduvāsare \|\| 336 \|\|*

336\. The tonsure ceremony should be performed in the northward transit of the Sun, when the Jupiter and Venus have not set, on a lunar day other than the full moon and new moon days and the rikta days (viz., 4th, 9th and 14th), on a Friday, Thursday, Wednesday or Monday.

## \|\| 1.56.337 \|\|

*dasrāditījyacandrendrapūṣabhāni śubhāni ca \|*  
*caulakarmaṇi hastakṣārrtrīṇitrīṇi ca viṣṇubhāt \|\| 337 \|\|*

337\. For the tonsure ceremony, the asterisms AsvinI, Punarvasu, Pusya, Mrgashiras, Jyestha, Rcvatl, three from Hasta, (viz., Hasta, Citra and Svatl), three from Sravana, (viz., Sravana, Sravistha and Satabhisak) are auspicious.

## \|\| 1.56.338 \|\|

*paṭṭabandhanacaulānnaprāśane copanāyane \|*  
*śubhadaṃ janmanakṣatramaśubhaṃ tvanyakarmaṇi \|\| 338 \|\|*

338\. One’s birth astcrism is auspicious for coronation, tonsure, first feeding and educational initiation into (Vedic) study and wearing the sacred thread), but not in other ceremonies.

## \|\| 1.56.339 \|\|

*aṣṭame śuddhisaṃyukteṃ śubhalagne śubhāṃśake \|*  
*janmāṣṭame na śītāṃśau ṣaṣṭāṣṭāntyavivarjite \|\| 339 \|\|*

339\. (Tonsure should be performed) when the 8th house is clear, during the rise of an auspicious sign and in an auspicious division thereof; when the Moon does not occupy the 8th house from the birth-house, and avoiding the sixth, eighth and twelfth houses.

## \|\| 1.56.340 \|\|

*dhanatrikoṇakendrasthaiḥ śubhaistryāyārigaiḥ paraiḥ \|*  
*abhyakte sandhyayornāre niśi bhuktvā na vāhave \|\| 340 \|\|*

340\. When the second (dkena), trikona- sand (1st, 5th and 9th houses) and kendras (1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th houses) and occupied by beneficent planets and the 3rd, 11th and 6th houses by the other planets.

## \|\| 1.56.340-343 \|\|

*dhanatrikoṇakendrasthaiḥ śubhaistryāyārigaiḥ paraiḥ \|*  
*abhyakte sandhyayornāre niśi bhuktvā na vāhave \|\| 340 \|\|*

*notkaṭe bhūṣite naiva yāne na navame 'hni ca \|*  
*kṣaurakarma mahīpānāṃ pañcamepañcame 'hani \|\| 341 \|\|*

*kartavyaṃ kṣoranakṣatre 'pyatha vāsyodaye śubham \|*  
*nṛpaviprājñayā yajñe maraṇe bandhamokṣaṇeṃ \|\| 342 \|\|*

*udvāhe 'khilavārarkṣatithiṣu kṣauramiṣṭadam \|*  
*kartavyaṃ maṅgaleṣvādau maṅgalāya kṣurārpaṇam \|\| 343 \|\|*

340b-341a. (Tonsure should not be performed) after an oilbath, at dawn or dusk, on Tuesdays and Saturdays (ara), at night, after meals, in battle, when one is angry, wearing ornaments, riding in a vehicle or on the ninth lunar day.

341b-342a. Trimming of the moustaches is recommended for kings regularly every fifth day; it о be done on the asterisms recommended for tonsure (but if the fifth day does not tally with the asterisms it may be done) at the time of rise of such an asterism (inconsiderate of other factors).

342b-343a. Tonsure is productive of beneficial results if done on the direction of kings and brahmins, on the occasion of sacrifice, death, release from bond, marriage and on (the ordained) week-days, asterisms and lunar days. ANKURARPANA: AUSPICIOUS SOWING

343b. At the beginning of all auspicious rites, ahkurarpana, ‘sowing of the seed \\ should be done with a view to gain auspiciousness (for the rite).

## \|\| 1.56.344-345 \|\|

*navame saptame vāpi pañcame divase 'pi vā \|*  
*tṛtīye bījanakṣatre śubhavāre śubhodaye \|\| 344 \|\|*

*samyaggṛhāṇyalaṅkṛtya vitānadhvajatoraṇaiḥ \|*  
*āśiṣo vācanaṃ kāryaṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyāṅganādibhiḥ \|\| 345 \|\|*

344-345. On the ninth, seventh, fifth, or third lunar day, on an asterism recommended for sowing,"5 on an auspicious weekday, when an auspicious sign is rising, the houses should be well decorated by awnings, banners and arches, and auspicious words of blessing should be caused to be uttered by auspicious ladies (/.., those who are not widows).

## \|\| 1.56.346-347 \|\|

*sahavāditranṛtyādyairgatvā prāguttarāṃ diśam \|*  
*tatra mṛdatatastīkṣṇā gṛhītvā punarāgataḥ \|\| 346 \|\|*

*mṛṇyaye 'pyathavā vaiṇave 'pi pātre prapūrayet \|*  
*anekabījasaṃyuktaṃ toyaṃ puṣpābhiśobhitam \|\| 347 \|\|*

346-347. Then (the master of the rite), preceded by the playing of musical instruments, dancing etc., should proceed in the north-easterly direction and collect from there sand and soft mud. Returning to the house, he should fill earthen or bamboo vessels (with the sand and mud brought) and pour over it water into which different seeds and flowers have been put. MAUNJlBANDHANA AND UPANAYANA: TYING THE MAUftjI BELT AND COMMENCING STUDIES

## \|\| 1.56.348 \|\|

*ādhānādaṣṭame varṣe janmato vāgrajanmanām \|*  
*rājñā mekādaśe maiñjībandhanaṃ dvādaśe viśām \|\| 348 \|\|*

348\. Maunjibandhana (lit. ‘tying the belt made of maurlji grass)3e is recommended on the eighth year after conception for brahminsy on the eleventh year for Ksatriyas and on the twelfth year for vatiyas.

## \|\| 1.56.349 \|\|

*janmataḥ pañcame varṣe vedaśāstrariṃśāradaḥ \|*  
*upavītī yataḥ śrīmānkāryaṃ tatropanāyanam \|\| 349 \|\|*

349\. Upanayana could be performed even, at the fifth year, since the boy endowed with the sacred thread done could become well versed in the Vedas and Sastras and be endowed with prosperity.

## \|\| 1.56.350 \|\|

*bālasya balahīno 'pari sito jīvaḥ śubhapradaḥ \|*  
*yathoktavatsare kāryamanukte nopanāyanam \|\| 350 \|\|*

350\. To the boy, even a week Venus or Jupiter would be beneficent. Upanayana should be performed only at the years ordained therefore and not at other times.

## \|\| 1.56.351 \|\|

*dṛśyamānagurau śukre śākheśe cottarāyaṇe \|*  
*vedānāmadhipā jīvaśukrabhaumabudhāḥ kramāt \|\| 351 \|\|*

351\. (Upanayana should be performed) when Jupiter, Venus and the lord of the (relevant) Veda are visible. The lords of the (four) Vedas are, in order: (figveda) Jupiter; (Yajurveda), Venus; (Samaveda:) Mars and (.Atharvavtda:) Mercury.

## \|\| 1.56.352 \|\|

*śaradgrīṣmavasaṃteṣu vyutkramāttu dvijanmanām \|*  
*mukhyaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ teṣāṃ tapomāsādipañcasu \|\| 352 \|\|*

352\. The appropriate seasons for the Upanayana of the three classes of twice-boms are, Autumn (Sarat), Hot season (Grifma) and Spring (Vasanta), taken in the reverse order. In general, the time ordained for them are the five months begin- ing with Magha (Tapas).

## \|\| 1.56.353 \|\|

*svakulācāradharmajño mādhamāse tu phalgune \|*  
*vidhijñaścārthavāṃścaitre vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ \|\| 353 \|\|*

353\. (One who wears the sacred thread) in the months of Magha and Phalguna will become well versed in the here- ditory practices of his family; if in the month of Chaitra he would become a knower of ordained duties, wealthy and an expert in the Vedas and Vedangas.37

## \|\| 1.56.354 \|\|

*vaiśāṣe dhanavānvendaśāstravidyāviśāradaḥ \|*  
*upanīto balāḍhyaśca jyeṣṭhe vidhividāṃ varaḥ \|\| 354 \|\|*

354\. One who wears the sacred thread in the month of Vaisakha would become wealthy, an expert in the Vedas, Sastras and the sciences, and physically strong; if in the month of Jyesfha, he would be a knower of ordained rules.

## \|\| 1.56.355 \|\|

*śuklapakṣe dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā pañcamī tathā \|*  
*trayodaśī ca daśamī saptamī vratabandhane \|\| 355 \|\|*

355\. For Upanayana, the most auspicious days are: In the bright fortnight, the 13th, 10th, 7th, 11th, 6th and the 12th, the other days are of middling benefit. In the dark fortnight, the 2nd, 3rd and 5th days are of middling effect and the rest are extremely bad. 4

## \|\| 1.56.356-357 \|\|

*śreṣṭhā tvekādaśī ṣaṣṭī dvādaśyanyāstu madhyamāḥ \|*  
*kṛthaṣṇe dvitrīṣusaṃkhyāśca tithyo 'nyā hyatininditāḥ \|\| 356 \|\|*

*dhiṣṇānyarkatrayāntejyarudrādityuttarāṇi ca \|*  
*viṣṇutrayāṃśvimitrābjayonibhānyupanāyane \|\| 357 \|\|*

356-357. The asterisms favourable for upanayana are: Hasta, Citra and Svati (arka-traya), Revatl, Pushya (Ijya), Ardra (Rudra), Punarvasu (Aditi), Uttaraphalguni, Uttarasatfha and Uttarabhadrapada, Sravana Dhanis^ha, Satabhisak (Vifnutraya), Aivini, Anuradha (Mitra) and RohinI (Abjayoni).

## \|\| 1.56.358-364 \|\|

*janmabhāddaśamaṃ karma saṃghātarkṣaṃ tu ṣoḍaśam \|*  
*aṣṭādaśaṃ samudayaṃ trayoviṃśaṃ vināśanam \|\| 358 \|\|*

*mānasaṃ mānasaṃ pañcaviṃśarkṣaṃ nācarecchubhameṣu tu \|*  
*ācāryasaumyakāvyānāṃ vārāḥ śastāḥ śaśīnayoḥ \|\| 359 \|\|*

*vārau tu madhyamau caiva vrate 'nyau ninditau matau \|*  
*tridhā vibhajya divasaṃ tatrādau karma daivikam \|\| 360 \|\|*

*dvitīye mānuṣaṃ kāryaṃ tṛtīye ḥṃśe ca paitṛkam \|*  
*svanīcage tadaṃśe vā svāribhe vā tadaṃśake \|\| 361 \|\|*

*guruśikhinośca śākheśe kalāśīlavivarjitaḥ \|*  
*svādhiśatrugṛhasthe vā tadaṃśasthe 'tha vā vratī \|\| 362 \|\|*

*śākheśe vā gurau śukre mahāpātakakṛdbhavet \|*  
*svoccasaṃsthe tadaṃśe vā svarāśau rāśige gaṇe \|\| 363 \|\|*

*śākheśe vā gurau śukre kendrage vā trikoṇage \|*  
*atīva dhanavāṃścaiva vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ \|\| 364 \|\|*

358-359a. The tenth asterism from the birth-asterism is called Karma, the sixteenth Safighata, the eighteenth SdmudAya, the twenty-third Vinafana9 and the twenty-fifth Manasa. No auspicious rite should be performed in these asterisms.

359b-360a. The week-days pertaining to Acarya, Saumya and Kavya, (viz., Thursday, Friday and Wednesday) are auspicious, the days pertaining to the Moon and the Sun are middling and the remaining two are detestable for commencing religious studentship (vrata).

360b-361a. Divide daytime into three. During the first part one should perform acts relating to the gods, during the second part, acts relating to men, and during the third part acts relating to the manes. (Upanayana, which comes under the first category, should therefore be performed only in the first part of the day.)

361b-362a. If Jupiter, Venus or the lord of one’s Veda or their divisions are in debilitation (nica), or are situated in enemy asterisms or divisions the student will lose his family status and his character.

362b-363a, Again, Jupiter, Venus or the lord of one’s Veda38 occupies an inimical house or its division, the student will be the perpetrator of great sins.

363b-364. If, however, Jupiter, Venus or the lord of one’s Veda or their divisions are in exultation (ucca) or occupy their own houses or their raSiganas, or the quadrant (kendra) or trine (trikona), the boy will be extremely wealthy and well versed in the Vedas and the Vedangas.

## \|\| 1.56.365 \|\|

*paramoccagate jīve śākheśe vātha vā sate \|*  
*vratī viśuddhe nidhane vedaśāstraviśāradaḥ \|\| 365 \|\|*

365\. If Jupiter, Venus or the lord of one’s Veda is in high exaltation and the eighth house is clear, the boy will be well versed in the Vedas and Sastras.

## \|\| 1.56.366 \|\|

*svādhimitragṛhasthe vā tasyoñcasthe tadaṃśage \|*  
*gurau bhṛgau vā śākheśe vidyādhanasamanvitaḥ \|\| 366 \|\|*

366\. If Jupiter, Venus or the lord of one’s Vedas or their divisions are in friendly houses or in their divisions or arc in exaltation he will be endowed with knowledge and wealth.

## \|\| 1.56.367 \|\|

*śākhādhipativāraśca śākhādhipabalaṃ śiśoḥ \|*  
*śaākhādhipatilagnaṃ ca durlabhaṃ tritayaṃ vrate \|\| 367 \|\|*

367\. It is rare that in the case of boy all the three, viz., the week-day of the lord of one’s Veda, the strength of the lord of one’s Veda and the rising sign of the lord of one’s Veda occur simultaneously.

## \|\| 1.56.368 \|\|

*tasmādvedvāṃśage candre vratī vidyāviśāradaḥ \|*  
*pāpāṃśage vā daridro nityaduḥkhitaḥ \|\| 368 \|\|*

368\. Thus, when the Moon is in the division of the lord of the Veda, the student would become learned, but if in the division of an evil sign or in a division of his own sign, he would be poor and constantly distressed.

## \|\| 1.56.369 \|\|

*śravaṇādini nakṣatre karkāṃśasthe niśākare \|*  
*tadā vratī vedaśāstradhanadhānyasamṛddhimān \|\| 369 \|\|*

369\. When the asterisms Sravana or Punarvasu (Aditi) (prevail and the Moon is in a division of Cancer, the student would be endowed with the knowledge of the Vedas and the sciences and with wealth and food grains.

## \|\| 1.56.370-372 \|\|

*śubhalagne śubhāṃśe ca naidhane śuddhisaṃyute \|*  
*lagne tu nidhane saumyaiḥ saṃyute vā nirīkṣite \|\| 370 \|\|*

*iṣṭairjīvārkacandrādyaiḥ pañcabhirbalibhirgrahai \|*  
*sthānādibalasaṃpūrṇaiścaturbhirvā śubhānvitaiḥ \|\| 371 \|\|*

*īkṣannaivātraikaviṃśamahādoṣavivarjite \|*  
*rāśayaḥ sakalāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ śubhagrahayutekṣitāḥ \|\| 372 \|\|*

370-372. All the signs are commendable (if the time for the studentship ceremony is fixed) in an auspicious lagna, in an auspicious division thereof, when the eighth house is clear, the lagna, which is not in the eighth house is occupied or aspected by beneficent planets or by the five planets Jupiter, Sun, Moon, etc., when they are friendly and strong or by four auspicious planets fully endowed with strength of position etc. or aspected by them, and devoid of the twentyo ne great blemishes (possible in a day)39.

## \|\| 1.56.373 \|\|

*śubhanavāṃśakagatā grāhyāste śubharāśayaḥ \|*  
*na kadācitkarkaṭāṃśaśubhekṣitayuto 'pi vā \|\| 373 \|\|*

373\. However, only the auspicious divisions of the ninefold division (navdmto) of the said signs are to be selected. But the division of Cancer should never be selected even if it is aspected by a beneficent planet.

## \|\| 1.56.374 \|\|

*tasmādgomithunāṃśāśca tulākanyāṃśakāḥ śubhāḥ \|*  
*evaṃvidhe lagnagate navāṃśe vratamīritam \|\| 374 \|\|*

374\. The divisions of Vrsabha and Mithuna, and Libra and Virgo are also auspicious. Studentship ceremony is to be performed only in a navamta selected in the above manner.

## \|\| 1.56.375-376 \|\|

*triṣaḍāyagataiḥ pāpaiḥ ṣaḍaṣṭāntyavivarjitaiḥ \|*  
*śubhaiḥ ṣaṣṭāṣṭalagnāntyavarjitena himāṃśunā \|\| 375 \|\|*

*svoñcasaṃstho 'pi śītāṃśurvratino yadi lagnagaḥ \|*  
*na karoti śiśuṃ niḥsvaṃ sarvataḥ kṣayarogiṇam \|\| 376 \|\|*

375-376. If evil planets occupy the 3rd, 6th and 11th (4ya) houses, beneficent planets are not to be found in the 6th, 8th and 12th houses, and if the Moon does not occupy the 6th, 8th or the 12th house from the lagna, the boy who takes the vow of studentship will be pennyless and always consumptive even if the Moon is in exaltation in its own house.

## \|\| 1.56.377 \|\|

*sphūrjite kendrage bhānau vratināṃ pitṛnāśanam \|*  
*pañcadoṣonitaṃ lagnaṃ śubhadaṃ copanāyane \|\| 377 \|\|*

377\. If the Sun is exalted in the quadrants, the student’s parents will die. A lagna which does not have any of the above five faults is productive of auspicious results in upanayana.

## \|\| 1.56.378 \|\|

*vinā vasaṃtaṛtunā kṛṣṇapakṣe galagrahe \|*  
*anadhyāye viṣṭiṣaṣṭyorna tu saskāramarhati \|\| 378 \|\|*

378\. The studentship ceremony should not be performed other than in spring, nor in the galagraha days, the days of nonstudy,40 the 6th nor in (the karana called)

## \|\| 1.56.379 \|\|

*trayodaśyādicatvāri saptamyādidinatrayam \|*  
*caturthī vā śubhāḥ proktā aṣṭāvete galagrahāḥ \|\| 379 \|\|*

379\. The eight galagraha (lit. ‘gripping the throat’) days. viz., the four days from the 13th, the three days from the 7th and the 4th (of the dark fortnight) are declared to be inauspicious. KSURIKABANDHANA — (GIRDING THE SWORD)

## \|\| 1.56.380-383 \|\|

*kṣurikābandhaṃ vakṣye nṛpāṇāṃ prākkaragrahāt \|*  
*vivāhokteṣu māseṣu śuklapakṣe 'pyanastage \|\| 380 \|\|*

*jīve śukre ca bhūputre candratārābalānvite \|*  
*maiñjībandhoktatithiṣu kujavarjitavāsare \|\| 381 \|\|*

*nacennavāṃśake karturaṣṭamodayavarjite \|*  
*śuddhe 'ṣṭame vidhau lagne ṣaṣṭāṣṭāntyavivarjite \|\| 382 \|\|*

*dhanatrikoṇakendrasthaiḥ śubhaistryāyārigaiḥ paraiḥ \|*  
*kṣurikābandhanaṃ kāryamarcayitvāmarānpitṝn \|\| 383 \|\|*

380a. Now, shall I set out ksurikAbandhana ‘the girding of the sword’, a ceremony (ordained) for Ksatriyas, before their marriage.

380b-383. The Kftirikabandhana ceremony should be performed after worshipping the gods and the manes, in the month recommended for marriage, in the bright fortnight, when Jupiter, Venus and Mars have not set, on days prescribed for Mawiji- bandhana (‘tying the belt of maufiji grass’),4a on a week-day other than Tuesday, a day endowed with the strength of the Moon and the astcrisms, in a navdrhsaka except the 8th, of the performer, the 8th house being clear, the Moon being in the lagna leaving out the 6th, 8th and 12th houses, and with beneficent planets occupying the 2nd (dhana) house, the trines (trikona) and the quadrants (kendra), while the others occupy the 3rd, 11th (aya) and 6th (ari) houses.

## \|\| 1.56.384 \|\|

*arcayetkṣurikāṃ samyagdevatānāṃ ca sannidhau \|*  
*tataḥ sulagne badhnīyātkaṭyāṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyutām \|\| 384 \|\|*

384\. First the sword should be duly worshipped, placing it in front of the deities. Later, in an auspicious lagna, the sword endowed with proper form and proportions should be tied to the performer’s waist.

## \|\| 1.56.385-386 \|\|

*āyāmārddhāgravistārapramāṇenaivacchedayat \|*  
*tacchedakhaṇḍānyāyāḥ syurdhvajāye ripunāśanam \|\| 385 \|\|*

*ghūmrāye maraṇaṃ siṃhe jayaḥ śuni ca rogitā \|*  
*dhanalābho vṛṣe 'tyantaṃ duḥkhī bhavati gardabhe \|\| 386 \|\|*

385-386. Prognostication by Луа. Divide half the length of the sword by the breadth of the blade. The remainders are called ауо.А'л (Remainder 1, called) Dhvaja-dya, foretells destruction of foes; (Rem. 2) Dhanur-dya foretells death; (Rem. 3) Simha, Victory; (Rem. 4)Svanaf ill health; (Rem. 5) Vrfa, gain of wealth; (Rem. 6), Gardabha, sorrow;

## \|\| 1.56.387-389 \|\|

*gajāye 'tyantasaṃprītirdhvāṅkṣe vittavināśanam \|*  
*khaḍgaputrikayormānaṃ gaṇayetsvāṅgulena tu \|\| 387 \|\|*

*mānāṅguleṣu paryāyāmekādaśamitāṃ tyajet \|*  
*śeṣāṇāmagulīnāṃ ca phalāni syuryathākramam \|\| 388 \|\|*

*putralābhaḥ śatruvadhaḥ strīlābho gamana śubham \|*  
*arthahāniścārthavṛddhiḥ prīti siddhijayaḥ stutiḥ \|\| 389 \|\|*

387a. (If the Rem. is 7, it is) Gaja-aya when there would be great happiness, and (ifthe Rem. is 8) it is Dhvanhsha (Kaka) when there would be loss of wealth.

387b-389. Prognostication through scars. Multiply the length of the sword, measured in one’s own ahgulis (two-finger breadths) by the length of the dagger (khadgaputrikd) and divide by 11. (If a scar or flaw occurs in the sword at distances from the handles indicated by) the several remainders, the effect would be, in order: (1) birth of a son, (2) death of the enemy, (3) acquisition of a wife, (4) travel, (5) auspiciousness, (6) loss of wealth, (7) gain of wealth, (8) satisfaction, (9) attainment (of desires),(10) victory and (11) praise.

## \|\| 1.56.390-397 \|\|

*sthito dhvaje vṛṣāye vā naṣṭācetpūrvato vraṇam \|*  
*siṃhegaje madhyabhāge tvantabhāge śvakākayoḥ \|\| 390 \|\|*

*dhṛmragarddabhayornaiva vraṇaṃ śrayontyabhāgagam \|*  
*athottarāyaṇe śukrajīvayorddaśyamānayoḥ \|\| 391 \|\|*

*dvijātīnāṃ gurorgehānnivṛttānāṃ yatātmanām \|*  
*citrottarāditījyāntyaharimitravidhātṛṣu \|\| 392 \|\|*

*bheṣvarkendujñejyaśukravāralagnāṃśakeṣu ca \|*  
*pratipatparvariktā mā cāṣṭamī ca dinatrayam \|\| 393 \|\|*

*hitvānyadivase kāryaṃ samāvartanamuṇḍanam \|*

*sukhaṃ tatrāpi bhāminyāṃ śīlavatyāṃ sthitaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*tasyāḥ sacchīlarlā dhastu sulagnavaśataḥ khalu \|\| 395 \|\|*

*praṇamya devavatpṛccherddaivajñaṃ bhaktipūrvakam \|*  
*tāṃbūlaphalapuṣpādyaiḥ pūrṇāñjalirupāgataḥ \|\| 397 \|\|*

390-391a. A scar in the first part (of the ajtgula is in- auspicious in the Dhvaja and Vrsha dyas. It is inauspicious if it occurs in the middle of the Simha and Gaja-ayas prevail. It is so towards the end, if the aazaand Kdka dyas prevail. In the Dhumra and Gardabha dyas, a scar will not bring prosperity if it is at the very end (of the adgula). SAMAVARTANA-(RETURN FROM STUDIES)

391b-394a. The ‘tonsure after return’(Samaoartana-mundana)u should be performed on the twice-borns when they return from their teachers’ homes after exerting themselves (in their studies). (The ceremony is to be conducted) during the north-ward course of the Sun; when Jupiter and Venus are visible; in the asterisms Citra, Uttaraphalgunl, Uttarasadha, Uttarabhadra- pada, Pusya (Ijya), Revati (Antya), Sravana (Hari), Anuradha (Mitra) and Rohinl (Vidhdtd); on the week-days of Sun, Moon, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus, and in their (auspicious) lagnas and divisions thereof and leaving out the 1st (pratipat), 4th, 9th and 14th (riktd)ib, new moon 8th and the ‘omitted day (dinakfqya)46 VIVAHAPRASNA: (SOLICITATION FOR MARRIAGE)

394b-395a. Ascertainment of auspicious time: О great brahmin! Of all the stages of life, that of the householder is the most exalted. There, too, happiness depends on the wife being of good character.

395b-396a. Her acquiring commendable character depends upon the beneficent lagna (at the time of wedlock). Hence I shall set out below the ascertainment of the purity of the lagna, taking into cognizance what has been stated on the subject by Brahma.

396b-397. On an auspicious day, (the enquirer) taking with him betel leaves, fruits, flowers etc., should approach, with folded hands, a well-qualified astrologer, who is comfortably seated and is having a clear mind (at the moment), and consult him, with attention, as if to a deity. (He should then convey to the astrologer the birth-sign, birth-asterism etc. of the proposed couple.)47

## \|\| 1.56.398 \|\|

*tatra cellagnagaḥ krūrastasmātsaptamagaḥ kujaḥ \|*

398\. If (at the time of the enquiry), the planet in the lagna is cruel and there is Mars in the seventh (house therefrom), the death of the couple should be predicted within eight years.

## \|\| 1.56.399 \|\|

*yadi lagnagataścandrastasmātsaptamagaḥ kujaḥ \|*

399\. If the Moon occupies the lagna and Mars is in the seventh house, the wise should anticipate the death of the husband within eight years.

## \|\| 1.56.400 \|\|

*lagnātpañcamagaḥ pāpaḥ śatrudṛṣṭaśca nīcagaḥ \|*

400\. If there be a malefic planet in the fifth house from the lagna, who is aspected by an enemy planet and is in debilitation, the girl will, without doubt, have her son still-born or will turn unchaste.

## \|\| 1.56.401 \|\|

*tṛtīyapañcasaptāyakarmago vā niśākaraḥ \|*

401\. The Moon, occupying the 3rd, 5th, 7th, 11th (dya) or 10th (karma) house from the lagnay if aspcctcd by Jupiter, will bring about the union of the (proposed) couple.

## \|\| 1.56.402 \|\|

*tulāgokarkaṭā lagnasaṃsthaḥ śukrendusaṃyutāḥ \|*

402\. If the sections in the lagna relating to Libra, Taurus and Cancer arc occupied or aspcctcd by Venus or Moon, then the people who solicit for the bride will get her.

## \|\| 1.56.403 \|\|

*strīdreṣkāṇaḥ strīnavāṃśe yugmalagnaṃ samāgatam \|*

## \|\| 1.56.404 \|\|

*evaṃ strīṇāṃ bhartṛlabdhiḥ puṃlagne puṃnavāṃśake \|*

404\. In the same manner, the bride will secure the solicited bridegroom if the lagna or navariisnka of the solicitor (i.e.. at the time of the crquiry) is male or is aspected by male planets.49

## \|\| 1.56.405 \|\|

*kṛṣṇapakṣe praśnalagnādyasya rāśī yadā \|*

405\. If the query is ma le in the dark fortnight, when the Moon occupies an even sign from the lagna or is aspected by an evil planet or is in the 8ih house (randhra), the marriage (solicited) will not take place.

## \|\| 1.56.406 \|\|

*puṇyairnimittaśakunaiḥ praśnakāle tu maṅgalam \|*

## \|\| 1.56.407-409 \|\|

407-409a. ICanyacarana, solicitation for the bride. On a day which is pure in respect of the five constituents (of the almanac)50, endowed with the strength of the Moon and the astcrisms, at the rise of the marital asterism, the solicitation for the bride (Kanyd-varana) should be made with the utterance of the pranava (syllable Оm) by the bridegroom, through his elders, at the bride’s house, to which place he should go with flowers, betel leaves, fruils, fragrant unguents and sanctified grain (aksata) and white garments, (the procession being) accompanied by music, musical instruments and words of benediction, warding off obstacles.

409b. The bride’s father should, then, offer him the bride with pleasure.

The bride should then worship Goddess Saci, who is the source of all good qualities, the most beautiful in the three worlds, is adorned with divinely fragrant unguents, garlands and garments, is endowed with all auspicious marks, wears all ornaments and illuminates all the directions by means of her superior gemset chains, is attended day and night, by thousands of beauteous maids, and pray to the Goddess thus:

414, “O Goddess Indrani, the dear consort of God Indra! bestow on me, at my marriage, fortune, health and male offspring.” MARRIAGE

*lagnābhimukhayoḥ pāpagrahayorṛjuvakrayoḥ \|\| 450 \|\|*

*sā kartarīti vijñeyā daṃpatyorgalakartarī \|*  
*kartarīyogaduṣṭaṃ yallagnaṃ tatparivarjayet \|\| 451 \|\|*

*api saumyagrahairyukta guṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ samanvitam \|*  
*ṣaḍaṣṭariṣphage candre lagnadoṣaḥ svasaṃjñakaḥ \|\| 452 \|\|*

450a. The said three tapes of junctures form three different types of Gandantas, which are all highly harmful.

450b-451a. (vii). Kartari. The crossing, (in their motion), of two evil planets, one in regular motion and the other in retrograde motion, while facing the lagna, is known as Kartari; it will cut the throats of couple (like a pair of scissors).

451b-452a. Discard the lagna which is tainted by the blemish of Kartari even if it be occupied by auspicious planets endowed with all good qualities.

452b. (viii-ix). Ripphashadashtendu- When Moon occupies the 6th, 8th and 12th (Rippha) houses, the blemish of that name is caused.

## \|\| 1.56.453-457 \|\|

*tallagnaṃ varjayedyatrājjīvaśukrasamanvitam \|*  
*uccage nīcage vāpi mitrabhe śatrurāśige \|\| 453 \|\|*

*api sarvaguṇopetaṃ daṃpatyornidhanapradam \|*  
*śaśāṅke grahasaṃyukte doṣaḥ saṃgrahasaṃjñakaḥ \|\| 454 \|\|*

*tasminsaṃgrahadoṣe tu vivāhaṃ naiva kārayet \|*  
*sūryeṇa saṃyute candre dāridyaṃ bhavati sphuṭam \|\| 455 \|\|*

*kujena maraṇaṃ vyādhiḥ saumyena tvanapatyatā \|*  
*daurbhāgyaṃ guruṇā yukte sāpatyaṃ bhārgaveṇa tu \|\| 456 \|\|*

*pravrajyā sūryaputreṇa rāhuṇā mūlasaṃkṣayaḥ \|*  
*ketunā saṃyute candre nityaṃ kaṣṭaṃ daridratā \|\| 457 \|\|*

453-454a. Discard, even with effort, the abovesaid lagnay even if it be occupied by Jupiter and Venus. For a lagna within an enemy house even if occupied by friendly planets, cither in exaltation or debilitation, and even if invested with all qualities, is deathly to couples.

454b-455a. (x) Sagraha. When the Moon is in conjunction with some other planets, the ‘blemish’ by name Sagraha occurs. Do not perform marriages (at a mukUrta) when the said blemish prevails.

455b-457. When Sun is in conjunction with the Moon, to be sure, poverty will result; with Mars, disease; with Mercury, childlessness; with Jupiter, misfortune; with Venus, having a cowife; with Saturn, turning a recluse; with Rahu, destruction of family base; and if the Moon is in conjunction with Ketu continued suffering and poverty will result.

## \|\| 1.56.458-468 \|\|

*pāpagrahayute candre daṃpatyormaraṇaṃ bhavet \|*  
*śubhagrahayute candre svoccasthe mitrarāśige \|\| 458 \|\|*

*doṣāyanaṃ bhavellagnaṃ daṃpatyoḥ śreyase sadā \|*  
*svoccago vā svarkṣago vā mitra kṣetragatopi vā \|\| 459 \|\|*

*pāpagnahayutaścandraḥ karoti maraṇaṃ tayoḥ \|*  
*daṃpatyoraṣṭamaṃ lagnamaṣṭamo rāśireva ca \|\| 460 \|\|*

*yadi lagnagataḥ sopi daṃpatyormaraṇapradaḥ \|*  
*sa rāśiḥ śubhasaṃyukto lagnaṃ vā śubhasaṃyutam \|\| 461 \|\|*

*lagnaṃ vivarjayedyatnāttadaṃśāṃśatadīśvarām \|*  
*daṃpatyordvādaśaṃ lagnaṃ rāśirvā yadi lagnagaḥ \|\| 462 \|\|*

*arthahānistayorasmāttadaṃśasvāminaṃ tyajet \|*  
*janmarāśyudayaścaiva janmalagnodayaḥ śubhaḥ \|\| 463 \|\|*

*tayorupacayasthānaṃ lagnetyantaśubhapradam \|*  
*khamārgaṇā vedapakṣāḥ kharāmā vedamārgaṇāḥ \|\| 464 \|\|*

*vahnicandrā rūpadasrāḥ kharāmā vyomabāhavaḥ \|*  
*dvirāmāḥ svāgnaṃyaḥ śūnyadasrāḥ kuñjarabhūmayaḥ \|\| 465 \|\|*

*rūpapakṣā vyomadasrā vedacandrāścaturddaśa \|*  
*śūnyacandrā vedacandrā ṣaḍṛkṣā vedabāhavaḥ \|\| 466 \|\|*

*śūnyadasrāḥ śūnyacandrāḥ pūrṇacandrā gatendravaḥ \|*  
*tarkacandrā vedapakṣāḥ kharāmāścāśvibhātkramāt \|\| 467 \|\|*

*ābhyāḥ parāstu ghaṭikāścatasro viṣasaṃjñitāḥ \|*  
*vivāhādiṣu kāryeṣu viṣanāḍīṃ vivarjayet \|\| 468 \|\|*

458-459a. If the Moon is in conjunction with evil planets the death of the couple will result. However, if the Moon, in exaltation, is in conjunction with beneficent planets in friendly signs, the lagna does not turn evil but always tends to their welfare.

459b-460a, On the other hand, Moon, in exaltation or in its asterism or in a friendly house, if it is in conjunction with an evil planet will cause their death.

460b-461a. (xi-xii). Ashtama-lagna and Ash\[ama rafi. The eighth lagna or the eighth sign (of birth) of the couple, if it occupies the lagna (of the time of the marriage) that too would cause the death of the couple.

461b-462a. Even if the said sign or the lagna is occupied by a benevolent planet, discard that lagna, and its divisions and also other houses governed by the lords (of the eighth houses of the couple).

462b-463a. The twelfth lagna or sign (of birth of the couple, occupying the lagna (of the marriage) will result in their loss of wealth. Hence discard the lord of that division of the lagna.

463b-464a. The rise of the birth sign and the rise of the birth lagna are auspicious. If the lagna (of thtmuhUrta) is in the upacaya-s70 of the above two, it is extremely auspicious.

464b-468. (xiii). Vifagkafi. Four ghafikds each in continuation of the undermentioned ghafikas, respectively, in the twentyseven asterisms are called Vifaghafikas. They should be eschewed in fixing times of marriages etc., even if endowed with other qualities. They are, in order from the asterism AsvinI: (1. AsvinI): 50, (2. Bharani): 24; (3. Kfttika): 30; (4. RohinI): 40; (5. Mrgasiras): 13; (6. Ardra): 21; (7. Punarvasu): 30; (8. Pusya); 20; 9. ASlesa); 32; (10. Magha): 30; (11. Purvaphalguni): 20; (12 UttaraphalgunI): 18; (13. Hasta): 2t\>; (14. Citra 20; (15. Svatl); 14; (16. ViSakha): 14; (17. Anuradha): 10; (18. Jyestha): 14; (19. Mula): 56; (20. Purvasatjha); 24; (21. Uttarasatfha): 20; (22. Sravana): 10; (23. Sravistha): 10; (24. Satabhisak): 18; (25. Purvabhadrapada); 16; (26. Uttarabhadrapada): 24; (27. Revatl): 30.

## \|\| 1.56.469 \|\|

*bhāskarādiṣu vāreṣu ye muhūrtāśca ninditāḥ \|*  
*vivāhādiṣu te varjyā apilakṣaguṇairyutāḥ \|\| 469 \|\|*

469\. MuhUrtadopa. Such muhUrtas in the week-day from, Sunday, as are censured (for other auspicious rites) are to be censured also for marriage etc., even if invested with good qualities.71

## \|\| 1.56.470 \|\|

*nihitāvāradoṣā ye sūryavārādiṣu kramāt \|*  
*api sarvaguṇopetāste varjyāḥ sarvamaṅgale \|\| 470 \|\|*

470\. Varadosha. Such days of the week for which blemishes have been indicated, in order, beginning with Sunday, arc to be eschewed also for (marriage, which is) the most auspicious rite, even if the days are endowed with all qualifications.72

## \|\| 1.56.471 \|\|

*ekārgalāṅghritulyaṃ yattallagnaṃ ca vivarjayet \|*  
*apiśukrejyasaṃyuktaṃ viṣasaṃyuktadugdhavat \|\| 471 \|\|*

471\. (xvi). Ekargala. Discard a lagna which encompasses even a fourth part of (an asterism having) the blemish of Ekargala, as if it is milk mixed with poison, even if (the lagna is) occupied by Venus and Brhaspati.73

## \|\| 1.56.472 \|\|

*grahaṇotpātabhaṃ tyājyaṃ maṅgaleṣu ṛtutrayam \|*  
*yāvacca śaśinā bhuktvā muktabhaṃ dagdhakāṣṭavat \|\| 472 \|\|*

472\. (xvii). Grahanotpatabha. (In an auspicious rite, like marriage), the asterism in which an eclipse or an Utpdta (like the fall of a meteor or occurrence of an earthquake) occurs should be discarded for three succeeding seasons (i.e. six months), thereafter as charred firewood, except when they?ure occupied by the moon and left (bhuktva muktam bham).

## \|\| 1.56.473 \|\|

*maṅgaleṣu tyajetśeṭairviddhaṃ ca krūrasaṃyutam \|*  
*akhilarkṣaṃ pañcagavyaṃ surābinduyutaṃ tathā \|\| 473 \|\|*

473\. (xviii-xix). Krurauiddhark^a and KrUrasamyuta. In auspicious rites (like marriage) discard all asterisms which are afflicted (viddha)7 or in conjunction with violent planets, as panchagavyd75 to which a drop of wine has been added.

## \|\| 1.56.474 \|\|

*pāda eva śubhairviddhamaśubhaṃ naiva kṛtstrabham \|*  
*krūraviddhaṃ yutaṃ dhiṣṇyaṃ nikhilaṃ naiva maṅgalam \|\| 474 \|\|*

474\. If the asterism in question had been afflicted only by its fourth part and that, too, by bcnefic planets, the whole asterism is not rendered inauspicious. However, if the affliction or being in conjunction is by cruel planets, the whole asterism has to be discarded.

## \|\| 1.56.475-479 \|\|

*tulāmithunakanyāṃśā dhanurantyārddhasaṃyutāḥ \|*  
*ete navāṃśāḥ śubhadā vṛṣabhasyāṃśakāḥ khalu \|\| 475 \|\|*

*antyāṃśāstepi śubhadā yadi vargottamāhvayāḥ \|*  
*anye navāṃśā na grāhyā yataste kunavāṃśakāḥ \|\| 476 \|\|*

*kunavāṃśakalagnaṃ yattyājyaṃ sarvaguṇānvitam \|*  
*yasmindine mahāpātastaddinaṃ varjayecchubhe \|\| 477 \|\|*

*api sarvaguṇopetaṃ dampatyormṛtyudaṃ yataḥ \|*  
*anuktāḥ svalpadoṣāḥ syurvidyunnīhāravṛṣṭayaḥ \|\| 478 \|\|*

*pratyarkapariveṣendracāpāṃbudharagarjanāḥ \|*  
*lattopagrahapātākhyā māsadagdhāhvayā tithiḥ \|\| 479 \|\|*

475-477a. (xx). Kunavdmfaka. The navetrhias Libra, Gemini and Virgo and the Second half of Sagittarius are auspicious except the ending in each. The ending will also be auspicious if they are of the vargottama category.76 The other navdrfifokas are not to be selected since they are Kunavdthiakas (‘Evil navarhiakas'). A lagna in which there is a Kunavamfaka is to be rejected even if endowed with all other qualifications.

477b-478a. (xxi). Mahapata Vaidhrli.77 The day on which the mahdpata Vaidhrti occurs should be eschewed in auspicious rites (like marriage), even if endowed with all qualities, for it would cause the death of the couple.

478b-479. Minor blemishes (Svalpadosa). Minor blemishes, not mentioned (above) also exist, like for instance, lightning and hailstorm; mock-sun, halo round the Sun and the Moon, rainbow, and thunder of clouds: Lalta; minor tremours etc., lunar days called ‘burnt month’ (dagdhamasa).

## \|\| 1.56.479 \|\|

*pratyarkapariveṣendracāpāṃbudharagarjanāḥ \|*  
*lattopagrahapātākhyā māsadagdhāhvayā tithiḥ \|\| 479 \|\|*

479\. Dagdha-lagna (burnt lagna), and the lagnas with the appellation ‘blind’, ‘deaf5 and ‘leme\\ Now, the explanation of these is given below,

## \|\| 1.56.480 \|\|

*dagdhalagnāndhabadhirapaṅgusaṃjñāśca rāśayaḥ \|*  
*evamādyāstatasteṣāṃ vyavasthā kriyate 'dhunā \|\| 480 \|\|*

480\. Lighttihig ami hails Iona. Lightning and hailstorm, which occur at unexpected limes, will indeed, be injurious to auspicious rites, though, in course of time, they will become noninjurious.

## \|\| 1.56.481 \|\|

*akālajā bhavantyete vidyunnīhāravṛṣṭayaḥ \|*  
*doṣāya maṅgale nūnamadoṣāyaiva kālataḥ \|\| 481 \|\|*

481\. There is, however, no doubt that anyone of Jupiter, Venus or Mercury will obviate the effect of these groups of blemishes if it is in a quadrant (kendia)78.

482-484a. Vedha (Piercing Affliction). (Draw? diagram with) five vertical lines, five across, and two each diagonally. Mark the asterism Kittika (Agnidhi

404b-485a. Lattci. The Sun and other planets affect, for a day, an asterism, ahead of or behind it, (alternately). Thus, the Sun affects the 12th asterism (ahead of it); Moon, the 22nd (behind it); Mars, the 3rd (ahead of it); Mercury, the 7th (behind it); Jupiter, the 6th (ahead of it); Venus, the 5th (behind it); Saturn the 8th (ahead of it); and Rahu, the 9ih behind it. (These days are to be scrupulously avoided in fixing muhUrtas.)

485b-486a. Patabha (Malignant asterism). Count from Hasta (Suryabha) the asterism Aslesa (Sarpa), Magha (Pitrya), Revati (Anlyd), Citra (Tvatfra), Anuradha (Mitra) and Sravana (Vifnubha) and count off those numbers from Asvini. The aste- risms got would be malignant asterisms (patabha) (?)

486b. In Saurastra and the Salva country the blemish of Latta is not taken note of.

## \|\| 1.56.487 \|\|

*kaliṅgavaṅgadeśeṣu pātitaṃ na śubhapradam \|*  
*bāhlike kurudeśe cānyasmindeśe na dūṣaṇam \|\| 487 \|\|*

487\. Path a \[Minor tumour) is not considered auspicious in Kalihga (Orissa) and Vanga (Bengal) countries. In Balhika, Kuru country and certain other regions, however, it is not a blemish at all.

## \|\| 1.56.483 \|\|

*tiryakpañcorddhūgāḥ pañca rekhā dve dve ca koṇayoḥ \|*  
*dvitīye śaṃbhukoṇe 'gnidhiṣṇyaṃ cakre pravinyaset \|\| 483 \|\|*

483\. Dagdha-tithi and Dagdha-lagna. The ‘burnt’ lunar days and the ‘burnt’ lagnas arc eschewed in Madhyadcsa (Madhya Pradesh) but not considered inauspicious in other areas.

## \|\| 1.56.489 \|\|

*ṣaṅgvaṃ dhakāṇalagnāni māsaśūnyāśca rāśayaḥ \|*  
*gauḍamālavayostyājyā anyadeśe na garhitāḥ \|\| 489 \|\|*

489\. The ‘lame, ‘blind’ and ‘deaf’ lagnaP and the signs which do not contain the ending of a lunar month are rejected in the Gauda and Malava regions, but not censured in other areas.

## \|\| 1.56.490 \|\|

*doṣaduṣṭaṃ sadā kālaṃ sannimārṣṭuṃ na śakyate \|*  
*api dhāturato grāhyaṃ doṣālpatvaṃ guṇādhikam \|\| 490 \|\|*

490\. Every moment is infested with some blemish or other, and it would be impossible even for the creator to wipe off the blemishes completely. Hence one should opt for the maximum of auspiciousness and the minimum of blemishes.

## \|\| 1.56.491-495 \|\|

*evaṃ sulagne daṃpatyoḥ kārayetsamyagīkṣaṇam \|*  
*hastocchritāṃ caturhastaiścaturasrāṃ samantataḥ \|\| 491 \|\|*

*staṃbhaścaturbhiḥ suślakṣṇairvāmabhāge tu sannatām \|*  
*samaṇḍapāṃ caturdikṣu sopānairatiśobhitām \|\| 492 \|\|*

*prāgudakpravaṇāṃ raṃbhāstaṃbhairhaṃsaśukādibhiḥ \|*  
*vicitritāṃ citrakuṃbhairvividhaistoraṇāṅkuraiḥ \|\| 493 \|\|*

*śṛṅgārapuṣpanicayairvarṇakaiḥ samalaṅkṛtām \|*  
*viprāśīrvacanaiḥ puṇyasrībhirdivyairmanoramām \|\| 494 \|\|*

*vāditranṛtyagītādyairhṛdayānandinīṃ śubhām \|*  
*evaṃ vidhāṃ samārohenmithunaṃ svāgnivedikām \|\| 495 \|\|*

491a. Marriage altar. In an auspicious lagna, (decided upon) in consideration of the above, should be arranged the mutual viewing of one another by the couple.

491b-495. The couple should then be made to ascend an auspicious altar on which holy hre is kept — an altar which is one cubit high, a square of four cubits on all sides; supported by four polished pillars; slightly slanting to the left; with a pavilion around, beautified by steps on the four sides; elongated on the east and the north; beautified by the planting of plantain trunks; ornamented by (replicas of) swans and parrots, painted pots, and shoots placed on the arches; decked with heaps of love-inciting flowers and colours; sanctified by the benedictions of brahmanas and pleasing with auspicious and divinely beautiful ladies; and making the heart merry with musical instruments, dance and songs.

## \|\| 1.56.496 \|\|

*aṣṭadhā rāśikūṭaṃ ca svādūḍugaṇarāśayaḥ \|*  
*rāśīśayonirvarṇākhyaṛtavaḥ putrapautradāḥ \|\| 496 \|\|*

496\. Mutual koroscopical agreement of the couple9,1. Eight are the mutual compatabilities which conduce to sons and grandsons: (i) Paily (ii) Stridfira, (iii) Gam, (iv) i», (v) Toni (vi) Varna, (vii) Rajju and (viii) Vasya.

## \|\| 1.56.497-500 \|\|

*ekarkṣe tvekarāśau hi vivāhaḥ prāṇahānidaḥ \|*  
*strīdhiṣṇyādādyanavake strīdūramatininditam \|\| 498 \|\|*

497-498a. Agreement of Rdii. Different asterism for the couple in the same rdii is excellent. Middling is to have different raHs, but the same asterism. The marriage of a couple born in the same asterism in the same rati results in death.

498b-499a. Striddra\> A distance within the first nine asterisms for the male horoscope from the asterism of the female is highly inauspicious, the second nine is middling and the third nine is excellent.

499b-500a. Agreement in Cana82. The asterisms in the human group (martya-gana) are: The three рйrvas and uttaras, (viz., Purvaphalguni, Purvasadha, Purvabhadrapada, Uttaraphalguni, Uttarasadha and Uttarabhadrapada), RohinI (Dhatr), Bharani (Tdmya), Ardra (Makefa).

500\. Those of the divine group are: Sravana (Hari), Vasu (Aditya), Hasta (Arka), Svatl (Vayu), Revatl (Antya), Anuradha (Mitra), AsvinI, Pusya (Ijya) and MfgaSIrsa (Indu).

## \|\| 1.56.501 \|\|

*rakṣogaṇaḥ pitṛtvāṣṭradvidaivāgnīndratārakāḥ \|*  
*vasuvārīśamūlāhitārakābhiryutāstataḥ \|\| 501 \|\|*

501\. Asterisms of the demonic gana (Rakfo-gana) are: Magha (Pitr), Citra (Tvdf(ra), Visakha (Dvidaivatya), Krttika \[Agni), Jyestha (Indra), Dhanistha (Vasu) Satabhisak (VariSa), Mula, and Aslesa (Ahi).

## \|\| 1.56.502 \|\|

*daṃpatyorjanmabhe caikagaṇe prītiranekadhā \|*  
*madhyamā devamartyānāṃ rākṣasānāṃ tayormṛtiḥ \|\| 502 \|\|*

502\. If the birth-asterism of the couple is the same, it would be pleasing in many ways. It is middling if one is human and the other divine. Death will result (if the human and the divine are united) with the demonic.

## \|\| 1.56.503 \|\|

*mṛtyuḥ ṣaṣṭāṣṭake pañcanavame tvanapatyatā \|*  
*naiḥsvya dvirdvādaśe 'nyeṣu daṃpatyoḥ prītiruttamā \|\| 503 \|\|*

503\. Agreement between the lords of the rail: If the lords of the raiis of the couple are one in the 6th house and the other in the 8th, death will result. If it be fifth and ninth, there would be childlessness. Second and twelfth houses, too, are not desirable. In the others, there will be excellent mutual attraction between the couple.

## \|\| 1.56.504 \|\|

*ekādhipe mitrabhāve śubhadaṃ pāṇipīḍanam \|*  
*dvirdādaśe trikoṇe ca na kadācitṣaḍaṣṭake \|\| 504 \|\|*

504\. If the said lords are identical or friendly, the marriage will be happy. It might be so even in the case of two and twelve and the trines (trikond), but never in the case of six and eight.

## \|\| 1.56.505-506 \|\|

*aśvebhameṣasarpāhihyotumeṣotumūṣakāḥ \|*
