505-506. Agreement of Tonif The animals relating to the asterisms ASvini etc. are in order: (1. ASvini): Horse; (2. Bharani): Elephant; (3. Krttika): Goat; (4. RohinI): Serpent; (5. Mrgasiras): Snake; (6. Ardra): Dog; (7. Punarvasu): Cat; (8. Pusya): Goat; (9. Ailesa): Cat; (10. Magha): Rat; (11. Purvaphalguni): Mouse; (12. Uttaraphalguni):Cow; (13. Hasta): Buffalo; (14. Citra): Tiger; (15. Svati): Buffalo; (16. Visakha): Tiger; (17. Anuradha); Deer; (18. Jyestha): Deer; (19. Mula): Dog; (20. Purvasadha): Monkey; (21. Uttarasadha): Ox; (22. Sravana): Monkey; (23. Sravistha); Lion; (24. Satabhisak): Horse; (25. Purvabhadrapada): Lion; (26, Uttarabhadrapada): Cow; (27. Rcvati): Elephant.

## \|\| 1.56.507 \|\|

*śvaiṇaṃ babhraragaṃ meṣavānarau siṃhavāraṇam \|*  
*govyāghramākhumārjāraṃ mahiṣāścaṃ ca śātravam \|\| 507 \|\|*

507\. The pairs Dog and deer, Mongoose and serpent Goat and monkey, Lion and elephant, Cow and tiger, Rat and cat, and Buffalo and horse are inimical.

## \|\| 1.56.508 \|\|

*jhaṣālikarkaṭā viprāsta dūrdhvāḥ kṣatriyādayaḥ \|*  
*puṃvarṇarāśeḥ strīrāśau satihīne yathāśubham \|\| 508 \|\|*

508\. Varna (caste)84. Pisces, Scorpio and Cancer are brahmanas; the further ones belong to the other castes.85 If the male’s raii is lower than that of the female in caste, it is inauspicious86.

## \|\| 1.56.509-511 \|\|

*catustrivdyaṅghribhotthāyāḥ kanyāyāścāśvibhātkramāt \|*  
*vahnibhādindubhānnāḍītricatuḥpañcaparvasu \|\| 509 \|\|*

*gaṇayetsaṃkhyayā caikanāḍyāṃ mṛtyurna pārśvayoḥ \|*  
*prājāpatyabrāhmadaivā vivāhāścārṣasaṃyutāḥ \|\| 510 \|\|*

*uktakāle tu kartavyāścatvāraḥ phaladāyakāḥ \|*  
*gandharvāsurapaiśācarākṣasākhyāstu sarvadā \|\| 511 \|\|*

509-510a. Rajju or (The 27 asteristns are in the form of a zigzag rope, each loop carrying 3 asterisms, thus forming three columns (nddis) of 9 asterisms each, (If the asterisms of the boy and the girl fall) in the same column, it indicates death and not so in adjacent columns.)87

510b-511a. Different types of marriages. (The three types of marriages) Prajdpatya, Brahma and Daiva are approved by the sage, and if performed at the said (auspicious) times, would be extremely beneficial.

511b. (The Asura marriage is achieved through the payment of money and PaiSfca by kidnapping the bride. The Raksasa marriage is done by winning over the bride in battle and Gandharva is made by mutual understanding.)88

## \|\| 1.56.512-514 \|\|

*caturthamabhijillagnamudayarkṣāñca saptamam \|*  
*godhūlikaṃ tadubhayaṃ vivāhe putrapautradam \|\| 512 \|\|*

*prācyā na ca kaliṅgānāṃ mukhyaṃ godhūlikaṃ smṛtam \|*  
*abhijitsarvadeśeṣu mukhyo doṣavināśakṛt \|\| 513 \|\|*

*madhyandinagate bhānau muhūrto 'bhijidāhvayaḥ \|*  
*nāśayatyakhilāndoṣānpinākī tripuraṃ yathā \|\| 514 \|\|*

512-513a. Abhijit and GodhUlika.89 The fourth lagna from the lagna at sunrise is called Abhijit and the seventh is called GodhUlikd. Both these are auspicious for marriage and (will bless the couple) with sons and grandsons. For the Easterners (belonging to Bengal, Assam etc.) and the people of Kalihga (Orissa), Godhulikd is important.

513b-514. Abhijit is considered as important in all regions as a destroyer of blemishes. The muhUrta (of two ndtjlikds) when the Sun is at the zenith is called Abhijit. It wipes off all blemishes as the Pinaka-bowed (Siva) wiped out the Tripuras.90

## \|\| 1.56.515 \|\|

*putrodvāhātparaṃ putrīvivāho na ṛtutraye \|*  
*na tayorvratamudvāhānmaṅgale nānyamaṅgalam \|\| 515 \|\|*

515\. Prohibitions in marriages. A daughter’s marriage should not be conducted for three seasons after a son’s marriage, neither should be performed the sacrament (for the change to married life, vrata). When there has been an auspicious event, there shall not be another auspicious event closely following.

## \|\| 1.56.516 \|\|

*vivāhaścaikajanyānāṃ ṣaṇmāsābhyantare yadi \|*  
*asaṃśayaṃ tribhirvarṣaistatraikā vidhavā bhavet \|\| 516 \|\|*

516\. If the marriages of two sisters are conducted within six months of each other, one of them will surely become a widow within three years.

## \|\| 1.56.517 \|\|

*pratyudvāho naiva kāryo naikasmai duhitṛdvayam \|*  
*na caikajanyayoḥ puṃsorekajanye tu kanyake \|\| 517 \|\|*

517\. Mutual marriages should not be performed nor should two daughters be married to the same groom, nor two daughters born of the same parents to two brothers born of the same parents.

## \|\| 1.56.518-519 \|\|

*naivaṃ kadācidudvāho naikadā muṇḍanadvayam \|*  
*divājātastu pitaraṃ rātrau tu jananīṃ tathā \|\| 518 \|\|*

*ātmānaṃ saṃdhyayorhanti nāsti gaṇḍe viparyayaḥ \|*  
*sutaḥ sutā vā niyataṃ śvasuraṃ hṝnti mūlajaḥ \|\| 519 \|\|*

518a. Nor should two marriages be conducted at the same time, nor two tonsures.

518b-519a. If a marriage is performed during Gatufa91, the child if born during day-time will kill his father, if during night, his mother, and ifduring the (morning and evening) twilights, himself. There is no exception to Gantfa.

519b. Л son and a daughter born in the asterism Mula will positively kill the father-in-law, but not one born in the ending quarter of that asterism.

## \|\| 1.56.520 \|\|

*tadantyapādajo naiva tathāśleṣādyapādajaḥ \|*  
*jyeṣṭāntyapādajau jyeṣṭaṃ bālo hṝnti na bālikā \|\| 520 \|\|*

520\. A boy, but not the girl, born in the first quarter of Aslesa and the latter two quarters of Jye^tha will also (kill the father-in-law).

## \|\| 1.56.521 \|\|

*na bālikāṃbumūlarkṣe mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tathā \|*  
*saindrī dhavāgrajaṃ hṝnti devaraṃ tu dvidaivajā \|\| 521 \|\|*

521\. A girl born in Mula or Purvasaqlha will not harm the father or the mother, but the one born in Jye^ha will kill the elder brother of the husband, and one born in Visakha (Dvidaiva) the younger brother.

## \|\| 1.56.521-523 \|\|

*na bālikāṃbumūlarkṣe mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tathā \|*  
*saindrī dhavāgrajaṃ hṝnti devaraṃ tu dvidaivajā \|\| 521 \|\|*

*ārabhyodvāhadivasāt ṣaṣṭe vāpyaṣṭame dine \|*  
*vadhūpraveśa saṃpattyaidaśame saptame dine \|\| 522 \|\|*

*hāyanadvitayaṃ janmabhalagnadivasānapi \|*  
*saṃtyajya hyatiśukre 'pi yātrā vaivāhikī śubhā \|\| 523 \|\|*

521-523. Vadhupraveia. For the auspicious entry of the bride into her husband’s household, the sixth, eighth, tenth or seventh clay counted from the day of marriage is recommended. (If it is delayed), the marriage journey should be made leaving out the second (and other even) years and eschewing the bride’s birth asterism, birth-lagna, and birth-day, and also avoiding position to Venus.94 INSTALLATION OF DEITIES

## \|\| 1.56.524-525 \|\|

*śrīpradaṃ sarvagīrvāṇasthāpanaṃ cottarāyaṇe \|*  
*gīrvāṇapūrvagīrvāṇamatriṇordṛśyamānayoḥ \|\| 524 \|\|*

*vicaitreṣveva māseṣu māghādiṣu ca pañcasu \|*  
*śuklapakṣeṣu kṛṣṇeṣu tadādiṣvaṣṭasu śubham \|\| 525 \|\|*

524a. The installation of any deity during the northward course of the Sun will conduce to prosperity.

524b-525. The installation would be auspicious if made at a time when both Mercury and Venus are visible, in the five months from Magha, but omitting Citra; in the bright fortnight and, if in the dark fortnight, in the first eight days, the lunar day being selected in accordance with the day patronised by the particular deity;

## \|\| 1.56.526-529 \|\|

*dineṣu yasya devasya yā titistatra tasya ca \|*  
*dvatīyādidvaye pañcamyāditastisṛṣu kramāt \|\| 526 \|\|*

*daśamyādeṣcatasṛṣu paurṇamāsyāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*tryuttarāditicandrāntyahastatrayagurūḍuṣu \|\| 527 \|\|*

*sāśvidhātṛjalādhīśaharimitravasuṣvapi \|*  
*kujavarjitavāreṣu kartuḥ sūrye balaprade \|\| 528 \|\|*

*candratārābalopete pūrvāhne śobhane dine \|*  
*śubhalagne śubhāṃśe ca kartturna nidhanodaye \|\| 529 \|\|*

526-527a. On the two lunar days beginning with the second, the three days beginning with the fifth, the four days beginning with the 10th, especially on full moon day;

527b-528a. On the asterisms, the three Uttards (viz.\> Uttara-phalgunI, Uttarasa^ha and Uttarabhadrapada), Mrga- Siras, Revati, Hasta, Citra, Svati and Pusya; and also on Asvini, RohinI, Purvasadha, Sravana, Anuradha, and Dhanistha;

528b-529. On week-days excepting Tuesday, when the Sun is strong with regards to the master (of the installation), when the potencies of the Moon and the asterisms are forthcoming; in the forenoon of that auspicious day, when the lagna and the division thereof are auspicious, and when no (asterism) deadly to the master is rising.

## \|\| 1.56.530 \|\|

*rāśayaḥ sakalāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ śubhagrahayutekṣitāḥ \|*  
*pañcāṣṭake śubhe lagne naidhane śuddhisaṃyute \|\| 530 \|\|*

530\. Nature of the signs and houses. All the signs are auspicious if occupied or aspected by benefic planets, the Pahcaka (Five sources of energy)93 being auspicious and the 8th house, indicating death, is vacant.

## \|\| 1.56.531 \|\|

*lagnasthāścandrasūryārarāhuketvarkasūnavaḥ \|*  
*kartturmṛtyupradāścānye dhanadhānyasukhapradāḥ \|\| 531 \|\|*

531\. The Moon, Mars, Sun, Node, Tail and Saturn would be harmful to the master if they occupy the lagna, while the other planets would bestow wealth, grain and happiness.

## \|\| 1.56.532 \|\|

*dvitīye neṣṭadāḥ pāpāḥ saumyāścandraścaḥ vittadāḥ \|*  
*tṛtīye nikhilāḥ kheṭāḥ putrapautrasukhapradāḥ \|\| 532 \|\|*

532a. In the second house, the evil planets will not bestow any desired fruit, while the benefics and the Moon will bestow wealth.

532b. In the third house, all the planets bestow sons, grandsons and happiness.

## \|\| 1.56.533 \|\|

*caturthe sukhadāḥ saumyāḥ krūrāḥ kheṭāśca duḥkhadāḥ \|*  
*glānidāḥ pañcame krūrāḥ saumyāḥ putrasukhapradāḥ \|\| 533 \|\|*

533a. In the fourth house, the benefic planets bestow happiness, while the violent planets bestow unhappiness.

533b. In the fifth house, the violent planets produce distress, while the benefic planets bestow sons and happiness.

## \|\| 1.56.534 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭe śubhāḥ śatrudāḥ syuḥ pāpāḥ śabrukṣayaṅkarāḥ \|*  
*vyādhidāḥ saptame pāpāḥ saumyāḥ śubhaphalapradāḥ \|\| 534 \|\|*

534a. In the sixth house the benefic planets become enemies, while the evil planets would destroy one’s enemies.

534b. In the seventh house, the evil planets cause disease, while the benefic planets bestow auspicious fruits.

## \|\| 1.56.535 \|\|

*aṣṭamasthāḥ khagāḥ sarvekarturmṛtyupradāyakāḥ \|*  
*dharme pāpā ghnanti saumyāḥ śubhadā maṅgalapradāḥ \|\| 535 \|\|*

535\. In the eighth house, all planets occupying it cause the death of the master. In the ninth house which indicates dharma, the evil planets cause distress, but the benefic planets are auspicious and bestow happiness.

## \|\| 1.56.536 \|\|

*karmagā duḥkhadāḥ pāpā saumyāścandraśca kīrtidāḥ \|*  
*lābhasthānagatāḥ sarve bhūrilābhapradā grahāḥ \|\| 536 \|\|*

536a. In the tenth house which indicates Kama, the evil planets give trouble but the benefic planets and the Moon bring glory.

536b. In the eleventh house, indicative of profit, all planets tend to bestow the maximum income (profit) (to the master).

## \|\| 1.56.537-541 \|\|

*vyayasthānagatāḥ śaśvadbahūvyayakarā grahāḥ \|*  
*hṝntyarthahīnāḥ kartāraṃ mantrahīnāstu ṛtvijam \|\| 537 \|\|*

*sriyaṃ lakṣaṇahīnāstu na pratiṣṭāsamo ripuḥ \|*  
*guṇādhikatare lagne doṣaḥ svalpataro yadi \|\| 538 \|\|*

*surāṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ tatra karturiṣṭārthasiddhidam \|*  
*nirmāṇāyatanagrāmagṛhādīnāṃ samāsataḥ \|\| 539 \|\|*

*kṣetramādau parīkṣeta gandhavarṇarasāṃśakaiḥ \|*  
*madhupuṣpāmlapiśitagandhaṃ viprānupūrvakam \|\| 540 \|\|*

*sitaṃ raktaṃ ca haritaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ yathākramam \|*  
*madhuraṃ kaṭukaṃ tiktaṃ kaṣāyakarasaṃ kramāt \|\| 541 \|\|*

537a. All the planets occupying the twelfth house indicating expenditure will make (the master) spend incessantly.

537b-538a. The images of deities, installed, if not endowed with wealth, will harm the master, and harm the priest if not properly invoked with sacred chants. If not sculptured according to specifications, they will injure the master’s wife. Indeed, there is no act so inimical (as an installation (which has not been properly performed).

538b-539a. If the installation is done during a lagna highly endowed with auspicious qualities, and if the blemishes are very little, the installation of deities would bestow upon the master all his desires. (VASTULAKshANA: CONSTRUCTION OF HOUSES)

539b-540a. Testing of the ground. Towards the construction of a town, village, house etc, first examine the ground for its qualities of smell, colour and taste.

540b-541. For brahmanas, (Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and sudras), it is auspicious if the earth has, respectively, the smell of honey, flower, sour fruit and flesh; has, respectively, the colours white, red, green and dark; and has, respectively, the tastes sweet, hot, bitter and astringent.

## \|\| 1.56.542 \|\|

*atyantavṛddhidaṃ nṝṇāmīśānaprāgudagplavam \|*  
*anyadikṣu plave teṣāṃ śaśvadatyantahānidam \|\| 542 \|\|*

542\. It is beneficial for all people if the ground slopes towards north-east, east or north. Slopes towards the other directions would always be highly harmful to them.

## \|\| 1.56.543 \|\|

*samagartāratnimātraṃ khanitvā tatra pūrayet \|*  
*atyantavṛddhiradhike hīne hāniḥ same samam \|\| 543 \|\|*

543\. Dig a (cubical) pit of the depth of one cubit and fill it (with the excavated earth). It would be extremely beneficial if there is earth to spare, if less, it is inauspicious and if just enough (to fill the pit), it is middling.

## \|\| 1.56.544 \|\|

*tathā niśādau tatkṛtvā pānīyena prapūrayet \|*  
*prātardṛṣṭe jale vṛddhiḥ samaṃ paṅke kṣayaḥ kṣaye \|\| 544 \|\|*

544\. Dig a similar pit at dusk and fill it with water. When examined in the morning, if there is water still, the place would be prosperous, if there is just slush, it would be middling, and if it is dry, it is inferior.

## \|\| 1.56.545 \|\|

*evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ samyak kṣetraṃ samīkṣyate \|*  
*diksādhanāya tanmadhye samaṃ maṇḍalamālikhet \|\| 545 \|\|*

545\. Orientation (East-west determination). When a ground with good characteristics as above has been selected, prepare a level surface in its middle and draw a circle thereon, for determining the east-west line.

## \|\| 1.56.546-548 \|\|

*dvādaśāṅgulakaṃ śaṅkuṃ sthāpyekṣettatra diktramam \|*  
*caturasrīkṛte kṣetre ṣaḍvargapariśodhite \|\| 546 \|\|*

*rekhāmārge ca karttavyaṃ prākāraṃ sumanoharam \|*  
*āyāmeṣu caturdikṣu prāgādiṣu ca satsvapi \|\| 547 \|\|*

*aṣṭāvaṣṭau pratidiśaṃ dvārāṇi syuryathākramam \|*  
*pradakṣiṇakramātteṣāmamūni ca phalāni vai \|\| 548 \|\|*

546a. Fix a 12-inch gnomon at its centre and with its help, determine the directions.64

546b-547a. Construction of the building. In the ground measured out as a rectangle and tested through the sixfold divisions (Sadvarga).96 a beautiful edifice should be erected, along the lines drawn.

547b-548. Windows in the outer walls of the residential enclosure. Along the directions on the four sides, reckoned from the east, eight gates each should be put up. In the clockwise order they will have the undermentioned effects:

## \|\| 1.56.549 \|\|

*hānirnaiḥ khyandhanaprāptirnṛpapūjā mahadvanam \|*  
*aticauryamatikrodho bhītirdiśi śacīpateḥ \|\| 549 \|\|*

549\. East: (i) Misfortune, (ii) Loss of wealth, (iii) gain of wealth, (iv) propitiation of the king, (v) great wealth, (vi) big theft, (vii) rage and (viii) fear.

## \|\| 1.56.550 \|\|

*nidhanaṃ bandhanaṃ bhītirarthāptirddhanavarddhanam \|*  
*anāntakaṃ vyādhibhayaṃ niḥsattvaṃ dakṣiṇādiśi \|\| 550 \|\|*

550\. South: (i) Death, (ii) imprisonment, (iii) fear, (iv) attainment of riches, (v) increase in wealth, (vi) freedom from doubts (vii) fear from diseases, and (viii) destruction of creatures.

## \|\| 1.56.551 \|\|

*putrahāniḥ śatruvṛddhirlakṣmīprāptirddhanāgamaḥ \|*  
*saubhāgyamatidaurbhāgyaṃ duḥkhaṃ śokaśca paścime \|\| 551 \|\|*

551\. West: (i) Loss of a son, (ii) prosperity to the enemy, (iii) attainment of riches, (iv) receipt of wealth, (v) happiness, (vi) extreme misfortune, (vii) unhappiness, and (viii) distress.

## \|\| 1.56.552 \|\|

*kalatrahānirniḥ sattvaṃ hānirddhānyadhanāgamaḥ \|*  
*saṃpadvṛddhirmāsabhītirāmayaṃ diśi śītagoḥ \|\| 552 \|\|*

552\. North: (i) Loss of one’s wife: (ii) destruction of creatures, (iii) Misfortune, (iv) attainment of grains and wealth, (v) wealth, (vi) prosperity, (vii) intense fear, and (viii) hunger.

## \|\| 1.56.553 \|\|

*evaṃ gṛhādiṣu dvāravistārāddviguṇocchritam \|*  
*paścime dakṣiṇe vāpi kapāṭaṃ sthāpayedgṛhe \|\| 553 \|\|*

553\. Doorways. The main doorway to the house is to be in the west or the south, its height being twice its breadth.

## \|\| 1.56.554 \|\|

*prākārāntaḥ kṣitiṃ kuryādekāśītipadaṃ yathā \|*  
*madhye navapade brahmasthānaṃ tadatininditam \|\| 554 \|\|*

554\. 81-division concept.M Divide the ground inside the boundary walls into 81 squares (by dividing the sides into nine equal divisions). Nine squares in the centre form the Brahma- sthana (‘place of Brahma’), which is highly inauspicious (for residential quarters).

## \|\| 1.56.555-560 \|\|

*dvātriṃśadaṃśāḥ prākārasamīyāṃśāḥ samantataḥ \|*  
*piśācāṃśe gṛhāraṃbhe duḥkhaśokabhayapradaḥ \|\| 555 \|\|*

*śeṣāśāḥ syuśca nirmāṇe putrapautradhanapradāḥ \|*  
*śirāḥ syurvāstunorekhā digvidigmadhyasaṃbhavāḥ \|\| 556 \|\|*

*brahmabhāgāḥ piśācāṃśāḥ śirāṇāṃ yatra saṃhatiḥ \|*  
*tatra tatra vijānīyādvāstuno marmasaṃdhayaḥ \|\| 557 \|\|*

*marmāṇi saṃdhayo neṣṭāḥ svasthe 'pyevaṃ niveśane \|*  
*saumyaphaālgunavaiśākhamāghaśrāvaṇakārtikāḥ \|\| 558 \|\|*

*evaṃ gṛhādiṣu dvāravistārāddviguṇocchritam \|*  
*paścime dakṣiṇe vāpi kapāṭaṃ sthāpayedgṛhe \|\| 553 \|\|*

*prākārāntaḥ kṣitiṃ kuryādekāśītipadaṃ yathā \|*  
*madhye navapade brahmasthānaṃ tadatininditam \|\| 554 \|\|*

*māsāḥ syurgṛhanirmāṇe putrārogyadhanapradāḥ \|*  
*akārādiṣu bhāgṣu dikṣu prāgādiṣu kramāt \|\| 559 \|\|*

*kharośvotha hariḥ śvākhyaḥ sapokhugajaśāśakāḥ \|*  
*digvargāṇāmiyaṃ yoniḥ svavargātpañcamo ripuḥ \|\| 560 \|\|*

555-556a. The thirytwo squares close to the outer wall, (i.e., the border squares, all round) pertain to the ghosts. Residential construction in the ghost region will result in unhappiness, distress and fear. The other squares (are auspicious and) tend to bless one with sons, grandsons and wealth for one’s constructing the house.

556b-558a. The east-west and north-south lines in the construction form its bloodvessels. The Brahma squares, the ghost squares and the intersecting points of the bloodvessels are to be understood as the vital junctures of the construction. The vital junctures are not commended for residential use.97

553b-559a. Time for building construction. The months Margasiras (Saumya), Phalguna, Vaisakha, Magha, Sravana and Karttika conduce to sons, health and wealth (to one who builds a house during these months).

559b-560. Digvargayoni. The (eight) groups (vargas) beginning with a (viz., (1) the vowels a etc., (2) ka-varga, (3) ca- varga, (4) fa-varga, (5) ta-varga, (6) pa-varga, (7) ya-ra-la-va and (8) sha-sha-sa-ha) are placed, in order, against the (eight) directions beginning with the east. (The eight animals and birds, viz.) (1) eagle, (2) cat, (3) lion, (4) dog, (5) serpent, (6) rat, (7) elephant and (8) deer are theyoni-s (animal-births) of the (eight) said direction-groups. Of these the fifth counted from its group is its enemy.98

## \|\| 1.56.561 \|\|

*sādhyavargaḥ puraḥ sthāpya pṛṣṭataḥ sādhakaṃ nyaset \|*  
*vyatyaye nāśanaṃ tasya ṛṇamadhyaṃ dhanācchubham \|\| 561 \|\|*

561\. Auspiciousness based on Varga-cakra. (In order to determine whether the selected spot would be beneficial for the owner’s residence), the varga of the sadhya (here, the village) and that of the sddhaka (owner) are separately (calculated) and each divided by 8. If the remainder got from the Varga of the sadhaka is greater, the land is good for him, otherwise, it will destroy him.09

## \|\| 1.56.562 \|\|

*ārabhya sādhakaṃ ghiṣṇyaṃ sādhyaṃ yāvaccaturguṇam \|*  
*vibhejetsaptabhiḥ śeṣaṃ sādhakasya dhanaṃ tadā \|\| 562 \|\|*

562\. Or, count the asterisms from the asterisms of the sddhaka (owner) to that of the sddhya (village), multiply that number by 4 and divide by 7. The greater the remainder, the owner will fare better in that land.100

## \|\| 1.56.563 \|\|

*vistāra āyāmaguṇo gṛhasya padamucyate \|*  
*tasmāddhanādhanāyarkṣavārāṃśāḥ saṃkhyayā kramāt \|\| 563 \|\|*

563\. Auspiciousness based on area. The product of length and breadth forms the area of a house. From it is calculated, in order, the numbers indicating (the nature of) its positiveness, negativeness, income, asterism, week-day and navumSa.101

## \|\| 1.56.564 \|\|

*dhanādhikaṃ gṛhaṃ vṛddhyai ṛṇādhikamaśobhanam \|*  
*viṣamāyaḥ śubhaghāyaiva samāyo nirdhanāya ca \|\| 564 \|\|*

564\. Positiveness conduces to prosperity, while negativeness is inauspicious. An odd number indicating income points to auspiciousness while an even number indicates penury.

## \|\| 1.56.565 \|\|

*ghanakṣayastṛtīyarkṣe pañcamarkṣe paraḥ kṣayaḥ \|*  
*ātmakṣayaḥ saptamarkṣe bhavatyeva hi bhartṛbhāt \|\| 565 \|\|*

565\. Auspiciousness based on as ter isms. The third nsterism (of the house) from that of the master of the house indicates depletion of wealth, the fifth astcrism indicates depletion of prestige, and the seventh asterism foretells death.

## \|\| 1.56.566 \|\|

*dvirdvādaśo nirdhanāya trikoṇamasutāya ca \|*  
*ṣaṭkāṣṭakaṃ mṛtyave syācchubhadārāśayaḥ pare \|\| 566 \|\|*

566\. Auspiciousness based on the signs. The second and twelfth sign conduces to poverty and triangular sign conduces to sonlessness. The sixth and eighth signs indicate death. The other signs are auspicious.

## \|\| 1.56.567 \|\|

*sūryāṅgārakavārāṃśā vaiśvānarabhayapradāḥ \|*  
*itare grahavārāṃśāḥ sarvakāmārthasiddhidāḥ \|\| 567 \|\|*

567\. Auspiciousness on the basis of week-days. Sundays and Tuesdays conduce to fear of fire. The days pertaining to the other planets conduce to the fulfilment of all desires.

## \|\| 1.56.568-570 \|\|

*nabhasyādiṣu māseṣu triṣu triṣu yathākramam \|*  
*pūrvādikaśirovāmapārśveśāyāpradakṣiṇam \|\| 568 \|\|*

*carāhvayo vāstupumān caratyevaṃ mahodaraḥ \|*  
*yaddiṅmukho vāstupumān kuryāttaddiṅmukhaṃ gṛham \|\| 569 \|\|*

*pratikūlamukhaṃ gehaṃ rogaśokabhayapradam \|*  
*sabalo mukhagehānāmeṣa doṣo na vidyate \|\| 570 \|\|*

568-569a. Deity of the dwelling and entrance to the house. The Deity of the dwelling (Vastu-puman) would be lying prostrate on the house-site with his head towards the east during the three months beginning with Nabhasya (i.e., Bhadrapada, Asvina and Karttika). This pot-bellied deity, called also Cara ‘the moving’ shifts its position anticlockwise every three months, (thus remaining with his head towards north during Margasirsa, Pausa and Magha, west during Phalguna. Chaitra and Vai sakha, and south during Jyestha, Asa^ha and Sravana).

569b-570. The main entrance to the house should be in the direction in which the head of the Deity of the dwelling is (at the time when construction is started). A house with its entrance turned opposite to the said direction will bring disease and distress (to the master of the house). This drawback will not affect a house which has entrances on all sides.

## \|\| 1.56.571 \|\|

*vṛtyeṭikāṃ svarṇareṇudhānyaśaivalasaṃyutam \|*  
*gṛhamadhye hastamātre garte nyāsāya vinyaset \|\| 571 \|\|*

571\. Commencement of construction. A mud pot, with gold, gems, grain and lotus seeds should be placed in л pit of the depth of a cubit in the centre of the house (-site) as a deposit).

## \|\| 1.56.572-574 \|\|

*vastvāyāmadalaṃ nābhistasmādadhyaṅgulatrayam \|*  
*kukṣistasminnyasecchaṅkuṃ putrapautravivardhanam \|\| 572 \|\|*

*caturviśatrayorviṃśatṣoḍaśadvādaśāṅgulaiḥ \|*  
*viprādīnāṃ kukṣimānaṃ svarṇavastrādyalaṅkṛtam \|\| 573 \|\|*

*khadirārjunaśālotthaṃ yugayantraṃ tarūdbhaghavam \|*  
*raktacandanapālāśaraktaśānaviśālajam \|\| 574 \|\|*

572a. The middle point of the longer siefe of the housesite is termed (ndbhi) (navel) and an area of three digits around it is its belly.

572b-574. At the navel a gnomon adorned with gold, clothes, etc., and conducive of sons and grandsons, has to be fixed. The measure of the gnomon for (the houses of) Brahinanas, (Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and Sud'ras) are, respectively, 24, 23, 16 and 12 digits. The gnomon should be constructed from the wood of khadira, arjuna, sain and pftga or from red sandal, раШа, r ok t as ala or visala.

## \|\| 1.56.573 \|\|

*caturviśatrayorviṃśatṣoḍaśadvādaśāṅgulaiḥ \|*  
*viprādīnāṃ kukṣimānaṃ svarṇavastrādyalaṅkṛtam \|\| 573 \|\|*

573\. Divide the gnomon into three, construct a square around it, then an octogon and then an unbroken circle (?) (anasram rjum dvaranam).

## \|\| 1.56.576-578 \|\|

*evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ parikalpya śubhe dine \|*  
*ṣaḍvargaśuddhisūtreṇa sūtrite dharaṇītale \|\| 576 \|\|*

*mṛdudhruvakṣiprabheṣu riktāmāvarjite dine \|*  
*vyarkāracaralagneṣu pāpe cāṣṭamavarjite \|\| 577 \|\|*

*naidhane śuddhisaṃyukte śubhaghalagne śubhāṃśake \|*  
*śubhekṣite 'tha vā yukte lagne śaṅkuṃ vinikṣipet \|\| 578 \|\|*

576-578. lux the gnomon prepared as above at the appropriate place duly marked with a string used to mark off the quadrants, signs etc. (tadvargetuddhisuttena),102 on an auspicious day, the prevailing asterism being one of the midu. dhruva or kfipra classes103 the lunar day being not newmoon or one of the 1 iktd ‘empty’ days (viz., the 4th, 9th and 14th tilhis), the day being not Sunday nor Tuesday, the lagna and the eighth house being not occupied by evil planets, the eighth house being vacant, the lagna being auspicious, and so also the ruwtmsaka division thereof, and the lagna being occupied or aspectcd by beneficent planets.

## \|\| 1.56.579-582 \|\|

*puṇyāhaghoṣairvāditraiḥ puṇyapuṇyāṅganādibhiḥ \|*  
*svatrikendratrikoṇasthaiḥ śubhaistryāyārigaiḥ paraiḥ \|\| 579 \|\|*

*lagnāṃśāṣṭāricandreṇa daivajñārcanapūrvakam \|*  
*ekadvitricatuḥśālāḥ sapta śālā daśāhvayāḥ \|\| 580 \|\|*

*tāḥ punaḥ ṣaḍvidhāḥ śālāḥ pratyekaṃ daśaṣaḍvidhāḥ \|*  
*dhruvaṃ dhānyaṃ jayaṃ nandaṃ kharaḥ kāntaṃ manoramam \|\| 581 \|\|*

*sumukhaṃ durmukhaṃ krūraṃ śatruṃ svarṇapradaṃ kṣayam \|*  
*ākrandaṃ vipulākhya ca vijayaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ gṛham \|\| 582 \|\|*

579-580a. The fixing of thegnoinon should be accompanied by the utterance of sacred hymns and the sounds of musical instruments played by the most auspicious ladies. The kendra and trikona houses (quadrants and trines) should be occupied by beneficent planets, the third and the eleventh (aya) and sixth houses being occupied by the other planets, and the Moon occupying the sixth house from lagna.

580b-582. Classification of dwellings. There arc six types of dwellings having, respectively, one, two, three, four, seven and ten halls; each of these are of sixteen types, which carry the appellations: Dhruva, Dharya, Jaya, Nanda, Svara, Kanta, Manorama, Sumukha, Durmukha, Кг йга, Satru, Svarnaprada, h\\saya, Akratida, Vipula and Vijaya.

## \|\| 1.56.583-591 \|\|

*gṛhāṇi gaṇayedevaṃ teṣāṃ prastārabhedataḥ \|*  
*guroragho laghuḥ sthāpyaḥ purastādūrdhvavannyaset \|\| 583 \|\|*

*gurubhiḥ pūrayetpaścātsarvaladhvavadhīrvidhiḥ \|*  
*kuryāllaghupade 'lindaṃ gṛhadvārātpradakṣiṇam \|\| 584 \|\|*

*pūrvādigeṣvalindeṣu gṛhabhedāstu ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*snānāgāraṃ diśi prācyāmāgneyyāṃ pākamandiram \|\| 585 \|\|*

*yāmyāṃ ca śayanāgāraṃ nairṛtyāṃ śāsramandiram \|*  
*pratīcyāṃ bhojanagṛhaṃ vā yavyāṃ dhānyamadiram \|\| 586 \|\|*

*kauberyāṃ devatāgāramīśānyāṃ kṣiramandiram \|*  
*śayyāmūtrāstratadvicca bhojanaṃ maṅgalāśrayam \|\| 587 \|\|*

*dhānyastrībhogavittaṃ ca śṛṅgārāyatanāni ca \|*  
*īśānyādikramasteṣāṃ gṛhanirmāṇakaṃ śubham \|\| 588 \|\|*

*eteṣvetāni śastrāṇi svaṃ sthāpyāni svadikṣvapi \|*  
*dhvajo dhūmrotha siṃhaḥ śvā saurameyaḥ kharo gajāḥ \|\| 589 \|\|*

*dhvāṅkṣaścaiva bhavantyaṣṭau pūrvādipāḥ kramādamī \|*  
*plakṣoduṃbaracūtākhyā niṃbastu hi vibhītakāḥ \|\| 590 \|\|*

*ya kaṭakā dugdhavṛkṣā vṛkṣāśvatthakapitthakāḥ \|*  
*agastisiṃdhuvālākhyatintiḍīkāśca ninditāḥ \|\| 591 \|\|*

583-584a. The possible types of dwellings can be calculated by the method of permutation and combination (as is done in metrics, where, in order to find the number of possible forms of a metre, the following procedure is adopted): Place the short syllable below the long syllable; and further, too, place the syllables, progressively. Thus fill the set entirely with long syllables and then add one with all short.104

584b-585a. Verandah. Construct narrow verandahs (alinda) round the building, starting from the entrance. Considering the verandahs from the east, there can be sixteen types of houses.

585b-587a. Location of the rooms. The bathroom shall be to the east and the kitchen to the south-east. The room for sleeping shall be to the south and the armoury to the southwest. To the west shall be the dining room and the granary to the northwest. The room for worship is to be in the north and the room for the storing of milk, curds etc. to the north-east.

587b-589a. Rooms for (1) bed, (2) urine, blood and faeces; (3)food, (4) auspicious things, (5) grain, (6) enjoyment with women, (7) wealth, and (8) ornaments, are to be located (in between the eight rooms mentioned above) beginning with the north east-east. Cconstruction of residences in this maimer is auspicious.105

589b-590a. Birds, beasts etc. of the direction. Flag, smoke, lion, dog, cow, ass, elephant, and crow — these eight are ascribed, in order, to the directions beginning with the east.106

590b-591. Inauspicious trees around the house. Pinks a, udumbara} cuta. snuhi, nimba, vibh\\takay thorny trees, milktrees, vota, ashvattha\> kapitthaka, agasti, sindhuvala and Untifika are not recommended (for being planted around a residence).

## \|\| 1.56.592 \|\|

*pittavāgrajadehasyātpaścime dakṣiṇe tathā \|*  
*gṛhapādāgṛhastabhāḥ samāḥ śastāśca nāsamāḥ \|\| 592 \|\|*

592a. An elder brother's house to the south or west (of one’s own) (is recommended) as that of one’s own father. (?)

592b. The foundations of a house are to be commended if they arc level and the pillars equal (in height), not otherwise.

## \|\| 1.56.593 \|\|

*nātyucchritaṃ nātinīcaṃ kuḍyotsedhaṃ yathāruci \|*  
*gṛhopari gṛhādīnāmevaṃ sarvatra cintayet \|\| 593 \|\|*

593\. The walls should not be too high nor too low, the height being fixed as one likes it. So also, the storeys, one over the other. In all such cases, the above shall be the consideration.

## \|\| 1.56.594-595 \|\|

*gṛhādīnāṃ gṛhaśrāvaṃ kramaśo 'ṣṭavidhaṃ smṛtam \|*  
*pāñcālamānaṃ vaidehaṃ kauravaṃ ca kujanyakam \|\| 594 \|\|*

*māgadhaṃ śūrasenaṃ ca gāndhārāvatikā smṛtam \|*  
*sacaturbhāgavistāramutsedhaṃ yattaducyate \|\| 595 \|\|*

594-595. Drains and gagoyles. Drains in houses are of eight types (as obtaining in different regions). They arc, in order: Pancala, Vaideha, Kaurava, Kaujanyaka, Magadlia, Surasena, Gandhara and Avantika. In all these the breadth is one fourth of the height.

## \|\| 1.56.596 \|\|

*pāñcālamātulānāṃ ca hyuttarottaravṛddhitaḥ \|*  
*vaidehādīnyaśeṣāṇi mānāni syuryathākramam \|\| 596 \|\|*

596\. The Pahcala type is the smallest and the others, Vaideha etc., are larger, in that order.

## \|\| 1.56.597-598 \|\|

*pāñcālamānaṃ sarveṣāṃ sādhāraṇamataḥ param \|*  
*avantimānaṃ viprāṇāṃ gāndhāraṃ kṣatriyasya ca \|\| 597 \|\|*

*kaujanyamānaṃ vaiśyānāṃ viprādīnāṃ yathottaram \|*  
*yathoditaṃ jalastrāvyaṃ dvitribhūmikaveśmanām \|\| 598 \|\|*

597-598. The Panchala measure is applicable to all. However, for the residences, in two or three storeys, of brahmanas etc., drains of special suitability are those of the Avanti measure to Brahmanas, Gandhara measure to Ksatriyas and Kaujaneya measure to Vaisyas.

## \|\| 1.56.599-600 \|\|

*uṣṭrakuñjaraśālānāṃ dhvajāyepyathā vā gaje \|*  
*paśuśālāśca śālānāṃ dhvajāyepyatha vā gaje \|\| 599 \|\|*

*dvāraśayyāśanāmatradhvajāḥ siṃhavṛṣadhvajāḥ \|*  
*vāstupūjāvidhiṃ vakṣye navaveśmapraveśane \|\| 600 \|\|*

599-600a. Stables. Stables for camels and elephants should have their heights with accord with the dhvaja or gaja measures. However, for cattle and horses, the height of the tables shall accord with the dhvaja or vrsha measures. The entrance, place for penning and place for feeding should accord respectively, with the dhvajay sirtiha and vrsha measures.107

600b. Vdstupujd. I shall now set out the procedure for the worship of the building before it is occupied.

## \|\| 1.56.601 \|\|

*hastamātrā likhedrekhā daśa pūrvā daśottarāḥ \|*  
*gṛhamadhye taṇḍuloparyekāśītipadaṃ bhavet \|\| 601 \|\|*

601\. On husked rice spread in the centre of the house, draw ten lines, (west to) east, a cubit in the length, and ten lines (across south to) north, thus forming 81 squares.

## \|\| 1.56.602 \|\|

*pañcottarānvakṣyamāṇāṃścatvariṃśatsurān likhet \|*  
*dvātrindvāhyataḥ pūjyāstatrāntaḥsthāsrayodaśa \|\| 602 \|\|*

602\. Mark the 45 deities mentioned below (in the appropriate squares), 32 of them in the border squares and 13 inside.

## \|\| 1.56.603 \|\|

*teṣāṃ sthānāni nāmāni vakṣyāmi kramaśodhunā \|*  
*īśānakoṇato bāhyo dvātriṃśatrridaśā amī \|\| 603 \|\|*

603\. Now, shall I state their names and places, in order. Here are the 32 deities (to be marked) from the northeast.

## \|\| 1.56.604-611 \|\|

*kṛpīṭayoniḥ parjanyo jayantaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ \|*  
*sūryaḥ śaśī mṛgākāśau vāyuḥ pūṣā ca nairṛtiḥ \|\| 604 \|\|*

*gṛhākṣato daṇḍadharo gāndharvo bhṛgurājakaḥ \|*  
*mṛgaḥ pitṛgaṇādhiśastato dauvāri kāhvayaḥ \|\| 605 \|\|*

*sāmaḥ sūryo 'ditiditī dvātriṃśatrridaśā amī \|*  
*atheśānādikoṇasthāścātvārastatsamīpagāḥ \|\| 606 \|\|*

*āpaḥ sāvitraghasaṃjñaśca jayo rudraḥ kramādamī \|*  
*ekāntarā syuḥ prāgādyāḥ parito brahmaṇaḥ smṛtāḥ \|\| 607 \|\|*

*aryamā savitā biṃbavivattkānvaktudhādhipaḥ \|*  
*mitrotha rājayakṣmā ca tathā pṛthvīdharāhvayaḥ \|\| 608 \|\|*

*āpavatso 'ṣṭamaḥ pañcacatvāriṃśatsurā amī \|*  
*āpaścaivāpavatsaśca parjanyo 'gnirditiḥ kramāt \|\| 609 \|\|*

*yaddikkānāṃ ca vargo 'yamevaṃ koṇeṣvaśeṣataḥ \|*  
*tanmadhye viṃśatirbāhyā dvipadāste tu sarvadā \|\| 610 \|\|*

*aryamā ca vivasvāṃśca mitraḥ pṛthvī dharāhvayaḥ \|*  
*brahmaṇaḥ pārito dikṣu catvārastripadāḥ smṛtāḥ \|\| 611 \|\|*

604-605a. (1) Siva, (2) Parjanya, (3) Jayanta, (4) Indra, (5) Siirya, (6) Candra, (7) Bhrsa, (8) AkaSa (Antariksaka), (9) Vayu, (10) Pusa, (11) Nirrti, (12) Grhaksata, (13) Yama (Dantfadhara), (14) Gandharva, (15) Bhrngaraja (Bhriguraja), (16) Mrga, (17) PitrganadhlSa (18) Dauvarika, (19) Sugrlva, (20) Pu?padanta, (21) Vanina (Jaladhisa), (22) Asura, (23) Sesa (? Sosa), (24) Papa (Rajayaksma), (25) Roga, (26) Naga (Bhogi), (27) Mukhya, (28) Nijakara (? Bhalla^a), (29) Soma, (30) Sunya (? Sarpa), (31) Aditi, and (32) Diti. These are the 32 deities.

605b-607a. (As has already been noted, Brahma occupies the nine squares at the centre). Outside (this Brahmapada)y are the four deities, Apah, Savitra, Jaya and Rudra in the comers, beginning from northeast.

607b-609a. Again, in the alternate squares around Brahma- paday beginning from the east, are the eight deities Aryama, Savita, Vivasvan, Indra (vibudhadhipah), Mitra, Rajayaksma, Prthvldhara and Apavatsa. These are the 55 deities (to be marked in the squares)loe.

609b-611. Classification of the deities. Apas, Apavatsa, Paijanya, Agni and Diti — these deities, form in order, (five) square-groups in all the corners. From among the deites, twenty are always two-square deities. Aryama, Vivasvan, Mitra, Prthvi- dhara who are on the four sides of Brahma are three-square deities.

## \|\| 1.56.612 \|\|

*brahmāṇaṃ ca tathaikadvitripadānarcayetsurān \|*  
*vāstumantreṇa vāstujño dūrvādadhyakṣatādibhiḥ \|\| 612 \|\|*

612\. Worship of the deities. The knower of house construction should worship Brahma and the two-square and three-square deities with the hymn of house-building and with dtirvd-grass, curds and rice grains.

## \|\| 1.56.613 \|\|

*brahmamantreṇa vā śvetavastrayugmaṃ pradāpayet \|*  
*āvāhanādisarvopacārāṃśca kramaśastathā \|\| 613 \|\|*

613\. With the chanting of the Brahma-hymn shall be offered two white pieces of cloth. In due order shall be performed the invocation of the deity and the bestowing of honours.

## \|\| 1.56.614 \|\|

*naivedyaṃ trividhānnena vādyaiḥ sahasamarpayet \|*  
*tāmbūlaṃ ca tataḥ kartā prārthayedvāstupūruṣam \|\| 614 \|\|*

614\. Offering of three types of cooked rice shall be made, as musical instruments are played, (after which) betel shall be offered. Then shall the master of the house pray (as follows):

## \|\| 1.56.615 \|\|

*madgṛhe dhanadhānyādisamṛddhaṃ kuru sarvadā \|\| 615 \|\|*

615\. “Olord! Deity of the dwelling! Obeisance to you, who are intent on lying on the ground! May you make my dwelling always rich in cash and grains.”

## \|\| 1.56.616 \|\|

*iti prārthya yathāśaktyā dakṣiṇāmarcakāya ca \|*  
*dadyāttadagre viprebhyo bhojanaṃ ca svaśaktitaḥ \|\| 616 \|\|*

616\. Having prayed thus, he should pay the priest dak find according to his mite and later feed the brahmanas in consonance with his capability.

## \|\| 1.56.617 \|\|

*anena vidhinā samyagvāstupūjāṃ karoti yaḥ \|*  
*ārogyaṃ putralābhaṃ ca dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ labhennaraḥ \|\| 617 \|\|*

617\. One who performs properly the worship of the dwelling in this manner, will attain health, birth of a son, wealth and grains.

## \|\| 1.56.618 \|\|

*akṛtvā vāstupūjāṃ yaḥ praviśennavamandiram \|*  
*rogānnānāvidhānkleśānaśnute sarvasaṃkaṭam \|\| 618 \|\|*

618\. On the contrary, one who enters (and dwells) in the residence without performing the worship of the dwelling, will have to endure disease, all kinds of difficulties and every calamity.

## \|\| 1.56.619 \|\|

*akapāṭamanācchannamadattabalibhojanam \|*  
*gṛhaṃ na praviśedevaṃ vipadāmākaraṃ hi tat \|\| 619 \|\|*

619\. Enter not a house which is either doorless or roofless, or for which neither sacrifice has been made nor people fed, for such a house is a source of danger. TRAVEL:YATRA

## \|\| 1.56.620 \|\|

*atho yātrā nṛpādīnāmabhīṣṭaphalasiddhaye \|*  
*syāttathā tāṃ pravakṣyāmi samyagvijñātajanmanām \|\| 620 \|\|*

620\. I shall now set down the dictums for travel for kings and all others whose time of birth is correctly known.

## \|\| 1.56.621 \|\|

*ajñātajanmanāṃ nṝṇāṃ phalāptirghuṇavarṇavat \|*  
*praśnodayanimittādyaisteṣāmapi phalodayaḥ \|\| 621 \|\|*

621\. In the case of those whose time of birth is not known the attainment of the predicted result would be by chance, like letters carved out by a worm.109 However, in their case also correct results can be predicted through (such methods of astrology as) PraSna and Nimitta,110

## \|\| 1.56.622 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭyaṣṭamīdvādaśīṣu riktāmāpūrṇimāsu ca \|*  
*yātrā śuklapratipadi nirddhanāya kṣayāya ca \|\| 622 \|\|*

622\. Inauspicious days for travel Travel on sixth, eighth and twelfth (lunar days), ‘empty days (viz, fourth, ninth and fourteenth), full moon and first of the bright fortnight will tend to penury and distress.

## \|\| 1.56.623 \|\|

*maitrāditīndvārkāntyāśvihāgitiṣyavasūḍuṣu \|*  
*asaptapañcatryādyeṣu yātrābhīṣṭaphalapradāḥ \|\| 623 \|\|*

623\. Auspicious asterisms for travel. Travel during the asterisms Anuradha (Maitra), Punarvasu, (Aditi), MrgaSiras (Indu), Hasta (Arka), Revatl (Antya), Sravana (Hari), Tisya (Pusya) and Dhanistha (Vasu) and also those other than the seventh, fifth, third and first, will yield one’s desires.

## \|\| 1.56.624 \|\|

*na mandendudine prācīṃ na vrajeddakṣiṇaṃ gurau \|*  
*sitārkayerna pratīcīṃ nodīcīṃ jñārayorddine \|\| 624 \|\|*

624\. shUla (Spear) on Week-days. Travel not towards the east on Saturday and Monday, not southwards on Thursday, not westwards on Friday and Sunday, and not northwards on Wednesday and Tuesday.

## \|\| 1.56.625 \|\|

*indrājapādacaturāsyāryamarkṣāṇi pūrvataḥ \|*  
*śūlāni sarvadvārāṇi mitrārkejyāśvabhāni ca \|\| 625 \|\|*

625a. aUla on asterisms. (Travel is inauspicious on account of) Sula towards the four directions, from east, in order, on the asterisms: (east):Jyestha; (south): Piirva-Bhadrapada; (West): Rohinl; and (north): Uttara-phalgunl.

625b. Auspicious asterisms for all directions. The (four) asterisms, Anuradha (Mitra), Hasta (Arka), Pusya (Ijya) and AsvinI are prescribed for (travel) in all directions (sarvadvara).

## \|\| 1.56.626-627 \|\|

*kramāddigdvārabhāni syuḥ saptasaptāgnidhiṣṇyataḥ \|*  
*parighaṃ laṅghayeddaṇḍaṃ nāgniśvasanardiggamam \|\| 626 \|\|*

*āgneyaṃ pūrvadigdhiṣṇyairvidiśaścaivameva hi \|*  
*digrāśayastu kramaśo meṣādyāśca punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 627 \|\|*

626-627a. Blemish of Parigha-dantfa. Seven asterisms each, counted from Krttika (Agnidhipiya) are prescribed for free (travel) in (the four) specific directions (dig-dvara) (reckoned from east). The (diagonal) line from south-east to north-west is called Parigha-dan\<}a, (‘cross-bar’) which should not be crossed (in travel as above).111 However on night travel south-east in the asterisms specified for the east, the same rule is applicable in the case of the other directions also (i.c., southern asterisms for southwest etc.).

627b» The rdiis of the directions (dig-raii) are Mesa etc.counted in continuation ‘in order’ (from the east).112 (One can cut the parigha-danda in travel if the dig-rdSi is favourable).

## \|\| 1.56.628 \|\|

*digīśvare lalāṭasthe yāturna punarāgamaḥ \|*  
*lagnastho bhāskaraḥ prācyāṃ diśi yāturlalāṭagaḥ \|\| 628 \|\|*

628a. Lala(ika-yoga.m(The lords of the directions are, in order: East: Sun; SE: Venus; South: Mars; SW: Rahu; West: Saturn; NW: Moon; North: Mercury, and NE: Jupiter.)114 When the lord of the direction (towards which one travels) is in the laid fa yoga, the traveller will not return home.

628b. The Sun in the lagna would be lalafaga (i.e.y in the laid fa yoga) for one travelling east.

## \|\| 1.56.629 \|\|

*dvādaśaikādaśaḥ śukro 'pyāgneyyāntu lalāṭagaḥ \|*  
*daśamasthaḥ kujo lagnādyābhyāṃ yāturlalāṭagaḥ \|\| 629 \|\|*

629\. Venus in the 12th and 11th houses would be laldfaga in the south-east. Mars in the 10th house would be laldtaga in the south.

## \|\| 1.56.630 \|\|

*navamāṣṭamago rāhurnaiṛtyāṃ tu lalāṭagaḥ \|*  
*lagnātsaptamagaḥ sauriḥ pratīcyāṃ tu lalāṭagaḥ \|\| 630 \|\|*

630\. Rahil in the 9th and 8th houses would be lalafaga in the southwest. Saturn in the 7th house from lagna would be lalafaga in the west.

## \|\| 1.56.631 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭaḥ pañcamagaścandro vāyavyāṃ ca lalāṭagaḥ \|*  
*caturthasthānagaḥ saumyaścottarasyāṃ lalāṭagaḥ \|\| 631 \|\|*

631\. The Moon in the 6th and the 5th houses would be lalafaga in the north-west. Mercury in the 4th house would be lalafaga in the north.

## \|\| 1.56.632 \|\|

*dvitristhānagato jīva īśānyāṃ vai lalāṭagaḥ \|*  
*lalāṭaṃ tu parityajya jīvitecchurvrajennaraḥ \|\| 632 \|\|*

632\. Jupiter in the 2nd and 3rd houses would be lalafaga in the north-cast. One who loves his life would keep away from laid fa-yoga.

## \|\| 1.56.633 \|\|

*vilomago graho yasya yātrālagropago yadi \|*  
*tasya bhaṅgaprado rājñasta dvargo 'pi vilagnagaḥ \|\| 633 \|\|*

633\. Effect if retrograde planets. If the planet in the lagna at the commencement of the journey is retrograde, that will cause the defeat of the king; so also the vargas of those planets, if in retrograde motion.

## \|\| 1.56.634 \|\|

*ravīndvayanayoryātamanukūlaṃ śubhapradam \|*  
*tadabhāve divārātrau yāyādyāturvadho 'nyathā \|\| 634 \|\|*

634\. Effect of Ay ana. Travel in the direction of the (northward or southward) course of the Sun and the Moon is beneficial (if both move in the same direction). If otherwise (/.

## \|\| 1.56.635 \|\|

*mūḍhe śukre kāryahāniḥ pratiśukre parājayaḥ \|*  
*pratiśukrakṛtaṃ doṣaṃ hṝntuṃ śaktā grahā na hi \|\| 635 \|\|*

635\. Effect of Venus. (Journey undertaken) when Venus has set will not be successful, while that against, the course of Venus would end in failure. The adverse effect ol going against Venus cannot be counteracted by other planet; (even if tlvy be in favourable positions).

## \|\| 1.56.636 \|\|

*vāsiṣṭakāśyapeyātribhāradvājāḥ sagautamāḥ \|*  
*eteṣāṃ pañcagotrāṇāṃ pratiśukro na vidyate \|\| 636 \|\|*

636\. However, persons belonging to the five gotras, Vasistha, Kasyapa, Atreya, Bharadvaja and Gautama, will not be affected by travelling against (the course) of Venus.

## \|\| 1.56.637 \|\|

*ekagrāme vivāhe ca durbhikṣe rājavigrahe \|*  
*dvijakṣobhe nṛpakṣobhe pratiśukro na vidyate \|\| 637 \|\|*

637\. Neither travel against Venus will afreet their journeys within the same village, in famine, during wars between kings, and agitation against brahmins or kings.

## \|\| 1.56.638 \|\|

*nīcago 'rigṛhastho vā vakrago vā parājitaḥ \|*  
*yāturbhaṅgapradaḥ śukraḥ svoñcasthaścejjayapradaḥ \|\| 638 \|\|*

638\. Venus will defeat the purpose of the traveller if it is in debilitation (nica), is in enemy planets' house, in retrogression or in defeat. On the other hand, if it is in exaltation, it will bring success.

## \|\| 1.56.639 \|\|

*svāṣṭalagneṣṭarāśau vā śatrubhāttvaṣṭamepi vā \|*  
*teṣāmīśastharāśau vā yāturmṛtyurna saṃśayaḥ \|\| 639 \|\|*

639\. Prognostication based on one's janma-lagna. (If travel is commenced) in the 8th house as reckoned from one's janma- lagna, or in the 8th rdfi\> or in the 8th lagna or rati of one’s enemy or in the rdii of the lords of the above, no doubt, the traveller will meet with his death.

## \|\| 1.56.640 \|\|

*janmeṣāṣṭamalagneśau mitho mitre vyavasthitau \|*  
*janmarāśyaṣṭamarkṣotthadoṣā naśyantiṃ bhāktaḥ \|\| 640 \|\|*

640\. However, if the lord of one’s janmalagna and that of the 8th lagna are friendly, the blemishes resulting from the janmardbi and 8th house will be counteracted.

## \|\| 1.56.641 \|\|

*krūragrahekṣito yukto dviḥsvabhāvo 'pi bhaṅgadaḥ \|*  
*yāne sthirodaye neṣṭo bhavyayuktekṣitaḥ svayam \|\| 641 \|\|*

641\. Houses aspccted or occupied by violent planets (viz, Sun, Saturn and Mars) and those of a double nature (viz., Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius and Pisces) will bring about failure. Travel is not recommended during the rising of the ‘firm’ (stkira) asterisms (viz., Uttaraphalgunl, Uttarasadha, Uttara- bhadrapada and Rohini). On the other hand, houses aspected or occupied by bencfic planets are good for travel.

## \|\| 1.56.642 \|\|

*vasvantyārddhādipañcarkṣe saṃgrahaṃ tṛṇakāṣṭayoḥ \|*  
*yāmyadiggamanaṃ śayyā na kuryādgehagopanam \|\| 642 \|\|*

642\. During the five asterisms (actually four and a half) from Dhanistha (Vasu) to the middle of Revati (antyardha), should not be done the following five things; (Dhanistha): cutting grass, (Satabhisak): collecting firewood; (Purvabhadra- pada): travel south; (Uttarabhadrapada):constructing cots; and (Revati): repairing houses.

## \|\| 1.56.643 \|\|

*janmodaye janmabhe vā tayorīśasyabhepi vā \|*  
*tābhyāṃ tayorikendreṣu yātuḥ śatrukṣayo bhavet \|\| 643 \|\|*

643\. (Of a king) who starts (for war) when the then lagna is his janma-Lagna on janma-rdii, or the lords of these two are in the then lagna, or the then lagna is the 3rd, 11th (ф'я), 6th (ari) or 10th house as reckoned from the above two, viz., ianmalagna and janmarali, the enemy will perish.

## \|\| 1.56.644 \|\|

*śīrṣodaye lagnagate diglagne lagnagopi vā \|*  
*śubhavārgotha vā lagne yātuḥ śatrukṣayastadā \|\| 644 \|\|*

644\. If a tirsodaya-rashi (sign rising with head)116 is rising, the dig-lagna is in the lagna, or a beneficent varga is in the lagna, (at the start of the journey) then, too, the enemy will perish.

## \|\| 1.56.645 \|\|

*śatrujanmodaye janmarāśervā nidhanodaye \|*  
*tayorīśasthite rāśau yātuḥ śatrukṣayo bhavet \|\| 645 \|\|*

645\. (If the journey is commenced by the king) at the enemy's janmalagna, janmardti or death-lagna (i.e., 8th house), or in the signs occupied by the lords of the above, then, also, tiic enemy will perish.

## \|\| 1.56.646 \|\|

*vakraḥ panthā mīnalagne yāturmīnāṃśakepi vā \|*  
*nindyo nikhilayātrāsu ghaṭalagno ghaṭāṃśakaḥ \|\| 646 \|\|*

646\. (If a king starts) when Pisces is rising (Mina-lagna) or in the Pisces-division of another sign, his journey will be tortuous (and unsuccessful). Similarly, the sign Aquarius or its section (in any other sign) is not recommended for any type of journey.

## \|\| 1.56.647-648 \|\|

*jalalagno jalāṃśo vā jalayoneḥ śubhāvahaḥ \|*  
*mūrtiḥ kośo dhanvinaśca vāhanaṃ mantrasaṃjñakam \|\| 647 \|\|*

*śatrumārgastathāyuśca manovyāpārasaṃjñikam \|*  
*prāptiraprāptirudayādbhāvāḥ syurdvādaśaiva te \|\| 648 \|\|*

647a. For (starting) a naval expedition or travel over the waters, the rising of ‘watery’ signs(jala-rdii)117 or the sections thereof in other signs, is auspicious.

647b-648. The twelve Bhavas (Houses). The twelve houses (relating to any time) are designated as follows, commencing from the then rising sign (udaya-lagna: (1) MUrti (Body), (2) Kola (Treasury), (3) Dhanvin (Archer), (4) Vdhana (Vehicle), (5) Mantra (Counsel), (6) Satru (Enemy), (7) Mdrga (Way), (8) Ayus (Age), (9) Manas (Mind), (10) Vydpdra (Occupation), (11) Prapti(Attainment) and (12) Aprdpti (Non-attainment).110

## \|\| 1.56.649 \|\|

*ghnanti krūrāstryāptivargaṃ bhāvānsūryamahīsutau \|*  
*na nighnato hi vyāpāraṃ saumyāḥḍha puṣṇantyariṃ vinā \|\| 649 \|\|*

649\. The violent planets (viz., Sun, Mars and Saturn), are destructive in all the houses except the 3rd and the 11 th (dpti). Sun and Jupiter do not harm the 10th house (Vydpdra). The benefic planets (viz., Jupiter, Venus, Moon and Mercury) make all houses except the 6th (Ari) flourish.

## \|\| 1.56.650-651 \|\|

*śukro 'staṃ ca na puṣṇāti mūrtiṃ mṛtyuṃ ca candramāḥ \|*  
*yāmyadiggamanaṃ tyaktvā sarvakāṣṭhāsu yāyinām \|\| 650 \|\|*

*abhijitkṣaṇayogo 'yamabhīṣṭaphalasiddhidaḥ \|*  
*pañcāṅgaśuddhirahite divase 'pi phalapradaḥ \|\| 651 \|\|*

650a. Venus, when set, does not benefit any house and the Moon does not benefit the 1st (MUrti) and the 8th (Mrtyu) houses.

650b-651. Effect of Abhijit. To travellers in all directions except to the south, the asterism Abhijit will fulfil all desires. This asterism is effectively beneficial even on a day which is not pure in relation to its five aspects (Pancdngasuddhi).119

652a. Combination benefic for travel. Multifarious are the combinations for travel (yatrd-yoga). I shall, therefore, set forth those combinations.

652b-653a. A combination would be effective, in the case of a brahmin, in view of the lagna; in the case of a Ksatriya in view of the asterisms and in view of the auspicious moment (muhUrta) in the case of others. So far as a thief is concerned, the omens count most.

653b-664a. In the Kendras (quadrants, viz 1st, 4th, 7th and 10th houses) and trikonas (trines, viz\> 1st, 5th and 9th houses) a (benefic) yoga would be constituted by дпу one of Venus, Mercury and Sun. A double yoga (adhi-yoga) would be constituted by two of them, and by three a super yoga (yogadhi-yoga).

654b-655a. Ajo^flwould afford protection (kshema) and in an adhiyoga one would be successful. And, in Togadhiyoga, protection, success and prosperity would result.

655b-656a. The Moon, Saturn and Sun occupying, respectively, the 10th (Vydpdra), 6th (Satru) and 1st (MUrli)9 houses, will ensure the victory of the king who is setting out for war.

656b-657a. The enemy’s forces will melt like lac in fire before a king who has marched when the planets Venus, Sun, Mercury, Saturn and Mars were occupying, respectively, the 1st (lagna), 7th (Marga), 11th (Aya)\> 3rd and 6th (Satru) houses.

657b-658a. The enemy’s army will be transported to the abode of Death by a king who had set out when Venus occupied the 1st house (lagna) and the other planets, the 2nd (Dhana) and the 11th (Aya) houses.

658b-659a. A king who sets out when Venus is in the lagna, the Sun in the 11th (Labha), and the Moon in the 2nd (Bandhu), will destroy the horde of enemies just as a lion would destroy a herd of elephants.

659b-660a. One who sets out when Venus is in exaltation, (the lord) of the lagna is also in exaltation and the Moon is in the 11th house would have all miseries destroyed as Kesava destroyed Piitana.120

660b-661a. If the kendra and trikona houses are occupied by the benefic planets and the cruel planets occupy the 3rd, 11th and 6th houses, misfortune will seek out the traveller as a wanton woman (abhisdrika) (would go out in search of her lover).

661b-662a. In front of a king who sets out when Venus, Sun and Moon occupy, respectively, 1st, 6th and 12th (randhra) houses, the enemy would not stand firm, as (the instable) friendship between evil persons.

662b-663a. The enemy’s land would be within the grasp of a king who sets out for battle when Saturn and Mars are strong in the 3rd (trikhatfa) and 11th (Aya) houses.

663b-664a. If a king sets out when Venus, which is in exaltation, occupies the lagna and the Moon is in the 11th house (labhagata), he will destroy his enemies, as Lord Siva, with his bow Pinaka, destroyed the Tripura demons.321

664b-665a. A king who sets out (for war) when Venus, which is in exaltation, occupies the lagncy and Jupiter occupies the 11th house (llibhaga) will kill his enemies just as God Kumara killed the demon Taraka.122

665b-666a. A king who marches (for battle) when Jupiter occupies the lagna, kendra or trikona, will consume his enemies just as fire burns out the forest.

666b-667a. Kings (who go for battle) when Mercury occupies the lagna, a benefic planet in the kendra and Venus (Dhiftiya) is in a (favourable) division (upakula), will dry up the enemies just as the rays of the Sun dry up the lake during summer.

667b-668a. A king going out when a benefic planet occupies a trikona or kendra and the Sun or the Moon the 11th house (Labha) will drive away the enemies just like the Sun drives out darkness.

668b-669a. A king will destroy his enemies just as fire burns cotton if benefic planets occupy their own houses, the kendra, trikonas and the 11 th house (Aya) when he sets out.

669b-670a. A king who goes out (for war) when Moon occupies its own house, Jupiter is in a kendra and Sukra (Mantri) is in the 7th house, will destroy all his enemies like the sacred Pahcaksara destroys all sin.123

670b-671a. A king who sets out when Venus, which is in the lagna, occupies also the vargottama division in it,124 will destroy the horde of enemies just as the remembrance of Hari (Harismrti) w'ould destroy all accumulated sin.126

671b-672a. (A king starting on an expedition) when the kendra is occupied by a benefic planet and the Moon in the trikona is also in the vargottama section, will crush his enemies along with their clan just as Indra crushed the (flying) mountains.126

672b-673a. A king will kill his enemies just as the kite kills serpents, (if he starts for battle) when Jupiter occupies a friendly house and Venus occupies the kendra or trikona.

673b-674a. (If a king) sets out when a benefic planet occupying the kendra or the trikona is also in the vargottama division (of the navdmSa), he will wash away his enemies just as (the sacred river) Ganges (Bhaglrathi) washes off sins.127

674b-675a. Those kings who set out to conquer their enemies in the above yogas called ‘Royal yogas’ (nrpdhvaya) (will be victorious and) their fire of anger would be put out by the tears of the enemy queens (who would be w'eeping on their fresh widowhood).

675b-676a. The tenth day of the bright fortnight of the month of Alvina is called Vijaya. For those who go out to fight that day there might be truce, but never defeat.

676b-677a. For omens and portents the mental attitude is most important. Hence it is up to all serious-minded people to cultivate the mental attitude.

677b-678. One who desires to continue alive should not undertake a journey when a festival, the ceremonies of bestowing the sacred thread, marriage and installation of a deity, and pollution due to death or child birth (which is in force) has not been duly completed.

## \|\| 1.56.678-684 \|\|

*asamāpte na kurvīta yātrāṃ martyo jijīviṣuḥ \|*  
*mahiṣondurayoryuddhe kalatrakalahārttave \|\| 678 \|\|*

*vastrādeḥ skhalite krodhe durukte na vrajennṛpaḥ \|*  
*ghṛtānnaṃ tilapiṣṭānnaṃ matsyānnaṃ ghṛtapāyasam \|\| 679 \|\|*

*prāgādikramaśo bhuktvā yāti rājā jayatyarīn \|*  
*sajjikā paramānnaṃ ca kāñjika ca payo dadhi \|\| 680 \|\|*

*kṣīraṃ tilodanaṃ bhuktvā bhānuvārādiṣu kramāt \|*  
*kulmāṣāṃśca tilānnaṃ ca dadhi kṣaudraṃ ghṛtaṃ payaḥ \|\| 681 \|\|*

*mṛgamāṃsaṃ ca tatsāraṃ pāyasaṃ ca khagaṃ mṛgam \|*  
*śaśamāṃsaṃ ca ṣāṣṭikyaṃ priyaguṅkamapūpakam \|\| 682 \|\|*

*citrāṇḍajapalaṃ kūrmaśvāvidgodhāṃśca śāsvakam \|*  
*haviṣyaṃ kṛśarānnaṃ ca mudgānnaṃ yavapiṣṭikam \|\| 683 \|\|*

*matsyānnaṃ ca vicitrānnaṃ dadhyannaṃ dasrabhātkramāt \|*  
*bhuktvā rājebhāśvarathanarairyāti jayatyarīn \|\| 684 \|\|*

678b-679a. A king should not set out when there is going on a buffalo fight or a goat fight, a quarrel between his queens or they are in their monthly course, clothes have been soiled, and when angry words have been uttered.

679b-680a. Food before setting out. A king will conquer his enemies if he starts towards the (four) directions beginning with east after a repast, in order, of rice with ghee, cooked sesame balls, dish of fish, and rice cooked in milk with ghee added.

680b-681a. On the week-days beginning from Sunday, (he should set out) after taking a food of (1) majjaka, (2) rice cooked in rice, (3) kanjikay (4) water, (5) curd, (6) milk and (7) cooked sesame.

681b-684. A king will conquer his enemies if he sets out on the 27 asterisms beginning with AsvinI, accompanied by his army consisting of elephants, chariots, horses and infantry, after having his repast on: (1) Kulmasa, (2) cooked sesame, (3) curd, (4) milk, (5) wine, (6) ghee, (7) water, (8) venison, (9) blood from the preceding, (10) rice cooked in milk, (11) bird’s flesh, (12) Venison, (13) hare’s flesh, (14) rice, (15) priyangu (mustard), (16) rice cakes cooked in oil, (17) variegated egg, (18) fruits, (19) flesh of tortoise, (20) of tvdvid (21) of godhd, (22) of aalyakay (23) sanctified food (havifya), (24) cooked rice-sesame mixture (krSardnna) 9 (25) cooked gram, (26) balls of cookedyava flour, (27) dish of fish, (28) variegated cooked rice, and (29) curd rice.128
