*pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni dakṣāṅghrau tāni bhūsure \|*  
*sveṣṭadevaṃ samudvāsya mantrī mārtaṇḍamaṇḍale \|\| 41 \|\|*

*tatastīraṃ samāgatyaṃ vastraṃ saṃkṣālya yatnataḥ \|*  
*vāsasī paridhāyātha kuryātsandhyādikaṃ sudhīḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. Whatever sacred waters arc there on the earth, are present in the right foot of a brahmin. Then the practiser of mantra should dismiss the desired deity in the disc of the sun, should come to the bank and wash his clothes carefully. The intelligent devotee should then wear two clothes and perform the sandhya rite.

## \|\| 1.66.43 \|\|

*rogādyaśakto manujaḥ kuryāttatrāgharmaṣaṇam \|*  
*athavā bhasmanā snāto rajobhiścaiva vākṣamaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. One who is unable due to illness etc., one who is not in a fit condition shall perform aghamarsanam or take his bath by means of bhasma (sacred ashes).

## \|\| 1.66.44-49 \|\|

*atha sandhyādikaṃ kuryān sthitvā caivāsane śubhe \|*  
*keśavena tathā nārāyaṇena mādhavena ca \|\| 44 \|\|*

*saṃprāśya toyaṃ govindaviṣṇubhyāṃ kṣālayetkarau \|*  
*madhusūdanatrivikramābhyāmoṣṭhau ca mārjayet \|\| 45 \|\|*

*vāmanaśrīdharābhyāṃ ca mukhaṃ hastau spṛśettataḥ \|*  
*hṛṣīkeśapadmanābhābhyāṃ spṛśeñcaraṇau tataḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*dāmodareṇa mūrddhānaṃ mukhaṃ saṃkarṣaṇena ca \|*  
*vāsudevena pradyumnena spṛśennāsike tataḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*aniruddhapuruṣottamābhyāṃ netre spṛśettataḥ \|*  
*adhokṣajanṛsiṃhābhyāṃ śravaṇe saṃspṛśettathā \|\| 48 \|\|*

*nābhiṃ spṛśedacyutena janārdanena vakṣasi \|*  
*hariṇā viṣṇunāṃsau ca vaiṣṇavācamanaṃ tvidam \|\| 49 \|\|*

44-49. Then he should perform sandhya rite seated on aiuauspicious seat. By uttering Kcsava, Narayana and Madhava he should sip water thrice. He should wash his hands with the names Govinda and Visnu. Saying Madhusudana and Trivikrama he should wipe off his lips. Saying Vamana and Sridhara he shall touch the mouth and the hands. Saying Hrsikesa and Padmanabha he shall touch the feet. Saying Damodara he shall touch the head. Saying Samkarsana he shall touch the mouth. Saying Vasudeva and Pradyumna he shall touch the nostrils. Saying Aniruddha aud Purusottama, he shall touch his eyes. Saying Adhokshaja and Nfsimha he shall touch his ears. Saying Acyuta he shall touch the navel, with Janardana he shall touch the chest. Saying Hari and Visnu he should touch his shoulder. This is the Vaishnava mode of acamana.

## \|\| 1.66.50-51 \|\|

*praṇavādyairṅentasvāhāntaiḥ keśavādikanāmabhiḥ \|*  
*mukhe nasoḥ pradeśinyānāmayā netrakarṇayoḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*kaniṣṭhayā nābhideśaṃ sarvatrāṅguṣṭyojanam \|*  
*ātmavidyāśivaistattvaiḥ svāhāntaiḥ śaivamīritam \|\| 51 \|\|*

50-51. The pranava must be uttered in the beginning and Kesava etc. must be used in the dative case with namaji at the end (om Kegavaya namah). The mouth and the nose should be touched with the index finger. The eyes and the ears should be touched with the ring finger, the navel with the little finger. The limbs are to be touched with the thumb. The Saiva mode of Acamana should be done with Atmatattva, vidyatattva and givatattva and ending with svaha (atmatattvaya svaha etc.).

## \|\| 1.66.52-53 \|\|

*dīrghatrayenduyugvyomapūrvakaiśca pibejjalam \|*  
*ātmavidyāsivaireva śaivaṃ svāhāvasānikaiḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*vāglajjāśrī mukhaiḥ proktaṃ śāktaṃ svāhāvasānikaiḥ \|*  
*vāglajjāśrīmukhaiḥ proktaṃ dvijācamanamarthadam \|\| 53 \|\|*

52-53. One shall sip water with vyoman~ha united with three long vowels = a, i, u and bindu =. The gaiva mode is with Atmatattva, vidyatattva, and givatattva and ends with svaha. The gAkta form of acamana is as follows. It begins with vak = aim, lajja = hrim and gri=srim and ends with svaha. The acamana of brahmins is said to be with vak, lajja and sri = aim, hrlm, grim and is the bestower of wealth.

## \|\| 1.66.54-55 \|\|

*tilakaṃ ca tataḥ kuryādbhāle suṣṭhu gadākṛti \|*  
*nandakaṃ hṛdaye śaṅkhacakre caiva bhujadvaye \|\| 54 \|\|*

*śārṅgabāṇaṃ mastake ca vinyasetkramaśaḥ sudhīḥ \|*  
*karṇamūle pārśvayośca pṛṣṭe nābhau kakudyapi \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. Thereafter, he should make the tilaka (a sectarian mark) on his forehead neatly in the shape of a mace. A mark like the sword of Krsna named Nandaka must be made on the chest, and the marks of the gankha (conch) and cakra (wheel) on the two arms. The wise devotee should then make the marks of the (bow) garnga and the arrow one after. He shall make similar marks at the rogt of the ears, at the sides, on the back, at the navel and on the head.

## \|\| 1.66.56-58 \|\|

*evaṃ tu vaiṣṇavaḥ kuryānmṛdbhistīrthodbhavādibhiḥ \|*  
*agnihotrodbhavaṃ bhasma gṛhītvā tryaṃbakeṇa tu \|\| 56 \|\|*

*kiṃvāgniriti mantreṇābhimantrya pañcamantrakaiḥ \|*  
*kramāttatpuruṣāghorasadyojātādināmabhiḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*pañca kuryātripuṇḍrāṇi bhālāṃsodarahṛtsu ca \|*  
*śaivaṃ śāktastrikoṇā bhaṃ nārīvadvā samācaret \|\| 58 \|\|*

56-58. These are to be done by a Vaishnava with the clay taken from the holy rivers etc. (The Saivas) after taking ashes from the agnihotra fire repeat the mantra beginning with: Tryambakam (yajamahe etc.) or the mantra beginning with agniriti bhasma, vayuriti bhasma etc. He shall then make five marks uttering five names of Tatpurusa, Aghora, Sadyojata etc. on the forehead, shoulders, belly and chest. The follower of Siva does this. The follower of Sakti shall make triangular marks or the mark as does a woman.

## \|\| 1.66.59-60 \|\|

*kṛtvā tu vaidikīṃ saṃdhyāṃ tāntrikīṃ ca samācaret \|*  
*ācamya vidhivanmantrī tīrthānyāvāhya pūrvavat \|\| 59 \|\|*

*tatastrivāraṃ darbheṇa bhūmau toyaṃ viniḥbhipet \|*  
*saptadhā tajjalenātha mūrddhānamabhiṣecayet \|\| 60 \|\|*

59-60. After performing sandhya rites according to the vedas, he should perform the TantrikI Sandhya. After sipping water according to the method he should invoke the holy water as before. Then with the Kusha grass he should sprinkle water on the ground three times. He shall sprinkle that water on his head seven times.

## \|\| 1.66.61-63 \|\|

*tataśca prāṇānāyamya kṛtvā nyāsaṃ ṣaḍaṅgakam \|*  
*ādāya vāmahasteṃ'bu dakṣeṇācchādya pāṇinā \|\| 61 \|\|*

*viyadvāyvagnitoyakṣmābījaiḥ saṃmantrya mantravit \|*  
*mūlena tasmāt ścotadbhirbindubhistattvamudrayā \|\| 62 \|\|*

*svaśiraḥ saptadhā prokṣyāvaśiṣṭaṃ tatpunarjalam \|*  
*kṛtvā tadakṣaraṃ mantrī nāsikāntikamānayet \|\| 63 \|\|*

61-63. Thereafter he should perform pranayama and 9a4aAganyasha (placement of mantras in six limbs). Then he should take water in the palm and cover it with the right hand. He, the knower of the mantra, should charge the water with the seed mantra of viyat=ha, vayu=»ya, agni — ra, toya — va, Ksma =» la and uttering the mulamantra and by means of tattvamudra he should sprinkle his head seven times with the water dripping from it. He should take the remaining water in his right palm and bring it near his nostril.

## \|\| 1.66.64-65 \|\|

*jalaṃ tejomayaṃ tañcākṛṣyāntaśceḍayā punaḥ \|*  
*prakṣālyāntargataṃ tena kalmaṣaṃ tajjalaṃ punaḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ piṅgalayā recayetsvāgratastathā \|*  
*kṣipedastreṇa tatpaścātkalpite kuliśopale \|\| 65 \|\|*

64-65. That brilliant water should be drawn inside by means of itfa for washing away all the sins lying within. When the water has turned black, it should be discharged by means of pingalain front ofhim (on his right palm). He should cast it on the ground by uttering the astra (phat) mantra conceiving the ground to be made of adamantine stone.

## \|\| 1.66.66-68 \|\|

*etaddhvi sarvapāpaghnaṃ proktaṃ caivāghamarṣaṇam \|*  
*tataśca hastau prakṣālya prāgvadācamya mantravit \|\| 66 \|\|*

*samutthāya ca mantrajñastāmrapātre sumādikam \|*  
*prakṣipyārghaṃ pradadyādvai mūlāntairmantramuccaran \|\| 67 \|\|*

*ravimaṇḍalasaṃsthāya devāyārghyaṃ prakalpayet \|*  
*dattvārghaṃ triranenātha devaṃ ravigataṃ smaret \|\| 68 \|\|*

66-68. This is called aghamarsana rite which dispels all sins. Then the knower of mantras should wash his hands and perform the acamana rite as before. The knower of the mantras shall get up and place flowers in a copper vessel. Repeating the mulamantra he should offer the arghya to the deity stationed in the disc of the sun. After offering the arghya three times with the mantra he should think of the presence of the deity in the sun.

## \|\| 1.66.69 \|\|

*svakalpoktāṃ ca gāyatrīṃ japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam \|*  
*aṣṭāṃviṃśativāraṃ vā guhyetimanunārpayet \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. He shall perform the japa of Gayatri one hundred and eight times according to his own Kalpa or twentyeight times and then dedicate it by uttering the mantra guhya.1

## \|\| 1.66.70 \|\|

*udyadādityasaṃkāśāṃ pustakākṣakarāṃbujām \|*  
*kṛṣṇājināṃbarāṃ brāhmīṃ dhyāyettārāṅkite 'mbare \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. During the morning he shall meditate on Brahml resembling the rising sun, having the book and rosary in her lotus-like hands and clad in Krsnajina (black deer skin). He shall meditate on her in the star-studded sky.

## \|\| 1.66.71-73 \|\|

*madhyāhne varadāṃ devīṃ pārvatīṃ saṃsmaretparām \|*  
*śuklāṃbarāṃ vṛṣārūḍhāṃ trinetrāṃ ravibiṃbagām \|\| 71 \|\|*

*varaṃ pāśaṃ ca śūlaṃ ca dadhānāṃ nṛkaroṭikām \|*  
*sāyāhne ratnabhūṣāḍhyāṃ pītakauśeyavāsasām \|\| 72 \|\|*

*śyāmaraṅgāṃ caturhastāṃ śaṅkhacakralasatkarām \|*  
*gadāpadmadharāṃ devīṃ sūryāsanakṛtāśrayām \|\| 73 \|\|*

71-73. During the midday he shall meditate on the goddess Parvatl, who is the bestower of boons, who is the greatest goddess seated on a bull. She is clad in white garments. She has three eyes, who is present in the disc of the sun and she holds in her hands the mudra of vara (boon), the noose, the trident and the human skull. During the evening he shall meditate on the goddess who is bedecked in gem-set ornaments, who is clad in yellow silk clothes, who is of dark colour, who has four hands wherein the sankha, cakra (discus), the iron club and the lotus shine and who has taken her seat in the sun.

## \|\| 1.66.74 \|\|

*tato devānṛṣīṃścaiva pitṝṃścāpi vidhānavit \|*  
*tarpayitvā sveṣṭadevaṃ tarpayetkalpamārgataḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. Then the knower of procedure shall propitiate devas, sages, and pitrs and then perform tarpana rite to his desired deity in accordance with the procedure laid down in the kalpas.

## \|\| 1.66.75-76 \|\|

*gurupaṅktiṃ ca saṃtarpyaṃ sāṃgaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ tathā \|*  
*sāyudhaṃ vainateyaṃ saṃtarpayāmīti tarpayet \|\| 75 \|\|*

*nāradaṃ parvataṃ jiṣṇuṃ niśaṭhoddhavadārukān \|*  
*viṣvaksena ca śaileyaṃ vaiṣṇavaḥ paritarpayet \|\| 76 \|\|*

75-76. Then performing the tarpana to the line of gurus with their arigas and family members, he should offer water saying. “I am giving water to Vainateya, with weapons. The Vaishnava should perform tarpana to Narada, Parvata, Jisnu, Nisa(ha, Uddhava, Daruka, Visvaksena and Saileya.

## \|\| 1.66.77 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃtarpya viprendra dattvārdhyaṃ ca vivasvate \|*  
*pūjāgāraṃ samāgatya prakṣālyāṅghrī upaspṛśet \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. Thus propitiating the sun, О eminent among the brah- manas, and offering arghya to the sun and returning to the chamber of worship he should wash his feet and perform the acamana rite.

## \|\| 1.66.78 \|\|

*agnihotrasthitānagnīn hutvopasthāya yatnataḥ \|*  
*pūjāsthalaṃ samāgatya dvārapūjāṃ samācaret \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. After making an oblation to the fire and worshipping it properly, he should come to the altar: he should worship the deities on the door-lintel.

## \|\| 1.66.79-81 \|\|

*gaṇeśaṃ corddhvaśākhāyāṃ mahālakṣmīṃ ca dakṣiṇe \|*  
*sarasvatīṃ vāmabhāge dakṣe vighneśvaraṃ punaḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*kṣetrapālaṃ tathā vāme dakṣe gaṅgāṃ prapūjayet \|*  
*vāme ca yamunāṃ dakṣe dhātāraṃ vāmatastathā \|\| 80 \|\|*

*vidhātāraṃ śaṅkhapadmanidhīṃśca vāmadakṣayoḥ \|*  
*dvārapālāṃstato 'bhyarcettattatkalpoditānsudhīḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

79-81. The intelligent devotee should worship GaneSa on the upper lintel of the door, Mahalaksmi on the right, Sarasvati on the left and VighneSvara on the right again, Ksetra- palaon the left. Ganga on the right, Yamuna on the left are to be worshipped. He shall worship Dhatr on the right and, Vidhatr on the left. He should worship Sankha and Padma on the left and on the right. He shall then worship dvarapalas, the guardians of the door as mentioned in different Kalpas.

## \|\| 1.66.82 \|\|

*nandaḥ sunandaścaṇḍaśca pracaṇḍaḥ pracalobalaḥ \|*  
*bhadraḥ subhadraścetyādyā vaiṣṇavā dvārapālakāḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. Nanda, Sunanda, Сап

## \|\| 1.66.83 \|\|

*nandī bhṛṅgī riṭī skando gaṇeśomāmaheśvarāḥ \|*  
*vṛṣabhaśca mahākālaḥ śaivā vai dvārapālakāḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. Nandin, Bhrngin, Riti, Skanda, Ganesa, Uma- maheivara, Vfsabha andMahakala are the doorkeepers according to shaivas.

## \|\| 1.66.84 \|\|

*brāhmayādyā mātaro 'ṣṭau tu śaktyo dvāḥsthitāḥ svayam \|*  
*seṃduḥ svanāmāgharṇādyā ṅenamoṃtā ime smṛtāḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. The eight mothers Brahmi and others are the eight aaktis stationed at the door. They are worshipped with pranava «om in the beginning, their names in the dative case and ending with папиф.

## \|\| 1.66.85 \|\|

*tataḥ sthitvāsane dhīmānācamya prayataḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*divyāntarikṣabhaumāṃśca vighnānutsārya yatnataḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. The intelligent one should sit steadily in the seat and after doing Acamana he should be pure and be of effort. He should remove the obstacles of heaven, sky and the earth carefully.

## \|\| 1.66.86-100 \|\|

*keśavādyāṃ mātṛkāntu nyasedvaiṣṇavasattamaḥ \|*  
*keśavaḥ kīrtisaṃyuktaḥ kāntyā nārāyaṇastathā \|\| 86 \|\|*

*mādhavastuṣṭisahito govindaḥ puṣṭisaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*viṣṇustu dhṛtisaṃyuktaḥ śāntiyuṅmadhusūdanaḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

*trivikramaḥ kriyāyukto vāmano dayitāyutaḥ \|*  
*śrīdharo medhayā yukto hṛṣīkiśaśca harṣayā \|\| 88 \|\|*

*padmanābhayutā śraddhā lajjā dāmodarānvitā \|*  
*vāsudevaśca lakṣmīyuk saṃkarṣaṇasarasvatī \|\| 89 \|\|*

*pradyumnaḥ prītisaṃyukto 'niruddho ratisaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*cakrī jayāyutaḥ paścādgadī durgāsamanvitaḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

*śārṅgī tu prabhayā yuktaḥ khaḍgī yuktastu satyayā \|*  
*śaṅkhī caṇḍāsamāyukto halī vāṇīsamāyutaḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

*musalī ca bilāsinyā śūlī vijayayānvitaḥ \|*  
*pāśī virajayā yukto kuśī viśvāsamanvitaḥ \|\| 92 \|\|*

*mukundo vinatāyukto nandajaśca sunandayā \|*  
*nindī smṛtyā samāyukto naro vṛddhyā samanvitaḥ \|\| 93 \|\|*

*samṛddhiyuṅnarakajicchuddhiyukca hariḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇo buddhyā yutaḥ satyo bhuktyā muktyātha sātvataḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

*saurikṣame sūrarame umāyukto janārdanaḥ \|*  
*bhūdharaḥ kledinīyukto viśvamūrtiśca klinnayā \|\| 95 \|\|*

*vaikuṇṭho vasudhāyukto vasudaḥpuruṣottamaḥ \|*  
*balī tu parayā yukto balānujaparāyaṇe \|\| 96 \|\|*

*bālasūkṣme vṛṣaghnastu saṃdhyāyuk prajñayā vṛṣaḥ \|*  
*haṃsaḥ prabhāsamāyukto varāho niśayā yutaḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

*vimalo dhārayā yukto nṛsiṃho vidyutā yutaḥ \|*  
*keśavādimātṛkāyā munirnārāyaṇo mataḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*

*amṛtādyā ca gāyatrī chando viṣṇuśca devatā \|*  
*cakrādyāyudhasaṃyuktaṃ kuṃbhādarśadharaṃ harim \|\| 99 \|\|*

*lakṣmīyutaṃ vidyudābhaṃ bahubhūṣāyutaṃ bhajet \|*  
*evaṃ dhyātvā nyasecchaktiṃ śrīkāmapuṭitākṣaram \|\| 100 \|\|*

86-100. The most excellent Vaishnava should perform the nyasa of Kesava along with the matrkas, (syllables of alphabets) KcSava is associated with Kirti, Narayana with Kanti, Madhava with Tusti, Govinda with Pusti, Visnu with Dhrti, Madhu- sudana with Santi, Trivikrama with Kriya, Vamana with Dayita, Sridhara with Medha, Hrsikesa with Harsa, Padmanabha with Sraddha, Damodara with Lajja, Vasudeva with Laksmi, Sankarsana with Sarasvati, Pradyumna with Priti, Aniruddha with Rati, Cakri with Jaya, Gadin with Durga, Sarngin with Prabha and Khadgin with Satya, Sankhin with Canda, Halin with Vani, Musalin with Vilasinl,'shulin with Vijaya, Pa sin with Viraja, Kusin with ViSva, Mukunda with Vinata, Nandaja with Sunanda, Nandin with Smfti, Nara with Rddhi, Narakajit with Samrddhi, Hari with Suddhi, Krsna with Buddhi, Satya with Bhukti, Satvata with Mukti, Sauri with Ksama, Sura with Rama, Janardana with Uma, Bhudhara with KledinT, Vi^vamurti with Klinna, Vaikuntha with Vasudha Purusottama with Vasuda Balin with Para, Balanuja with Parayana, Bala with Suksma, Vrsaghna with Sandhya, Vr?a with Prajfia, Varaha with Nisa, Vimala with Dhara, Nisimha with Vidyuta. Narayana is the sage of matrkas beginning with amrta related to Kesava. The metre is Gayatri and the deity is Visnu. One should worship Hari who is equipped with discus and other weapons, who is holding a vessel and a mirror. He is accompanied by Laksmi who has the brilliance of lightning and is adorned with a lot of ornaments. Having done this meditation one should make nyasas with Kama = Klim added to the letter. (Om klim am Kesavaya klrtyai namah)

## \|\| 1.66.101-104 \|\|

*vadettadviṣṇuśaktibhyāṃ hṛdayaṃ praṇavādikam \|*  
*tvagaṃsṛṅmāṃsamedo 'sthimajjāśukrāṇyasūnvadet \|\| 101 \|\|*

*prāṇaṃ krodhaṃ tathā mabhyāmantānyādidaśasvapi \|*  
*eka maulau mukhe caika dvika netre dvikaṃ śrutau \|\| 102 \|\|*

*nasordvayaṃ kapole ca dvayaṃ dve dviradacchade \|*  
*ekaṃ tu rasanāmūle grīvāyāmekameva ca \|\| 103 \|\|*

*kavargaṃ dakṣiṇe bāhau cavargaṃ vāmabāhuke \|*  
*ṭatavargauṃ pādayostu paphau kuṅkṣidvaye nyaset \|\| 104 \|\|*

101-104. One should say pranava in the beginning with each Visnu associated with its Sakti and end in hrdaya« namah. One should say (with a corresponding letter) tvak (skin) asrk (blood), mariisa (flesh), medas (fat), asthi (bones), majja (marrow), iukra (semen), prana, krodha, atman with letters beginning with ya onward, in all ten locations. One letter on the head, one in the mouth, two in the eyes, two in the ears, two, in the nostrils, two in the cheeks, two in lips, one at the root of the tongue and one in the neck. The letters of kavarga should be fixed in the different portions of the right arm, the letters of cavarga in the left arm, the letters of tavarga and tavarga on two legs, the letters pa and pha are to be placed in two bellies.

## \|\| 1.66.105-106 \|\|

*pṛṣṭhavaṃśe vamityuktaṃ nābhau bhaṃ hṛdaye tu mam \|*  
*yādisaptāpi dhātusthā haṃ prāṇe laṃ tathātmani \|\| 105 \|\|*

*kṣaṃ krodhe kramato nyasya viṣṇu pūjākṣamo bhavet \|*  
*pūrṇodaryā tu śrīkaṇṭho hyananto vijarānvitaḥ \|\| 106 \|\|*

105-106. The letter bais to be placed on the back (spinal bone), the letter bha in the navel and the letter ma in the heart. The seven letters beginning with the ya are to be placed on the seven dhatu.s. The letter ha is to be placed on the prana, and the letter la in the inner atman. The letter ksa is to be placed in anger (supreme atman). After the placement of all these letters in their proper sequence one is competent to perform the worship of Visnu.

Thus meditating, he should make a nyasa of the deity beginning with tara = oin with the deity in the dative along with its Kala.

150\. (The following are the jatis): Namah, Svaha, Vasaf, hum, vausat and phat. Thereafter he shall meditate on the favourite lord endowed with ornaments and weapons. After making six nyasas in the image, he shall begin worship.

## Chapter 67.

## \|\| 1.67.1-3 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvāca*  
*atha vakṣye devapūjāṃ sādhakābhīṣṭasiddhidām \|*  
*trikoṇaṃ caturasraṃ vā vāmabhāge prakalpya ca \|\| 1 \|\|*

*sampūjyā sreṇa saṃkṣālya hṛdādhāraṃ nidhāya ca \|*  
*tatrāgnimaṇḍalaṃ cedvā pātraṃ saṃkṣālya cāsrataḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*ādhāre nāmasaṃ sthāpya tatra cedravimaṇḍalam \|*  
*klimamātṛkā pūlamuñcaranpūrapejjalaiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

Sanat Kumara Said:

1-3. Henceforth, I shall recount the worship of devas, which bestows desired ends on the aspirant. After drawing a triangle or a square, to his left, one should worship it and then wash it with astra = phat and placing the adhara (support of the vessel) with hrt = namah. Then placing the camasa the vessel on the support, he should fill it with water while meditating there the disc of the sun and repeating the alphabets in their ascending order (vilomamatrka).

## \|\| 1.67.4 \|\|

*catreñjumaṇḍalaṃ prārcya tīrthānyāvāhya pūrvavat \|*  
*gomudrayāmṛtīkṛtya kavacenāvaguṇṭhayet \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. He shall worship the disc of the moon thereafter invoking the holy tlrthas as before. Then he should make it (the water) turn into nectar by means of gomudra and should cover it with Kavaca = hum.

## \|\| 1.67.5 \|\|

*saṃkṣālyāsreṇa praṇavaṃ taduparyaṣṭadhā japet \|*  
*sāmānyārghamidaṃ proktaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ nṛṇām \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. After washing it with astra = phat, he shall then perform the japa of pranava = om, eight times over it. This is called samanyargha (an arghya for the general purpose) and the bestower of all attainments.

## \|\| 1.67.6 \|\|

*tajjalaṃ rkicidudūdhṛtya prokṣiṇyā sādhakottamaḥ \|*  
*ātmānaṃ yāgavastūni tena saṃprokṣayetputhak \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The excellent sadhaka shall take a little water from the proksanl vessel and sprinkle himself as well as the articles to be used in the ritual separately.

## \|\| 1.67.7 \|\|

*ātmavāmāgrataḥ kuryātṣaṭṭkoṇāntasrikoṇakam \|*  
*caturasreṇa saṃveṣṭya saṃkṣālyārghodakena ca \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. He should make a triangle inside two intersecting triangles in front of him and to his left. It should be surrounded by a square and washed by the water from the argha vessel.

## \|\| 1.67.8-9 \|\|

*tatastu sādhakaśreṣṭhaḥ staṃbhayecchaṅkhamudrayā \|*  
*āgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu hṛdādyaṅgacatuṣṭayam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*netraṃ madhye dikṣu cāsraṃ trikoṇe pūjayettataḥ \|*  
*mūlakhaṇḍatrayenāthādhāraśaktiṃ tu madhyagām \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. The excellent sadhaka should arrest it by means of samkhamudra. He should then worship the four limbs (ahgas) beginning with hit = namah in the four corners from south-east to north-east. He shall worship the middle portion with netra vausaf and the quarters with astra =» phat. He shall then worship the triangle, the adharashakti (the power as support) as present in the middle by means of mulamantra.

## \|\| 1.67.10 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivadasraṃsaṃkṣālitaṃ hṛdā \|*  
*pratiṣṭāpya tripadikāṃ pūjayenmanunāmunā \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Thus worshipping duly as washed by means of astra- phaf and established by means of hit «= namah, he should place the tripadika (a three-legged stool) and worship it by means of the following mantra.

## \|\| 1.67.11 \|\|

*maṃ vahnimaṇḍalā yeti tato deśakalātmane \|*  
*amukārdhyeti pātrānte sanāpahṛdayoṃ'time \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. (Namo vahnimandalaya dasakalatmane amuka arghya patrasaxmya namah) I bow to the disc of the fire having Kalas and which is the receptacle of the seat for the person referred to here.

## \|\| 1.67.12 \|\|

*caturviṃśativarṇo 'yamādhārasyārcane manuḥ \|*  
*svamantrakṣālitaṃ śaraṃvaṃ saṃsyāpyāya samarcayet \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The mantra for the purpose of worshipping the support (adhara) consists of twenty four letters. He shall then place the conch washed with its own mantra = phat and then worship.

## \|\| 1.67.13 \|\|

*tāraḥ kārṃmamahāṃste tu tato jalacarāya ca \|*  
*varma phaṭ hṛdayaṃ pāñcajanyāya hṛdayaṃ maneḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. (He should utter) tara = om in the beginning, then mahan, then jalacaraya, then varma=hum phat, hrdavam (?) (svaha), pa ftcajanyaya, hfdayam^ namah (om mahajalacaraya hum phat svaha paficpjanyaya namah).

## \|\| 1.67.14 \|\|

*tatrārkamaṇḍalāyeti dvādaśānte kalāramane \|*  
*amukārdhyeti pātrānte namontastryakṣivarṇavān \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. He should then worship the disc of the sun consisting of twelve kalas and adding the name of the deity referred to with its relation to the verse of the arghya and then add namah in the end. (arkamantfalaya dvadasakalatmane amuka arghyapatraya namah). It has three times two syllables (?)

## \|\| 1.67.15-17 \|\|

*sampūjya tena tatrārceddvādaśārkakalāḥ kramāt \|*  
*tataḥ śuddhajalairmūlaṃ vilomamātṛkāṃ paṭhan \|\| 15 \|\|*

*śaṅkhamāpūrayettasminpūjayenmanunāmunā \|*  
*oṃ somamaṇḍalāyeti ṣoḍaśānte kalātmane \|\| 16 \|\|*

*amukārdhyāmṛtāyeti hṛnmanuścārdhyapūjane \|*  
*tatra ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyākā yajeñcandramasaḥ kalāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

15-17. After worshipping thereby, one shall worship the twelve kalas of the sun in due order. Therefore, he shall fill the conch by means of pure water reciting the mulamantra (the principal mantra) and the letters of alphabets in the ascending order (i.e. from ksa to a) and then worship it with the following mantra. Om obeisance to the disc of the moon consisting of sixteen kalas and which is of the nature of nectar and has taken the form of the arghya of the deity referred to here (Om somamandalaya sodaSakalatmane amuka arghyapatraya namah). The mantra for the purpose of worshipping the arghya is the kalas of the moon.

## \|\| 1.67.18 \|\|

*tatastu tīrthānyāvāhya gaṅge cetyādipūrvavat \|*  
*gomudrayāmṛtīkṛtyācchādayenmatsmamudrayā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Therefore, the holy rivers are invoked repeating‘O Gariga’ etc. as before. He should make it turn into nectar by means of Gomudra. He shall then cover it with Matsyamudra.

## \|\| 1.67.19 \|\|

*kavacenāvaguṇṭhyātha rakṣedastreṇa tatpunaḥ \|*  
*cintayitveṣṭadevaṃ ca tato mudrāḥ pradarśayet \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. He shall cover it with kavaca^ hum and guard it again with astra-phat. Meditating on the desired deity he should show mudras.

## \|\| 1.67.20 \|\|

*śaṅkhamauśalacakākhyāḥ paramīkaraṇaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*mahāmudrāṃ yonimudrāṃ darśayetkramataḥ sudhīḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. (The learned man should show indue order) sankha,1 musala, paramlkarana and then the mudras called mahamudra, yonimudra.

## \|\| 1.67.21 \|\|

*gāruḍī gālinī caiva mukhye mudre prakīrtite \|*  
*gandhapuṣpādibhistatra pūjayeddevatāṃ smaranaṭ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The garutfl1 and galinl2 are known to be the chiefest of the mudras. He should worship the deity there by means of sandal paste and flowers after recalling the deity in his mind.

## \|\| 1.67.22 \|\|

*aṣṭakṛtvo japenmūlaṃ praṇavaṃ cāṣṭadhā tathā \|*  
*śaṅkhāddakṣiṇadigbhāge prokṣaṇīpātramādiśet \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. He should repeat the principal mantra eight times and the pranava also eight times. He shall place the proksanf vessel to the southern side of the conch.

## \|\| 1.67.23-24 \|\|

*prokṣaṇyāṃ tajjalaṃ kiñcitkṛtvātmānaṃ tridhā tataḥ \|*  
*ātmatattvātmane hṛñca vidyātattvātmane namaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*śivatattvātmane hṛñca ityetairmanubhistribhiḥ \|*  
*prokṣetpuṣpākṣataiścāpi maṇḍalaṃ vidhivatsudhīḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. He should take a little water from the proksani and sprinkle it thrice. He shall sprinkle himself with that water repeating the following three mantras: Om obeisance to atmatattva, to vidyatattva and to Sivatattva adding om and hjt = namah. The intelligent devotee should worship duly the diagram (man^ala) with flowers and aksatas(raw rice grains).

## \|\| 1.67.25-27 \|\|

*athavā mūlagāyatryā pūjādravyāṇi prokṣayet \|*  
*pādyārdhyācamanūyārthaṃ madhuparkārthamapyuta \|\| 25 \|\|*

*pātrāṇyādhārayuktāni sthāpayedvidhinā puraḥ \|*  
*pādyaṃ śyāmākadūrvābjaviṣṇukrāntajalaiḥ smṛtam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*ardhyaṃ puṣpākṣatayavaiḥ kuśāgratilasarṣapaiḥ \|*  
*gandhadūrvādalaiḥ proktaṃ tataścācamanīyakam \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. He should sprinkle the articles for the worship with the mulagayatri. For pad у a (water for washing the feet), arghya (offerings), acamaniya (water for rinsing the mouth), and madhuparka, he should place vessels with their stands in front of him. The padya water is known to consist of gyamaka (green) durva grass, lotus, Visnukranta (wild jasmine) flowers. The arghya consists of water with flowers, aksatas, barley grains, tips of kusha grass, sesamum seeds and mustard. The acamanlya water contains sandal pastes and blades of durva grass.

## \|\| 1.67.28 \|\|

*jātīphalaṃ ca kaṅkolaṃ lavaṅgaṃ ca jalānvitam \|*  
*kṣaudrājyadadhisaṃmiśraṃ madhuparkasamīritam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Madhuparka is said to contain jatiphala, kankola cloves along with water and a mixture of honey, clarified butter and curds.

## \|\| 1.67.29 \|\|

*ekasminnathavā pātre pādyādīni prakalpayet \|*  
*śaṅkarārkārcane śaṅkhamayenaiva praśasyate \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. All these padyas are to be placed in a single vessel or otherwise. But for worshipping Sankara or the sun the vessel of Sankha is not recommended.

## \|\| 1.67.30 \|\|

*śvetākṛṣṇāruṇāpītāśyāmāraktāsitāsitāḥ \|*  
*raktāṃbarābhayakarādhyeyāḥspuḥ pīṭhaśaktayaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The pl(hasaktis should be meditated upon as having white, black, pink, yellow, dark-coloured, reddish, white, not white and red garments. They should be meditated upon with hands showing gesture of assurance (abhaya).

## \|\| 1.67.31 \|\|

*svarṇādilikhite yantre śālagrāme maṇau tathā \|*  
*vidhinā sthāpitāyāṃ vā pratimāyāṃ prapūjayet \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. One should worship either in the yantra inscribed in plates of gold or in the salagrama stone or in an idol installed according to religious injunction.

## \|\| 1.67.32 \|\|

*aṅguṣṭādivitastyantamānā svarṇādidhātubhiḥ \|*  
*nirmitā śubhadā gehe pūjanāya dine dine \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. For the purpose of daily worship at home the idol made of gold and other metals is auspicious. Its measurement may be of the length of the thumb upto the span of vitasti (the measure of twelve angulis)

## \|\| 1.67.33 \|\|

*vakrāṃ dagdhāṃ khaṇḍitāṃ ca bhinnamūrddhadṛśaṃ punanaḥ \|*  
*spaṣṭāṃ vāpya ntyajādyaiśca pratimāṃ naiva pūjayet \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. One should not worship an idol if it is crooked, burnt, or broken, if its head is split, or if it is looking upward, or if it is touched by an antyaja (outcaste) and others.

## \|\| 1.67.34-35 \|\|

*bāṇādiliṅge vābhyarcetsarvalakṣaṇalakṣite \|*  
*mūlena mūrtiṃ saṃkalpya dhyātvā devaṃ yathoditam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*āvāhā pūjayetasyāṃ parivāragaṇaiḥ saha \|*  
*śālagrāme sthāpitāyāṃ nāvāhanavisarjane \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. Or he should worship in a Banalinga etc. endowed with good characteristics. He should conceive the image of the deity by means of mulamantra (the principal mantra) and meditate in the manner as mentioned. He should invoke the deity and worship the idol (as conceived by him) along with the attending deities. In a Salagrama or in the installed idol, there is neither avahana (invocation) nor visaijana (dismissal).

## \|\| 1.67.36-38 \|\|

*puṣpāñjaliṃ samādāya dhyātvā mantramudīrayet \|\| 36 \|\|*

*ātmasaṃsthamajaṃ śuddhaṃ tvāmahaṃ parameśvara \|*  
*araṇyāmiva havyāśaṃ mūrtāvāvāhayāmyaham \|\| 37 \|\|*

*taveyaṃ hi mahāmūrtistasyāṃ tvāṃ sarvagaṃ prabho \|*  
*bhaktirevahasamākṛṣṭaṃ dīpavatsthāpayāmyaham \|\| 38 \|\|*

36-38. He should take handful of flowers, meditate and utter the mantra: "O ParameSvara, unto this idol I invoke you who are pure, unborn, self-established (atmasamstha) like the fire in the агащ. This is verily your great image. О lord, I instal you in that, for you are present everywhere. I shall instal you who have been drawn near by means of attachment of devotion like the lamp with oil.

## \|\| 1.67.39 \|\|

*sarvāntaryāmiṇe devaṃ sarvabījamaya śubham \|*  
*ravātmasthaāya paraṃ śuddhamāsanaṃ kalpayāvyaham \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. О lord, you are the immanent soul in everyone for the establishment in atman. I offer you this pure, auspicious seat consisting of Bijas.

## \|\| 1.67.40 \|\|

*ananyā tava deveśa mūrtiśaktiriyaṃ prabho \|*  
*sāṃnidhyaṃ kuru tasyāṃ tvaṃ bhaktānugrāhakāraka \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. О lord of devas, this miirtishakti of yours is non- different from you. О benefactor of devotees, be present therein.

## \|\| 1.67.41 \|\|

*ajñānājuca mattattvādvaikalyātsādhanasya ca \|*  
*yadyapūrṇaṃ bhavetkalpaṃ katathāpyabhimukho bhava \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Even if the rituals are incomplete either due to my ignorance or arrogance or due to deficiency in any material, be favourable to me.

## \|\| 1.67.42 \|\|

*dṛśā pūyūṣavarṣiṇyā pūrayanyajñaviṣṭare \|*  
*mūrtauṃ vā yajñasaṃpūrtyai sthito bhava maheśvara \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. О Mahesvara, with your eyes showing nectar, for the purpose of fulfilling yajna, be stationed in the sacrificial seat or in the murti.

## \|\| 1.67.43 \|\|

*abhaktavāṅmanaścakṣuḥ śrotradūrāyitadyute \|*  
*svatejaḥ pañjareṇāśu veṣṭito bhava sarvataḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. О God, your lustre is far away from speech mind and the eyes of non-devotee, be enveloped all round by means of enclosure of your refulgence immediately.

## \|\| 1.67.44 \|\|

*yasya darśanāmicchanti devāḥ svābhīṣṭasiddhaye \|*  
*tasmai te parameśāya svāgataṃ svāgataṃ ca me \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Welcome to you, the great Isha, whose vision Devas wish for fulfilling their desire. To me you are welcome.

## \|\| 1.67.45 \|\|

*kṛtārtho 'nugṛhīto 'smi saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ mama \|*  
*āgato devadeveśaḥ sukhāgatamidaṃ punaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. My desire has been attained, favour has been shown to me and my life has become fruitful, for the lord of devas has come. I say welcome to you again.

## \|\| 1.67.46 \|\|

*yadbhaktileptasaṃparkātparamānandasaṃbhavaḥ \|*  
*tasmai me paraṇābjāya pādyaṃ śuddhāya kalpyate \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. I offer padya to your lotus-like feet. A slight touch of devotion of your feet brings about supreme bliss.

## \|\| 1.67.47 \|\|

*vedānāmapi vedāya devānāṃ devatātmane \|*  
*ācāmaṃ kalpayāmīśa śuddhānāṃ śuddhihetave \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. О lord, the veda of the vedas and the deity of the deities, I offer this acamanlya to you for the purpose of causing purification to those who are already pure.

## \|\| 1.67.48 \|\|

*tāpatrayahara divyaṃ paramānandalakṣaṇam \|*  
*tāpatrayavinirmuktyai tavārghyaṃ kalpayāmyaham \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. О lord, I am presenting this arghya unto you for being liberated from three kinds of miseries (tapa). The arghya is characterised by supreme bliss. It is divine and it dispels three kinds of miseries.

## \|\| 1.67.49 \|\|

*sarvakāluṣyahīnāya paripūrṇasukhātmane \|*  
*madhuparkamidaṃ deva kalpayāmi prasīda me \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. О lord, you are of the nature of perfect happiness and free from all kinds of stains, I offer unto you this madhu- parka. Be pleased with me.

## \|\| 1.67.50 \|\|

*avacchiṣṭo 'pyaśucirvāpi yasya smaraṇamātrataḥ \|*  
*śuddhimāpnoti tasmai te punarācamanīyakam \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Again do I offer you acamanlya the second time. Merely by remembering you, one who is defiled by ucchi?ta (leavings of food), or one who is impure otherwise attains purification.

## \|\| 1.67.51 \|\|

*snehaṃ gṛhāṇa snehena lokanātha mahāśaya \|*  
*sarvalokeṣu śuddhātmandadāmi snehamuttamam \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. О lord of the worlds, О high-souled one, please accept oil out of compassion to me. You are pure-souled in the world. I am presenting this excellent oil to you.

## \|\| 1.67.52 \|\|

*paramānandabodhābdhinimagnanijamūrtaye \|*  
*sāṃgopāṅgamidaṃ snānaṃ kalpayāmyahamīśa te \|*  
*sahasraṃ vā śataṃ vāpi yathāśaktyādareṇa ca \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. О lord, your own form is immersed in the ocean of great bliss and enlightenment. I offer you this ablution along with its ancillaries and sul\>ancillaries with respect and in accordance with my capacity. It may be a thousand times or it may be only a hundred times.

## \|\| 1.67.53-55 \|\|

*gandhapuṣpādikairīśa manunāṃ cābhiṣiñcet \|\| 53 \|\|*

*māyāci trapaṭacchannanijaguhyorutejase \|*  
*nirāvaraṇavijñāna vāsaste kalpayāmyaham \|\| 54 \|\|*

*yamāśritya ma hāmāyā jagatsaṃmohinī sadā \|*  
*tasmai te parameśāya kalpayāmyuttarīyakam \|\| 55 \|\|*

53-55. He should make the ablution with perfumes, flowers etc. by repeating the mantra of the Lord. “O lord whose perfect knowledge is unveiled, I offer this raiment to you whose secret and great splendour is enveloped by the cover of Maya of diverse colours. I offer this uttariya (upper cloth) to you, the great Lord. By resorting to you, Mahamaya always functions in deluding the entire universe.”

## \|\| 1.67.56 \|\|

*raktaṃ śaktyarkavighneṣu pītaṃviṣṇau sitaṃ śive \|*  
*tailādidūṣitaṃ jīrṇaṃ sacchidraṃ malinaṃ tyajet \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. To Sakti, the sun and VighneSvara red cloth is offered, to Visnu yellow and to Siva white. One should avoid a cloth that is defiled by oil etc, that which is old, is in rags or dirty.

## \|\| 1.67.57 \|\|

*yasya śaktitrayeṇadaṃ saṃprītamakhilaṃ jagat \|*  
*yajñasūtrāya tasmai te yajñasūtraṃ prakalpaye \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. I offer this sacred thread (Yajnasutra) to the one who himself is Yajnasutra (the presiding deity of sacrifice) and by whose three-fold shakti the entire universe is permeated.

## \|\| 1.67.58 \|\|

*svabhāvasundarāṅgāya nānāśaktyāśrayāya te \|*  
*bhūṣaṇāni vicitrāṇi kalpayāmyamarārcita \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. О lord, worshipped by the immortal ones, I offer you ornaments of diverse kinds, to you whose limbs are naturally handsome, to you who are the support of various 6aktis.

## \|\| 1.67.59 \|\|

*paramānandasaurabhyaparipūrṇadigantaram \|*  
*gṛhāṇa parama gandha kṛpayā parameśvara \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. О great Lord, accept this perfeedy pure perfume that has filled up all quarters with its blissful fragrance.

## \|\| 1.67.60 \|\|

*turīyavanasaṃbhūtaṃ nānāguṇamanoharam \|*  
*amandasaurabhapuṣpaṃ gṛhyatāmidamuttamam \|*  
*japākṣatārkadhattūrānviṣṇau naivārpayetkvacit \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. May this excellent flower that is grown in the best garden (turiyavana) and is charming on account of possessing diverse good qualities, and excessively fragrant be accepted. The following things should not be offered to Visnu. Japa (chinarose), aksatas (new rice grains), arka and dhattiira flower.

## \|\| 1.67.61 \|\|

*ketakīṃ kuṭajaṃ kundaṃ bandhūkaṃ kesaraṃ japām \|*  
*mālatīpuṣpaka caiva nārpayettu maheśvare \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. The KetakI, Kutaja, Kunda (a variety of Jasmine), Kesara (measure ferria), bandhuka and japa and the malati flower should never be offered to Mahefvara.

## \|\| 1.67.62 \|\|

*mātuliṅgaṃ ca tagaraṃ ravau naivārpayetkvacit \|*  
*śaktau dūrvārkamandārān gaṇeśe tulasīṃ tyajet \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. The tagara (Jabernal montena coroiiaria) and the matulunga (pomegranate) shall never be offered to the sun. One should eschew durva, arka, and mandara flowers in the worship of Sakti and Tulasi in the worship of Ganesha.

## \|\| 1.67.63-65 \|\|

*sarojinīdamanakau tathā marubakaḥ kuśaḥ \|*  
*viṣṇukrāntā nāgavallī dūrvāpāmārgadāḍimau \|\| 63 \|\|*

*dhātrī muniyutānāṃ ca patrairdevārcanaṃ caret \|*  
*kadalī badarī dhātrī tintiṇī bījapūrakam \|\| 64 \|\|*

*āmradāḍimajaṃbīrajaṃbūpanasabhūruhāḥ \|*  
*eteṣāṃ tu phalaiḥ kuryāddevatāpūjanaṃ budhaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

63-65. The following can be used in the worship of all deities: Lotus, damanaka, marubaka, kusa, Visnuk^anta, nagavalll, durva, apamarga and dadima. One should perform the worship of deities with the leaves of dhatri (myrobalan) of three varieties. The wise worshipper with the fruits of Kadali (plantain), badari the jujube dhatri, tintini, bijapuraka (pomegranate), atnra (mango), dadima (pomegranate variety) jamblra (sour lemon), and panasa (jack fruit).

## \|\| 1.67.66-67 \|\|

*śuṣkaistu nārcayeddevaṃ patraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalairapi \|\| 66 \|\|*

*dhātrī khadirabitvānāṃ tamālasya dalāni ca \|*  
*chinnabhinnānyapi mune na dūṣyāṇi jagurbudhāḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. One should not worship the lord with such flowers, leaves or fruits as are dry. The experts say that the leaves of dhatri (myrobalan), khadira (acacia catechu) bilva and tamala (xanthocymus pictorious), should not be abandoned. О sage, even when they are split and torn.

## \|\| 1.67.68 \|\|

*padmamāmalakaṃ tiṣṭecchuddhaṃ caiva dinatrayam \|*  
*sarvadā tulasī śuddhā bilvapatrāṇi vai tathā \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. The lotus, amalaka (embylic myrobalan) remain pure for three days. The tulasi and the leaves of bilva are always pure.

## \|\| 1.67.69 \|\|

*palāśakāśakusumaistamālatulasīdalaiḥ \|*  
*chātrīdalaiśca dūrvābhirnārcayejjagadaṃbikām \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. One shall not worship jagadamba with the flowers of palala and kaSa (butea frondosa and long reed), with the leaves of tamala, tulasi, dhatri and durva grass.

## \|\| 1.67.70 \|\|

*nārpayetkusumaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ deve hyadhomukham \|*  
*puṣpapatrādikaṃ vipra yathotpannaṃ tathārpayet \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. One shall not offer flowers, leaves or fruits over the deity with face down. Leaves and flowers, О brahmin, should be offered as they are grown.

## \|\| 1.67.71 \|\|

*vanaspatirasaṃ divyaṃ gandhāḍhyaṃ sumanoharam \|*  
*āghreyaṃ devadeveśa dhūpaṃ bhaktyā gṛhāma me \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. О lord of deities, the essence of the plant is divine, rich with fragrance, pleasing to the mind and is worthy to be inhaled. Please accept the incense that I have offered devoutly to you.

## \|\| 1.67.72 \|\|

*suprakāśaṃ mahādīpaṃ sarvadā timirāpaham \|*  
*ghṛtavartisamāyuktaṃ gṛhāṇa mama satkṛtam \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Accept the great lamp having good brilliance. It always dispels darkness and has the wick soaked in ghee. Most reverently I submit it to you.

## \|\| 1.67.73 \|\|

*annaṃ caturvidhaṃ svādu rasaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ samanvitam \|*  
*bhaktyā gṛhāṇa me deva naivedyantuṣṭidaṃsadā \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. О lord, accept naivcdya offered devoutly by me. It contains four kinds of cooked food. It is tasty and contains six flavours and bestows satisfaction.

## \|\| 1.67.74 \|\|

*nāgavallīdalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pūgakhadiracūrṇayuk \|*  
*karpūrādisugandhāḍhyaṃ yaddattaṃ tadgṛhāṇa me \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. Accept the excellent nagavalll leaves (betel) accompanied by hreca-nut and catecha powder (khadira ейпц). It is rich with the fragrance of camphor etc. Please accept as I offer them to you

## \|\| 1.67.75 \|\|

*dadyātpuṣpāñjaliṃ paścātkuryādāvaraṇārcanam \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. Then he should offer handful of flowers and perform worship of the attending deities (avarana).

## \|\| 1.67.76-77 \|\|

*yadāśābhimukho bhūtvā pūjanaṃ tu samācaret \|*  
*saiva prācī tu vijñeyā tato 'nyā vidiśo daśa \|\| 76 \|\|*

*keśareṣvagnikoṇādi hṛdayādīni pūjayet \|*  
*netramagre dikṣu cāstraṃ aṅgamantrairyathākramam \|\| 77 \|\|*

76-77. The direction facing which one performs worship should be known as the east. The other ten directions are to be ascertained accordingly. One should worship in the pericarp beginning with the south-east etc the hrd-namah netra =. vausat in the front and astra — phat in all directions uttering the angamantras duly.

## \|\| 1.67.78 \|\|

*śuklaśvetasitaśyāmakṛṣṇaraktārciṣaḥ kramāt \|*  
*varābhayakarā dhyeyāḥ svasvadikṣvaṃ gaśaktayaḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. The angagaktis should be meditated upon in their respective quarters. Their complexion being sparkling, white, grey, dark black and red and their hands showing the gesture of granting boons and fearlessness.

## \|\| 1.67.79-80 \|\|

*amukāvaraṇānte tu devatā iti saṃvadet \|*  
*sālaṅkārāstataḥ paścātsāṃgāḥ saparicārikāḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*savāhanāḥ sāyudhāśca tataḥ sarvo pacārakaiḥ \|*  
*saṃpūjitāstarpitāśca varadāḥ saṃtvidaṃ paṭhet \|\| 80 \|\|*

79-80. He should mention the name of avarana as referred to here, then add devata, then utter salamkarah well- adomed with ornaments, then utter sangah and saparicarikah, savahanah (along with their attendants, servants and vehicles), sayudhafc with weapons. May they be pleased with us and be givers of boons after being worshipped with all ingredients and made fully satisfied, (amukavarana devata salankaras sangah saparicarikah savahanah sayudhah sarvopacarakaih sampujitah tarpitah varadah santu — this is the mantra).

## \|\| 1.67.81-82 \|\|

*mūlānte ca samuñcārya divatāyai nivedayet \|*  
*abhīṣṭasiddhiṃ me dehi śaraṇāgatavatsala \|\| 81 \|\|*

*bhaktayā samarpaye tubhyamamukāvaraṇārcanam \|*  
*ityuñcārya kṣipetpuṣpāñjaliṃ devasya mastake \|\| 82 \|\|*

81-82. At the end of the miilamantra, uttering the mantra (just mentioned) he should offer everything to the deity. He should say: О lord, favourably disposed towards those who seek refuge, grant unto me the object of my desire. I offer this presentation of worshipping such and such avarana deity to you with devotedness. After saying this, he should cast the handful of flowers on the head of the lord.

## \|\| 1.67.83 \|\|

*tatastvabhyarcyanīyāḥ syuḥ kalpoktāścāvṛtīḥ kramāt \|*  
*sāyudhāṃstata indrādyānsvasvadikṣu prapūjayet \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. Then the attending deities as mentioned in the kalpas should be worshipped. He should worship Indra and others equipped with their respective weapons and placed in their respective quarters.

## \|\| 1.67.84 \|\|

*idro vahniryamo rakṣo varuṇaḥ pavano vidhuḥ \|*  
*īśāno 'tha vidhiścaivamadhastātpanna gādhipaḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. They are Indra, Agni, Yama, Raksas, Varu^a, Pavana, the moon, I Sana, and Brahma and in the bottom the lord of the serpents.

## \|\| 1.67.85 \|\|

*airāvatastathā meṣo mahiṣaḥ pretastimirmṛgaḥ \|*  
*vājī vṛṣo haṃsakūrmauṃ vāhanāni vidurbudhāḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

85» Learned people know these as their vehicles viz. Airavata (elephant), mesha (ram)., mahifa (buffalo), preta (ghost), timi (whale), mrga (deer), vajin (horse), v^sa (bull), hamsa (swan), and kurma (tortoise).

## \|\| 1.67.86 \|\|

*vajraṃ śaktiṃ daṇḍakhaḍgau pāśāṃ kuśagadā api \|*  
*triśūlaṃ padmacakre ca kramādindrādihetayaḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. The respective weapons of Indra and others are as follows: Vajra (thunderbolt), Sakti (javelin), danda (staff), khadga (sword), pasa (noose), ankuSa (goad), gada (club), trHula (trident), padma (lotus), cakra (discus).

## \|\| 1.67.87-88 \|\|

*samāpyāvaraṇārcāṃ tu devatārārtikaṃ caret \|*  
*śaṅkhatoyaṃ parikṣipyodvāhurnṛtyan patetkṣitau \|\| 87 \|\|*

*daṇḍavañcāpyathotthāya prārthayitvā nije śvaram \|*  
*dakṣiṇe sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā tatra saṃskāramācaret \|\| 88 \|\|*

87-88. After worshipping the avarana he shall perform the arartrika (waving of lamp and incense) of the deities. After pouring the water from the conch-shell he shall lift his arms and dance, then fall prostrate on the ground like a staff. He shall then get up and pray to his favourite deity. He shall make an altar on the right hand side of him and perform its consecratory rite.

## \|\| 1.67.89 \|\|

*mūlenekṣaṇamastreṇa prokṣaṇaṃ tāḍanaṃ punaḥ \|*  
*kuśaistadvarmaṇābhyukṣya pūjya tatra nyasedvasum \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. The looking at the altar is to be done with the mulamantra, the sprinkling of it with astra (phat), the striking to be done by kusa grass, abhyuksana (sprinkling over) by varma hum. Then he should make a nyasa of vasu.

## \|\| 1.67.90-92 \|\|

*pradāpya tatra juhuyāddhyātvā caiveṣṭadevatām \|*  
*mahāvyāhṛtibhiryastu samastābhiścatuṣṭayam \|\| 90 \|\|*

*juhuyātsarpiṣā bhaktaistilairvā pāyasena vā \|*  
*saghṛtaiḥ sādhakaśreṣṭhaḥ pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā \|\| 91 \|\|*

*punarvyāhṛtibhaghirhutvā gandhādyaiḥ punararcayet \|*  
*devaṃ saṃyojayenmūrtauṃ tato vahniṃ visarjayet \|\| 92 \|\|*

90-92. He should kindle the fire and after intensifying it he should perform homa after meditating on the desired deity. He shall then perform mahavyahrti homa separately and then collectively with ghee, cooked rice, gingelly seeds or milk pudding. The excellent sadhaka shall perform twentyfive oblations with ghee. After offering homa with mahavyahrti, he shall again offer worship to the deity with sandal pastes etc. Then inviting the deity of the fire to the idol of the pi^ha, he should dismiss it.

## \|\| 1.67.93 \|\|

*bho bho vahne mahāśakte sarvakarmaprasādhaka \|*  
*karmāntare 'pi saṃprāpte sānnidhyaṃ kuru sādaram \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. О vahni of great power, О achiever of holy rites, even when another holy rite befalls me, be gracefully present.

## \|\| 1.67.94-97 \|\|

*visṛjyāgnidevatāyai dadyādācamanīyakam \|*  
*avaśiṣṭena haviṣā gandhapuṣpākṣatānvitam \|\| 94 \|\|*

*devatāpārṣadebhyo 'pi pūrvoktebhyo baliṃ dadet \|*  
*ye raudrā raudrakarmāṇo raudrasthānanivāsinaḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

*yoginyo hyugrarūpāśca gaṇānāmadhipāśca ye \|*  
*vighnabhūtāstathā cānye digvidikṣu samāśritāḥga \|\| 96 \|\|*

*sarve te prītamanasaḥ pratigṛhṇantvimaṃ balim \|*  
*ityaṣṭadikṣu datvā ca punarbhūtabaliṃ caret \|\| 97 \|\|*

94-97. After the ritualistic dismissal he shall offer acama- niya to the fire-god. By means of the havis left over, he should offer oblations to the attendants of the deity as mentioned before along with sandal pastes, fragrant flowers and akshatas “May all Rudras who are the doers of terrific activities, who are the dwellers of dreadful abode, may the Yoginis of terrible forms, may the overlords of the Ganas and others who act as obstacles and who resort to various quarters and their interstices, may all these accept this bali with delightful minds”. Thus he shall offer oblations in the eight quarters and perform bhutabali (oblations to the goblins) again.

## \|\| 1.67.98 \|\|

*pānīyamamṛtīkṛtya mudrayā dhenusaṃjñayā \|*  
*devatāyāḥ kare dadyātpunaścācamanīyakam \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. By means of dhenumudra he shall make the drinking water change into nectar and offer acamanxya again into the hand of the deity.

## \|\| 1.67.99 \|\|

*devamudvāsya mūrtisthaṃ punastatraiva yojayet \|*  
*naivedyaṃ ca tato dadyāttattaducchiṣṭabhojine \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. After ritualistically dismising the lord stationed in the mOrti, he shall re-unite him there itself. He shall give naivedya (food-offering) to different ucchishJabhojins (those who partake of the leavings of food)

## \|\| 1.67.100 \|\|

*maheśvarasya caṇḍeśo viṣvaksenastathā hareḥ \|*  
*caṇḍāṃśustaraṇervaktatuṇḍaścāpi gaṇeśituḥ \|*  
*śakterucchiṣṭacāṇḍālī proktā ucchiṣṭabhojinaḥ \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. The following are the ucchistabhojins viz. Can^esa of MaheSvara (Siva), Vxsvaksena of Visnu, Candarhsu of Tarani (sun), Vakratuntfa of Ganesa and СапфШ of Sakti.

## \|\| 1.67.101 \|\|

*tato ṛṣyādikaṃ smṛtvā kṛtvā mūlaṣaḍaṅgakam \|*  
*japtvā mantraṃ yathāśakti devatāyai nivedayet \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. Thereafter, he shall remember the sage etc and perform the tnulasadanga nyasa. After repeating the japa of the mantra according to his ability he should offer it to the deity.

## \|\| 1.67.102 \|\|

*guhyātiguhyagoptā tvaṃ gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japam \|*  
*siddhirbhavatu me deva tvatprasādāttvayi sthitā \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. You are protector of the secret of secrets. Accept this japa performed by us. О lord, by your grace, may siddhi (attainment) lying with you be mine.

## \|\| 1.67.103-104 \|\|

*tataḥ parāṅmukhaṃ cārghaṃ kṛtvā puṣpaiḥ prapūjayet \|*  
*dorbhyāṃ pabhdyāṃ ca jānubhyāmurasā śirasādṛśā \|*  
*manasā vacasā ceti praṇāmo 'ṣṭāṅga īritaḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

*bāhubhyāṃ ca sajānubhyāṃ śirasā vacasāpi vā \|*  
*pañcāṅgakaḥ praṇāmaḥ syātpūjāyāṃ pravarāvubhau \|\| 104 \|\|*

103-104. Then he should place the arghya turned back and worship it with flowers. Obeisance to you of eight limbs with hands, feet, knees, chest, head, eyes, mind or speech. Obeisance to you having five limbs with the hands, feet, knees, head or speech. In worship both of them are the most distinguished.

## \|\| 1.67.105 \|\|

*natvā ca daṇḍavanmantrī tataḥ kuryātpradakṣiṇāḥ \|*  
*viṣmusomārkavighnānāṃ vedārdhendvadrivahnayaḥ \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. The knowerof mantras should perform obeisance by prostrating like a staff. He should perform circumambulations two for Visnu, one for Soma, seven for the Sun and three for Vighne^vara.

## \|\| 1.67.106-109 \|\|

*tataḥ stotrādikaṃ mantrī prapaṭhe dbhaktipūrvakam \|*  
*itaḥ pūrṇaṃ prāṇabuddhidehadharmādhikārataḥ \|\| 106 \|\|*

*jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyante 'vasthāsu manasā vadet \|*  
*vācā hastābhyāṃ ca padbhyā mudareṇa tataḥ param \|\| 107 \|\|*

*śiṣṇānte yatsmṛtaṃ paścādyaduktaṃ yatkṛtaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*tatsarvaṃ ca tato brahmarpaṇaṃ bhavatu ṭhadvayam \|\| 108 \|\|*

*māṃ madīyaṃ ca sakalaṃ viṣṇave ca samarpaye \|*  
*tāraṃ tatsadato brahmarpaṇamastu manurmataḥ \|\| 109 \|\|*

106-109. Then the knower of the mantra should recite hymns etc. with devotion (Then taking water in his palm he should utter beginning with itahpurvam) ‘previously by virtue of my possession of prana (vital energy), buddhi (intellect and the physical body with their attributes, he should state after, during the various conditions of waking, dreaming and deep sleep,whatever has been done by the mind, hands, feet, belly, penis, whatever is remembered, after this he should mention, ‘whatever has been uttered, has been done, may that be dedicated entirely to Brahman, then he should say two thas-svaha. I dedicate myself and whatever is mine to Vi?^u. The mantra is known to be ‘Om tat sat Brahmarpanamastu’.

## \|\| 1.67.110-117 \|\|

*praṇavādyo 'ṣṭavasvarṇo hyanenātmānamarpayet \|*  
*ajñānādvā pramādādvā vaikalyātsādhanasya ca \|\| 110 \|\|*

*yannyūnamatiriktaṃ vā tatsarvaṃ kṣantumarhasi \|*  
*dravyahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ mantrahīnaṃ mayānyathā \|\| 111 \|\|*

*kṛtaṃ yattatkṣamasveśa kṛpayā tvaṃ dayānidhe \|*  
*yanmayā kriyate karma jāgratsvaprasuṣuptiṣu \|\| 112 \|\|*

*tatsarvaṃ tāvakī pūjā bhūyādbhūtyai ca me prabho \|*  
*bhūmau skhalitapādānāṃ bhūmirevāvalaṃbanam \|\| 113 \|\|*

*tvayi jātāparādhānāṃ tvameva śaraṇaṃ prabho \|*  
*anyathā śaraṇaṃ nāsti tvameva śaraṇaṃ mama \|\| 114 \|\|*

*tasmātkāruṇyabhāvena kṣamasva parameśvara \|*  
*aparādhasahasrāṇi kriyante 'harnniśaṃ mayā \|\| 115 \|\|*

*dāso 'yamiti māṃ matvā kṣamasva jagatāṃ pate \|*  
*āvāhanaṃ na jānāmi na jānāmi visarjanam \|\| 116 \|\|*

*pūjāṃ caiva na jānāmi tvaṃ gatiḥ parameśvara \|*  
*saṃprārthyaivaṃ tato mantrī mūlānte ślokamuñcaret \|\| 117 \|\|*

110-117. The mantra beginning with pragava = om having sixtyfour letters (8 x 8 - 64) should be used for surrendering oneself. It behoves you to forgive everything if it is deficient or superfluous due to ignorance, or due to blunder or due to lack of materials. Olia, О storehouse of mercy, kindly forgive if anything is done otherwise, or if it is devoid of articles, deficient in any rite or deficient in mantras. О Lord, whatever has been done by me in the states of waking, dreaming and deep sleep may be conducive to my prosperity. It shall be your worship. Those who stumble on the ground, have the ground itself as their support. О Lord, those who offend you have only you as their refuge. I have no other refuge, hence you alone are my refuge. О Paramesvara, hence you forgive me. Thanks to your merciful nature. Thousands of crimes are being committed by me day and night. О Lord of the worlds, forgive the same considering that I am but your slave. I do not know avahana (invocation) neither do I know visarjana (dismissal). О great lord, I do not know your worship as well, you alone are my goal. After praying thus the knower of the mantras should utter the verse at the end of the mulamantra.

## \|\| 1.67.118 \|\|

*gaccha gaccha paraṃ sthānaṃ jagadīśa jaganmaya \|*  
*yanna brahmādayo devā jānanti ca sadāśivaḥ \|\| 118 \|\|*

118\. ‘O Lord of the universe, the immanent one, go, О go to your supreme abode of which Brahma and other gods and even Sadagiva do not have any knowledge.

## \|\| 1.67.119-120 \|\|

*iti puṣpāñjaliṃ datvā tataḥ saṃhāramudrayā \|*  
*nidhāya devaṃ sāṃgaṃ ca svīyadṛtsarasīruhe \|\| 119 \|\|*

*suṣumṇāvartmanā puṣpamāghrāyodvāsayed budhaḥ \|*  
*śaṅkhacakraśilāliṅgavighnasūryadvayaṃ tathā \|\| 120 \|\|*

119-120. Repeating the above verse he should offer handful of flowers and then by means of samharamudra,1 he should place the deity along with its attending deities in the lotus heart by means of susumnapatha. The wise worshipper should inhale the fragrance of the flower and thus perform the ritualistic dismissal of it. One should never worship two sankhas, cakras, Silas (Salagrama), lingas, two idols of VighneSvaras, two of suns and three Saktis together. It is conducive to misery. 1

## \|\| 1.67.121-124 \|\|

*śaktitrayaṃ na caikatra pūjayedduḥkhakāraṇam \|*  
*akālamṛtyuharaṇaṃ sarvavyādhivināśan \|\| 121 \|\|*

*sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ viṣṇupādodakaṃ śubham \|\| 122 \|\|*

*tattadbhaktairgṛhī tavyaṃ tannaivedyaniveditam \|*  
*agrāhyaṃ śivanirmālyaṃ patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ jalam \|\| 123 \|\|*

*śālagrāmaśilāsparśātsarvaṃ yāti pavitratām \|*  
*pūjā pañcavidhā tatra kathitā nāradākhilaiḥ \|\| 124 \|\|*

121-124. The holy water from the feet of Visnu is auspicious. It wards off premature death and it is the destroyer of all ailments. It reduces all sins. The naivedya (food offering) to the different deities shall be taken by the respective devotees. Siva’s nirmalya (remains of worship), leaves, flowers, fruits or even water should not be partaken of. By the contact of Sala- grama stone everything is rendered pure. О Narada, worshipping is said to be of five kinds.

## \|\| 1.67.125 \|\|

*āturī sautikī trāsī sādhanā bhāvinī tathā \|*  
*daurbodhī ca kramādāsāṃ lakṣaṇāni śṛṇuṣaava me \|\| 125 \|\|*

125\. They are aturi (pertaining to the sick) sautikl (that of the polluted), trasi (that of the frightened), sadhanabhavini (the articles for the worship are mentally conceived) and daurbodhl (that which is done by ignorant people). Listen to the characteristics of them in their order.

## \|\| 1.67.126-129 \|\|

*rogādiyukto na srāyānna japenna ca pūjayet \|*  
*vilokya pūjāṃ devasya mūrtiṃ vā sūryyamaṇḍalam \|\| 126 \|\|*

*praṇamyātha smaranmantramarpayetkumāñjalim \|*  
*roge nivṛtte snātvātha natvā saṃpūñcedgurum \|\| 127 \|\|*

*tvatprasādājjagannātha jagatpūjya dayānidhe \|*  
*pūjāvicchedadoṣo me māstviti prārthayecca tam \|\| 128 \|\|*

*dvijānapi ca saṃpūjya yathāśaktyā pratoṣya ca \|*  
*tebhyaścāśiṣamādāya devaṃ prāgvattator'cayet \|\| 129 \|\|*

126-129. One who is sick shall not take bath, or perform japa or puja. He shall witness other person’s worship. Looking at the idol or the disc of the sun he shall bow down or recollecting the mantra he should offer handful of flowers. When sickness is cured he shall take bath. He shall then bow down to and worship his preceptor. He shall then pray as follows: ‘By your grace, О lord of the universe, О storehouse of mercy, worthy of being worshipped by the world, let no defect arise in me on account of the break in the puja’. He shall show honour to the Brahmanas and propitiate them according to his capacity. Then on receiving their blessings he should worship the lord as before.

## \|\| 1.67.130-132 \|\|

*āturī kathitā hyeṣā sotikyatha nigadyate \|*  
*sūtakaṃ dvividhaṃ proktaṃ jātākhyaṃ mṛtasaṃjñakam \|\| 130 \|\|*

*tatra snātvā mānasīṃ tu kṛtvā saṃdhyāṃ samāhitaḥ \|*  
*manasaiva yajeddevaṃ manasaiva japenmanum \|\| 131 \|\|*

*nivṛtte sūtake prāgvatsaṃpūjya ca guruṃ dvijān \|*  
*tebhyaścāśiṣamādāya tato nityakramaṃ caret \|\| 132 \|\|*

130-132. The puja called aturi has been recounted. Now the sautiki form is being explained. Sutaka is said to be of two forms: One is named jataka and the other is mftaka i.e. due to the nativity of a child and death. The devotee should take his bath and perform sandhya mentally with concentration. He should worship the deity mentally and make a japa of the mantra. When the period of pollution is over he shall worship the preceptor and the brahmans as before. After securing their blessings he should resume daily rites. This is called sautiki form of worship. The type called trasi is being explained now.

## \|\| 1.67.133-135 \|\|

*eṣā tu sautikī proktā trāsī cātha nigadyate \|*  
*duṣṭebhyastrāsamāpanno yathālabdhopacāraṅkaiḥ \|\| 133 \|\|*

*mānasairvai yajeddevaṃ trāsī sā parikīrtitā \|*  
*pūjāsādhanavastūnāma sāmarthye tu sarvataḥ \|\| 134 \|\|*

*puṣpaiḥ patraiḥ phalairvāpi manasā vā yajedvibhum \|*  
*sādhanābhāvinī hyeṣā daurbodhīṃ śṛṇu nārada \|\| 135 \|\|*

133-135. When one is afraid of wicked people one worships the lord with whatever form of service one finds available or mentally. This is called trasi. If there is deficiency of the means of worship in everything, he should worship the lord with flowers, leaves or fruits or worship mentally. This is called sadbhavanabhavini. О Narada, now listen to Daurbodhi type of worship.

## \|\| 1.67.136 \|\|

*striyo vṛddhā stathā bālā mūrkhāstaistu yathākramam \|*  
*yathājñānakṛtā sā tu daurbodhīti prakīrtitā \|\| 136 \|\|*

136\. Women, old people, children and ignorant people do this out of ignorance, hence it is called daurbodhi.

## \|\| 1.67.137-140 \|\|

*evaṃ yathākathañcittu pūjāṃ kuryāddhi sādhakaḥ \|*  
*devapūjāvihīno yaḥ sa gacchennarakaṃ dhruvam \|\| 137 \|\|*

*vaiśvadevādikaṃ kṛtvā bhojayeddvijasattamān \|*  
*deve niveditaṃ paścādbhuñjīta svagaṇaiḥ svayam \|\| 138 \|\|*

*ācamyānanaśuddhiṃ ca kṛtvā tiṣṭet kiyatkṣaṇam \|*  
*purāṇamitihāsaṃ ca śṛṇuyātsvajanaiḥ saha \|\| 139 \|\|*

*samarthaḥ sarvakalpeṣu yo 'nukalpaṃ samācaret \|*  
*na sāṃgaśayikaṃ tasya durmaterjāyate phalam \|\| 140 \|\|*

137-140. The aspirant should peiform puja in any of the above ways. One who is devoid of worship of the lord certainly goes to hell. After performing the rites of VaiSvadeva etc. he should feed the best of brahmins. Afterwards he shall partake of what has been offered unto the lord with his near relatives. He shall rinse his mouth and make his mouth and face pure. Then take a little rest and then listen to the puranas, itihasas etc along with his kinsmen. One who is able to perform the best of alternatives but performs with the substitute he, the wicked-minded person, will get a doubtful result.

## Chapter 68. GatieSa Mantra

## \|\| 1.68.1 \|\|

*śrīsanatkumāra uvāca \|*  
*atha vakṣye gaṇeśasya mantrānsarveṣṭadāyakān \|*  
*yānsamārādhya viprendra sādhako bhuktimuktimān \|\| 1 \|\|*

Sri Sanatkumara said:

1\. Henceforth, I shall describe the mantras of GancSa that bestow all desired objects. О leading brahmana by propitiating Ganesa the aspirant shall attain worldly pleasures and liberation.

## \|\| 1.68.2-5 \|\|

*avyayo viṣṇuvanitā śaṃbhustrī mīnaketanaḥ \|*  
*smṛtirmāṃseṃdumanvāḍhyā sā punaścandraśekharā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*ṅeṃto gaṇapatistoyaṃ bhujaṅgo varadeti ca \|*  
*sarvānte janamuñcārya tato me vaśamānaya \|\| 3 \|\|*

*vahniḥ priyānto mantro 'yaṣṭāviṃśativarṇavān \|*  
*gaṇako 'sya muniśchando gāyatrī viyudādikā \|\| 4 \|\|*

*gaṇeśo devatā bījaṃ ṣaṣṭaśaktistadādikā \|*  
*śrīmanmahāgaṇapatiprītaye viniyogakaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

2-5. The immutable, the consort of Visnu, the wife of Sambhu, mlnaketana, smrti, mamsa adorned with indu and manu and with the moon in the crest, Ganapati in the dative, then at the end vara varada be added, then at the end of sarva one should utter janam, then add me vasam anaya bring them all to my control. This mantra ends in vahnipriya ‘svaha’ with twentyeight letters.

## \|\| 1.68.6 \|\|

*ṛṣiṃ śirasi vakre tu chandaśca hṛdi devatām \|*  
*guhye bījaṃ padoḥ śaktiṃ nyasetsādhakasattamaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The excellent sadhaka should place the sage (of the mantra) on the head, the metre on the face, the deity on the heart, the bijas in the private parts and Sakti in the feet.

## \|\| 1.68.7 \|\|

*ṣaḍdīrghāḍhyena bījena yaṃ ca bījādinā punaḥ \|*  
*ṣaḍaṅgāni nyasedasya jātiyuktāni mantravit \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The bija is possessed of six long vowels which again are to be joined with the bija, then he the knower of mantras should make the placement of letters in six limbs with the jati — (namah, svaha etc.)

## \|\| 1.68.8 \|\|

*śaivī ṣaḍaṅgamudrāya nyastavyā hi ṣaḍaṅgake \|*  
*gāmādyaṃ caiva bhūrlokaṃ nābhyantaṃ pādayornyaset \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The mudras as known to belong to Siva are to be placed in six of the limbs. He should make the placement (nyasa) beginning with gam from the feet to the navel and also the region of bhu.

## \|\| 1.68.9 \|\|

*gīmādyaṃ ca bhuvarlokaṃ kaṇṭhāntaṃ nābhito nyaset \|*  
*svarlokaṃ caiva gūmādyaṃ kaṇṭhadimastakāvadhi \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. From the navel to the throat he should place glm and others and the bhuva region. The syllable gum etc and the region of svar are to be placed from the throat to the head.

## \|\| 1.68.10-11 \|\|

*vyāpakaṃ mūlamantreṇa nyāso 'yaṃ bhuvanābhidhaḥ \|*  
*mūlamantraṃ samuñcārya mātṛkāvarṇamīrayet \|\| 10 \|\|*

*tadante 'pi ca mūlaṃ syānnamoṃ'taṃ mātṛkāsthale \|*  
*kṣāntaṃ vinyasya mūlena vyāpakaṃ racayetsudhīḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11.1 The vyapaka nyasa (the extended one) is to be done with mulamantra (the principal mantra). This is called bhuvana nyasa. After uttering the mulamantra one should utter the matrka then there should be the mula and namah in place of matrka. Thps he should proceed upto the letter ksa, then he should make the extended nyasa with the principal mantra. avyaya — om. Visnuvanitd^Srim, Sambhustri — krtm. mlnahetana — klim, smrtx= ga, mamsa^la. indu —. manu=au\> candraiekhara — Gapapati in the dative gapapataye vara, varada, sarvalokam m? vafaminaya, vahmpnyd= svahd.

## \|\| 1.68.12-13 \|\|

*varṇanyā so 'yamākhyātaḥ padanyāsastathocyate \|*  
*pañcatribāṇavahnīnducandrākṣinigamaiḥ kramāt \|\| 12 \|\|*

*vibhaktairmūlagāyatryā hṛdantairaṣṭabhiḥ padaiḥ \|*  
*bhāladeśe mukhe kaṇṭhe hṛdi nābhyūrujānuṣu \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. The placement with letters has been mentioned. Now padanyasa (the placement with pada ---=words) is being mentioned. The words of the mulagayatrl divided into eight portions of syllables containing five, three, five, three, one, one, two and four respectively. (Райса, tri, vana, vahni, indu, candra, aksi, nigama) and adding lr t - namah at the end. They are to be placed on the forehead, in the face, in the neck, in the heart, in the navel, in thighs, on the knees and on the feet. After making the nyasa he should make the extended one with the mula.

## \|\| 1.68.14-16 \|\|

*pādayoścaiva vinyasya mūlane vyāpakaṃ caret \|*  
*vadettatpuruṣāyānte vidmaheti padaṃ tataḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*vakratuṇḍāya śabdānte dhīmahīti samīrayet \|*  
*tanno dantiḥ pracovarṇā dayāditi vadetpunaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*eṣoktā mūlagāyatrī sarvasiddhipradāyinī \|*  
*evaṃ nyāsavidhiṃ kṛtvā dhyāyedevaṃ hṛdaṃbuje \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. He should say — ‘tatpurusaya and then say at the end of it ‘vidmahe’. After the end of the word, ‘vakraiundaya he should say ‘dhimahi’. Then the word tanno dantih, he should utter the word pracodayat.1 This is the mulagayatrl which bestows all attainments. After performing this, one should meditate thus in his lotus-heart.

## \|\| 1.68.17 \|\|

*udyanmārtaṇḍasadṛśaṃ lokasthityantakāraṇam \|*  
*saśaktikaṃ bhūṣitāṅgaṃ danta cakrādyudāyudham \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. “I meditate upon the deity who resembles the rising sun, who is the cause of maintenance and dissolution of the world. He is accompanied with Sakti, well-adorned and has lifted upcakra (discus) and toot!) (danta).”

## \|\| 1.68.18-20 \|\|

*evaṃ dhyātvā catuścatvāriṃśatsāhasrasaṃyutam \|*  
*caturlakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ aṣṭadravyairdaśāṃśataḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*juhuyādvidhivanmantrī saṃskṛte havyavāhane \|*  
*ikṣavaḥ saktavo mocāphalāni cipiṭāstilāḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*modakā nārikelāni lājā dravyāṣṭakaṃ smṛtam \|*  
*pīṭhamādhāraśaktyādiparatatvāntamarcayet \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. Thus meditating one shall repeat the mantra four hundred and fortyfour thousand times. He should perform the homa rite with eight kinds of articles in the consecrated fire with one tenth of the number repeated. The eight articles are: sugarcane, fried grain, flour, unripe banana flower, the beaten rice, the sesamum seeds, sweetmeats, coconuts and the parched grain. He should worship the Pltha beginning with adharaSakti and ending with the Paratattva (the supreme truth).

## \|\| 1.68.21 \|\|

*ṣaṭkoṇāntastrikoṇaṃ ca bahiraṣṭadalaṃ likhet \|*  
*bhūpuraṃ tadbahiḥ kṛtvā gameśaṃ tatra pūjayet \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. He should inscribe a triangle inside two intersecting triangles (satkona) and then outside of it he should draw an eight-petailed lotus. Then outside of them he should draw bhupura and worship Ganesa there.

## \|\| 1.68.22-23 \|\|

*tīvrākhyā jvālinī nandā bhogadā kāmarūpāṇī \|*  
*agrā tejovatī satyā navamī vidhnanāśinī \|\| 22 \|\|*

*sarvādiśaktikamalāsanāya hṛdayāntikaḥ \|*  
*pīṭhamantro 'yametena dadyādāsanamuttamam \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Tlvra, Jvalini, Nanda, Bhogada, KamarupinI, Ugra, Tejovatl, Satya, and the ninth one is VighnanaSini. All these are to be worshipped with hrdaya ~ namah in the end. 1

## \|\| 1.68.24-25 \|\|

*tatrāvāhya gaṇādhīśaṃ madhye sampūjya yatnataḥ \|*  
*vikoṇabāhye pūrvādicaturdikṣaavarcayetkramāt \|\| 24 \|\|*

*śriyaṃ śriyaḥ patiṃ caiva gaurīṃ gaurī patiṃ tathā \|*  
*ratiṃ ratipatiṃ pāścānmahīpūrva ca potriṇam \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. Ganadhlsa is to be invoked there and be worshipped in the middle carefully. Outside the triangle in the eastern quarters etc, one should worship Sri and the consort of Sri, Gauri and the consort of Gauri. He shall worship Rati and the consort of Rati, the earth and the boar.

## \|\| 1.68.26-28 \|\|

*kramādilvavaṭāśvatthapriyagūnāmadhor'cayet \|*  
*ramā padmadvayakarā śaṅkhacakradharo hariḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*gaurī pāśāṅkuśadharā ṭaṅkaśūladharo haraḥ \|*  
*ratiḥ padmakarā puṣpabāṇacāpadharaḥ smaraḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*śūkavrīhyagrahastā bhūḥ potrī cakragadādharaḥ \|*  
*devāgre pūjayellakṣmīsahitaṃ tu vināyakam \|\| 28 \|\|*

26-28. He should worship them under the bilva, vata, asvattha and priyarigu trees respectively. Rama has two lotuses in her hands, Hari holds sankha and cakra (conch and discus), Gauri holds noose and goad, and Нага holds axe and trident. Rati has a lotus in her hand and Kama holds the flower arrows and the bow. In the tip of her hands the Earth has the awn of barley and grains, the Boar holds the discus and the iron club. In front of the Lord one should worship Vinayaka accompanied by Laksmi.

## \|\| 1.68.29-31 \|\|

*pūjayetṣaṭsu koṇeṣu hyāmodādyānpriyāyutān \|*  
*āmodaṃ siddhisaṃyuktamagrataḥ paripījayet \|\| 29 \|\|*

*pramodaṃ cāgnikoṇe tu samṛddhisahitaṃ yajet \|*  
*īśakoṇe yajetkīrtisaṃyutaṃ sumukhaṃ tathā \|\| 30 \|\|*

*vāruṇe madanāvatyā saṃyutaṃ durmukhaṃ yajet \|*  
*yajennairṛtyakoṇe tu vighnaṃ madadravāyutam \|\| 31 \|\|*

29-31. He should worship Amoda etc. with their consorts in the six corners. He should worship Amoda with Siddhi in front. He should worship Pramoda accompanied by Samrddhi in the south-east comer. In the same way he should worship Sumukha accompanied by Kirti in the north-east comer. He should worship Durmukha accompanied by Madanavatl in the West. He should worship vighna accompanied by Madadrava in South-West corner.

## \|\| 1.68.32-35 \|\|

*drāviṇyā vighnakartāraṃ vāyukoṇe samarcayet \|*  
*pāśāṅkuśābhayakarāṃstaruṇārkasamaprabhān \|\| 32 \|\|*

*kapolavigaladdānagandhalubdhā liśobhitān \|*  
*ṣaṭkoṇobhayapārśve tu śaṅkhapadmanibhau kramāt \|\| 33 \|\|*

*sahitau nijaśaktibhyāṃ dhyātvā pūrvavadarcayet \|*  
*keśareṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni patreṣvaṣṭau tu mātaraḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*indrādyānapi vajjrādīnpūjayeddharaṇīgṛhe \|*  
*evamārādhya vighneśaṃ sādhayetsvamanorathān \|\| 35 \|\|*

32-35. He should worship Vighnakarta with DravinI in the north-west corner. All of them have the noose, goad,mudra of protection in their hands. They have the lustre resembling the young sun and are adorned with the bees covetous of ichor oozing out of their cheeks. On each side of the satkona (two intersecting triangles) the two divine treasures shankha and padma are to be meditated upon along with their shaktis and worshipped as before. In the filaments of the lotus he should worship the six angas (limbs) and on the petals eight matrs are to be worshipped. He should worship Indra etc. and the weapons vajra (thunderbolt) etc. in the blmgfha(the square outside the cakra). Thus worshipping Vighneia one should achieve one’s cherished desires.

## \|\| 1.68.36 \|\|

*catuścatvāriṃśatāḍhyaṃ catuḥ śatamatandritaḥ \|*  
*tarpayedaṃbubhiḥ śuddhairgajāsyaṃ dinaśaḥ sudhīḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The intelligent devotee shall perform attentively the tarpana rite of Gajasya (the elephant-faced deity) by means of pure water four hundred and fortyfour times every day.

## \|\| 1.68.37-38 \|\|

*padmaistu vaśayedbhūpāṃstatpatnīścotpalaistathā \|*  
*kumudairmantriṇo 'śvatthasamidbhirvāḍavāñśubhaiḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*uduṃmbarotthairnṛpatīnvaiśyānplakṣasamudbhavaiḥ \|*  
*vaṭodbhavaiḥ samidbhiśca vaśayedantimānbudhaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. He should captivate kings by means of oblations through lotuses, their queens by lilies, one shall captivate the ministers through kumuda (white lilies) flowers and brahmins by means of the auspicious twigs of fig trees. A learned man should captivate kings by means of udumbara twigs: Vaisyas through plaksa twigs and the castes placed in the last.

## \|\| 1.68.39 \|\|

*ājyena śriyamāpnoti svarṇāptirmadhunā bhavet \|*  
*godugdhena gavāṃ lābho dadhnā sarvasamṛddhimān \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. One obtains prosperity and glory by means of ghee and acquisition of gold by means of honey. Cows are obtained through cow’s milk and one shall have all prosperity through curds.

## \|\| 1.68.40 \|\|

*annāptirannahomena samidbhirvetasāṃ jalam \|*  
*vāsāṃsi labhate hutvā kusuṃbhakusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The acquisition of cooked food (anna) by means of (Ноmа) oblation is done with cooked rice. Water is obtained by means of samidh (fuel) of Vetasa reeds. One obtains clothes by performing the sacrifice with the auspicious kusumbha flowers.

## \|\| 1.68.41 \|\|

*atha sarveṣṭadaṃ vakṣye caturāvṛttitarpaṇam \|*  
*mūlenādau caturvāraṃ pratyekaṃ ca pratarpayet \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Henceforth, I shall recount tarpana that are repeated four times and which bestow desired things to everyone. In the beginning he should offer water four times to everyone uttering the mulamantra.

## \|\| 1.68.42-43 \|\|

*pūrvamantrākṣarairmantraiḥ svāhāntaiśca catuścatuḥ \|*  
*mūlamantraiścaturvārapūrvakaṃ saṃpratarpya ca \|\| 42 \|\|*

*mithunādīṃstataḥ paścātpūrvavatsaṃpratarpayet \|*  
*devena sahitāṃ śaktiṃ śaktyā ca sahitaṃ tu tam \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. He should perform tarpana four times with each of the syllables of the previous mantra, then four times with the mantra ending in svaha: then propitiating the deity four times with the mulamantra, he should propitiate the pairs (of deities) in the previous manner. The Sakti accompanied by the lord and the lord accompanied by the Sakti should be propitiated.

## \|\| 1.68.44 \|\|

*evañca ṣaḍviṃśatidhā mithunāni bhavanti hi \|*  
*svanāmādyarṇabījāni tāni santarpayetkramāt \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Thus there will be twentysix pairs. He should perform tarpana by means of seed letters which is the first letter of their respective names.

## \|\| 1.68.45-47 \|\|

*bhavetsaṃbhūya sacatuścatvāriṃśañcatuḥ śatam \|*  
*evaṃ saṃtapya tatpaścātpūrvavatsopacārakaiḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*sarvābhīṣṭaṃ ca saṃprārthya praṇamyodvāsayetsudhīḥ \|*  
*bhādrakṛṣṇacaturthyādipratimāsamatandritaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*ārabhyārke dayaṃ mantrī yāvaccandrodayo bhavet \|*  
*tāvannopaviśedbhūmau jitavākkriyāmānasaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

45-47. Thus it will be four hundred and fortyfour times in aggregate. After doing propitiation of the deity in this way, he should then offer (upacara) services as before. Then praying for all his cherished desires and paying homage to the deity, the learned devotee should dismiss the lord. He shall begin the vrata thus. On the fourth day, in the dark half of the month of Bhadra, he should be free from lassitude (in performing the Vrata). Beginning with the sunrise till the rising of the moon he should not take his seat on the ground, he should have control over his speech, and attain steadiness of mind.

## \|\| 1.68.48 \|\|

*tataścandrodaye mantrī pūjayedgaṇanāyakam \|*  
*pūrvoktavidhinā samyaṅnānāpuṣpopahārakaiḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. When the moon rises, the mantri (the worshipper of a mantra) should worship Gananayaka properly in the manner mentioned before, by means of various offerings of flowers.

## \|\| 1.68.49 \|\|

*ekaviṃśatisaṃkhyākānmodakāṃśca nivedayet \|*  
*tadagre prajapenmantramaṣṭottarasahasrakam \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. He should offer to him twentyone modakas (sweet meat). He should repeat mantra one thousand and eight times before him.

## \|\| 1.68.50 \|\|

*tataḥ karpūrakāśmīraraktapuṣpaiḥ sacandanaiḥ \|*  
*ardhyaṃ dadyāttu mūlānte ṅeṃte gaṇapatiṃ tataḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Then he should offer arghya with camphor, saffron, red flowers and sandal pastes with the miilamantra adding ganapati in the dative in the end.

## \|\| 1.68.51 \|\|

*idamardhyaṃ kalpayāmi hṛdantor'dhyamanurmataḥ \|*  
*stutvā natvā visṛjyātha yajeccandramasaṃ punaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. (Idamarghyam kalpayami namah) I present this arghya and bow. This is considered to be the mantra for the arghya. After eulogising, bowing down and dismissing (the deity) he should worship the moon again.

## \|\| 1.68.52 \|\|

*ardhyaṃ dadyāñcaturvāraṃ pūjayitvā guruṃ tataḥ \|*  
*nivediteṣu viprāya dadyādardhāṃśca modakān \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. He should offer arghya four times. Then after worshipping his preceptor, he should give half the number of sweet meats and the arghya to brahmanas.

## \|\| 1.68.53-55 \|\|

*svayamarddhānprabhuñjīta brahmacārī jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ vrataṃ yaḥ kurute samyaksaṃvatsarāvadhi \|\| 53 \|\|*

*putrānpautrānsukhaṃ vittamārogyaṃ labhate naraḥ \|*  
*sūryodayādaśaktaścedastamārabhya mantravit \|\| 54 \|\|*

*candrodayāntaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā vratamācaret \|*  
*evaṃ kṛte 'pi pūrvoktaṃ phalamāpnoti niścitam \|\| 55 \|\|*

53-55. Half the number of sweet meats he shall himself partake of. He should avoid sexual intercourse and should have control over his senses. One who performs this vrata properly for a year, attains sons, grandsons, happiness, wealth and health. If he is unable to perform vrata (the pious observance) beginning from sunrise, the knower of the mantra should perform it from the sunset till the rising of the moon according to procedure given before. Even if he performs thus, he would certainly attain fruits as stated before.

## \|\| 1.68.56-58 \|\|

*gaṇiśapratimāṃ dantidantena kapināpi vā \|*  
*gajabhagrena niṃbena sitārkeṃṇāthavā punaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*kṛtvā tasyāṃ samāvāhya prāṇasthāpanapūrvakam \|*  
*abhyarcya vidhivanmantrī rāhugraste niśākare \|\| 57 \|\|*

*spṛṣṭrā caiva nirahārastāṃ śikhāyāṃ samudvahan \|*  
*dyūte vivāde samare vyavahāre jayaṃ labhet \|\| 58 \|\|*

56-58. The idol of Gariela is to be made of ivory, or of a margosa tree (branch) broken by a monkey or an elephant or of a white arka plant. After instilling prana in it and invoking Ganeia there and worshipping him properly when the moon is in eclipse, he should touch it without taking any food and should carry it in the shikha (the sacred hair on the hair). Thereby he shall be victorious in gambling, battles and legal disputes.

## \|\| 1.68.59-60 \|\|

*bījaṃ varāho binddhāḍhyau manvindvānnau kalau tataḥ \|*  
*smṛtirmāṃseṃdumanvāgrā karṇocchiṣṭagaṇe vadet \|\| 59 \|\|*

*bakaḥ sadīrghapavano mahāyakṣāya yaṃ baliḥ \|*  
*balimantro 'yamākhyāto na cedvarṇo 'khileṣṭadaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

59-60.1 Bijam (gam) Varaha (ha) adorned with bindu (m) then к and 1 adorned with Manu (au) and bindu, smrti (ga) mamsa (la) attached with manu (au) and bindu, then one should utter Karna (a),-Ucchistagane, baka (6) with a long vowel (i.e. a) then pavana (ya), then utter maha Yaksaya unto the great Yaksa this baJi (offering) is presented. This mantra is intended for presenting an offering which serves the purpose of attaining all desired ends.

## \|\| 1.68.61-62 \|\|

*praṇavo bhuvaneśānīsvabījānte navārṇakaḥ \|*  
*hastīti ca piśācīti likheñcaivāgriṃsuṃdarī \|\| 61 \|\|*

*navārṇo 'yaṃ samuddiṣṭo bhajatāṃ sarvasiddhidaḥ \|*  
*padaiḥ sarvaṇa mantreṇa pañcāṅgāni prakalpayet \|\| 62 \|\|*

61-62. Pranava = om, then bhuvaneSvarl = hrim, then after the deitie’s own bija^gam the nine-syllabled mantra, will come which is hasti pisacl likhe and agnisundari = Svaha This nine-syllabled one which has just been mentioned is the bestower of all siddhis to those who worship (it). With all the letters of the mantra he should make six ancillary parts.

## \|\| 1.68.63 \|\|

*anyatsarvaṃ samānaṃ syātpūrvamantreṇa nārada \|*  
*athābhidhāsye vidhivadvakratuṇḍamanuttamam \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. О Narada, everything else is similar to the previous mantra. Henceforth, I shall duly recount the mantra of the excellent Vakratuntfa.

## \|\| 1.68.64 \|\|

*toyaṃ vidhirvahniyuktakarṇendvāḍhyo haristathā \|*  
*sadīrgho dārako vāyurvarmānto 'yaṃ rasārṇakaḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*
