2-3a. On the sixth day in the bright half of the month of Chaitra, the excellent holy rite of Kumara Vrata is to be observed. By worshipping the six-faced Lord on that day in accordance with the different injunctions of worship, one shall attain a son who is endowed with all good qualities and who will live for a long time.

3b-4a. On the sixth day, in the bright half of the month of Vaisakha, the devotee should worship Karttika (Skanda). By doing so, one attains motherly affection and happiness. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

4b-5a. By duly worshipping Divakara (the Sun) on the sixth day in the bright half of the month of Jyestha, one attains all desired benefits, thanks to his Grace. There is no doubt about this.

5b-6. The excellent holy rite of Skanda is to be observed on the sixth day in the bright half of the month of Asa

## \|\| 1.115.7-10 \|\|

*śrāvaṇe śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu śarajanmānamarcayet \|*  
*upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirbhaktyā paramayānvitaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*labhate 'bhīpsitānarthānṣaṇmukhasya prasādataḥ \|*  
*bhādramāse kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭyāṃ lalitāvratamucyate \|\| 8 \|\|*

*prātaḥ snātvā vidhānena nārī śuklāmbarāvṛtā \|*  
*śuktamālyayadharā vāpi nadyāḥ saṃgamavālukām \|\| 9 \|\|*

*gṛhītvā vaṃśapātre tu dhṛtvā piṇḍākṛtiṃ ca tām \|*  
*pañcadhā lalitāṃ tatra dhyāyedvanavilāsinīm \|\| 10 \|\|*

7-8a. On the sixth day in the bright half of the month of Sravana, the devotee, endowed with great devotion, should worship Sarajanman (i. e. Karttikeya) with the sixteen Upacaras (types of services). Thanks to the grace of the sixfaced Lord, he attains all desired objects.

8b-10. The holy vow that has to be observed on the sixth day in the month ofBhadrapada, the Lalita Vrata1 is being recounted. A woman devotee should take morning bath duly on that day. She should wear white cloth and white garlands. She should take the sand from the confluence of a river, in a bamboo basket. She should then make five lumps of the sandy soil and meditate on goddess Lalita, the sportive lady of the forest.

## \|\| 1.115.11-12 \|\|

*paṅkajaṃ karavīraṃ ca nepālīṃ mālatīṃ tathā \|*  
*nīlotpalaṃ ketakīṃ ca saṃgṛhya tagaraṃ tathā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*ekaikāṣṭaśataṃ grāhyamaṣṭāviṃśatireva ca \|*  
*akṣatāḥ kalikā gṛhya tābhirdevīṃ prapūjayet \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. She should then take one hundred and eight flowers of each of lotus, Karavlra Nepali, Jasmine, blue lotus, KetakI and Tagara and twentyeight unbroken buds. With these she should worship the goddess.

## \|\| 1.115.13-15 \|\|

*prārthayedagrataḥ sthitvā devīṃ tāṃ giriśapriyām \|*  
*gaṅgādvāre kuśāvartte vilvake nīlaparvate \|\| 13 \|\|*

*snātvā kanakhale devi harariṃ labdhavatī patim \|*  
*lalite subhagaṃ devi sukhasaubhāgyadāyini \|\| 14 \|\|*

*anataṃ dahi saubhāgyemahyaṃ tubhyaṃ namo 'namanaḥ \|*  
*mantreṇānena kusumaiśvaṃpakasya suśobhanaiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. Sitting in front of the goddess, the beloved wife of Siva, she should pray as follows: “By taking bath in Kana- khala, on the mountain Nllaparvata, ih the KuSavarta, in the Gangadvara and in the Bilvaka you obtained Нага as husband. О blessed goddess Lalita, the bestower of happiness and conjugal blessedness, grant unto me endless blessedness. Obeisance, unto you again and again.” Uttering this Mantra, she should worship the goddess with splendid Campaka flowers duly. She should then place the Naivedya in front of the goddess.

## \|\| 1.115.16-20 \|\|

*abhyarcya vidhivattasyā navaidyaṃ purato nyaset \|*  
*trapuṣairapi kūṣmāṇḍairnālikeraiḥ sudāḍimaiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*bījapūraiḥ sutuḍīraiḥ kāravallaiḥ sacirbhaṭaiḥ \|*  
*phalaistatkālasaṃbhūtaiḥ kṛtvā śobhāṃ tadagrataḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*virūḍhadhānyāṅkurakaiḥ sudīpāvalibhistathā \|*  
*sāddhai sargaṇakaidhūpaḥ sauhālakakarañjakaiḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*guḍapuṣpaiḥ karṇaveṣṭaḍairmodakairupamodakaiḥ \|*  
*bahuprakārairnaivedyairyathā vibhavasārataḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*evamabhyarcya vidhivadrātrau jāgaraṇotsavam \|*  
*gītavādyanaṭairnṛtyaiḥ prokṣaṇīyairanekadhā \|\| 20 \|\|*

16-20. The Naivedya should consist of Trapusa (a kind of fruit) Кйshтагц1а (gourd), coconut, excellent pomegranates, Типфга, Karavella(the gourd Momordica charantia), Cirbhata (a sort of cucumber) and other seasonal fruits taken fresh. The surroundings of the image of the goddess should be beautified with rows of excellent lights and germinating food grains. There should be incense of Sarganaka (?) alongwith Sauhalakha and Karafijaka (?). Gudapuspa (Bassia latifilia) should be placed as ornament of the cars. According to one’s affluence, sweetmeats of large and small varieties of various kinds should be used as Naivedya. After worship, she should celebrate the festival of keeping awake with songs and instrumental music, as well as dances and other scenic items of various types. The chaste lady should spend the whole of that night with her female friends.

## \|\| 1.115.21-30 \|\|

*sakhībhiḥ sahitā sādhvī tāṃ rātriṃ prasabhaṃ nayet \|*  
*na ca saṃmīlayennetre nārīyāmacatuṣṭayam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*durbhagā duṣkṛtā vandhyā netrasaṃmīlanādbhavet \|*  
*evaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā saptamyāṃ saritaṃ nayet \|\| 22 \|\|*

*gandhapuṣpaistathābhyarcya gītavādyapuraḥsaraiḥ \|*  
*tacca dadyāddvijendrāya naivedyādi dvijottama \|\| 23 \|\|*

*snātvā gṛhaṃ samāgatya hutvā vaiśvānaraṃ tataḥ \|*  
*devānpitṝnmanuṣyāṃśca pūjayitvā suvāsinīḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*kanyakāścaiva saṃbhojya brāhmaṇāndaśa pañca ca \|*  
*bhakṣyabhojyairbahuvidhairdatvā dānāni bhūriśaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*lalitā me 'stu suprītā ityuktvā tānvisarjayet \|*  
*yaḥ kaścidācaredetadvrataṃ saubhāgyadaṃ param \|\| 26 \|\|*

*naro vā yadi vā nārī tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*yadvrataiśca tapobhiśca dānairvā niyamairapi \|\| 27 \|\|*

*tadeteneha labhyeta kiṃ bahūktena nārada \|*  
*mṛteranantaraṃ prāpya śivalokaṃ sanātanam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*modate lalitādevyā śaive vai sakhivacciram \|*  
*nabhasye māsi yā śuklā ṣaṣṭhī sā candanāhvayā \|\| 29 \|\|*

*tasyāṃ devīṃ samabhyarcya labhate tatsalokatām \|*  
*rohiṇī pātabhaumaistu saṃyutā kapilā bhavet \|\| 30 \|\|*

21-26a. The woman devotee shall not close her eyes throughout the four Yamas (yama — 3 hours) (of the night). By closing her eyes, she will become sinful, barren and unhappy. After keeping awake thus, she should take (everything) to a river on the SaptamI day (i. e. seventh day) to the accompaniment of songs and instrumental music. О excellent Brahmana, she should give that Naivedya etc. to a leading Brahmana. After taking her bath, she should return home and get the Ноmа performed in the fire. The Devas, Pitrs and human beings (i. e. guests) shall be worshipped. She should worship and feed married women, virgins and fifteen Brahmanas with various kinds of foodstuffs and edibles. She should give them various charitable gifts as well. Saying “May Lalita be pleased with me”, she should bid farewell to them.

26b-29a. Listen to the merit of this Vrata that bestows conjugal blessedness whether performed by a man or a woman. О Narada, of what avail is much talk? That benefit which one desires by means of holy rites, austerities, charitable gifts and observances is attained by this holy rite. After death, the devotee attains the eternal Sivaloka and rejoices along with goddess Lalita like her companion in the world of Siva for a long time.

29b-30. The sixth day in the bright half of the month of Bhadrapada is called Candana sha?thi. By worshipping the goddess on that day, the devotee attains the same world as that of the deity. If the shashthi coincides with the constellation Rohini, the astronomical division called ‘Vyatipata and Tuesday it is called Kapila^thl.1

## \|\| 1.115.31 \|\|

*tasyāṃ raviṃ samabhyarcya vratī niyamatatparaḥ \|*  
*labhate vāñchitānkāmānbhāskarasya prasādataḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The observer of the Vrata devoted to the observance, should worship the Sun on that day. Thanks to the grace of Sun-God, he attains cherished desires.

## \|\| 1.115.32 \|\|

*annadānaṃ japo homaṃ pitṛdevarṣitarpaṇam \|*  
*sarvamevākṣayaṃ jñeyaṃ kṛtaṃ devarṣisattama \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. О excellent celestial sage, the charitable gift of cooked food, Japa, Ноmа, the rites of Tarpana to the Pitrs, Devas and sages, when performed on this day, all these should be known as everlasting.

## \|\| 1.115.33 \|\|

*kapilāṃ dhenumabhyarcya vastramālyānule panaiḥ \|*  
*pradadyādvedaviduṣe dvādaśātmapratuṣṭaye \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. After worshipping a tawny coloured cow with clothes, garlands and unguents, it shall be given to a Vedic Scholar for propitiating the sun.

## \|\| 1.115.34 \|\|

*atheṣuśuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu pūjyā kātyāyanī dvija \|*  
*gandhādyairmaṅgaladravyairnaivedyairvividhaistathā \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. On the sixth day in the bright half of the month of Asvina, О Brahmana, goddess Katyayani should be worshipped with scents and other auspicious articles and also with various kinds of Naivedya.

## \|\| 1.115.35-39 \|\|

*tataḥ kṣamāpya deveśīṃ praṇipatya visarjayet \|*  
*pūjyātra saikatī mūrtiryadvā dvijasatī mudā \|\| 35 \|\|*

*vastrālaṅkaraṇairbhavyaiḥ kātyāyinyāḥ pratuṣṭaye \|*  
*kanyā varaṃ prāpnuyācca vāñcitaṃ putramaṅganā \|\| 36 \|\|*

*kātyāyinīprasādādvai nātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|*  
*kārtike śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu ṣaṇmukhena mahātmanā \|\| 37 \|\|*

*devasenā mahābhāgā labdhā sarvusurārpitā \|*  
*atastasyāṃ suraśreṣṭhāṃ devasenāṃ ca ṣaṇmukham \|\| 38 \|\|*

*saṃpūjya nikhilaireva upacārairmanoharaiḥ \|*  
*prāpnuyādatulāṃ siddhiṃ manobhīṣṭāṃ dvijottama \|\| 39 \|\|*

35-36a The devotee should then crave forgiveness from the goddess of the Devas, bow to her, and bid farewell to her.

36b-37a. No doubt need be entertained in this respect that, thanks to the grace of Katyayini, a virgin shall attain the desired bridegroom and a woman the desired son.

37b-39. The highly blessed army of the Devas was entrusted (dedicated) to him (Skanda) by the Devas and hence acquired by the nobleminded six-faced Lord on the sixth day in the bright half of the month of Karttika. Hence, on that day, the devotee should worship the army of the Devas consisting of excellent Devas as well as the six-faced Lord with all charming Upacaras. О excellent Brahmana, he shall achieve Siddhi mentally desired by him.

## \|\| 1.115.40 \|\|

*atraiva vahnipūjoktāṃ tāṃ ca sampaksamācaret \|*  
*vividhadravyahomaiśca vahnipūjāpuraḥ saram \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The worship of the fire-god is also prescribed for this day. The devotee should carry it out perfectly alongwith the worship of fire, and Homas, with different kinds of articles of worship.

## \|\| 1.115.41-42 \|\|

*mārgaśīrṣe śaklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ nihatastārakāsuraḥ \|*  
*skandena satkṛtiḥ prāptā brahamādyaiḥ parikalpitā \|\| 41 \|\|*

*tato 'syāṃ pūjayetskandaṃ gandhapuṣpākṣataiḥ phalaiḥ \|*  
*vastrairābhūṣaṇaścāpi naivedyairvividhaistathā \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. The Asura Taraka was killed on the sixth day in the bright half of the month of Margasirsa. The Satkrti (honour and greetings) offered by Brahma and other gods were received by Skanda. Hence on this day, the devotee should worship Skanda with scents, fragrant flowers, raw rice grains, fruits, clothes, ornaments and diverse kinds of Naivedya.

## \|\| 1.115.43 \|\|

*ravivāreṇa saṃyuktā tathā śatabhiṣānvitā \|*  
*yadi cetsā samuddiṣṭā caṃpāhvā munisattama \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. If the shashthi coincides with Sunday or the constellation Satabhisak or Satatarash О excellent sage, it is called Campasasthi.1 The NP uses both forms — Katyayani: Katyayini 1. This delimitation of the term Campd shaffhi is supported by Hemadri (CC-Vrata I. 590-596 wherein he quotes the SK.P.) and by Smrti Kaustubka 221-222. VRJ. (p. 108) requires Vaidhrti Yoga, Tuesday and Visakha Naksatra on this day to call it Campd faffhi. But this combination is so rare that it occurs once in 30 years or so. It is strongly recommended that god Maheivara should be seen on this day. But in Maharashtra, Margaiirsha shu. Sa?(hi is called Campd shaffhi irrespective of the day or Yoga.

## \|\| 1.115.44 \|\|

*tasyāṃ viśveśvaro devo draṣṭavyaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ \|*  
*pūjanīyo vedanīyaḥ smartavyaḥ saukhyamicchatā \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. On that day, Lord Vishveshvara, the destroyer of sins, should be seen, worshipped, known and remembered by one who wishes for happiness.

## \|\| 1.115.45-47 \|\|

*snānadānādikaṃ cātra sarvamakṣayyamucyate \|*  
*pauṣamāse śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ devo dinapatirdvija \|\| 45 \|\|*

*viṣṇurūpī jagattrātā pradurbhūtāḥ sanātanaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*sa tasmātpūjanīyo 'syāṃ dravyairgandhapuraskṛtaiḥ \|*  
*naivedyairvasttrabhūṣādyaiḥ sarvasaukhyamabhīpsubhiḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

45a. Holy dip, charitable gift etc., performed on this day are proclaimed to be everlasting.

45b-47. О Brahmana, it was on the sixth day in the bright half of the month of Pausa that Dinapati (the Sun) manifested himself in the form of eternal Visnu, the protector of the Universe. Hence, on this day, he is to be worshipped with scents and other articles of worship, Naivedyas, clothes and ornaments by those who desire for all kinds of happiness.

## \|\| 1.115.48-51 \|\|

*māghamāse sitā ṣaṣṭhī varuṇāhvā smṛtā tu sā \|*  
*tasyāṃ varuṇamabhyarcyedviṣṇurūpaṃ sanātanam \|\| 48 \|\|*

*raktairgandhāṃśukaiḥ puṣpairnaivedyairdhūpadīpakaiḥ \|*  
*evamabhyarcya vidhivadyadyaccābhilaṣennaraḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*tattacca phalato labdhvā modate tatprasādataḥ \|*  
*phaālgune śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu devaṃ paśupatiṃ dvija \|\| 50 \|\|*

*mṛnmayaṃ vidhinā kṛttvā pūjayedupacārakaiḥ \|*  
*saṃsnāpya śatarudreṇa pṛthakpañcāmṛtairjalaiḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

48-50a. The sixth day in the bright half of the month of Magha is called Varuna1 Sasthl. On that day, one should worship god Varuna who has the eternal form of Visnu, with scents, red silken garments, flowers, Naivedyas, incense and lights. By worshipping thus in accordance with the injunctions, the man obtains whatever he desires. After attaining all the fruits he rejoices, thanks to his grace.

50b-51. On the sixth day in the bright half of the month of Phalguna, О Brahmana, the devotee should make an image of Lord Pasupati duly in clay and worship it with Upacaras (sixteen articles and modes). He should bathe the image with water or Paftcamrta while uttering Satarudra mantra.

## \|\| 1.115.52-53 \|\|

*gandhairālipya suśvetairakṣataiḥ śvetapuṣpakaiḥ \|*  
*bilvapatraiśca dhattūrakusumaiśca phalaistathā \|\| 52 \|\|*

*sampūjya nānānaivedyairnīrājya vidhivattataḥ \|*  
*kṣamāpya praṇipatyainaṃ kailāsāya visarjayet \|\| 53 \|\|*

52-53. While unguents shall be smeared over the image, the deity should be worshipped with raw rice-grains, white flowers and fruits. Different kinds of Naivedya should be offered. Nirajana (waving of lights) is duly performed. After bowing to and craving forgiveness of the Lord, he should be ritualistically sent to Kailasa.

## \|\| 1.115.54 \|\|

*evaṃ kṛta śivārcastu naro nāryathavā mune \|*  
*iha bhuktvā varānbhogānante śivagatiṃ labhet \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. О sage, whether he is a man or a woman, whoever performs the worship of Siva thus, enjoys all worldly pleasures here and in the end attains the goal of Siva

## Chapter 116. The Exposition of the rites to be observed on the Saptami (Seventh) day.

## \|\| 1.116.1 \|\|

*sanātana uvāca*  
*śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi saptamyāste vratānyaham \|*  
*yāni kṛtvā naro bhaktyā sūryasāyujyamāpnuyāt \|\| 1 \|\|*

Sanatana said:

1\. О Narada, listen. I shall recount to you the holy rites to be observed on the Saptami1 days (seventh day of a lunar fortnight). On observing them with devotion, the man attains Sayujya (entire identity) with the Sun-god.

## \|\| 1.116.2-7 \|\|

*caitre tu śuklasaptamyāṃ bahiḥ snānaṃ samācaret \|*  
*sthaṇḍile gomayālipte gauramṛttikayāstṛte \|\| 2 \|\|*

*likhitvāṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ vibhāvam \|*  
*vinyasetpūrvapatre tu devau dvau kṛtadhātukau \|\| 3 \|\|*

*āgneyaṃ ca nyasenpatre gandharvauṃ kṛtakārakau \|*  
*dakṣiṇe ca nyasetpatre tathaiva rākṣasadvayam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*ākṛtau dvau nyasetpatre nairṛte munisattama \|*  
*kādraveyau mahānāgau paścime kṛtacārakau \|\| 5 \|\|*

*vāyavya yātudhānau dvau uttare ca ṛṣidvayam \|*  
*aiśānye vinyasetpatpe grahameko dvijottama \|\| 6 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kāryaṃ gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ \|*  
*dīpairdhūpaiḥ sanaivedyaistāṃbūlakramukādibhiḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

2-7. One shall take external (i. e. outside the village or town in a river or well) bath on the Saptami (seventh) day in the bright half of the month of Chaitra. He should draw the mystic diagram of the eight-petalled lotus on an altar on the dry ground smeared with cowdung and strewn with white sand. Vibhavasu (the sun-god must be placed in the pericarp. The two devas Krta, Dhatuka (?) should be placed in the eastern petal; the Gandharvas, Krta, Karaka should be placed in the South-east petal; two Raksasas shall be placed in the Southern petal. О excellent sage, the two Akrtas (?) shall be placed in the South-west petal, the two great serpents, the sons of Kadru, should be placed (as if they are) in motion in the Western petal, two Yatudhanas should be placed in the north-west petal, two sages shall be placed in the northern petal; О excellent Brahmana, the devotee should fix one planet in the northeast petal. Their worship is to be performed by means of scents, garlands, unguents, lights, incense, Naivedyas, petel leaves, areca nuts and other things.

## \|\| 1.116.8-9 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃpūjya homaṃ tu ghṛtenāṣṭaśataṃ caret \|*  
*sūryasyāṣṭāṣṭa cānyeṣāṃ pradadyādāhutīḥ kramāt \|\| 8 \|\|*

*nāmamantreṇa vedyāṃ vā tataḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ dadet \|*  
*dakṣiṇā ca tato deyā dvijebhyaḥ śaktito dvija \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. After worshipping them thus, the devotee should perform Ноmа with ghee. He should give one hundred and eight oblations to the sun-god and offer as oblations eight Ahutis for each of the others, in due order, uttering their names as mantras. Thereafter, he should perform Purnahuti on the altar. О Brahmana, in accordance with one’s capacity, monetary gifts should be given to Brahmanas.

## \|\| 1.116.10 \|\|

*etatkṛtvā vidhaānaṃ tu sarvasaukhyamavāpnuyāt \|*  
*dehānte maṇḍalaṃ bhānorbhattvā gacchetparaṃ padam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. After carrying out all these injunctions, the devotee shall attain all happiness. At the time of death, he penetrates his way through the disc of the Sun and goes to the greatest region.

## \|\| 1.116.11 \|\|

*vaiśākhaśuklasaptamyāṃ jahnunā jāhnavī svayam \|*  
*krodhātpītā punastyaktā karṇarandhrāttu dakṣiṇāt \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. It was on the seventh day in the bright half of the month of Vaisakha thatJahnavi (the Ganga) was angrily drunk up by Jahnu himself and subsequently let off through the right ear.

## \|\| 1.116.12 \|\|

*tāṃ tatra pūjayetsnātvā pratyūṣe vimale jale \|*  
*gandhapuṣpākṣatādyaiśca sarvairevopacārakaiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. On that day, the devotee should worship Jahnavi after taking bath in the pure water, early in the morning. He should worship with scents, fragrant flowers, unbroken rice grains and other things, with all requisite upacaras (articles of worship), etc.

## \|\| 1.116.13 \|\|

*tato ghaṭasahasraṃ tu deyaṃ gaṅgāvrate tvidam \|*  
*bhaktyā kṛtaṃ saptakulaṃ nayetsvargamasaṃśayaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Then, a thousand pots are to be given (as gifts) in the course of this Gangavrata. If devotedly performed, this Vrata1 is competent to take seven generations in his family to heaven.

## \|\| 1.116.14-27 \|\|

*kamalavratamapyatra proktaṃ tadvidhirucyate \|*  
*tilamātraṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ vidhāya kamalaṃ śubham \|\| 14 \|\|*

*vastrayugmāvṛtaṃ kṛtvā gandhadhūpādinārcayet \|*  
*namaste padmahastāya namaste viśvadhāriṇe \|\| 15 \|\|*

*divākara namastubhyaṃ prabhākara namo 'stu te \|*  
*iti saṃprārthya deveśaṃ sūrye cāstamupāgate \|\| 16 \|\|*

*sodakuṃbhaṃ tu tatpadmaṃ kapilāṃ ca dvijer'payet \|*  
*taddine tūpavastavyaṃ bhoktavyaṃ ca pare 'hani \|\| 17 \|\|*

*saṃbhojya brāhmaṇānbhaktyā vratasākalyamāpnuyāt \|*  
*nibavrataṃ ca tatreva tadvidhānaṃ śṛṇuṣva me \|\| 18 \|\|*

*niṃbapatraiḥ smṛtā pūjā bhāskarasya dvijottama \|*  
*khakholkāyeti mantreṇa praṇavādyena nārada \|\| 19 \|\|*

*niṃbapatraṃ tato 'śnīyācchayedbhūmau ca vāgyataḥ \|*  
*dvijānpare 'hni saṃbhojya svayaṃ bhuñjīta bandhubhiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*niṃbapatravrataṃ caitatkartṛāṇāṃ sarvasaukhyadam \|*  
*saptamī śarkarākhyaiṣā proktā taccāpi me śṛṇu \|\| 21 \|\|*

*amṛtaṃ pibato hastātsūryasyāmṛtabindavaḥ \|*  
*niṣpeturbhuvi cotpannāḥ śālimudgayavekṣavaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*śarkarā ca tatastasmādikṣusārāmṛtopamā \|*  
*iṣṭā raverataḥ puṇyā śarkarā havyakavyayoḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*śarkarāsaptamī caiva vājimedhapalapradā \|*  
*sarvaduḥkhopaśamanī putrasaṃtativardhinī \|\| 24 \|\|*

*asyāntu śarkarādānaṃ śarkarābhojanaṃ tathā \|*  
*kartavyaṃ hi prayatnena vratame tadravipriyam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*yaḥ kuryātparāyā bhaktyā sa vai sadgatimāpnuyāt \|*  
*jyeṣṭhe tu śuklasaptamyāṃ jāta indro raviḥ svayam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*taṃ saṃpūjya vidhānena sopavāso jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*svargatiṃ labhate vipra devendrasya prasādataḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

14-18a. The holy rite of Kamalavrata is also recommended on this day.3 Its procedure is being proclaimed. An auspicious lotus is made out of gold of the weight of a gingelly seed. It is then covered with two clothes. The devotee should then worship it with scents, incense and other things, and pray as follows: “Hail to you the lotus-handed god; obeisance to you the supporter of the universe. О Divakara, (Sun-god) salutations to you. О Prabhakara (Sun-god), homage to you.” After praying thus to the Lord of the Devas, he should offer that lotus alongwith the water pot and a Kapila (tawny coloured) cow to a Brahmana, after sunset. He should observe fast throughout that day and take food only on the pcxt day. By feeding the Brahmanas with devotion, he shall attain the entire benefit of the Vrata.

18b-21a. The holy rite Nimbavrata is also to be performed on this day. Listen to its injunction even as I recount it. О excellent Brahmana, the worship of the sun is to be performed with the leaves of Nimba (Margosa), uttering the Mantra ‘Khakholkaya’ (ТА 10. 59. 1, TAA 10. 66) etc. beginning with the Pranava; О Narada, he should then eat the leaves of Nimba silently and lie down on the bare ground. After feeding the Brahmanas the next day, he should himself take food alongwith his kinsmen. This Nimbapatravrata bestows all happiness on those who observe it.

21b-26a. The holy rite of Sarkarasaptaml is also to be observed on this day. Listen to its procedure also from me. While the sun was drinking nectar by means of his hand, drops of Amrta (nectar) fell on the ground, and they grew into the plants of Sali rice, Mudga (greengram), Yava (barley) and Iksu (Sugarcane). Sarkara (sugar) is therefore the essence of sugarcane and nectar-like and so is liked by the sun. It is holy and used in Havya and Kavya. Sarkara Saptami yields the same benefit as the horse-sacrifice. It pacifies all miseries. It increases the line of sons and daughters. On this day sugar must be given as gift and taken alongwith food. This holy rite must be assiduously performed, as it is liked by the Sun-god. He who observes this with great devotion, shall attain the goal of the good (i.e. Heaven).

26b-27. Indra himself was born as the sun on the seventh day in the bright half of the month of Jyestha. He should be worshipped according to the injunction. The devotee observes fast and subdues his sense-organs. О Brahmana, thanks to the grace of Devendra, he attains heaven.

## \|\| 1.116.28-30 \|\|

*āṣāḍhaśuklasaptamyāṃ vivasvānnāma bhāskaraḥ \|*  
*jātastaṃ tatra saṃprārcya gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pṛthak \|\| 28 \|\|*

*labhate sūryasāyujyaṃ viprendrātra na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*śrāvaṇe śuklasaptamyāmavyaṅgākhyaṃ vrataṃ śubham \|\| 29 \|\|*

*kārpāsaṃ tu caturhastaṃ sārddha vastraṃ hi gopateḥ \|*  
*pūjānte prītaye deyaṃ vratametacchubhāvaham \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-29a. On the seventh day in the bright half of the month of Asatfha, the sun god became Vivasvan (the refulgent Sun). The devotee worships him separately with scents and fragrant flowers. О leading Brahmana, he (the observer of this Vrata) attains identity with the Sun.

29b-30. The auspicious holy rite called Avyangavrata1 is to be observed on the seventh day in the bright half of the month of Sravana. At the end of the Puja of Gopati (sun) in order to propitiate him, he must give a cotton cloth four and a half Hastas long. This Vrata is very auspicious.

## \|\| 1.116.31 \|\|

*yadi ceddhastayukteyaṃ tadā syātpāpanāśinī \|*  
*asyāṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ sarvaṃ cākṣayyatāṃ vrajet \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. If this Saptami coincides with the Hasta constellation it will be destructive of sins. Charitable gifts, Japa, Ноmа, — everything performed on this day shall attain everlasting status.

## \|\| 1.116.32-33 \|\|

*bhādre tu śuklasaptamyāmamuktābharaṇavratam \|*  
*somasya tu maheśasya pūjanaṃ cātra kīrtitam \|\| 32 \|\|*

*gaṅgādibhiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirupacāraiḥ samarcanam \|*  
*prārthya praṇamya visṛjetsarvakāmasamṛddhaye \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. The holy rite of Amuktabharana is to be observed on the seventh day in the bright half of the month of Bhadra- pada. The worship of Mahesa accompanied by Uma is glorified on this day. He is worshipped alongwith Gariga and others with the sixteen Upacaras.' After the prayer and (paying) obeisance, he should ritualistically bid farewell to the deity, for the flourishing increase of all desires.

## \|\| 1.116.34-39 \|\|

*phalasaptamikā ceyaṃ tadvidhānamudīryate \|*  
*nālikeraṃ ca vṛntākaṃ nāraṅgaṃ bījapūrakam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*kūṣmāṇḍaṃ bṛhatīpūgamiti sapta phalāni vai \|*  
*mahādevasya purato vinyasyāparadorakam \|\| 35 \|\|*

*saptatantukṛtaṃ saptagranthiyuktaṃ dvijottama \|*  
*saṃpūjya parayā bhaktyā dhārayedvāmake kare \|\| 36 \|\|*

*strī naro dakṣiṇe caiva yāvadvarṣaṃ samāpyate \|*  
*saṃbhojya viprānsaptaiva pāyasena visṛjyasa tān \|\| 37 \|\|*

*svayaṃ bhuñjīta matimān vratasaṃpūrtihetave \|*  
*phalāni tāni deyāni saptasvapi dvijeṣu ca \|\| 38 \|\|*

*evaṃ tu sapta varṣāṇi kṛtvopāsya yathāvidhi \|*  
*sāyujyaṃ labhate vipra mahādevasya tadvratī \|\| 39 \|\|*

34-39. The holy rite of PhalasaptamI is also to be observed on this day. Its procedure is being described: The seven fruits are — a coconut, a brinjal, an orange, a pomegranate, a white gourd, Brhatl and areca nut. These are placed in front of Mahesa. A thread in which seven threads are turned and seven knots are made is also placed in front of Mahesa, О excellent Brahmana, after worshipping the Lord with great devotion, the woman-devotee shall wear the thread round her left hand and the man-devotee round his right hand. This shall be worn till the end of a year. He should feed seven Brahmanas with milk puddings and bid farewell to them. The intelligent devotee shall partake of it himself In order to make Vrata perfect and complete, those fruits are given to seven Brahmanas. О Brahmana, the observer of thsh Vrata continues it for seven years with due observances of fast. Such an observer of this Vrata attains identity with Mahadeva.

## \|\| 1.116.40-47 \|\|

*āśvine śuklapakṣe tu vijñeyā śubhasaptamī \|*  
*tasyāṃ kṛtasnānapūjo vācayitvā dvijottamān \|\| 40 \|\|*

*ārabhya kapilāṅgāṃ ca saṃpūjya prārthayettataḥ \|*  
*tvāmahaṃ dadmi kalyāṇi prīyatāmaryamā svayam \|\| 41 \|\|*

*pālaya tvaṃ jagatkatsnaṃ yato 'si dharmasambhavā \|*  
*ityuktvā vedaviduṣe dattvā kṛtvā ca dakṣiṇām \|\| 42 \|\|*

*namaskṛtya svayaṃ vipra visṛjetprāśayetvaravayam \|*  
*pacagavyaṃ vrataṃ cetthaṃ vidhāya śvo dvijottamān \|\| 43 \|\|*

*bhojayitvā svayaṃ cādyāttadannaṃ dvijaśeṣitam \|*  
*kṛtaṃ hyetadgataṃ vipra subhāṣyaṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*devadevaprasādena bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt \|*  
*atha kārtikaśuklāyāṃ śākākhyaṃ saptamīvratam \|\| 45 \|\|*

*tasyāṃ tu saptaśākānisasvarṇakamalāni ca \|*  
*pradadyātsaptaviprebhyaḥ śākāhārastataḥ svayam \|\| 46 \|\|*

*dvitīye 'hni dvijānbhojya datvā tebhyo 'nnadakṣiṇām \|*  
*visṛjya bandhubhiḥ sārddhaṃ svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

40-45a. The holy rite SubhasaptamI1 is to be observed on the seventh day in the bright half of the month of Asvina. On that day, the devotee should begin the holy rite by taking his bath and worshipping the deity. He should make excellent Brahmanas read the holy books. He should then worship a Kapila cow and pray thus — “O gentle one, I am gifting you away. May Aryama, the sun himself be pleased. Protect you, the entire Universe, since you are born ofDharma.” After praying thus, he gives the cow to a Vedic Scholar, alongwith the monetary gift. О Brahmana, after, bowing down to him, he himself should set the cow free. He should take in only Pancagavya. Thus, the Vrata is concluded. On the next day he should feed Brahmanas. He should partake of that food that is left over by them. О Brahmana, this Vrata that is performed thus, is well praised. A person endowed with faith shall attain worldly pleasures and salvation, thanks to the grace of the Lord of the Devas.

45b-47. The holy rite called Saka SaptamI is to be observed on the seventh day in the bright half of the month of Karttika. On that day, the devotee should give seven different vegetables to seven Brahmanas alongwith gold lotuses. He himself shall take in only vegetable food. On the next day, he should feed the Brahmanas and give them monetary gifts as well. After bidding farewell to them, he himself should partake of the food silently alongwith his kinsmen.

## \|\| 1.116.48-51 \|\|

*mārgasya sitasaptamyāṃ mitravratamudāhṛtam \|*  
*yadviṣṇordakṣiṇaṃ netraṃ tadeva kṛtavāniha \|\| 48 \|\|*

*adityāṃ kaśyapājjajñe mitro nāmā divākaraḥ \|*  
*ato 'syāṃ pūjanaṃ tasya yathoktavidhinā dvija \|\| 49 \|\|*

*kṛtvā dvijānbhojayitvā saptaiva madhurādinā \|*  
*suvarṇadakṣiṇāṃ datvā visṛjyāśnīta ca svayam \|\| 50 \|\|*

*kṛtvaitadvidhinā lokaṃ sṛryyasya vrajati dhruvam \|*  
*dvijobrāhmaṃ tathā śūdraḥ satkulejanma cāpnuyāt \|\| 51 \|\|*

48-51. The holy rite of Mitravrata is to be observed on the seventh day in the bright half of the month of MargaSIrsa. The sun was born of Aditi and Kafyapa and was named Mitra and Visnu made him his right eye. Hence on this day, О Brahmana, the devotee shall worship him duly and feed seven. Brahmanas with sweets and other things. He should then bid farewell to them and take food himself. After duly performing this, the devotee shall certainly attain the world of the Sun. A Brahmana devotee attains Brahma’s world and a Sudra devotee takes his rebirth in a good family.

## \|\| 1.116.52-54 \|\|

*pauṣasya śuklasaptamyāṃ vrataṃ cābhayasaṃjñitam \|*  
*upoṣya bhānuṃ triḥsandhyaṃ samabhyarcya dharāsthitaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*kṣīrasiktānnasaṃbaddhaṃ modakaṃ prasthasaṃmitam \|*  
*dvijāya datvā bhojyānyānsaptāṣṭabhyaśca dakṣiṇām \|\| 53 \|\|*

*pṛthavī vā suvarṇaṃ vā visṛjyāśnīta ca svayam \|*  
*abhayākhyaṃ vrataṃ tvetatsarvasyābhayadaṃ smṛtam \|\| 54 \|\|*

52-54. The holy rite called Abhaya SaptamI is to be observed on the seventh day in the bright half of the month of Pausa. The devotee observes fast and performs the holy rite standing on the bare ground (dhara-sthitah). He worships the sun during the three Sandhyas (dawn, noon and dusk), then gifts to a Brahmana a Prastha-measure of sweet meats alongwith cooked rice soaked in milk. Thereafter, he feeds seven other Brahmanas and gives Daksina to all the eight, which may be in the form of a piece of land or gold. He then bids farewell to them and takes food himself. This is the holy rite called Abhaya. It bestows fearlessness (or Liberation from Samsara) on all.

## \|\| 1.116.55 \|\|

*mārtaṇḍākhyaṃ vrataṃ nāma kathayanti dvijāḥ pare \|*  
*ekameveti ca proktamekadaivatayā budhaiḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Other Brahmanas call this by the name of Martanda Vrata. But learned men say that both are the same, the deity being one and the same.

## \|\| 1.116.56-64 \|\|

*māghe tu kṛṣṇasaptamyāṃ vrataṃ sarvāptisaṃjñakam \|*  
*samupoṣya dine tasminsampūjyādityabimbakam \|\| 56 \|\|*

*sauvarṇaṃ gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ kṛtvā rātrau ca jāgaram \|*  
*pare 'hni viprānsambhojya pāyasena tu sapta vai \|\| 57 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇāṃ nālikerāṇi tebhyo datvā guruṃ tataḥ \|*  
*sauvarṇaṃ tu raverbimbaṃ yuktaṃ dakṣiṇayā nyayā \|\| 58 \|\|*

*samarpya ca bhṛśaṃ prārthya visṛjyādyātsvayaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*etatsarvāptidaṃ nāma saṃproktaṃ sārvakāmikam \|\| 59 \|\|*

*vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa dvaitaṃ sidhyeddhi sarvathā \|*  
*māghasya śuklasaptamyāmacalākhyaṃ vrataṃ smṛtam \|\| 60 \|\|*

*trilocanajayantīyaṃ sarvapāpaharā smṛtā \|*  
*rathākhyā saptamī ceyaṃ cakravartitvadāyinī \|\| 61 \|\|*

*asyāṃ samarcya savituḥ pratimāṃ tu haimīṃ haimāśvayuktarathagāṃ tu dadetsahebhām \|*  
*yo bhāvabhaktisahitaḥ sa gato hi lokaṃ śambhoḥ sa modata ihāpi ca bhuktabhogaḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

*bhāskarī saptamī ceyaṃ koṭibhāsvadgrahopamā \|*  
*aruṇodayavelāyāmasyāṃ snānaṃ vidhīyate \|\| 63 \|\|*

*arkasya ca badaryāśca sapta sapta dalāni vai \|*  
*nidhāya śirasi snāyātsaptajanmāghaśāntaye \|\| 64 \|\|*

56-60a. The holy Vrata called Sarvapti1 (SaptamI) is to be observed on the seventh day in the dark half of the month of Magha. The devotee observes fast during the day and worships the disc of the Sun made of gold, with scents, fragrant flowers, etc. and keeps awake at night. The next day he should feed seven Brahmanas with milk-puddings and give them coconuts as Daksina. To the preceptor, he gives the gold replica of the Sun’s disc alongwith other Daksinas. He should pray to him earnestly and bid farewell to him. Thereafter, he takes food himself. This is called the holy rite of Sarvaptida. It yields all cherished desires. Thanks to the power of this Vrata, dualism (Dvaitam) is achieved in every respect (? desires are fulfilled).

60b-62a. The holy rite of Acalavrata is performed on the seventh day in the bright half of the month of Magha. This is also called Trilocana Jayanti (Birth anniversary of the threeeyed Lord). It is remembered as the destroyer of all sins.

62b-64. It is also Ratha Saptami1 that grants (even) emperorship. The devotee should worship the image of Sun made of gold. The image is placed in a chariot yoked to golden horses. Alongwith elephants, he shall give this (as gift to a deserving person). He who performs this Vrata devoutly joyfully enjoys all the pleasures in this world and goes to the region of god Siva. This Saptami is Bhaskarl Saptami and is comparable to a crore of shining planets. On this day, it is laid down that one shall take one’s bath at the time of Arunodaya (day-break). He shall place on his head seven leaves each of Arka and Badarl and take his bath for absolving the sins of seven births.

## \|\| 1.116.65-68 \|\|

*putrapradaṃ vrataṃ cātra prāhādityaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ \|*  
*yo māghasitaptamyāṃ pūjayenmāṃ vidhānataḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

*tasyāhaṃ putratāṃ yāsye svāṃśena bhṛśatoṣitaḥ \|*  
*tasmājjitendriyo bhūtvā samupoṣya divāniśam \|\| 66 \|\|*

*pūjayedapare cāhni homaṃ kṛtvā dvijāṃ stataḥ \|*  
*dadhyodanena payasā pāyasena ca bhojayet \|\| 67 \|\|*

*anena vidhinā yamtu kurute putrasaptamīḥ \|*  
*labhate sa tu satputraṃ cirāyuṣamanāmayam \|\| 68 \|\|*

65-68. Lord Sun has himself prescribed a Putraprada Vrata (holy rite that grants sons) on this day. “I shall be born with a part of mine as the son of the person who duly worships me on the seventh day in the bright half of the month of Magha. I will be very much delighted.” Hence, the devotee should conquer his sense-organs and observe fast for a day and a night. On the next day, he should perform Ноmа and feed the Brahmanas with cooked rice mixed with curds or milk and puddings.He who performs the holy rite of Putra Saptami according to these injunctions, shall get a good son who will be free from ailments and will live for a long time.

## \|\| 1.116.69-70 \|\|

*arkapatrairyajedarkamarkapatrāṇi cāśnuyāt \|\| 69 \|\|*

*arkanāma japecchaśvaditthaṃ cārkapuṭavratam \|*  
*dhanadaṃ putradaṃ caitatsarvapāpapraṇāśanam \|\| 70 \|\|*

69-70. One should perform the rite of Arkaputa on the seventh day in the bright half of the month of Tapasya (Phal- guna). He should worship the sun with the leaves of the Arka (the sun) plant. He shall eat the leaves of the Arka plant. He shall repeat the names of the sun continuously. Thus is the holy rite called Arkapufavrata. It bestows sons and wealth. It destroys all sins.

## \|\| 1.116.71 \|\|

*trivargadāmiti prāhuḥ kecidetadvataṃ dvija \|*  
*yajñavrataṃ tathāpyanye vidhivaddhomakarmaṇā \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. О Brahmana, some call this holy rite Trivargada- Vrata (a Vrata that bestows Dharma, Artha and Kama the three aims of life), others call it Yajnavrata on account of the rite of Ноmа duly performed in it.1 О excellent Brahmana, it is said that the sun is to be propitiated in all the Saptamls in all the months. It shall enable one to realise all desires.

## Chapter 117. The review of the Vishalas to be observed on Ashtami (eighth days of Lunar fortnights)

## \|\| 1.117.1 \|\|

*sanātana uvāca*  
*śuklāṣṭamyāṃ caitramāse bhavānyāḥ procyate janiḥ \|*  
*pradakṣiṇaśataṃ kṛtvā kāryo yātrāmahotsavaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

Sanatana said:

1\. Bhavani’s birth is reported to have taken place on the eighth day in the bright half of the month of Chaitra. The great festival of Yatra (procession) must be performed by making a hundred circumambulations.

## \|\| 1.117.2 \|\|

*darśanaṃ jagadambāyāḥ sarvānandapradaṃ nṛṇām \|*  
*atraivāśo kakalikāprāśanaṃ samudāhṛtam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The vision of the mother of the Universe is the bestower of all joys and pleasures on men. On this very same day the holy rite of Asoka-Kalika-Prashana(drinking of water mixed with the tender sprouts of the Asoka tree) also has to be observed.

## \|\| 1.117.3 \|\|

*aśokakalikāścāṣṭau ye pibanti punarvasau \|*  
*caitre māsi sitāṣṭamyāṃ na te śokamavāpnuyuḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Those who drink (water mixed with) eight buds of the Ashoka tree on the eighth day in the bright half of the month of Chaitra, when the constellation of Punarvasu coincides with it, never experience any sorrow.1

## \|\| 1.117.4-12 \|\|

*mahāṣṭamīti ca proktā devyāḥ pūjāvidhānataḥ \|*  
*vaiśākhasya sitāṣṭamyāṃ samupoṣyātra vāriṇā \|\| 4 \|\|*

*snātvāparājitāṃ devīṃ māṃsībālakavāribhiḥ \|*  
*snāpayitvārcya gandhādyairnaivedyaṃ śarkarāmayam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*kumārīrbhojayeccāpi navamyāṃ pāraṇāgrataḥ \|*  
*jyotirmayavimānena bhrājamāno yathā raviḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*lokeṣu vicaredvipra devyāścaiva prasādataḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ jyeṣṭhamāse pūjayitvā trilocanam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*śivaloke vasetkalpaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ \|*  
*jyeṣṭhaśukle tathāṣṭamyāṃ yo devīṃ pūjayennaraḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*sa vimānena carati gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ \|*  
*śuklāṣṭamyāṃ tathā'ṣāḍhe snātvā caiva niśāṃbunā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*tenaiva snāpayeddevīṃ pūjayecca vidhānataḥ \|*  
*tataḥ śuddhajalaiḥ snāpya viliṃpetseṃducandanaiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*naivedyaṃ śarkaropetaṃ datvā'camanamarpayet \|*  
*bhojayitvā tato viprāndatvā svarṇaṃ ca dakṣiṇām \|\| 11 \|\|*

*visṛjya ca tataḥ paścātsvayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ \|*  
*etadvrataṃ naraḥ kṛtvā devīlokamavāpnuyāt \|\| 12 \|\|*

4a. This is also called MahastamI since the worship of goddess is ordained.

4b-7a. On the eighth day in the bright half of the month ofVaiSakha, the devotee observes fast. He takes his bath (in cool) water and performs the rite of ablution to the goddess Aparajita by means of the water from MamsI (Indian Spikenard) and Balaka (a fragrant root of the Plant Andropogom Muricatus. After worshipping with scents etc., Naivedya comprising of sugar is offered. Before performing breakfast on the following Navaim day, he should feed some virgins. О Brahmana, thanks to the grace of the goddess, he will move about in the worlds (above) in a refulgent aerial chariot, himself brilliant like the sun.

7b-9a. By worshipping the three-eyed Lord on the eighth day in the dark half of the month of Jyestha, the devotee shall remain in the SivaLoka. He will be bowed to by all the Devas. The man who worships the goddess on the eighth day in the bright half of the month of Jyestha moves about in an aerial chariot alongwith the groups of Gandharvas and Apsaras.

9b-12. On the eighth day in the bright half of the month of Asadha, the devotee takes his bath in water, mixed with turmeric powder. With the same water, he shall perform the rite of ablution of the goddess in accordance with the injunctions. After bathing the deity in pure water, subsequendy, he should smear the deity with camphor and sandal paste. After offering Naivedya consisting of sugar, water for Acamana rite should be offered. He should then feed Brahmanas and give them suitable gold and monetary gifts. After bidding them farewell, he should take food himself silently. By performing this holy rite, the man shall attain to the world of the goddess.

## \|\| 1.117.13-14 \|\|

*nabhaḥśukletathāṣṭamyāṃ devīmiṣṭvā vidhānataḥ \|*  
*kṣīreṇa snāpayitvā ca miṣṭānnaṃ vinivedayet \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tato dvijān bhojayitvā pare 'hni svayamapyuta \|*  
*bhuktvā samāpayedadvrataṃ saṃtativardhanam \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. On the eighth day in the bright half of the month of Sravana, tlie devotee should worship the goddess in accordance with the religious injunctions. After bathing the idol in milk, he should offer sweet cooked rice as Naivedya. He should feed Brahmanas on the next day, take food himself and conclude the holy rite. This holy rite increases the progeny.

## \|\| 1.117.15 \|\|

*nabhomāse sitāṣṭamyāṃ daśāphalamiti vratam \|*  
*upavāsaṃ tu saṃkalpya snātvā kṛtvā ca naityikam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The holy rite called Dasaphala vrata1 is on the eighth day in the dark half of the month of Sravana. The devotee decides on fasting, takes his bath and performs the Nitya (usual, prescribed) rites.

## \|\| 1.117.16-17 \|\|

*tulasyāḥ kṛṣṇāvarṇāyā dalairdaśabhirarcayet \|*  
*kṛṣṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ tathānantaṃ govindaṃ garuḍadhvajam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*dāmodaraṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ padmanābhaṃ hariṃ prabhum \|*  
*etaiśca nāmabhirnityaṃ kṛṣṇadevaṃ samarcayet \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. With ten leaves of black-coloured Tulas!, he worships uttering (in the dative case) these ten names of the Lord — Krsna (i.e. Kfsnaya namah) Visnu, Ananta, Govinda, Garudadhvaja, Damodara, Hrslkesa, Padmanabha, Hari and Prabhu. One should always worship Lord Krsna by means of these names.

## \|\| 1.117.18 \|\|

*namaskāraṃ tataḥ kuryātpradakṣiṇasamanvitam \|*  
*evaṃ daśadinaṃ kuryādvratānāmuttamaṃ vratam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. He should then circumambulate the deity and prostrate himself before it. Thus he should perform the most excellent of all the Vratas for ten days.

## \|\| 1.117.19 \|\|

*ādau madhye tathā cānte homaṃ kuryādvidhānataḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇamantreṇa juhuyāccaruṇāṣṭottaraṃ śatam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, he should perform homa in accordance with the injunctions. Uttering the Mantra of (the names of) Krsna, he should perform hundred and eight Homas with Caru (cooked rice soaked in ghee).

## \|\| 1.117.20-21 \|\|

*homānte vidhinā samyagācāryyaṃ pūjayetsudhīḥ \|*  
*sauvarṇe tāmrapātre vā mṛnmaye veṇupātrake \|\| 20 \|\|*

*tulasīdalaṃ suvarṇena kārayitvā sulakṣaṇam \|*  
*haimīṃ ca pratimāṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. At the end of the Ноmа, the intelligent devotee should worship the preceptor duly. He should get a replica of the leaf of TulasI exquisitely made in gold and place it in a vessel made of gold, copper, clay or bamboo. He should get an image made in gold and worship it in accordance with the injunctions. The text: nabhomdse sita flamy am need be emended as nabhomdsi’ sita flamy dm. The avagraha (marked here as) before sita is necessary as this Vrata falls on Srava^a K. r8th (HD. V. i. P. 311, also VRJ. p. 122 ff) If amdnta reckoning is not taken, it will fall on Bhadrapada which is not recognised in the NP here.

## \|\| 1.117.22 \|\|

*nidhāya pratimāṃ pātre hyācāryāya nivedayet \|*  
*dātavyā gauḥ savatsā ca vastrālaṅkārabhūṣitā \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. He should place the image in the vessel and offer it to the preceptor. A cow alongwith its calf, shouldЪе given fully bedecked in ornaments and clothes.

## \|\| 1.117.23 \|\|

*daśāhaṃ kṛṣṇadevāya pūrikā daśa cārpayet \|*  
*tāśca dadyādvidhijñāya svayaṃ vā bhakṣayedvratī \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. For ten days, he should offer ten Purikas (fried cakes of wheat flour) to the Lord Kr?na. The observer of the rite shall either offer these Purikas to a knower of the mode (of worship) or eat them himself.

## \|\| 1.117.24 \|\|

*śayanaṃ ca pradātavyaṃ yathāśakti dvijottama \|*  
*daśame 'hni tato mūrtiṃ sadravyāṃ guraver'payet \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. О excellent Brahmana, a bed also should be given as gift in accordance with his capacity. On the tenth day he should give the image to the preceptor.

## \|\| 1.117.25-26 \|\|

*vratānte daśaviprebhyaḥ pratyekaṃ daśa pūrikāḥ \|*  
*dadyādeva daśābdaṃ tu kṛtvā vratamanuttamam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*upoṣya vidhinā bhūyātsarvakā masamanvitaḥ \|*  
*ante kṛṣṇasya sāyujyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. At the conclusion of the holy rite, ten Purikas should be given to each of the ten Brahmanas. He should continue this rite for ten years. After performing this excellent Vrata for ten years and after duly observing the fast, the devotee shall realise all his cherished desires. There is no doubt in this that in the end, he will attain Sayujya (One-ness) with Krsna.

## \|\| 1.117.27-34 \|\|

*kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamī ceyaṃ smṛtā pāpaharā nṛṇām \|*  
*kevalenopavāsena tasmiñjanmadine hareḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*saptajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*upavāsī tilaiḥ snāto nadyādau vimale jale \|\| 28 \|\|*

*sudeśe maṇḍape kḷpte maṇḍalaṃ racayetsudhīḥ \|*  
*tanmadhye kalaśaṃ sthāpya tāmrajaṃ vāpi mṛnmayam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*tasyopari nyasetpātraṃ tāmraṃ tasyopari sthitām \|*  
*haimīṃ vastrayugācchannāṃ kṛṣṇasya pratimāṃ śubham \|\| 30 \|\|*

*pādyādyairupacāraistu pūjayetsnigdhamānasaḥ \|*  
*devakīṃ vasudevaṃ ca yaśodāṃ nandameva ca \|\| 31 \|\|*

*vrajaṃ gopāṃstathā gopīrgāśca dikṣu samarcayet \|*  
*tata ārārtikaṃ kṛtvā kṣamāpyānamya bhaktitaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*tiṣṭhettathaivārddharātre punaḥ saṃsnāpayeddharim \|*  
*pañcāmṛtaiḥ śuddhajalairgandhādyaiḥ pūjayetpunaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*dhānyākaṃ ca yavānīṃ ca śuṇṭhīṃ khaṇḍaṃ ca nārada \|*  
*sājyaṃ raupye dhṛtaṃ pātre naivedyaṃ vinivedayet \|\| 34 \|\|*

27-28a. This day remembered as (Krsna-JanmastamI)1 removes the sins of men. Merely by observing fast on this birthday of Hari, one is undoubtedly liberated from the sins of seven births.

28b-31a. The devotee who observes fast shall take his bath with gingelly seeds mixed in the pure water of a river etc. The intelligent devotee shall make a mystic diagram on the platform erected in a good place. In its middle, a Kalak (vessel) made of copper or clay is placed. Over this vessel, another copper vessel is placed. Above this latter vessel, the auspicious golden image of Kr?na is placed and covered with two cloths. With a pure mind, he should then worship it with Padya and other Upacaras.

31b-34. In the eight quarters he should worship DevakI, Vasudeva, Yasoda, Nanda, Vraja (colony of the cowherds), cowherds, cowherdesses and cows. Arartika rite (waving of lights before the deity) is performed. Forgiveness is craved for, by bowing down with devotion. The devotee remains thus till midnight, when he bathes Hari with Pancamrta and pure water. He should again worship the Lord with scents and other things. He should then offer the following things as Naivedya in a silver vessel: viz. Coriander, barley, ginger, sugarcandy, and ghee. О Narada, these should be offered as Naivedya.

## \|\| 1.117.35 \|\|

*punarārārtikaṃ kṛtvā daśadhā rūpadhāriṇam \|*  
*vicintayanmṛgāṅkāya dadyādarghyaṃ samudyate \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. After performing the Arartika (waving of lights in front of the deity) rite once again, he should think of the Lord as assuming ten different forms. He should then offer Arghya to the rising moon.

## \|\| 1.117.36 \|\|

*tataḥ kṣamāpya deveśaṃ rātrikhaṇḍaṃ nayedvratī \|*  
*paurāṇikaiḥ stotrapāṭhairgītavādyairanekadhā \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. After requesting the Lord of the Devas for forgiveness the observer of the holy rite should pass the rest of the night by reciting hymns from the Puranas and sing diverse songs in accompaniment of instrumental music.

## \|\| 1.117.37 \|\|

*tataḥ prabhāte vipragryānbhojayenmadhurānnakaiḥ \|*  
*datvā ca dakṣiṇāṃ tebhyo visṛjettuṣṭamānasaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. After the daybreak, he should feed eminent Brahmanas with sweet cooked rice. Delighted in his mind, he should offer Daksina and bid them farewell.

## \|\| 1.117.38 \|\|

*tatastāṃ pratimāṃ viṣṇoḥ svarṇadhenudharānvitām \|*  
*gurave dakṣiṇāṃ datvā visṛjyāśrīta ca svayam \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Thereafter, he should give that image of Visnu to- the preceptor alongwith gold, cow and plot of land as well as monetary gifts. After bidding farewell to him, the devotee should partake of his food.

## \|\| 1.117.39 \|\|

*dārāpatyasuhṛdbhṛtyarevaṃ kṛtvā vrata naraḥ \|*  
*sākṣādgokamāpnoti vimānavaramāsthitaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. After performing thus the holy rite, the man attains Goloka itself, in the company of his wife, children, friends and servants. He goes there, seated in an excellent aerial chariot.

## \|\| 1.117.40 \|\|

*naitena sadṛśaṃ cānyadvratamasti jagattraye \|*  
*kṛtena yena labhyeta koṭyaikādaśakaṃ phalam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. In the whole of the three worlds, there is no other holy Vrata equal to this. By performing this, the ^benefit of a Crore of Ekadasi Vratas is acquired.

## \|\| 1.117.41-43 \|\|

*śuklāṣṭamyāṃ nabhasyasya kuryādrādhāvrataṃ naraḥ \|*  
*pūrvavadrādhikāṃ haimīṃ kalaśasthāṃ prapūjayet \|\| 41 \|\|*

*madhyāhne pūjayitvenāmekabhaktaṃ samāpayet \|*  
*śakto bhaktaścopavāsaṃ pare 'hni vidhinā tataḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*suvāsinīrbhojayitvā gurave pratimārpaṇam \|*  
*kṛtvā svayaṃ ca bhuñjītaṃ vratamevaṃ samāpayet \|\| 43 \|\|*

41-43. On the eighth day in the bright half of the month of Nabhasya (Bhadrapada) a person should perform the holy rite of Radhavrata.1 As before, he should perform the worship of the gold image of Radha placed on the pot. At mid-day, after worshipping her, the devotee should take in a single meal. The devotee who is physically strong observes fast (for the complete day). On the next day, he feeds the Suvasinis in accordance with injunctions. He then offers the image to the preceptor. He shall partake of his food and formally conclude Vrata.

## \|\| 1.117.44 \|\|

*vratenānena viprarṣe kṛtena vidhinā vratī \|*  
*rahasyaṃ goṣṭhajaṃ labdhvā rādhāparikare vaset \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. О Brahmana sage, if this holy rite is performed duly, the observer of Vrata obtains the esoteric secret of the Vraja (of Krsna’s time) and stays among the followers of Radha.

## \|\| 1.117.45-46 \|\|

*dūrvāṣṭamīvrataṃ cātra kathitaṃ tacca me śṛṇu \|*  
*śucau deśe prajātāyāṃ dvarvāyāṃ dvijasattama \|\| 45 \|\|*

*sthāpya liṅgaṃ tato gandhaiḥ puṣpairdhūpaiśca dīpakaiḥ \|*  
*naivedyairarcayedbhaktyā dadhyakṣataphalādibhiḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

45-46. The holy rite of Durvastaml too is to be observed on this day. Listen to it from me. О excellent Brahmana, the Linga is to be placed on the Durva-grass growing in a pure and clean spot. He should then worship it with flowers, incense, scents, lights and Naivedyas, viz. curds, raw rice grains and fruits. At the end of Puja, he should, with great concentration, offer Arghya uttering the two Mantras.

## \|\| 1.117.47-50 \|\|

*arghyaṃ pradadyātpūjānte mantrābhyāṃ susamāhitaḥ \|*  
*tvaṃ dūrve 'mṛtajanmāsi surāsuranamaskṛte \|\| 47 \|\|*

*saubhāgyaṃ saṃtatiṃ dehi sarvakāryakarī bhava \|*  
*yathā śākhā praśākhābhirvistṛtāsi mahītale \|\| 48 \|\|*

*tathā vistṛtasaṃtānaṃ dehi me 'pyajarāmaram \|*  
*tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya viprānsaṃbhojya tatra vai \|\| 49 \|\|*

*bhuktvā svayaṃ gṛhaṃ gacchedatvā vipreṣu dakṣiṇām \|*  
*phalāni ca praśastāni miṣṭāni surabhīṇi ca \|\| 50 \|\|*

47-49a.2 “O Diirva grass, bowed to by the Devas and the Asuras, your birth is from nectar. Grant blessedness and line of children to me. Be a bestower of achievements of my works. Just as you are spread over the ground with your branches and branchlets, so also grant me growing progeny that shall be immortal and unageing.”

49b-50. The devotee then circumambulates it, feeds Brahmanas, gives Daksina to the Brahmanas, takes food himself and returns home. Alongwith the monetary gifts, he should give Brahmanas splendid, fragrant and sweet fruits.

## \|\| 1.117.51 \|\|

*evaṃ puṇyā pāpaharā nṛṇā dūrvāṣṭamī dvija \|*  
*caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ strījanānāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Thus, О Brahmana, the holy rite of Durvastaml is sacred and destructive of the sins of men of all the four castes and particularly of the woman folk.

## \|\| 1.117.52 \|\|

*yā na pūjayate dūrvā nārī mohādyathāvidhi \|*  
*janmāni trīṇi vaidhavyaṃ labhate sā na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. If any woman, out of delusion, does not worship Durva duly, undoubtedly she becomes a widow for three births.

## \|\| 1.117.53 \|\|

*yadā jyeṣṭharkṣasaṃyuktā bhavecjaivāṣṭabhī dvija \|*  
*jyeṣṭhā nāmnī tu sā jñeyā pūjitā pāpanāśinī \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. О Brahmana, if the AstamI coincides with the constellation Jyestha, it should be known as Jyesthastaml.1 If worshipped, it is destructive of sins.

## \|\| 1.117.54 \|\|

*athaināṃ tu samārabhya vrataṃ ṣoḍaśavāsaram \|*  
*mahālakṣmyāḥ samuddiṣṭaṃ sarvasaṃpadvivardhanam \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. The holy rite of Mahalaksmi begins on this day and lasts for sixteen days. It brings about all riches.

## \|\| 1.117.55 \|\|

*kariṣye 'haṃ mahālakṣmīvrataṃ te tvatparāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*tadavighnena me yātu samāptiṃ tvatprasādataḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. ctO Mahalaksmi, I am devoted to you and I shall perform your Vrata. Hence, thanks to your grace, may it come to a conclusion (May it be completed) without any impediment.”

## \|\| 1.117.56 \|\|

*ityuccārya tato baddhā ḍoraka dakṣiṇe kare \|*  
*ṣoḍaśagranthisahitaṃ guṇaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryutam \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. After saying this, the devotee twists round sixteen threads to form a string. He ties sixteen knots therein and ties the string round his right hand.

## \|\| 1.117.57 \|\|

*tato 'nvahaṃ mahālakṣmīṃ gandhādyairarccayedvratī \|*  
*yāvatkṛṣṇāṣṭamī tatra caredudyāpanaṃ sudhīḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. The observer of the holy rite should worship Mahalaksmi everyday, with scents and other things, upto the following AstamI in the dark half.

## \|\| 1.117.58 \|\|

*vastramaṇḍapikāṃ kṛtvā sarvatobhadramaṇḍale \|*  
*kalaśaṃ supratiṣṭhāpya dīpamuddyotayettataḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58a. On that day the intelligent devotee should perform the rite of Udyapana (concluding rite).

58b. Under the canopy of cloth, the devotee makes the mystic diagram called Sarvatobhadra. The Kalasa (vessel) is installed thereon and a lamp is lit.

## \|\| 1.117.59-62 \|\|

*uttārya ḍorakaṃ bāhoḥ kuṃbhasyādho nivedayet \|*  
*catasraḥ pratimāḥ kṛtvā sauvarṇīstatsvarūpiṇīḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

*snapanaṃ kārayettāsāḥ jalaiḥ pañcāmṛtaistathā \|*  
*upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*jāgarastatra kartavyo gītavāditraniḥ svanaiḥ \|*  
*tato niśīthe saṃprāpte 'bhyudite 'mṛtadīdhitau \|\| 61 \|\|*

*datvārghyaṃ bandhanaṃ dravyaiḥ śrīkhaṇḍādyairvidhānataḥ \|*  
*candramaṇḍalasaṃsthāyai mahālakṣyai pradāpayet \|\| 62 \|\|*

59-62. He should take off strings from the arm and keep it below the water pot. Four images in the form of the deity are made in gold, and they are bathed in water and Paftcamrta. After worshipping them in accordance with the injunctions, with the sixteen types of Upacaras, the devotee keeps awake till midnight, to the accompaniment of songs and instrumental music. At midnight, when the nectar-rayed moon rises, Arghya is offered to Mahalaksmi stationed in the middle of the moon’s disc, in accordance with the injunctions, together with Srikhanda (sandal) and other material. The string is also offered. \[ The following Mantras are utterred \]

## \|\| 1.117.63 \|\|

*kṣīrodārṇavasaṃbhūta mahālakṣmīsahodara \|*  
*pīyūṣadhāma rohiṇyāḥ sahitār'ghyaṃ gṛhāṇa me \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. “O Moon, born of the ocean of milk, brother of Mahalaksmi, О storehouse of nectar, accompanied by Rohini, accept my Arghya.”

## \|\| 1.117.64 \|\|

*kṣīrodārṇavasambhūte kamale kamalālaye \|*  
*viṣṇuvakṣasthalasthe me sarvakāmapradā bhava \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. “O Kamala, born of the ocean of milk, a resident of the Lotus, resting on the chest of Visnu, be the bestower of all the cherished desires on me.”

## \|\| 1.117.65 \|\|

*ekanāthe jagannāthe jamadagnipriye 'vyaye \|*  
*reṇuke trāhi māṃ devi rāmamātaḥ śivaṃ kuru \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. “O gentle lady Renuka, О beloved wife of Jamadagni, О Mistress of the Universe, having only a single Lord, О unchanging one, О mother of Parasurama, do what is auspicious to me”.

## \|\| 1.117.66-69 \|\|

*mantrairetairmahālakṣmīṃ prārthya śrotriyayoṣitaḥ \|*  
*samyaksaṃpūjya tāḥ samyaggandhayāvakakajjalaiḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

*saṃbhojya juhuyādagnau bilvapadmakapāyasaiḥ \|*  
*tadalābhe ghṛtairvipra gṛhebhyaḥ samidhastilān \|\| 67 \|\|*

*mṛtyuñjayāya ca paraṃ sarvarogapraśāntaye \|*  
*candanaṃ tālapatraṃ ca puṣpamālāṃ tathākṣatān \|\| 68 \|\|*

*durvāṃ kausumbhasūtraṃ ca yugaṃ śrīphalameva vā \|*  
*bhakṣyāṇi ca nave śūrpe pratidravyaṃ tu ṣoḍaśa \|\| 69 \|\|*

66-69. The devotee should pray to the goddess Mahalaksmi with the above Mantras. He should worship Brahmana women duly with scents, lac juice and collyrium and feed them. He should perform Ноmа oblating in the fire Bilva, lotus and milk puddings. If they are not available О Brahmana, homa is performed with ghee. For acquiring houses, homa is performed with sacrificial twigs or gingelly seeds. For conquering (i. e. averting) death and for subduing ailments the following articles are offered as gifts viz. — sandal paste, palmyra leaf, flower-garland, raw unbroken rice grains, Diirva grass, thread with saffron applied, two coconuts and foodstuffs. The food-stuffs should be placed in a new winnowing basket. There must be sixteen of them in each item.

## \|\| 1.117.70-71 \|\|

*samācchādyānyaśūrpeṇa vratī dadyātsamantrakam \|*  
*kṣīrodārṇavasaṃbhūtā lakṣmīścandrasahodarā \|\| 70 \|\|*

*vratenānena saṃtuṣṭā bhavatādviṣṇuvallabhā \|*  
*cetasraḥ pratimāstāstu śrotriyebhyaḥ samarpayet \|\| 71 \|\|*

70-71. The observer of the holy rite shall cover it with another winnowing basket and present it uttering the following Mantra: — “May Lakshml, born of the ocean of milk, sister of the moon and the beloved wife of Visnu be pleased with this Vrata”. He (the person performing this Vrata) should dedicate the four gold images to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 1.117.72 \|\|

*tatastu caturo viprān ṣoḍaśāpi suvāsinīḥ \|*  
*miṣṭānnenāśayitvā tu visṛjettāḥ sadakṣiṇāḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Thereafter, with sweet ccoked rice he shall feed four Brahmanas and sixteen Suvasinls (married women whose husbands are alive). He should bid farewell to them giving them their due Daksinas.

## \|\| 1.117.73-74 \|\|

*samāptiniyamaḥ paścādbhañjīteṣṭaiḥ samanvitaḥ \|*  
*etadvrataṃ mahālakṣmyāḥ kṛtvā vipra vidhānataḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

*bhuktveṣṭānaihikān kāmāṃllakṣmīloke vasecciram \|*  
*eṣāṣokāṣṭamī coktā yasyāṃ pūrṇaṃ ramāvratam \|\| 74 \|\|*

73-74. After concluding the observances, he should take food in the company of the affectionate ones. By performing this Vrata of Mahalaksmi, О Brahmana, in accordance, with the injunctions, one enjoys all worldly desirable pleasures and one shall live in the world of Laksmi for a long time. This is called Asokastam! also, and in it the holy rite of Rama (Sri) is complete.

## \|\| 1.117.75-80 \|\|

*atrāśokasya pūjā syādekabhaktaṃ tathā smṛtam \|*  
*kṛtvāśokavrataṃ nārī hyaśokā śokajanmani \|\| 75 \|\|*

*yatra kutrāpi saṃjātā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|*  
*āśvine śuklapakṣe tu proktā vipra mahāṣṭamī \|\| 76 \|\|*

*tatra durgācanaṃ proktaṃ savrairapyupacārakaiḥ \|*  
*upavāsaṃ caikabhaktaṃ mahāṣṭamyāṃ vidhāya tu \|\| 77 \|\|*

*sarvato vibhavaṃ prāpya modate devavacciram \|*  
*ūrjje kṛṣṇādike 'ṣṭamyāṃ karakākhyaṃ vrataṃ smṛtam \|\| 78 \|\|*

*tatromāsahitaḥ śaṃbhuḥ pūjanīyaḥ prayatnataḥ \|*  
*candrodayer'ghadānaṃ ca vidheyaṃ vratibhiḥ sadā \|\| 79 \|\|*

*putraṃ sarvaguṇopetamicchadbhirvividhaṃ sukham \|*  
*gopāṣṭamīti saṃproktā kārtike dhavale dale \|\| 80 \|\|*

75-76a. On this day, the Asoka tree is worshipped and only a single meal is taken every day. By performing the Ashoka Vrata, the lady, wherever she is born in this world of sorrow, becomes free from sorrow. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

76b-78a. О Brahmana, Mahastami1 is to be observed in the bright half of the month of Alvina. On that day, Durga is to be worshipped with all Upacaras. By observing fast or taking a single meal on the Mahastami day, the devotee attains all round affluence and rejoices like a god for a long time.

78b-80. The holy rite of Karaka Vrata is to be observed in thedark half of the month of Karttika. On that day, Sambhu accompanied by Uma is to be assiduously worshipped. Arghya is also to be always offered, at the time of the moon-rise, by the observers of the Vrata who wish for a son endowed with all good qualities or happiness of diverse kinds.

## \|\| 1.117.80-81 \|\|

*putraṃ sarvaguṇopetamicchadbhirvividhaṃ sukham \|*  
*gopāṣṭamīti saṃproktā kārtike dhavale dale \|\| 80 \|\|*

*tatrakuryādgavāṃ pūjāṃ gogrāsaṃ gopradakṣiṇām \|*  
*gavānugamanaṃ dānaṃ vāñchansarvāśca saṃpadaḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

80b-81. Gopashtami rite is to be observed in the bright half of the month of Karttika. On that day, one shall perform the worship of cows; fodder is offered to the cows, cows are circumambulated and followed. Cows are given as gifts by those who desire all riches.

## \|\| 1.117.82-85 \|\|

*kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ mārgaśīrṣe mithunaṃ darbhanirmitam \|*  
*anaghāṃ cānaghāṃ tatra bahuputrasamanvitam \|\| 82 \|\|*

*sthāpayitvā śubhe deśe gomayenopalepite \|*  
*pūjayedgandhapuṣpādyairupacāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

*saṃbhojya dvijadāṃpatyaṃ visṛjellabdhadakṣiṇam \|*  
*vratametannaraḥ kṛtvā nārī vā vidhipūrvakam \|\| 84 \|\|*

*putraṃ sallakṣaṇopetaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

82-85. A special holy rite is performed on the eighth day in the dark half of the month of MargashIrsha. Tfie image of a couple is made out ofDarbha grass. They are named Anagha and Anagha. They are accompanied by many sons, (images are made of these as well). On a spot scrubbed and cleaned with cow dung and made auspicious, the couple are placed and worshipped with scents, fragrant flowers, and diverse kinds of Upacaras. The devotee feeds a Brahmana couple and bids farewell to them after giving them Daksinas. A man or a woman can perform this holy rite. By performing it in accordance with the injunctions, he or she gets a son endowed with good characteristics. There is no doubt about this.

## \|\| 1.117.86-87 \|\|

*mārgāśīrṣasitāṣṭamyāṃ kālabhairavasannidau \|*  
*upoṣya jāgaraṃ kṛtvā mahāpāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 86 \|\|*

*yatkiñcidaśubhaṃ karma kṛtaṃ mānuṣajanmani \|*  
*tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti kālabhairavadarśanāt \|\| 87 \|\|*

86-87. On the eighth day in the bright half of the month of Margaslrsa, the devotee observes fast in the presence of Kalabhairava. By doing so and keeping awake for that night, one is liberated from great sins. Whatever inauspicious sin has been committed by a person in his birth as a human being, is dissolved entirely by seeing Kalabhairava image;

## \|\| 1.117.88 \|\|

*atha pauṣasitāṣṭamyāṃ śrāddhamaṣṭakasaṃjñitam \|*  
*pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidaṃ varṣaṃ kulasantativarddhanam \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. The holy rite of Sraddha called Astaka1 is to be observed on the eighth day in the dark half of the month of Pausa. It makes the Pitrs (manes) satisfied for a year. It increases the line of children in the family.

## \|\| 1.117.89 \|\|

*śuklāṣṭamyāṃ tu pauṣasya śivaṃ sampūjya bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*bhuktimuktimavāpnoti bhaktimekāṃ samācaran \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. By worshipping Siva devotedly on the eighth day in the bright half of the month of Pausa, one attains worldly pleasures and liberation by acting in pursuance of his (unflinching) devotion.

## \|\| 1.117.90 \|\|

*kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ tu māghasya bhadrakālīṃ samarcayet \|*  
*bhaktito vairivṛndaghnīṃ sarvakāmapradāyinīm \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. On the eighth day in the dark half of the month of Magha, one should, with great devotion, worship Bhadrakall, the destroyer of the hosts of enemies, and the bestower of all cherished desires to her devotees.

## \|\| 1.117.91 \|\|

*māghamāse sitāṣṭamyāṃ bhīṣmaṃ saṃtarpayaddvija \|*  
*saṃtatiṃ tvavyavacchinnāmicchaṃścāpyaparājayam \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. О Brahmana, one who wishes for an unbroken line of children and absence of defeat in battle, should propitiate Bhisma on the eighth day in the bright half of the month of Magha.

## \|\| 1.117.92 \|\|

*phaālgune tvasitāṣṭamyāṃ bhīprāṃ devīṃ samarcayet \|*  
*tatra vrataparo vipra sarvakāmasamṛddhaye \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. О Brahmana, on the eighth day in the dark half of the month of Phalguna, one should worship goddess Bhima. For the achievement of all cherished desires, he should be devoted to the Vrata.

## \|\| 1.117.93 \|\|

*śuklāṣṭamyāṃ phaālgunasya śivaṃ cāpi śivāṃ dvija \|*  
*gandhādyaiḥ samyagabhyarcya sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. О Brahmana, by worshipping properly with scents and other things, Siva and Siva on the eighth day in the bright half of the month of Phalguna, one shall become the Lord of all Siddhis (Super-natural Powers.)

## \|\| 1.117.94 \|\|

*phaālgunāparapakṣe tu śītalāmaṣṭamīdine \|*  
*pūjayetsarvavapakkānaiḥ saptamyāṃ vidhivatkṛtaiḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. One should worship goddess Sitala1 on the eighth day in the second fortnight of the month of Phalguna, with all kinds of cooked food prepared duly on the previous Saptami (seventh) day.

## \|\| 1.117.95 \|\|

*śītale tvaṃ jaganmātā śītale tvaṃ jagatpitā \|*  
*śītale tvaṃ jagadvātrī śītalāyai namonamaḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. “O Sltala, you arc the mother of the Universe. О Sltala,)ou are the father of the Universe. О Sitala, you are the support and base of the Universe. Obeisance, to you, salutations to you, О Sitala.

## \|\| 1.117.96 \|\|

*vande 'haṃ śītalāṃ devīṃ rāsabhasthāṃ digaṃbarām \|*  
*mārjanī kalaśopetāṃ visphoṭakavināśinīm \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. I bow down to goddess Sitala, who is seated on a donkey, is naked, holds the broom and the water pot and who destroys swellings.

## \|\| 1.117.97 \|\|

*śītale śītale cetthaṃ ye japanti jale lthitāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ tu śītalā devī syādvisphoṭakaśāntidā \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. Goddess Sitala shall be the bestower of calmness and quellcr of swellings to those who stand in water and repeat the name “Sitala, Sitala”.

## \|\| 1.117.98 \|\|

*ityevaṃ śītalāmantrairyaḥ samarcayate dvija \|*  
*tasya varṣaṃ bhavecchāntiḥ śītalāyāḥ prasādataḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. О Brahmana, thanks to the grace of goddess Sitala, he (thedevotee) shall be tranquil for a year; — he who worships Sitala by means of these Mantras of Sitala.

## \|\| 1.117.99 \|\|

*sarvamāsobhaye pakṣe vidhivaccāṣṭamīdine \|*  
*śivāṃ vāpiśivaṃ prārcyalabhate vāñchitaṃ phalam \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. By worshipping Siva and Siva on the eighth day in any of the halves and in any of the months, one attains the desired benefit.

## Chapter 118. The Exposition of the Vratas to be observed on Navaml (ninth) day (in the lunar fortnight)

## \|\| 1.118.1 \|\|

*sanātana uvāca*  
*atha vakṣyāmi viprendra navamyāste vratāni vai \|*  
*yāni kṛtvā narā loke labhante vāñchitaṃ phalam \|\| 1 \|\|*

Sanatana said:

1\. О leading Brahmana, henceforth, I shall recount to you the Vratas to be observed on the Navaml day (i.e. ninth day in the lunar fortnight). On performing these rites, people in the world attain the desired fruit.

## \|\| 1.118.2 \|\|

*caitrasya śuklapakṣe tu śrīrāmanavamīvratam \|*  
*tatropavāsaṃ vidhivacchakto bhaktaḥ samācaret \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The holy rite of Sri Rama Navaml1 is on the ninth day in the bright half of the month of Chaitra. A devotee who is physically strong, should duly observe full fast on that day.

## \|\| 1.118.3 \|\|

*aśaktaścaikabhaktaṃ vai madhyāhnotsavataḥ param \|*  
*viprānsaṃbhojya miṣṭānnai rāmaprīti sumācaret \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. If he is incapable physically (to observe full fast), he should take a single meal on that day after the midday festival. He shall propitiate Rama, by feeding the Brahmanas with sweet cooked rice.

## \|\| 1.118.4-7 \|\|

*gobhūtilahariraṇyādyervastrālaṅkaraṇestathā \|*  
*eva yaḥ kurute bhaktyā śrīrāmanavamīvratam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*vidhūya cehapāpāni vraje dviṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam \|*  
*uktaṃ mātṛvrataṃ cātra bhairaveṇa samanvitāḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*sraggandhavasranamanaivedyaiścatuḥṣṭistu yoginīḥ \|*  
*atraiva bhadrakālo tu yoginīnāṃ mahābalā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhaḥ sarvāsāmādhipatye 'bhiṣecitā \|*  
*tasmāttāṃ pūjayeccātra sopavāso jitendriyaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

4-5a. By means of (gifts of) cows, plots of lands, gingel- ly seeds, gold etc, and by means (of gifts of) clothes and ornaments, Brahmanas should be propitiated. He who devoutly performs the holy rite of Sri Ramanavami shall shake off all his sins in this world and attain the region of Visnu.

5b-7. The holy rite of Matrvrata is also to be observed on this same day. The Yoginls, sixtyfour in number, accompanied by Bhairava, are to be propitiated by means of garlands, scents, clothes and Naivedyas. О prominent Brahmana, it was on this day that Bhadrakall was crowned in the chieftancy of all mothers. Hence, one should worship her by observing fast and controlling his sense-organs, on this day.

## \|\| 1.118.8 \|\|

*rādhe navamyāṃ dalayoścaṇḍikāṃ yastu pūjayet \|*  
*vidhinā sa vimānena devataiḥ saha modate \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. He who worships Cantjika on the ninth day in either of the fortnights of the month of Vaisakha, in accordance with the injunctions in the matter, rejoices alongwith the Devas.

## \|\| 1.118.9-12 \|\|

*jyeṣṭhaśuklanavamyāṃ tu sopavāso narottamaḥ \|*  
*umāṃ saṃpūjya vidhivatkumārīrbhojayeddvijān \|\| 9 \|\|*

*svabhaktyā dakṣiṇāṃ datvā śālyannaṃ payasāśnuyāt \|*  
*umāvratamidaṃ vipra yaḥ kuryādvidhivannaraḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*sa bhuktveha varānbhogānante svargagatiṃ labhet \|*  
*āṣāḍhe māsi viprendra yaḥ kuryātpakṣayordvija \|\| 11 \|\|*

*naktaṃ caindrīṃ samabhyarcyedairāvatagatāṃ sitām \|*  
*sa bhavedvai valoke tu bhogabhāragdevayānagaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

9-11a. On the ninth day in the bright half of the month of Jyestha, the excellent man who observes fast, should worship Uma duly and feed virgins and Brahmanas in accordance with his ability. He should give them monetary gifts to the extent of his capacity. He should partake of only cooked aali rice along- with milk. О Brahmana, the man who duly performs this Uma Vrata1 enjoys great pleasures in this world. In the end, he attains the goal of heaven.

1 lb-12. (Defective) О chief of Brahmanas, he who performs (the following) holy rite on the ninth day in either of the fortnights in the month of Asadha and worships the fair- complexioned goddess Aindri riding the elephant Airavata and and partakes food only at night, shall become the enjoyer of pleasures in the world of the Devas. He will move about in the vehicle of the Devas or he will proceed along the path called Devayana.

## \|\| 1.118.13-15 \|\|

*śrāvaṇe māsi viprendra yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam \|*  
*pakṣayorupavāsaṃ vā kaumārīṃ caṇḍikāṃ yajet \|\| 13 \|\|*

*evaṃ pāpaharāṃ gandhaiḥ puṣpairdhūpaiśca dīpakaiḥ \|*  
*naivedyairvividhaiścaiva kumārībhojanaistathā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā kaumārīvratamuttamam \|*  
*sa vimānena gacchedvai devīlokaṃ sanātanam \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. In the month of Sravana, О leading Brahmana, the devotee should take food only at night, or he shall observe fast for two fortnights and worship Kaumari Candika. He should worship the goddess, the remover of sins, by means of scents, fragrant flowers, incense, lights and different Naivedyas. He should feed virgins. He who performs the excellent Kaumari Vrata devotedly in this manner, shall go to the eternal world of ihe goddess by means of an aerial chariot.

## \|\| 1.118.16-20 \|\|

*bhādre tu navamī śuklā nandāhvā parikīrtitā \|*  
*tasyāṃ yaḥ pūjayeddurgāṃ vidhivaccopacārakaiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labdhvā viṣṇuloke mahīyate \|*  
*āśvine śuklanavamī mahāpūrvā prakīrtitā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*aparāhne śamīpūjā kāryāsyāṃ prāgdiśi dvija \|*  
*tato niśāyāṃ prāgyāme khaḍgaṃ dhanuriṣūngadām \|\| 18 \|\|*

*śūlaṃ śaktiṃ ca paraśuṃ chirikāṃ carma kheṭakam \|*  
*chatraṃ dhvajaṃ gajaṃ cāśva govṛṣaṃ pustakaṃ tulām \|\| 19 \|\|*

*daṇḍaṃ pāśaṃ cakraśaṅkhau gandhādyairupacārakaiḥ \|*  
*saṃpūjya mahiṣaṃ tatra bhadrakālyai samālabhet \|\| 20 \|\|*

16-17a. The ninth day in the bright half of the month of Bhadrapada is glorified by the name of Nanda Navaml. He who worships Durga duly with all Upacaras (articles of worship and other formalities) on that day, attains the benefit of a horse- sacrifice and is honoured in the world of Visnu.

17b-20. The ninth day in the bright half of the month of Asvina is glorified by the name Mahanavami.3 On this day, О Brahmaria, the worship of the Sami tree should be performed in the afternoon in the eastern quarter. Then, at night, in the first watch (Yama) =3 hours), the following (pertaining to the goddess) should be worshipped viz — sword, bow, arrpws, iron club, trident, javelin, axe, dagger, leathern shield, and umbrella, banner, elephant, horse, cow and bull, book, balance, baton, noose and discus and the conch. After worshipping a buffalo with scents and other articles of worship (Upacara), it should be chopped off and dedicated to Bhadrakall.

## \|\| 1.118.21 \|\|

*evaṃ baliṃ vidhāyātha bhuktvā pakkānna meva ca \|*  
*dvijebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ datvā vrataṃ tatra samāpayet \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. After offering oblations and after partaking of only cooked rice, the devotee should give the monetary gifts to the Brahmaria and formally conclude the Vrata.

## \|\| 1.118.22 \|\|

*evaṃ yaḥ pūjayeddurgāṃ nṝṇāṃ durgatināśinīm \|*  
*iha bhuktvā varānbhogānante svargatimāpnuyāt \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. He who thus worships Durga, the destroyer of miseries and sufferings of men, enjoys excellent worldly pleasures here and shall attain heavenly region in the end.

## \|\| 1.118.23 \|\|

*kārtike śuklanavamī yākṣayā sā prakīrtatā \|*  
*tasyāmaśvatthamūle vai tarppaṇaṃ samyagācaret \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The ninth day in the bright half of the month of Karttika is glorified as Aksaya NavamI (everlasting NavamI) On that day, the devotee should perforin the rite of Tarpana at the roots of Asvattha (the holy fig tree).

## \|\| 1.118.24 \|\|

*devānāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ cāpi nārada \|*  
*svaśākhoktaistathā mantraiḥ sūryāyārghyaṃ tator'payet \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. О Narada, with mantras special to his own branch of the Vedas, that Tarpana rite of the Devas, sages and Pitrs should be performed correctly. Then the devotee should offer Arghya to the sun.

## \|\| 1.118.25 \|\|

*tato dvijānbhojayitvā miṣṭānnena munūśvara \|*  
*svayaṃ bhuktvā ca vihareddvijebhyo dattadakṣiṇaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Then he should feed Brahtnanas with sweet cooked rice. After taking his food and giving Daksina to the Brahmanas, he should rest and relax, О chief of sages.

## \|\| 1.118.26 \|\|

*evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā japadānaṃ dvijārcanam \|*  
*homaṃ ca sarvamakṣayyaṃ bhavediti vidhervayaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. It is the word (precept) of Vidhi (god Brahma) that, if anyone performs Japa, Dana, worship of the Brahmanas, Ноmа thus, everything of such acts shall be entirely everlasting.

## \|\| 1.118.27-31 \|\|

*mārge tu śuklanavamī nandinī parikīrtitā \|*  
*tasyāmupoṣito yastu jagadaṃbāṃ prapūjayet \|\| 27 \|\|*

*gandhādyaiḥ so 'śvamedhasya phalabhāṅnātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*pauṣe śuklanavamyāṃ tu mahāmāyāṃ prapūjayet \|\| 28 \|\|*

*ekabhaktaparo vipra vājapeyaphalāptaye \|*  
*māghamāse tu vā śuklā navamī lokapūjitā \|\| 29 \|\|*

*mahānandeti sā proktā sadānandakarī nṛṇām \|*  
*tasyāṃ snānaṃ tathā dānaṃ japo homa upoṣaṇam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*sarvamakṣayatāṃ yāti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|*  
*phaālgunāmalapakṣasya navamī yā dvijottama \|\| 31 \|\|*

27-28a. The ninth day in the bright half of the month of MargaSIrsa is glorified as NandinI (NavamI). He who observes fast on that day and worships elaborately goddess Jagadamba (the mother of the Universe) with scents and other things, attains the benefit of a horse-sacrifice. There is no doubt in this respect.

28b-29a. The devotee should worship Mahamayaon the ninth day in the bright half of the month of Pausa. О Brahmana, that is conducive to the acquisition of the fruit of a Vajapeya-sacrifice provided he takes only a single meal every day.

29b-31a. The ninth day in the bright half of the month of Magha is worshipped by the people. It is called Mahananda as it always causes delight to men. No doubt need be entertained in this respect that the holy bath, charitable gift, Japa, Ноmа, observance of fast, everything performed on that day has an everlasting benefit.

31b. О excellent Brahmana, the ninth day in the bright fortnight of the month of Phalguna is of a highly meritorious nature. It is called Ananda.1 It is remembered as the remover of all sins. О excellent Brahmana, he who observes fast on that day and worships goddess Ananda attains all desired benefits. It is the Truth. It is the Truth that is spoken by me.

## Chapter 119. The Holy rites to be observed on Dasami (i.e. tenth) days (in The Lunar fortnight)

## \|\| 1.119.1 \|\|

*sanātana uvāca*  
*atha te 'haṃ pravakṣyāmi daśamyā vai vratāni ca \|*  
*yāni kṛtvā naro bhaktyā dharmarājapriyo bhavet \|\| 1 \|\|*

Sanatana said:

1\. Henceforth, I shall recount to you the holy rites to be observed on Dasami (tenth) days (of lunar fortnights). On observing them devotedly, man becomes a favourite of Dharmaraja.

## \|\| 1.119.2 \|\|

*caitraśuklada śamyāṃ tu dharmarājaṃ prapūjayet \|*  
*tatkālasaṃbhavaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalairgandhādibhistathā \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. On the tenth day, in the bright half of the month of Chaitra, the devotee should worship Dharmaraja1 by means of the seasonal Sowers and fruits plucked for tlie nonce, and scents and other things

## \|\| 1.119.3 \|\|

*sopavāso vaikabhakto bhojayitvā dvijottamān \|*  
*caturddaśatatastebhyaḥ śaktyā dadyācca dakṣiṇām \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. He should either observe fast or take a single meal per day. After feeding fourteen excellent Brahmanas, he should give them monetary gifts according to his capacity.

## \|\| 1.119.4 \|\|

*evaṃ yaḥ kurute vipra dharmarājaprapūjanam \|*  
*sa dharmasyājñayāgaccheddevaiḥ sādharmyamacyutaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. О Brahmana, he who thus performs the worship of Dharmaraja, shall at the behest of Dharma, attain similarity with the Devas — a position from which he will not fall.

## \|\| 1.119.5-6 \|\|

*daśamyāṃ mādhave śukle viṣṇumabhyarcya mānavaḥ \|*  
*gandhādyairupacāraiśca śvetapuṣpaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*śataṃ pradakṣiṇāḥ kṛtvā vipransaṃbhojya yatnataḥ \|*  
*labhate vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. On the tenth day in the bright half of the month of Vaisakha, a man should worship god Visnu with scents and other articles of worship and formalities) as well as with white fragrant flowers. He should make hundred circumambula- tions, (round Visnu’s shrine) and assiduously feed Brahmanas. He (thereby) attains to the world of Visnu (Visnuloka). No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

## \|\| 1.119.7 \|\|

*jyeṣṭhe śukladaśamyāṃ tu jāhnavī saritāṃ varā \|*  
*samāyātā dharāṃ svargāttasmātsā puṇyadā smṛtā \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. It was on the tenth day in the bright half of the month of Jyestha that the Jahnavl (the river Ganga), the most excellent of all the rivers, came to the Earth from the heaven. Hence, the day is remembered as the bestower of merit.

## \|\| 1.119.8-9 \|\|

*jyeṣṭhaḥ śukladalaṃ hasto budhaśca daśamīḥ tithiḥ \|*
