## \|\| 2.65.10-11 \|\|

*rajasvalātvaṃ naitāsāṃ puṇyakṣetraprabhāvataḥ \|*  
*rantukaṃ tu purāsādya dvārapālaṃ mahābalam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*yakṣaṃ samabhivādyātha tatra yātrāṃ samārabhet \|*  
*tato gacchennaraḥ puṇyaṃ bhadre 'ditivanaṃ mahat \|\| 11 \|\|*

10a. These rivers are not frothy and foaming in view of the greatness of the sacred holy centre.

10b-11 A The devotee should first go to Rantuka and pay respects to that Yaksa, the extremely powerful gatekeeper. Only then the pilgrim should begin his pilgrimage.

## \|\| 2.65.11-17 \|\|

*yakṣaṃ samabhivādyātha tatra yātrāṃ samārabhet \|*  
*tato gacchennaraḥ puṇyaṃ bhadre 'ditivanaṃ mahat \|\| 11 \|\|*

*adityā yatra putrārthaṃ samyak cīrṇaṃ mahattapaḥ \|*  
*tatra snātvā samabhyarcya devamātaramaṅganā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*sūte putraṃ mahāśūraṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam \|*  
*tato gacchedvarārohe viṣṇoḥ sthānamanuttamam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*vimalaṃ nāma vikhyātaṃ yatra sannihito hariḥ \|*  
*vimale tu naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā ca vimaleśvaram \|\| 14 \|\|*

*vimalaḥ sa labhellokaṃ devadevasya cakriṇaḥ \|*  
*hariṃ ca baladevaṃ ca dṛṣṭvaikāsanamāsthitau \|\| 15 \|\|*

*mucyate kilbiṣātsadyo mohinyatra na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*tataḥ pāriplavaṃ gacchettīrthaṃ lokeṣu viśrutam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*tatra snātvā ca pītvā yo brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam \|*  
*santoṣya dakṣiṇādyena brāhmayajñaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 17 \|\|*

11b-13a. Thereafter, О auspicious lady, the man should go to the holy Aditivana.1 It was here that a great penance was duly performed by Aditi for obtaining sons. By taking holy dip and worshipping Aditi, the mother of the Devas, the lady-devotee gives birth to a great and heroic son endowed with all auspicious characteristic features.

13b-16a. Thereafter, О fair lady, the pilgrim should go to the excellent spot of Visnu that is famous by the name of Vimnla.2 Lord Hari is present here. By taking holy dip in Vimala and by visiting lord of Vimala the devotee should become (free from impurities). He shall attain the world of discus-bearing lord of the Devas. О Mohini, there is no doubt about this that by visiting Hari and Baladeva occupying one and the same seat, the devotee shall immediately be liberated from sins.

16b-17. Thereafter, the devotee should go to the Tirtha Pariplava3 wcllknown in the worlds. By taking holy dip there and drinking its waters as well as by propitiating a Brah- mana who has mastered the Vedas, by means of monetary gifts etc., the devotee shall derive the benefit of Brahma-Yajna.

## \|\| 2.65.18 \|\|

*yatrāsti saṅgamo bhadre kauśikyāḥ pāpanāśanaḥ \|*  
*tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā prāpnoti priyasaṅgamam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. By devoutly taking a holy dip in the place where the sin-destroying confluence of the Kausiki4 is present, О splendid lady, the man attains union with his beloved ones.

## \|\| 2.65.19 \|\|

*tatastu pṛthivītīrthamāsādya kṣāntimānnaraḥ \|*  
*snāto bhaktyā mahābhāge prāpnoti gatimuttamām \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Thereafter, the man endowed with forbearance should go to the Prthivi tirtha and devoutly take holy dip. Thereby, О blessed lady, he attains excellent salvation.

## \|\| 2.65.20 \|\|

*dharaṇyāmaparādhā ye kṛtāḥ syuḥ puruṣeṇa vai \|*  
*tānsarvānkṣamate devī tatra snātasya dehinaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The goddess (Earth) forgives the offences committed by a man on the Earth, if that embodied soul takes his holy dip there.

## \|\| 2.65.21 \|\|

*tato dakṣāśrame puṇye dṛṣṭvā dakṣeśvaraṃ śivam \|*  
*aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. By visiting Siva, the lord of Daksa in the holy hermitage Daksasrama, the man obtains the benefit of a horse- sacrifice.

## \|\| 2.65.22 \|\|

*tataḥ śālakinīṃ gacchettatra snātvā samarcayet \|*  
*hariṃ hareṇa saṃyuktaṃ vāñchitārthasya labdhaye \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Thereafter, the devotee shall go to Salakini. After taking a holy dip there, he should worship Hari in communion with Нага, for achieving the desired object.

## \|\| 2.65.23 \|\|

*nāgatīrthaṃ tataḥ prāpya snātvā tatra vidhānavit \|*  
*sarpiścāsya dadhi prāśya nāgebhyo hyabhayaṃ labhet \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The devotee who knows rules of procedure should go to Nagatirtha and take holy dip there. By taking in ghee and curds thereafter, he shall attain freedom from the fear of serpents.

## \|\| 2.65.24 \|\|

*tataḥ sāyamupāvṛtya rantukaṃ dvārapālakam \|*  
*ekarātroṣitastatra pūjayettaṃ pare'hani \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Thereafter, he should return in the evening to the shrine of Rantuka. Staying there for a night, the devotee should worship the getekeeper on the next day.

## \|\| 2.65.25 \|\|

*gandhādyairupacāraistu brāhmaṇaṃ prārcya bhojayet \|*  
*tataḥ pañcanadaṃ gacchettīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The next day he should worship a Brahmana receiving him with scents and other articles of service and then feed him. Thereafter, he should go to the Tirtha, Pancanada, well known in the three worlds.

## \|\| 2.65.26-31 \|\|

*pañca nādāḥ kṛtā yatra hareṇāsurabhīṣaṇāḥ \|*  
*tena pañcanadaṃ nāma sarvapātakanāśanam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*yatra snānena dānena nirbhayo jāyate naraḥ \|*  
*koṭitīrthaṃ tato gacchedyatra rudre ṇa mohini \|\| 27 \|\|*

*koṭitīrthānyupāhṛtya sthāpitāni mahātmanā \|*  
*tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā koṭīśvaraṃ haram \|\| 28 \|\|*

*pañcayajñabhavaṃ puṇyaṃ tatprabhṛtyāpnuyātsadā \|*  
*tatraiva vāmano devaḥ sarvairdevaiḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*tasmāttaṃ tatra sampūjya agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*tato'śvitīrthamāsādya śraddhāvānvijitendri yaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*snātvā tatra yaśasvī ca rūpavāṃśca naro bhavet \|*  
*tato vārāhatīrthaṃ ca prāpya viṣṇuprakalpitam \|\| 31 \|\|*

26-27a. It was here that Siva gave out five loud shouts that terrified the Asuras. Hence, the holy centre is famous by the name Pancanada. It is destructive of all sins. By taking a holy dip there and making charitable gifts, the man becomes fearless.

27b-29a. Thereafter, he should go to Kotitirtha, О Mohini, where a crore of Tirtha were brought as installed by Rudra the Great Atman. By taking the holy dip in that Tirtha and by visiting Нага, Ko(isvara (the lord of crores) the devotee shall attain the merit originating from five Yajnas ever since that day.

29b-30a. It was here alone that lord Vamana was installed by all Devas. З0В. Hence by worshipping him the devotee shall derive the benefit of Agnisfoma sacrifice.

31 A. Thereafter, he should go to Asvitirtha. By having faith and mastering sense-organs as well as by taking holy dip therein, the man shall become renowned and handsome.

## \|\| 2.65.31-33 \|\|

*snātvā tatra yaśasvī ca rūpavāṃśca naro bhavet \|*  
*tato vārāhatīrthaṃ ca prāpya viṣṇuprakalpitam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*āplutya śraddhayā tatra naraḥ sadgatimāpnuyāt \|*  
*tato vrajetsomatīrthaṃ yatra somo varānane \|\| 32 \|\|*

*tapastaptvā hyarogo'bhūttatra snānaṃ samācaret \|*  
*datvā ca tatra gāmekāṃ rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 33 \|\|*

31b-32a. Then he should go to the Varahatirtha created by Visnu. By taking holy dip therein with faith, the man shall attain good goal.

32b-33. Thereafter, О fairfaced lady, he should go to Soma tirtha1 where Soma (the moon) performed penance and became free from ailments. The devotee should like his holy plunge therein. By giving a cow as gift there, he shall attain the benefit of Rajasuya sacrifice.

## \|\| 2.65.34 \|\|

*bhūteśvaraṃ ca tatraiva jvālāmāleśvaraṃ tathā \|*  
*tāṇḍaliṅgaṃ samabhyarcya na bhūyo bhavamāpnuyāt \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. By worshipping Bhutesvara, Jvalamalesvara and Tan

## \|\| 2.65.35 \|\|

*ekahaṃse naraḥ snātvā go sahasraphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*kṛtaśauce naraḥ snātvā puṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. By taking a holy dip in Ekahaihsa, the man shall attain the benefit of charitable gift of a thousand cows. By taking holy bath in Krtasauca the man shall attain the benefit of sacrifice called Pun

## \|\| 2.65.36 \|\|

*tato muñjavaṭaṃ nāma prāpya devasya śūlinaḥ \|*  
*samuṣya ca niśāmekāṃ prārcyeśaṃ gaṇapo bhavet \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Thereafter, the devotee should go to the holy centre of the trident-bearing lord, called munja-vata. By observing fast for a night and worshipping Isa he shall be the lord of Ganas.

## \|\| 2.65.37 \|\|

*prasādya yakṣiṇīṃ tatra dvārasthāmupavāsakṛt \|*  
*snātvābhyarcyāśayedviprānmahāpātakaśāntaye \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. The devotee should propitiate the female YaksinI stationed at the threshold by observing fast, taking the holy dip and worshipping. For quelling great sins, he should feed the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 2.65.38 \|\|

*pradakṣiṇamupāvṛtya puṣkaraṃ ca tato vrajet \|*  
*tatra snātvā pitṝnprārcya kṛtakṛtyo naro bhavet \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. He shall circumambulate them. Thereafter, he shall go to Puskara. By taking a bath and by worshipping the Pitrs, he shall have his objects accomplished.

## \|\| 2.65.39 \|\|

*kanyādānaṃ ca yastatra kārtikyāṃ vai samācaret \|*  
*prasannā devatāstasya yacchantyabhimataṃ phalam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. If any one offers the gift of a virgin (i.e. if he gives a virgin away in marriage) there on the fullmoon day of Karttika, the deities will be delighted and give him the desired benefit.

## \|\| 2.65.40 \|\|

*kapilaśca mahāyakṣo dvārapālo'tra saṃsthitaḥ \|*  
*vighnaṃ karoti pāpānāṃ sukṛtaṃ ca prayacchati \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Kapila, the great Yaksa, is stationed here as the gatekeeper. He creates obstacles in the commission of sins (to the sinners). He grants merit too.

## \|\| 2.65.41-43 \|\|

*patnī tasya mahābhāgā nāmnolūkhalamekhalā \|*  
*āhatya dundubhiṃ sā tu bhramate nityameva hi \|\| 41 \|\|*

*vārayetpāpinaḥ snānāttathā sukṛtino nayet \|*  
*tato rāmahradaṃ gacchetsnātvā tatra vidhānataḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*devānpitṝnṛṣīniṣṭvā bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca vindati \|*  
*rāmamabhyarcya sacchraddhaḥ svarṇaṃ dattvā dhanī bhavet \|\| 43 \|\|*

41-42a His highly blessed wife Okhalamekhala continuously beats the Dundubhi drum and wanders every where. She prevents sinners from taking bath. She leads the meritorious ones.

42b-43 Thereafter, the devotee shall go to Ramahrada.1 By taking a holy dip therein duly and by worshipping the Devas, Pitrs and sages the devotee shall attain worldly plcasuses and liberation. By worshipping Parasurama faithfully and by making gift of gold, the devotee shall become rich.

## \|\| 2.65.44 \|\|

*vaṃśamūlaṃ samāsādya snātvā svaṃ vaṃśamuddharet \|*  
*kāyaśodhanake snātvā śuddhadeho hariṃ viśet \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. By going to Vamsamula Tirtha and by taking the holy bath therein, the devotee shall uplift his own race. By taking the holy dip in Kayasodhanaka (that which purifies the body) the devotee’s body shall become pure and he shall enter Hari.

## \|\| 2.65.45 \|\|

*lokoddhāraṃ tataḥ prāpya snātvābhyarcya janārdanam \|*  
*prāpnoti śāśvataṃ lokaṃ yatra viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. The devotee shall go to Lokoddhara. By taking bath and worshipping Janardana, he shall attain the permanent world where the eternal Visnu abides.

## \|\| 2.65.46 \|\|

*śrītīrthaṃ ca tataḥ prāpya śālagrāmamanuttamam \|*  
*snātvābhyarcya hariṃ nityaṃ paśyati svāntike sthitam \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. He should then go to Sritirtha and after taking bath should worship the excellent Salagrama. Thereby, he sees Hari present continuously near him.

## \|\| 2.65.47 \|\|

*kapilāhradamāsādya snātvābhyarcya surānpitṝn \|*  
*sahasrakapilāpuṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. After reaching Kapilahrada, he should take a holy bath and worship Devas and Pitrs. Thereby, he derives the merit of a thousand tawny-coloured cows.

## \|\| 2.65.48 \|\|

*kapilaṃ tatra viśveśaṃ samabhyarcya vidhānataḥ \|*  
*devaiśca satkṛto bhadre sākṣācchivapadaṃ labhet \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. By duly worshipping Kapila, the lord of the universe, О gentle lady, the devotee shall be duly greeted by Devas and he shall derive the region of Siva himself.

## \|\| 2.65.49 \|\|

*sūryatīrthe tato bhānuṃ sopavāsaḥ samarcayet \|*  
*agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ labdhvā vrajeddivam \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Thereafter, observing fast, he should worship the sun in the Suryatirtha. After attaining the benefit of Agnistoma sacrifice, he shall go to heaven.

## \|\| 2.65.50 \|\|

*pṛthivīvivaradvāri sthito gaṇapatiḥ svayam \|*  
*taṃ dṛṣṭvātha samabhyarcya yajñasya phalamāpnuyāt \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Ganapati himself is stationed at the entrance to a crevice into the Earth. By visiting him and duly worshipping him, the devotee shall attain the benefit of a Yajna.

## \|\| 2.65.51 \|\|

*devyāstīrthe naraḥ snātvā labhate rūpamuttamam \|*  
*brahmāvarte naraḥ snātvā brahmajñānamavāpnuyāt \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. By taking a holy dip in the Tirtha of Goddess, a man obtains excellent features. By taking holy dip Brahma- varta, a man attains perfect knowledge of the Brahman.

## \|\| 2.65.52 \|\|

*sutīrthake naraḥ snātvā devarṣipitṛmānavān \|*  
*samabhyarcyāśvamedhasya yajñasya phalamāpnuyāt \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. By taking holy dip in Sutirthaka and by worshipping Devas, sages, Pitrs and human beings, a man obtains the benefit of a horse-sacrifice.

## \|\| 2.65.53 \|\|

*kāmeśvarasya tīrthe tu snātvā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|*  
*sarvavyādhivinirmukto brahma prāpnoti śāśvatam \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. By performing holy bath in the Tirtha of Kames- vara witli faith, the devotee shall be liberated from all ailments. He shall attain the eternal Brahman.

## \|\| 2.65.54 \|\|

*snātasya mātṛtīrthe tu śraddhayābhyarcakasya tu \|*  
*āsaptamaṃ kulaṃ devi varddhate śrīranuttamā \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. By taking a holy dip and worshipping with faith in the Matrtirtha the family flourishes till the eleventh generation. Excellent prosperity increases.

## \|\| 2.65.55 \|\|

*tataḥ sītāvanaṃ gacchettatra tīrthaṃ mahacchubhe \|*  
*punātidarśanādeva puruṣānekaviṃśatim \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Thereafter, the devotee should go to Sitavana.1 О auspicious lady, there is a great Tirtha there. By its mere vision, it sanctifies twenty-one generations.

## \|\| 2.65.56-57 \|\|

*keśānprakṣipya vai tatra pūto bhavati pāpataḥ \|*  
*daśāśvamedhikaṃ tatra tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam \|\| 56 \|\|*

*darśanāttasya tīrthasya mukto bhavati kilbiṣaiḥ \|*  
*mānuṣāhvaṃ tatastīrthaṃ prāpya snānaṃ samācaret \|\| 57 \|\|*

56-57. By casting off the tresses of hair there, the devotee becomes liberated from sins. The Tirtha named Dasasvame- dliika is well known in all the three worlds. By seeing that Tirtha one shall be liberated from sins. Thereafter, he shall go to the Tirtha called Manusa2 and take the holy bath.

## \|\| 2.65.58-59 \|\|

*yadīcchenmānuṣaṃ janma punaśca vidhinandini \|*  
*mānuṣācca tatastīrthātkrośamātre mahānadī \|\| 58 \|\|*

*apagā nāma vikhyātā tatra snātvā vidhānataḥ \|*  
*śyāmākaṃ payasā siddhaṃ bhojayed dvijasattamān \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. О daughter of god Brahma, if one wishes for a human birth once again one shall take bath in the Tirtha Manusa. The river Mahanadi three kilometres from the Manusa Tirtha is well known. After taking bath there in accordance with the injunctions, the devotee should feed excellent Brahmana on Syairiaka rice cooked in milk.

## \|\| 2.65.60-61 \|\|

*tasya pāpaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti pitṝṇāṃ śrāddhato gatiḥ \|*  
*nabhasye māsi kṛṣṇe tu pitṛpakṣe mahālaye \|\| 60 \|\|*

*caturdaśyāṃ tu madhyāhne piṇḍado muktimāpnuyāt \|*  
*brāhmodumbarakaṃ gacchedbrahmaṇaḥ sthānakaṃ tataḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

60-61 A. His sins perish. He attains salvation by performing the rite of Sraddha to the Pitrs. At midday on the fourteenth day during the Pitrpaksa (the dark fortnight dedicated to the manes) called Mahalaya in the month of Bhadra-pada, the devotee shall offer Pindas. Thereby, he shall attain liberation.

## \|\| 2.65.61-65 \|\|

*caturdaśyāṃ tu madhyāhne piṇḍado muktimāpnuyāt \|*  
*brāhmodumbarakaṃ gacchedbrahmaṇaḥ sthānakaṃ tataḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

*tatra brahmarṣikuṇḍeṣu snātaḥ somaphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*vṛddhakedārake tīrthe sthāṇuṃ daṇḍisamanvitam \|\| 62 \|\|*

*samarcya yatra cāpnoti naro'ntarddhānamicchayā \|*  
*kalaśyāṃ ca tato gacchedyatra devī svayaṃ sthitā \|\| 63 \|\|*

*snātvāsyāmambikāṃ prārcya taretsaṃsārasāgaram \|*  
*sarake kṛṣṇabhūtāyāṃ dṛṣṭvā devaṃ maheśvaram \|\| 64 \|\|*

*śaivaṃ padamavāpnoti naraḥ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|*  
*tisraḥ koṭyastu tīrthānāṃ sarake santi bhāmini \|\| 65 \|\|*

61b-62a. Thereafter, he should go to Brahma’s spot Brahmodumbaraka. He who takes a holy dip in the pools of Brahmarsis (Brahmanical sages) obtains the benefit of Somaya ga.

62b-63a. By worshipping Sthanu accompanied by Dan- din in the Tirtha called Vrddhakedaraka the man attains the power of vanishing at will.

63b-64a. Thereafter, the devotee should go to KalasI where the goddess herself is present. By taking a holy dip here and worshipping Ambika, one shall cross the ocean of worldly existence.

64b-65. By visiting lord Mahesvara at Saraka1 on the fourteenth day in the dark half of the month, the man endowed with faith, shall attain the region of Siva. О beautiful lady, there are three classes of Tirthas at Saraka.

## \|\| 2.65.66-75 \|\|

*rudra koṭistathā kūpe saromadhye vyavasthitā \|*  
*tasminsarasi yaḥ snātvā rudra koṭiṃ smarennaraḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

*pūjitā rudra koṭistu tena syānnātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*īhāspadaṃ ca tatraiva tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam \|\| 67 \|\|*

*yasminmuktimavāpnoti darśanādeva mānavaḥ \|*  
*tatrasthānarcayitvā ca devānpitṛgaṇānapi \|\| 68 \|\|*

*na durgatimavāpnoti manasā cintitaṃ labhet \|*  
*kedāraṃ ca mahātīrthaṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśanam \|\| 69 \|\|*

*tatra snātvā ca puruṣaḥ sarvadānaphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*anyajanmeti vikhyātaṃ sarakasya tu pūrvataḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

*saro mahatsvacchajalaṃ devau hariharau yataḥ \|*  
*viṣṇuścaturbhujastatra liṅgākāraḥ śivaḥ sthitaḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

*tatra snātvā ca tau dṛṣṭvā stutvā mokṣaṃ labhennaraḥ \|*  
*nāgahrade tato gatvā snātvā caitre sitāntake \|\| 72 \|\|*

*śrāddhado muktimāpnoti yamalokaṃ na paśyati \|*  
*tatastriviṣṭapaṃ gacchettīrthaṃ devaniṣevitam \|\| 73 \|\|*

*yatra vaitaraṇī puṇyā nadī pāpapramocinī \|*  
*tatra snātvārcayitvā ca śūlapāṇiṃ bṛṣadhvajam \|\| 74 \|\|*

*sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā gacchatyeva parāṃ gatim \|*  
*rasāvarte naraḥ snātvā siddhimāpnotyanuttamām \|\| 75 \|\|*

66-67a. The Rudrakoti (thecrore ofRudras) is stationed in the well in the middle of the lake. The man who takes bath in that lake and remembers Rudrakoti is meritorious. There is no doubt about this that Rudrakoti it worshipped by him.

67b-69a. There is another Tirtha there itself, viz. Ihaspa- padam (Basis for desire). It is destructive of sins. By its mere sight a man attains liberation. By worshipping Devas and Pitrs, the man wards off mishaps. He shall obtain everything mentally thought of.

69b-70a. There is a great Tirtha called Kedara. It is destructive of all sins. By taking a holy bath there, the man shall achieve the benefit of all gifts.

70b-71a. There is a great lake of very clear water to the east of Saraka. It is well known by the name “Anyajanma” (another birth), where the lord Hari and Нага are present. Visnu stands there in his four-armed form, while Siva abides there in the form of a Linga. By performing holy ablution there in visiting and eulogising the deity, the man obtains liberation.

71b-73a. Thereafter, the devotee shall go to Nagahrada and take a holy dip towards the end of the bright half of the month of Chaitra. By offering Sraddha, he attains liberation. He never sees the world of Yama.

73b-75. Thereafter, the devotee shall go to the Tirtha Trivistapa that is resorted to by the Devas. There is a holy river Vaitarani there. It liberates one from sins. By taking a holy dip and worshipping the trident-bearing and bull-emblemed deity, he shall purify his soul of all sins. He will definitely attain the greatest goal (Moksa). By taking holy dip in the Rasavarta the man attains excellent Siddhi.

## \|\| 2.65.76 \|\|

*caitrasya sitabhūtāyāṃ snānaṃ kṛtvā vilepake \|*  
*pūjayitvā śivaṃ bhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. On the fourteenth day in the bright half of the month of Chaitra, the devotee should take a holy dip in the Vilepaka and worship Siva devoutly. Thereby he is liberated from all sins.

## \|\| 2.65.77 \|\|

*tato gacchennaro devi phalakīvanamuttamam \|*  
*yatra devāḥ sagandharvāstapyante paramaṃ tapaḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. Thereafter, О gentle lady, the man should go to the excellent Phalakivana1 where Devas perform great penance along with the Gandharvas.

## \|\| 2.65.78 \|\|

*tatra nadyāṃ dṛṣadvatyāṃ naraḥ snātvā vidhānataḥ \|*  
*devānpitṝṃstarpayitvā hyagniṣṭomātirātrabhāk \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. By taking a holy dip in the river Drsadvatl there in accordance with the injunctions and by performing the rite of Tarpana to the Devas and Pitrs. the man shall attain the benefit of Agnistoma and Atiratra sacrifices.

## \|\| 2.65.79 \|\|

*darśe tathā vidhudine tatra śrāddhaṃ karoti yaḥ \|*  
*gayāśrāddhasamaṃ tatra labhate phalamuttamam \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. On the new-moon day or on Lunar-day (Full-moon day (?) the man shall perform Sraddha rite there. He attains an excellent benefit thereby on a par with that of Gayasraddha.

## \|\| 2.65.80-86 \|\|

*śrāddhe phalamaraṇyasya smaraṇaṃ pitṛtṛptidam \|*  
*pāṇighāte tatastīrthe pitṝnsantarpya mānavaḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

*rājasūyaphalaṃ prāpya sāṅkhyaṃ yogaṃ ca vindati \|*  
*tatastu miśrake tīrthe snātvā martyo vidhānataḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

*sarvatīrthaphalaṃ prāpya labhate gatimuttamām \|*  
*tato vyāsavane gatvā snātvā tīrthe manojave \|\| 82 \|\|*

*manīṣiṇaṃ vibhuṃ dṛṣṭvā manasā cintitaṃ labhet \|*  
*gatvā madhuvanaṃ caiva devyāstīrthe naraḥ śuciḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

*snātvā devānṛṣīniṣṭvā labhate siddhimuttamām \|*  
*kauśikīsaṅgame tīrthe dṛṣadvatyāṃ naraḥ plutaḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

*niyato niyatāhāraḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate \|*  
*tato vyāsasthaladyaṃ gacchedyatra vyāsena dhīmatā \|\| 85 \|\|*

*putraśokābhibhūtena dehatyāgo viniścitaḥ \|*  
*punarutthāpito devaistatra gatvā na śokabhāk \|\| 86 \|\|*

80a. That is the benefit of the Sraddha. The remembrance of the forest yields satisfaction to the Pitrs.

80b-81a. Thereafter, the devotee shall go to the Tirtha Panighata and perform the rite of Tarpanas to the Pitrs. Thereby he attains the benefit of Rajasiiya and of Sankhya and Yoga as well.

81b-82a. Then the man should perform bath in the Tirtha MiSraka in accordance with the injunctions. Thereby he attains the benefit of all the Tlrthas and attains excellent salvation.

82b-83a. Thereafter he should go to Vyasavana1 and take a holy dip in the Tirtha Manojava. By visiting the lord Manlsin he shall attain whatever is mentally thought of.

83b-84a After going to the Madhu-vana, he should take a holy bath in the Tirtha of the goddess and be pure. By worshipping Devas and sages, he attains an excellent SiddhL

84b-85a The man shall take a holy plunge in the Tirtha, the confluence of Kausiki and Drsadvatl. If he observes restraints and restricts his diet, lie shall be liberated from all sins.

85b-86. Thereafter, the devotee should go to Vyasa- sthali. It was here that the intelligent Vyasa, overwhelmed by grief at the bereavement of his son, decided on casting oif his body. He was re-suscitated to life by Devas. By going to that holy spot, the man is rid of his grief.

## \|\| 2.65.87 \|\|

*kinduśūkūpamāsādya tilaprasthaṃ pradāpya ca \|*  
*gaccheddhi paramāṃ siddhiṃ mṛto muktivāpnuyāt \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. After going to the well of Kindusu kupa the devotee should make a gift of a Prastha measure of gingolly seeds. Thereby, he attains the greatest Siddhi. If he dies there, he shall attain liberation.

## \|\| 2.65.88 \|\|

*āhnaṃ ca muditaṃ caiva dvai tīrthe bhuvi viśrute \|*  
*tayoḥ snātvā viśuddhātmā sūryalokamavāpnuyāt \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. Two Tirthas are well-known over the Earth Viz. Ahna and Mudita. By taking a holy dip therein and purifying the soul, the devotee shall attain the world of Sun-

## \|\| 2.65.89 \|\|

*mṛgamucyaṃ tato gatvā gaṅgāyāṃ praṇataḥ sthitaḥ \|*  
*arcayitvā mahādevamaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. Thereafter, he should go to the Tirtha Mrgamucya on the Ganga. By bowing down and worshipping Mahadeva, the devotee shall attain the benefit of a horse-sacrifice.

## \|\| 2.65.90 \|\|

*koṭitīrthaṃ tato gatvā snātvā koṭīśvaraṃ śivam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā stutvā śraddadhānaḥ koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. Thereafter, he should go to Kotitirtha. By taking a holy dip, by visiting Sivakotisvara and by eulogising him faithfully, he shall attain the benefit of a crore of sacrifices.

## \|\| 2.65.91-92 \|\|

*tato vāmanakaṃ gacchettriṣu lokeṣu viśrutam \|*  
*yatra vāmanajanmābhūdbaleryajñajihīrṣayā \|\| 91 \|\|*

*tatra viṣṇupade snātvā pūjayitvā ca vāmanam \|*  
*sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā viṣṇuloke mahīyate \|\| 92 \|\|*

91-92. Thereafter, the devotee shall go to Vamana- kunda2 well-known in the three worlds. It was here that Vamana his birth with the desire to destroy Bali’s Yajna. By taking the holy bath at Visnupada therein and by worshipping Vamana, the devotee shall be freed of all sins. He is honoured in the world of Visnu.

## \|\| 2.65.93-94 \|\|

*jyeṣṭhāśramaṃ ca tatraiva sarvapātakanāśanam \|*  
*jyeṣṭhasya śuklaikādaśyāṃ sopavāsaḥ pare'hani \|\| 93 \|\|*

*snātvā tatra vidhānena śreṣṭhatvaṃ labhate nṛṣu \|*  
*śrāddhaṃ tatra kṛtaṃ devi pitṝṇāmatituṣṭidam \|\| 94 \|\|*

93-94. The hermitage Jycsthasrama is destructive of all sins. The devotee should observe fast on the eleventh day in the bright half of the month of Jyestha. On the next day, he should perform ablution therein in accordance with the injunctions. Thereby, lie attains the greatest excellence among men. О gentle lady, the Sraddha performed there gives great satisfaction to the Pitis.

## \|\| 2.65.95 \|\|

*tatraiva koṭitīrthaṃ ca triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam \|*  
*tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. There itself is the Kotitlrtha well known in the three worlds. By taking a holy dip in that Tlrtha he shall obtain the benefit of a crore of sacrifices.

## \|\| 2.65.96 \|\|

*tatra koṭīśvaraṃ nāma devedavaṃ maheśvaram \|*  
*samabhyarcya vidhānena gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. By duly worshipping Mahesvara, the lord of the Dcvas, named Kotlsvara, the devotee shall attain chieftancy of the Ganas.

## \|\| 2.65.97-99 \|\|

*sūryatīrthaṃ ca tatraiva snātvātra ravilokabhāk \|*  
*kulottāraṇake tīrthe gatvā snānaṃ samācaran \|\| 97 \|\|*

*uddhṛtya svakulaṃ svarge kalpāntaṃ nivasettataḥ \|*  
*pavanasya hrade snātvā dṛṣṭvā devaṃ maheśvaram \|\| 98 \|\|*

*vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ śaivaṃ padamavāpnuyāt \|*  
*snātvā ca hanumattīrthe naro muktimavāpnuyāt \|\| 99 \|\|*

97a. By taking a holy dip in the Siiryatlrtha the devotee shall attain the world of the Sun.

97b-98a. Going to the Tlrtha called Kulottaranaka and taking a holy dip therein, the devotee uplifts his family. He then stays in heaven till the end ofKalpa.

98b-99a. By taking a holy dip in the Deep pool of the Wind-God and by visiting lord Mahesvara, the devotee shall be liberated from all sins and attain Siva’s region.

99b. By taking a holy dip in the Hanumattirtha the man shall attain liberation.

## \|\| 2.65.100 \|\|

*śālahotrasya rājarṣestīrthe snātvāghavarjitaḥ \|*  
*śrīkumbhākhye sarasvatyāstīrthe snātvātha yajñavāk \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. By taking a holy dip in the Tlrtha of the saintly king Salahotra the devotee shall be devoid of sins. By taking the holy dip in the Tlrtha of the Sarasvati named Srikumbha the man shall attain the benefit of Yajna.

## \|\| 2.65.101 \|\|

*snātaśca naimiṣe kuṇḍe naimiṣasnānapuṇyabhāk \|*  
*snātvā vedavatītīrthe strī satītvamavāpnuyāt \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. By taking the holy dip in the Naimisakunda the devotee attains the merit of ablution in the Naimisa. By taking a holy bath in the Vedavati tlrtha a woman shall attain the Status of Satl (Parvatl).

## \|\| 2.65.102 \|\|

*brahmatīrthe naraḥ snātvā brāhmaṇyaṃ labhate naraḥ \|*  
*brahmaṇaḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra gatvā na śocati \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. By taking a holy dip in the Brahma Tlrtha a man obtains Brahmana-hood. This is the greatest spot of Brahma. By going there none comes to grief.

## \|\| 2.65.103 \|\|

*somatīrthe naraḥ snātvā svargatiṃ samavāpnuyāt \|*  
*saptasārasvataṃ tīrthaṃ prāpya snātvā ca muktibhāk \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. By taking a holy dip in Somatirtha, a man shall attain heavenly goal. By going to and by having a holy dip in the seven Sarasvata Tirthas the man shall attain liberation. m

## \|\| 2.65.104-105 \|\|

*yatra sapta sarasvatyaḥ samyagaikyaṃ samāgatāḥ \|*  
*suprabhā kāñcanākṣī ca viśālā ca manoharī \|\| 104 \|\|*

*sunandā ca suveṇuśca saptamī vimalodakā \|*  
*tathaivauśanase tīrthe snātvā mucyeta pātakaiḥ \|\| 105 \|\|*

104-105. The seven Sarasvatis viz Suprabha, Kaftca- naksl, Visala, Manohari, Sunanda, Suvenu and Vimalodaka join together there. By taking a holy bath in the Ausanasa Tirtha, the devotee shall be freed from all sins.

## \|\| 2.65.106 \|\|

*kapālamocane snātvā brahmahāpi viśudhyati \|*  
*vaiśvāmitre naraḥ snāto brāhmaṇyaṃ samavāpnuyāt \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. By taking a holy dip in the Kapalamocana even a Brahmana-slayer becomes pure. A man who takes a holy dip in the Vaisvamitra Tirtha shall attain Brahmana-hood.

## \|\| 2.65.107 \|\|

*tataḥ pṛthūdake snātvā mucyate bhavabandhanāt \|*  
*avakīrṇe naraḥ snātvā brahmacaryaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. By taking the holy dip in the Prthudaka1 one is liberated from worldly bondage. By taking a holy dip in the Avakirna a man attains the benefit of celibacy.

## \|\| 2.65.108 \|\|

*madhusrāve'thaprayātaḥ snāto mucyeta pātakaiḥ \|*  
*snātvā tīrthe ca vāsiṣṭhe vāsiṣṭhaṃ lokamāpnuyāt \|\| 108 \|\|*

108\. One who goes to Madhusrava and takes a holy bath shall be liberated from sins. By taking the holy dip in the Vasisthatlrtha, the devotee attains the world of Vasistha.

## \|\| 2.65.109 \|\|

*aruṇāsaṅgame snātvā trirātropoṣito naraḥ \|*  
*snātvā muktimavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|\| 109 \|\|*

109\. By taking a holy bath in the confluence of Aruna and by observing fast for three days, the devotee attains liberation. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

## \|\| 2.65.110 \|\|

*samudrā statra catvārasteṣu snāto naraḥ śubhe \|*  
*gosahasraphalaṃ labdhvā svargaloke mahīyate \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. О auspicious lady, there are four seas there. One who takes a holy dip there attains the benefit of the gift of a thousand cows. He is honoured in the heavenly world.

## \|\| 2.65.111 \|\|

*somatīrthaṃ ca tatrānyattasminsnātvā ca mohini \|*  
*caitre ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca śuklāyāṃ śrāddhaṃ kṛtvoddharetpitṝn \|\| 111 \|\|*

111\. There is another Somatirtha there. О Mohini, by taking holy bath in that on the sixth day in the bright half of the month of Chaitra, and by performing Sraddha, one shall uplift the Pitrs.

## \|\| 2.65.112 \|\|

*atha pañcavaṭe snātvā yogamūrtidharaṃ śivam \|*  
*samabhyarcya vidhānena daivataiḥ saha modate \|\| 112 \|\|*

112\. By taking a holy dip in the Panchavata and by duly worshipping Siva who has assumed the Yogic form, the devotee rejoices along with the Devas.

## \|\| 2.65.113 \|\|

*kurutīrthe tataḥ snātaḥ sarvasiddhimavāpnuyāt \|*  
*svargadvāre pluto martyaḥ svargaloke mahīyate \|\| 113 \|\|*

113\. One who takes a holy dip in the Kurutlrtha shall attain all Siddhis. The man who takes a plunge in the Svargadvara, is honoured in the heavenly world.

## \|\| 2.65.114-116 \|\|

*snāto hyanarake tīrthe mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ \|*  
*tato gacchennaro devi kāmyakaṃ vanamuttamam \|\| 114 \|\|*

*yasminpraviṣṭamātrastu mucyate sarvasañcayaiḥ \|*  
*athādityavanaṃ prāpya darśanādeva muktibhāk \|\| 115 \|\|*

*snānaṃ ravidine kṛtvā tatra vāñchitamāpnuyāt \|*  
*yajñopavītike snātvā svadharmaphalabhāgbhavet \|\| 116 \|\|*

114a. One who takes bath in the Tirtha Anaraka is liberated from all sins.

114b-115a. О gentle lady, thereafter, the man should go to the excellent forest Kamyaka Vana.1 The moment he enters, he is liberated from all accumulations of sins.

115b-116a. After reaching Adityavana, if he visits (the deity) he will be liberated. By taking holy dip there on a Sunday, the devotee shall attain everything desired.

116b. By taking a holy dip in the Yajftopavltika Tirtha, the devotee shall attain the benefit of maintaining his own duty.

## \|\| 2.65.117 \|\|

*tataścatuḥpravāhākhye tīrthe snātvā narottamaḥ \|*  
*sarvatīrthaphalaṃ prāpya modate divi devavat \|\| 117 \|\|*

117\. Thereafter, the excellent man shall take a holy dip in the Tirtha Catuhpravaha. Thereby, he attains the benefit of all Tirthas and rejoices in heaven like a Deva.

## \|\| 2.65.118 \|\|

*snātastīrthe vihāre tu sarvasaukhyamavāpnuyāt \|*  
*durgātīrthe naraḥ snātvā na durgatimavāpnuyāt \|\| 118 \|\|*

118\. One who takes bath in the Tirtha Vihara shall attain all happiness- By taking a holy dip in the Durga Tirtha a man never faces misfortunes.

## \|\| 2.65.119 \|\|

*tataḥ sarasvatīkūpe pitṛtīrthāparāhvaye \|*  
*snātvā santarpya devādīṃllabhate gatimuttamām \|\| 119 \|\|*

119\. Thereafter, the devotee should take bath in the well Sarasvati also known as Pitr-Tlrtha, and perform the Tarpana rite to the Devas and others; thereby he shall attain excellent salvation.

## \|\| 2.65.120 \|\|

*snātvā prācīsarasvatyāṃ śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ \|*  
*durlabhaṃ prāpnuyātkāmaṃ dehānte svargatiṃ labhet \|\| 120 \|\|*

120\. By taking a holy dip in the PracI Sarasvati2 (Eastern Sarasvati) and by performing the Sraddha rites in accordance with the injunctions, the devotee shall attain even inaccessible desires. At the time of death, he shall attain heavenly goal.

## \|\| 2.65.121-123 \|\|

*śukratīrthe naraḥ snātvā śrāddhadaḥ proddharetpitṝn \|*  
*aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ caitre kṛṣṇe viśeṣataḥ \|\| 121 \|\|*

*sopavāso brahmatīrthe muktibhāṅnātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*sthāṇutīrthe tataḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā sthāṇuvaṭaṃ naraḥ \|\| 122 \|\|*

*mucyate pātakairghorairiti prāha pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*darśanātsthāṇuliṅgasya yātrā pūrṇā prajāyate \|\| 123 \|\|*

121-122a. By taking a holy dip in the Sukra Tirtha and offering Sraddha a man shall uplift the Pitrs. He should observe fast on the eighth or the fourteenth day particularly in the dark half of the month of Gaitra and take bath in the Brahma Tirtha. Undoubtedly he will attain liberation.

122b-123. Thereafter, he shall take bath in the Sthanu- Tlrtha and visit the Sthanuvrsa. The man thereby is liberated from terrible sins. So says Pitamaha. By visiting the Sthanu- linga the pilgrimage becomes complete.

## \|\| 2.65.124 \|\|

*kurukṣetrasya deveśi satyaṃ satyaṃ mayoditam \|*  
*kurukṣetrasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati \|\| 124 \|\|*

124\. О goddess, the pilgrimage of the holy centre Kurukshetra is thus complete. Truth and nothing but the truth is uttered by me. There.has never been and there never will be a Tirtha like Kurukshetra.

## \|\| 2.65.125-127 \|\|

*tatra dvādaśa yātrāstu kṛtvā bhūyo na janmabhāk \|*  
*pūrtamiṣṭaṃ tapastaptaṃ hutaṃ dattaṃ vidhānataḥ \|\| 125 \|\|*

*tatra syādakṣayaṃ sarvamiti vedavido viduḥ \|*  
*manvādau ca yugādau ca grahaṇe candra sūryayoḥ \|\| 126 \|\|*

*mahāpāte ca saṅkrānto puṇye cāpyanyavāsare \|*  
*snātastatraḥ kurukṣetre phalānantyamavāpnuyāt \|\| 127 \|\|*

125a. By undertaking twelve such pilgrimages the devotee is not born again.

125b-126a. Holy rites and laudable public works like digging tanks, wells, penances, Homas, duly given charitable gifts etc. at that place, everything shall be everlasting. They who know the Vedas know this.

126b-127. One who takes a holy dip on the inaugural days of Manvantaras and Yugas, during lunar and solar eclipses during the transits of the sun, on Mahapata period and on other holy occasions shall attain infinite benefits.

## \|\| 2.65.128 \|\|

*kalijānāṃ tu pāpānāṃ pāvanāya mahātmanām \|*  
*brahmaṇā kalpitaṃ tīrthaṃ kurukṣetraṃ sukhāvaham \|\| 128 \|\|*

128\. It is for the purification of sins of noble souls, originating from the Kali age that the pleasant Tirtha of Kurukshetra has been created by Brahma.

## \|\| 2.65.129 \|\|

*ya imāṃ kīrtayetpuṇyāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm \|*  
*śṛṇuyādvā naro bhaktyā so'pi pāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 129 \|\|*

129\. He too who glorifies this sacred story that destroys sins, or the man who devoutly listens to this, is liberated from sins

## \|\| 2.65.130 \|\|

*yadyaddadāti yastatra kurukṣetre ravigrahe \|*  
*tattadeva sadāpnoti naro janmani janmani \|\| 130 \|\|*

130\. In every birth, the man shall always attain whatever he gives away at Kurukshetra at the time of solar eclipse.

## \|\| 2.65.131 \|\|

*atha kiṃ bahunoktena vidhije śṛṇu niścitam \|*  
*sevetaiva kurukṣetraṃ yadīcchedbhavamokṣaṇam \|\| 131 \|\|*

131\. Now, of what avail is much talk? О daughter of Brahma, listen to this decision. If one wishes fir deliverance from worldly bondage, one shall of necessity resort to Kurukshetra.

## \|\| 2.65.132 \|\|

*etadeva mahatpuṇyametadeva mahattamaḥ \|*  
*etadeva mahajjñānaṃ yadvrajetsthāṇutīrthakam \|\| 132 \|\|*

132\. This is the greatest merit. This is the greatest penance. This alone is the greatest perfect knowledge if one goes to the Sthanutlrtha.

## \|\| 2.65.133 \|\|

*kurukṣetrasamaṃ tīrthaṃ nānyadbhuvi śubhāvaham \|*  
*sācāro vāpyanācāro yatra muktimavāpnuyāt \|\| 133 \|\|*

133\. There is no other Tirtha on the Earth as splendid as Kurukshetra. Whether one adheres to the Acaras or not (i.e. discipline of castes and stages of life) one attains liberation there.

## \|\| 2.65.134-135 \|\|

*etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'ha tvayānaghe \|*  
*kurukṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ sarvapāpanikṛntanam \|\| 134 \|\|*

*puṇyadaṃ mokṣadaṃ caiva kimanyacchrotumicchasi \|\| 135 \|\|*

134-135. О sinless lady, what I have been asked, I have told you entirely, about the greatness of Kurukshetra that destroys sins. It is meritorious. It bestows salvation. What else do you wish to hear?

## Chapter 66. Glory of Gnngadvara (Or Haridvara)

## \|\| 2.66.1 \|\|

*mohinyuvāca- kurukṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ śrutaṃ pāpāpahaṃ mahat \|*  
*tvatto dvijavaraśreṣṭha sarvasiddhipradaṃ nṛṇām \|\| 1 \|\|*

Mohini submitted:

1\. О most excellent one among the Brahmanas, the greatness of Kurukshetra that is exceedingly destructive of sins, and which bestows Siddhis on men, has been heard from you.

## \|\| 2.66.2 \|\|

*gaṅgādvāreti yatkhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyāvahaṃ guro \|*  
*tatsamākhyāhi bhadraṃ te śrotuṃ vāñchāsti me hṛdi \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. О preceptor, blessed are you. Kindly recount to me the meritorious Tlrtha well known as Gahgadvara.1 There is great desire in my heart to hear about it. Vos и narrated:

## \|\| 2.66.3 \|\|

*vasuruvāca- śṛṇu bhadre pravakṣyāmi māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam \|*  
*gaṅgādvārasya te puṇyaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāṃ śubham \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Listen, О gentle lady, I shall describe to you the greatness of Gahgadvara that destroys sins. It is holy and auspicious to those who listen and read.

## \|\| 2.66.4 \|\|

*yatra bhūmimanuprāptā bhagīratharathānugā \|*  
*śrīgaṅgālakanandākhyā nagānbhittvā sahasraśaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. It is at this place that the holy Gariga named Ala- kananda reaches the Earth piercing through the mountains in thousand places and following the chariot of Bhagiratha. The editor of the Sk. Text remarks: Thus the greatness of Kurukshetra is completely recounted. Now the greatness of Gahgadvara is begun.

## \|\| 2.66.5 \|\|

*yatrāyajata yajñeśaṃ purā dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ \|*  
*tatkṣetraṃ puṇyadaṃ nṝṇāṃ sarvapātakanāśanam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. It is here that Daksa,1 the Prajapati, formerly worshipped Yajftcsa (Lord of Yajrias). That holy place bestows merits on men and destroys sins.

## \|\| 2.66.6 \|\|

*yasminyajñe samāhūtā devā indra purogamāḥ \|*  
*svaiḥ svairgaṇaiḥ samāyātā yajñabhāgajighṛkṣayā \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. In this Yajna, Devas with their leaders like Indra and others had been invoked. With a desire to partake of their shares in the Yajna, they came here accompanied by their attendants.

## \|\| 2.66.7 \|\|

*yatra devarṣayaḥ prāptāstathā brahmarṣayo'malāḥ \|*  
*śiṣyapraśiṣyaiḥ sahitāstathā rājarṣayaḥ śubhe \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. О auspicious lady, the divine sages, pure Brahmanical sages and saintly kings together with their disciples and their disciples’ disciples had come there.

## \|\| 2.66.8-10 \|\|

*sarve nimantritāstena brahmaputreṇa dhīmatā \|*  
*gandharvāpsaraso yakṣāḥ siddhavidyādharoragāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*samprāptā yajñasadanamṛte śarvaṃ pinākinam \|*  
*tatastu gacchatāṃ teṣāṃ sapriyāṇāṃ vimāninām \|\| 9 \|\|*

*dakṣayajñotsavaṃ prītyānyonyaṃ varṇayatāṃ satī \|*  
*śrutvā sotkā mahādevaṃ prārthayāmāsa bhāminī \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-9a. All of them had been invited by that intelligent son of Brahma. The Gandharvas, Apsaras, Yaksas, Siddhas, Vidyadharas and serpents — all came to the place of Yajna, except Siva, the Pinaka-bearing deity.

9b-10. As the invitees were going in their aerial chariots along with their wives, they were extolling the festivities in the Yajna of Daksa delightedly. The beautiful lady Satl heard (their descriptions) and became eager (to see it for herself). She therefore requested Mahadeva for permission to go.

## \|\| 2.66.11-12 \|\|

*tacchrutvā bhagavānāha na śreyo gamanaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*atha devamanādṛtya bhāvino'thasya gauravāt \|\| 11 \|\|*

*jagāmaikākinī bhadre dra ṣṭuṃ pitṛmakhotsavam \|*  
*tataḥ sā tatra samprāptā na kenāpi sabhājitā \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. On hearing it, the Lord said: “It is not conducive to welfare to go there”. In view of the gravity of the inevitable future, she disregarded the lord and went there to participate in the celebration of the Yajna by her father. When she reached there, she was neither honoured nor welcomed by anyone.

## \|\| 2.66.13-16 \|\|

*prāṇāṃstatyāja tanvaṅgī tajjātaṃ kṣetramuttamam \|*  
*tasmiṃstīrthe tu ye snātvā tarpayanti surānpitṝn \|\| 13 \|\|*

*te syurdevyāḥ priyatamā bhogamokṣaikabhāginaḥ \|*  
*ye'nye'pi tatra svānprāṇāṃstyajantyanaśanādibhiḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*te'pi sākṣācchivaṃ prāpya nāpnuvanti punarjanim \|*  
*atha tannāradācchrutvā bhagavānnīlalohitaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*maraṇaṃ svapriyāyāstu vīrabhadraṃ vinirmame \|*  
*sa sarvaiḥ pramathairyuktastaṃ yajñaṃ samanāśayat \|\| 16 \|\|*

13-15a The beautiful lady laid down her life there and that spot became an excellent holy centre.2 Those who take their holy bath in that Tlrtha and perform the rite of Tarpana to the Devas and Pitrs, shall be favourites of the goddess. They will be able to enjoy worldly pleasures as well as salvation. Those who cast off their lives there by means of fasts etc. attain Siva himself. They are not reborn in Samsara.

15b-16. On hearing about the death of his beloved from Narada, lord Nilalohita (Siva) created Vlrabhadra. Accompanied by all the Pramathas, he destroyed that Yajna completely.

## \|\| 2.66.17 \|\|

*punarvidheḥ prārthanayā mīḍhvānsadyaḥ prasāditaḥ \|*  
*saṃdadhe ca punaryajñaṃ vikṛtaṃ prakṛtisthitam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. By the subsequent prayer of Brahma God Siva was immediately propitiated. He reorganized the Yajna. The disorganized Yajna was brought back to normalcy.

## \|\| 2.66.18 \|\|

*tatastattīrthamatulaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam \|*  
*jātaṃ yatrāplutaḥ somo mukto yakṣmagrahādabhūt \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Thereafter, that Tirtha has become unequalled and destructive of all sins. By performing ablution into it, the moon-god became free from the grip of consumptive diseases.

## \|\| 2.66.19 \|\|

*tatra yo vidhivatsnātvā yaṃ yaṃ kāmaṃ vicintayet \|*  
*taṃ tamāpnoti vidhije nātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. No doubt need be entertained in this respect, О daughter of Brahma. He who duly takes bath in that Tirtha attains every desire he cherishes.

## \|\| 2.66.20 \|\|

*yatra yajñeśvaraḥ sākṣādbhagavānviṣṇuravyayaḥ \|*  
*stuto dakṣeṇa devaiśca tattīrthaṃ harisaṃjñitam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Hari Tirtha is that holy centre where the immutable lord Visnu, the lord of Yajnas, was eulogised by Daksa and Devas.

## \|\| 2.66.21 \|\|

*tatra yo vidhivanmartyaḥ srāyāddharipade sati \|*  
*sa viṣṇorvallabho bhūyādbhuktimuktyekabhājanam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The man who duly takes a holy bath there at Haripada, О chaste lady, shall be a beloved favourite of Visnu and the receptacle of worldly pleasures and salvation.

## \|\| 2.66.22 \|\|

*ataḥ pūrvadiśi kṣetraṃ trigaṅgaṃ nāma viśrutam \|*  
*yatra tripathagā sākṣāddṛśyate sakalairjanaiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. To the east of this is the well known holy centre Triganga. The Tripathaga (Ganga flowing along the three paths) is directly seen there by the people.

## \|\| 2.66.23 \|\|

*tatra snātvātha santarpya devarṣipitṛmānavān \|*  
*samyakchraddhāyuto martyo modate divi devavat \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. By taking a holy bath therein and by performing the rite of Tarpana to the Devas, sages, Pitrs and human beings, the man endowed with perfect faith rejoices in heaven like a god.

## \|\| 2.66.24 \|\|

*tatra yastyajati prāṇānpravāhe patitaḥ sati \|*  
*sa vrajedvaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma devaiḥ samyaksabhājitaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. О chaste lady, he who falls into the current and abandons his life, shall go to the abode of Visnu. He is duly honoured by Devas.

## \|\| 2.66.25 \|\|

*tataḥ kanakhale tīrthe dakṣiṇīṃ diśamāśrite \|*  
*trirātropoṣitaḥ snātvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Thereafter, the devotee should go to the Tirtha, Kanakhala1 in the southern direction. In observing fast for three nights and by taking a holy dip in the Tirtha, one is liberated from all sins.

## \|\| 2.66.26 \|\|

*atha yastatragāṃ dadyādbrahmaṇe vedapārage \|*  
*sa kadācinna paśyettu devi vaitaraṇīṃ yamam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. О gentle lady, he who gives a cow there to a Brahmana who has mastered the Vedas never sees Vaitarani nor Yajna.

## \|\| 2.66.27-28 \|\|

*atra japtaṃ hutaṃ taptaṃ dattamānantyamaśnute \|*  
*atraiva jahnutīrthe ca yatra vai jahnunā purā \|\| 27 \|\|*

*rājarṣiṇā nipītābhūdgaṇḍūṣīkṛtya sā nadī \|*  
*prasāditena sā tena muktā karṇādvinirgatā \|\| 28 \|\|*

27a. Anything given or offered into the sacred fire, or Japa, or penance performed here attains everlasting benefit.

27b-28. The Jahnu Tirtha is also here where formerly that river was drunk up by the royal sage Jahnu after making a mouthful of her. When he was propitiated, the river was released by him and it came out of his ear.

## \|\| 2.66.29-32 \|\|

*tatra snātvā mahābhāge yo naraḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ \|*  
*sopavāsaḥ samabhyarcedbrāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*bhojayetparamānnena svarge kalpaṃ vasetsa tu \|*  
*atha paścāddiśi gataṃ koṭitīrthaṃ sumadhyame \|\| 30 \|\|*

*tathaivottaradigbhāge saptagaṅgeti viśrutam \|*  
*tīrthaṃ paramakaṃ devi sarvapātakanāśanam \|\| 32 \|\|*

29-30a. О blessed lady, the man who takes his holy dip there, who observes fast, who is equipped with faith and who duly propitiates a Brahmana who has mastered the Vedas, by feeding him with excellent cooked rice, shall stay in the heaven for the duration of a Kalpa. ЗОВ-31. О lady of fine waist-line, thereafter, the devotee should go to the Ко ti tirtha which is in the western direction. By visiting Kotina the merit acquired is a crore of times more. By observing fast for a night there, the devotee shall attain the benefit of Pundarika sacrifice.

32\. Similarly, in the northern quarter, there is the great Tirtha well known as Saptagariga.1 О gentle lady, it is destructive of all sins.

## \|\| 2.66.33-35 \|\|

*yatrāśramāśca puṇyā vai saptarṣīṇāṃ mahāmate \|*  
*teṣu sarveṣu tu pṛthak snātvā santarpya devatāḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*pitṝṃśca labhate martya ṛṣilokaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*bhagīrathena vai rājñā yadānītā surāpagā \|\| 34 \|\|*

*tadā sā prītaye teṣāṃ saptadhārāgatābhavat \|*  
*saptagaṅgaṃ tatastīrthaṃ bhuvi vikhyātimāgatam \|\| 35 \|\|*

33-34a. О highly intelligent lady, the holy hermitages of the seven sages are there. By taking a holy bath severally in those Tirthas and by performing the rite of Tarpana to the gods and to the Pitrs, the man obtains the eternal world of sages.

34b-35 When the Divine river Gariga was being brought by king Bhaglratha, the river, thanks to her love and fondness for them (seven sages), flowed in seven currents. Therefore, the Tirtha became famous as Saptagariga.

## \|\| 2.66.36 \|\|

*sa āvartaṃ tataḥ prāpya santarpyāmarapūrvakān \|*  
*snātvā devendra bhavane modate yugameva ca \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The devotee then goes to the Avarta and performs Tarpana rite to all, beginning with the Devas, after the holy bath. Thereby, he rejoices in the abode of Devendra for the period of a Yuga.

## \|\| 2.66.37 \|\|

*tato bhadre samāsādya kapilāhradamuttamam \|*  
*dhenuṃ dattvā dvijāgryāya gosahasraphalaṃ labhet \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Thereafter, О gentle lady, the devotee should go to the excellent Kapilahrada. By giving a cow as gift to an excellent Brahmana he shall attain the benefit of giving a thousand cows.

## \|\| 2.66.38 \|\|

*atraiva nāgarājasya tīrthaṃ paramapāvanam \|*  
*atrābhiṣekaṃ yaḥ kuryātso'bhayaṃ sarpato labhet \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The extremely sacred Tirtha of Nagaraja, (king of serpents, is here itself. He who performs the rite of ablution here, shall derive protection from serpents.

## \|\| 2.66.39 \|\|

*tato lalitakaṃ prāpya śantanostīrthamuttamam \|*  
*snātvā santarpya vidhivatsurādīm̐ llabhate gatim \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Thereafter, the devotee should go to Lalitakaand the excellent Tirtha of Santanu. By taking the holy bath therein and performing the rite of Tarpana in accordance with injunctions the gods and others, the devotee attains salvation.

## \|\| 2.66.40 \|\|

*yatra śantanunālabdhā gaṅgā mānuṣyamāgatā \|*  
*tatraiva tatyaje dehaṃ vasūnsūtvānuvatsaram \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. It was here that Ganga who had come in a human form was attained by Santanu. After giving birth to the Vasus year by year, it was here that she threw them in and finally cast off her body.

## \|\| 2.66.41-42 \|\|

*taddeho nyapatattatra tatrābhūdṛkṣajanma ca \|*  
*tatra yaḥ snāti manujo bhakṣayedoṣadhīṃ ca tām \|\| 41 \|\|*

*sa na durgatimāpnoti gaṅgādevīprasādataḥ \|*  
*bhīmasthalaṃ tataḥ prāpya yaḥ snāyātsukṛtī naraḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42a. Where the body was cast off, medicinal trees grew up. The man who takes bath there and eats parts of the trees never sees any misfortune by the grace of goddess Ganga.

42b. Thereafter, the devotee shall go to the Tirtha Bhlmasthala.1 He who takes a holy bath there is a meritorious man.

## \|\| 2.66.43 \|\|

*bhogānbhuktveha dehānte svargatiṃ samavāpnuyāt \|*  
*etānyuddeśato devi tīrthāni gaditāni te \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. After enjoying pleasures here, the devotee shall attain heavenly status after death О gentle lady, these holy centres have been narrated to you very briefly.

## \|\| 2.66.44-46 \|\|

*anyāni vai mahābhāge santi tatra sahasraśaḥ \|*  
*yo'sminkṣetre naraḥ snāyātkumbhagejye'jage ravau \|\| 44 \|\|*

*sa tu syādvākpatiḥ sākṣātprabhākara ivāparaḥ \|*  
*atha yāte prayāgādipuṇyatīrthe pṛthūke \|\| 45 \|\|*

*atha yo vāruṇe yoge mahāvāruṇake tathā \|*  
*mahāmahāvāruṇe ca srāyāttatra vidhānataḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

44-45a О blessed lady, there are thousands of other Tirthas there. He who takes a holy dip in this sacred holy centre when Jupiter is in Aquaries and the sun is in Aries, shall be a master of speech and shall be like the Sun god himself in refulgence.

45b-46. After having completed the pilgrimage of Prayaga and other holy centres full of sacred waters, the pilgrim should assiduously take a holy bath in the following Tirthas Viz: Varuna, Yoga, Mahavaruna and Mahamahavaruna. He shall take holy bath in accordance with injunctions.

## \|\| 2.66.47-48 \|\|

*sampūjya brāhmaṇān bhaktyā sa labhedbrahmaṇaḥ padam \|*  
*saṅkrāntau vāpyamāyāṃ vā vyatīpāte yugādike \|\| 47 \|\|*

*puṇye'hani tathānyadvai yatiṃñciddānamācaret \|*  
*tattu koṭiguṇaṃ bhūyātsatyametanmayoditam \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. By worshipping the Brahmanas devotedly, he shall attain the region of Brahma. If he makes any charitable gift during the transit of the Sun, or on the new-moon day, or when the Vyatlpata period of time occurs, or on the anniversary day of the beginning of Yugas, or during other sacred days, it shall have a crore times more benefit. It is the truth that has been declared by me.

## \|\| 2.66.49 \|\|

*gaṅgādvāraṃ smaredyo vai dūrasaṃstho'pi mānavaḥ \|*  
*sadgatiṃ sa samāpnoti smarannante yathā harim \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. He who remembers Gangadvara even when he is far away, attains good goal like the person who remembers Hari in the end.

## \|\| 2.66.50 \|\|

*yaṃ yaṃ devi haridvāre pūjayetprayato naraḥ \|*  
*sa sa devaḥ suprasannaḥ pūrayettanmanorathān \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. That deity whom pure man worships at Haridvara shall become delighted and fulfil his desires.

## \|\| 2.66.51 \|\|

*etadeva tapaḥsthānametadeva japasthalam \|*  
*etadeva hutasthānaṃ yatra gaṅgā bhuvaṃ gatā \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. The place where Ganga entered the Earth is itself a place of penance, it is a place of Japa and the place of Ноmа.

## \|\| 2.66.52 \|\|

*yastatra niyato martyo gaṅgānāmasahasrakam \|*  
*trikālaṃ paṭhati snātvā so'kṣayāṃ santatiṃ labhet \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. The man who observes restraints and after taking a holy dip, repeats the thousand epithets of the Ganga three times per day, shall attain a line of progeny that gets never extinct.

## \|\| 2.66.53 \|\|

*gaṅgādvāre purāṇaṃ tu śṛṇuyādyaśca bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*niyamena mahābhāge sa yāti padamavyayam \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. О blessed lady, he who devoutly listens to the Purana at Gangadvara with due observance of restraints, attains the unchanging region (i.e. the permanent abode of the Supreme Lord).

## \|\| 2.66.54 \|\|

*haridvārasya māhātmyaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti narottamaḥ \|*  
*paṭhedvā bhaktisaṃyuktaḥ so'pi snānaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. The excellent man who listens to or reads the greatness of Haridvara with great devotion shall acquire the benefit of the holy bath there.

## \|\| 2.66.55-56 \|\|

*devi tiṣṭhati yadgehe māhātmyaṃ likhitantvidam \|*  
*tadgṛhe sarpacaurāgnigraharājabhayaṃ nahi \|\| 55 \|\|*

*varddhaṃte sampadaḥ sarvā viṣṇudevaprasādataḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. О gentle lady, there is no cause of fear from serpents, thieves, fires, evil planets or tyrannous kings. All the riches increase, thanks to the grace of lord Visnu.

## Chapter 67. The Greatness of Badarikashrama

## \|\| 2.67.1 \|\|

*mohinyuvāca- aho dvijavarākhyātaṃ gaṅgādvārasamudbhavam \|*  
*māhātmyamadhunā brūhi badaryāḥ pāpanāśanam \|\| 1 \|\|*

Mohinisaid:

1\. О excellent Brahmana, the greatness of Gangadvara has been recounted. Now narrate the greatness of Badari that is destructive of sins. Vasu said:

## \|\| 2.67.2 \|\|

*vasuruvāca- śṛṇu bhadre pravakṣyāmi māhātmyaṃ badarībhavam \|*  
*yacchrutvā mucyate janturjanmasaṃsārabandhanāt \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Listen, О gentle lady, I shall describe in detail to you the greatness of Badari. On hearing this, a creature (the living soul) is liberated from the bondage of birth and samsara.

## \|\| 2.67.3 \|\|

*badaryākhyaṃ hareḥ kṣetraṃ sarvapātakanāśanam \|*  
*muktidaṃ bhavabhītānāṃ kalidoṣaharaṃ nṛṇām \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The holy centre of Hari named Badari is destructive of all sins. It bestows liberation on those men who are afraid of worldly existence and it dispels the defects of Kali Yuga.

## \|\| 2.67.4-5 \|\|

*yatra nārāyaṇo devo naraśca bhagavānṛṣiḥ \|*  
*dharmānmūrtyāṃ labdhajanī yayaturgandhamādanam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*yatrāsti badarīvṛkṣo bahugandhaphalānvitaḥ \|*  
*tasminsthāne mahābhāga ākalpādāsthitau tapaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. There, lord Narayana and the holy sage Nara who were born of Murti and Dharma, went to Gandhamadana mountain where there is a Badari tree endowed with many fruits of sweet fragrance. О blessed lady, on that spot, they have been engaged in penance ever since the beginning of Kalpa.

## \|\| 2.67.6 \|\|

*nāradādyairmunivaraiḥ kalāpagrāmavāsibhiḥ \|*  
*siddhasaṅghaiḥ parivṛtau lokānāṃ sthitaye sthitau \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. They are surrounded by Nara da and other excellent sages staying in the village of Kalapa1 and also by the groups of Siddhas. They stationed themselves there for the sustenance of the world.

## \|\| 2.67.7 \|\|

*yatrāgnitīrthaṃ vikhyātaṃ vartate sarvasiddhidam \|*  
*mahāpātakinastatra snātvā śudhyanti pātakāt \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. There is a well known holy centre named Agnitlrtha2 (Hot water spring). It yields all Siddhis. Even those who are defiled by great sins become purified by taking holy dip therein.

## \|\| 2.67.8 \|\|

*durvarṇaṃ hāṭakaṃ yadvadagnau dhmātaṃ viśuddhyti \|*  
*tathāgnitīrthaṃ āplutya dehī pāpairvimucyate \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Just as the discoloured gold becomes pure when heated in the fire, so also the embodied soul becomes liberated from sins by plunging into the Agnitlrtha. The editor of the text of N. P. introduces this chapter with the remark: Henceforth the greatness of Badari is begun. Mod. Badrinath in Garhwal, (Uttar Pradesh)

## \|\| 2.67.9 \|\|

*cāndrā yaṇasahasraistu kṛcchraiḥ koṭibhireva ca \|*  
*yatphalaṃ labhate martyastatsnānādvahnitīrthataḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. By taking a holy dip in the Agnitlrtha a man obtains that benefit which is obtained from thousands of GaNarayanas and crores of Krcchras.

## \|\| 2.67.10 \|\|

*śilāḥ pañcāpi tattīrthe santi yanmadhyataḥ sthitam \|*  
*agnitīrthaṃ vidhisute darśanāttadaghāpaham \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. There are five rocky slabs.1 О daughter of Brahma, Agnitlrtha is situated in their midst. By its mere sight, it dispels sins.

## \|\| 2.67.11 \|\|

*nārado yatra bhagavāṃstapastepe sudāruṇam \|*  
*sā śilā nāradī nāma darśanādeva muktidā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. That rocky slab is called Narad! 6ila where the holy sage Narada performed a terrible penance. By its very sight, it yields liberation.

## \|\| 2.67.12-15 \|\|

*nityadā yatra sānnidhyaṃ harerasti sulocane \|*  
*tatra nāradakuṇḍaṃ ca yatra snāto naraḥ śuciḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*bhuktiṃ muktiṃ harerbhaktiṃ yadyadvāñchettu tallabhet \|*  
*etasyāṃ yo naro bhaktyā snānaṃ dānaṃ surārcanam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*homaṃ japaṃ tathānyadvā yatkaroti tadakṣayam \|*  
*vainateyaśilā cānyā tasmin kṣetre śubhāvahā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*yatra taptaṃ tapastīvaṃ garuḍena mahātmanā \|*  
*triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi haridarśanakāmyayā \|\| 15 \|\|*

12-14a. О lady of beautiful eyes, there is the perpetual presence of Hari, there. The Naradakunda (holy pool of Narada) is also there. The man who takes a holy bath there becomes pure. He obtains whatever he desires, such as worldly pleasures, salvation and devotion to Hari. Whatever a man performs here with devotion such as holy bath, charitable gift, worship of Devas, Ноmа, Japa or other rites are imperishable.

14b-15. There is another splendid rocky slab in that holy centre. It is called Vainateyasila. It was here that a very severe penance was performed у Garuda of noble soul, for thirty thousand years with the desire for seeing Hari.

## \|\| 2.67.16 \|\|

*tataḥ prasanno bhagavāndadau tasmai varaṃ śubhe \|*  
*ajeyo daityasaṅghānāṃ nāgānāṃ ca vibhīṣaṇaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. О auspicious lady, the delighted lord granted him the boon and said, “O dear one, be unconquerable to the host of Daityas, and a terror unto the serpents.

## \|\| 2.67.17-20 \|\|

*vāhanaṃ bhava me vatsa prasanno'ha tavopari \|*  
*tvannāmneyaṃśilākhyātiṃ gamiṣyati mahītale \|\| 17 \|\|*

*darśanātpuṇyadā nṝṇāṃ yatra taptaṃ tvayā tapaḥ \|*  
*atra mukhyatame gaṅgā tīrthe matprītikāmyayā \|\| 18 \|\|*

*āvirastu mahābhāga puṇyadā snānakāriṇām \|*  
*pañcagaṅge tu yaḥ snātvā devādīṃstarpayiṣyati \|\| 19 \|\|*

*na tasya punarāvṛttirbrahmalokātsanātanāt \|*  
*evaṃ datvā varaṃ viṣṇurbabhūvāntarhitastadā \|\| 20 \|\|*

17-18a. Become my vehicle. I am delighted with you. This rocky slab where the penance has been performed by you will become famous over the Earth by your name. By its mere sight it shall be the bestower of merit on men.

18b-19a. In this most important Tirtha on Ganga, with a desire to attain my love (you have performed penance). О blessed one, may it manifest itself as the granter of merits to those who take their holy dip here.

19b-20. He who takes a holy bath in the Pancaganga and performs the rites of Tarpana to the Devas and others, does not return from the eternal world of Brahma.” After granting this boon, Visnu vanished then.

## \|\| 2.67.21-22 \|\|

*garuḍo'pyājñayā viṣṇorvāhanatvamupāgataḥ \|*  
*tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ jātaṃ pāpavināśanam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*puṇyadaṃ vai smareccāpi vainateyagatipradam \|*  
*athānyā tu śilā tatra vārāhīti śubhāvahā \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22a. At the behest of Visnu, Garu^a attained the state of being the vehicle of Visnu. Thereafter, that holy centre has become destructive of sins.

22b. It is the bestower of merits on being remembered. It yields the goal ofVainateya. There is another auspicious slab of a rock. It is known as Varahl (Sila).

## \|\| 2.67.23 \|\|

*yatroddhṛtya mahīṃ devo hiraṇyākṣaṃ nipātya ca \|*  
*śilārūpeṇa cākramya sthitaḥ pāpavināśanaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. It was here that the lord (in the form of a divine Boar) lifted up the Earth after striking down Hiran- yaksa and occupied this position in the form of a rocky slab. He is the destroyer of sins.

## \|\| 2.67.24 \|\|

*tatra yo manujo gatvā gaṅgāmbhasyamale plutaḥ \|*  
*pūjayettāṃ śilāṃ bhaktyā sa na durgatimāpnuyāt \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. The man who goes there, plunges into the pure waters of Ganga and worships that rocky slab with devotion does not attain misfortunes or hell.

## \|\| 2.67.25 \|\|

*athānyā nārasiṃhākhyā śilā tatra sureśvarī \|*  
*hiraṇkaśipuṃ hatvā sthito yatra babhūva ha \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. There is another rocky slab called Narasimha sila. The lord of Devas killed Hiranyakasipu and rested there on the rock.

## \|\| 2.67.26 \|\|

*tataḥ surarṣibhiḥ sarvaiḥ krodhastasya nivāritaḥ \|*  
*prārthitaśca viśālāyāṃ sthātuṃ tatra sadaiva hi \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Later on, his anger was assuaged by the celestial sages. He was requested to stay perpetually there at Visala (i.e. Badarikasrama).

## \|\| 2.67.27 \|\|

*caturbhujastathā tatra śilārūpamupāgataḥ \|*  
*jalakrīḍāparo nityaṃ vartate toyamadhyagaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The four-armed deity accordingly assumed the rocky form. Engaged in aquatic sports, he permanently stays in the middle of water.

## \|\| 2.67.28 \|\|

*tatra yaḥ snāti manujo nṛhareḥ pūjayecchilām \|*  
*sa labhedvaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma punarāvṛttidurlabham \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The man who takes a holy bath there and worships the rocky slab, attains the abode of Visnu from which rarely does any one return to Samsara.

## \|\| 2.67.29 \|\|

*pañcamīṃ tu śilāṃ devi vahnikuṇḍataṭasthitām \|*  
*naranārāyaṇākhyāṃ ca vakṣyāmi śṛṇu sāmpratam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. О gentle lady, know the fifth rocky slab situated on the banks of Vahnikupa (i.e. the hot water spring thereof). It is called Naranarayana Sila. I shall explain about it now, listen.

## \|\| 2.67.30 \|\|

*kṛte yuge tu sarveṣāṃ naranārāyaṇo hariḥ \|*  
*pratyakṣaṃ vasate tatra bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. In the age called Krtayuga, Hari in the form of Naranarayana stayed there directly visible to all as the bestower of worldly pleasures and liberation.

## \|\| 2.67.31 \|\|

*tretāyāṃ munibhirdevairyogibhirdṛśyate śubhe \|*  
*nānyaiḥ samāsthito yogaṃ lokasthitividhāyakaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. О auspicious lady, in the age named Tretayuga, he is seen by the sages, Devas and Yogins and not by others. He himself adopts the Yogic posture and remains as the sustainer of worlds.

## \|\| 2.67.32 \|\|

*dvāpare samanuprāpte jñānayogena dṛśyate \|*  
*nānyopāyena kenāpi tiṣye darśanatāṃ gataḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. When Dvapara Age arrives he is seen by the path of knowledge and not by any other means. In the Tiaya (i.e. Kali age) he becomes (completely) invisible.

## \|\| 2.67.33 \|\|

*tato brahmādayo devā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ \|*  
*stutvā vāgbhirvicitrābhirdevaṃ prāsādayanharim \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Therefore, Brahma and other Devas, sages and ascetics, eulogised lord Hari with various kinds of praise and propitiated him.

## \|\| 2.67.34 \|\|

*tato'śarīriṇī vāṇī prāha tānvidhipūrvakān \|*  
*kalau na darśanaṃ yāmi sarvadharmavivarjite \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Thereupon, an incorporeal voice (from heaven) addressed Brahma and others: CT shall not be visible in the Kali age that is devoid of virtue and piety.

## \|\| 2.67.35 \|\|

*yadi vo darśane śraddhā maṇḍapasya sureśvarāḥ \|*  
*gṛhīdhvaṃ māmakīṃ mūrtiṃ śailadyaṃ nāradakuṇḍagām \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. О leading Devas, if you have faith in viewing the Man^apa (ceremonial hall) take up my image of rock situated in the Narada Kunda”.

## \|\| 2.67.36-37 \|\|

*tatastāṃ giramākarṇya brahmādyā hṛṣṭamānasāḥ \|*  
*niṣkāsya śailadyaṃ tāṃ divyāṃ mūrtiṃ nāradakuṃḍagām \|\| 36 \|\|*

*sthāpayāmāsurabhyarcya svaṃ svaṃ dhāma yayustataḥ \|*  
*vaiśākhe māsi te devā gacchanti nijamandiram \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. On hearing those words, Brahma and others became delighted at heart. They took out that divine rock image situated in the Naradakunda and installed it. After worshipping it, they went to their respective abodes. It is in the month of Vaisakha that Devas go back to their abodes.

## \|\| 2.67.38-39 \|\|

*kārtike tu samāgatya punararcāṃ caranti ca \|*  
*tato vaiśākhamārabhya mānavā himasaṃkṣayāt \|\| 38 \|\|*

*labhante darśanaṃ puṇyāḥ pāpakarmavivarjitāḥ \|*  
*ṣaṇmāsaṃ daivataiḥ pūjyā ṣaṇmāsaṃ mānavaistathā \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. They come back again in the month of Karttika and perform the rite of worship. At the beginningof Vaisakha, due to the melting away of snow, the meritorious human beings devoid of sinful actions are able to see the deity. The deity is to be worshipped for six months by Devas and for six months by human beings.

## \|\| 2.67.40-41 \|\|

*evaṃ vyavasthayā mūrtistatprabhṛtyāvirāsa sā \|*  
*yaḥ śailadyaṃ pratimāṃ viṣṇoḥ pūjayedbhaktibhāvataḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*naivedyaṃ bhakṣayeccāpi sa muktiṃ labhate dhruvam \|*  
*etāḥ pañca śilāḥ puṇyā viśālāyāṃ vyavasthitāḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41 A. It is under these conditions that the image manifested itself from that time onwards. He who devoutly worships the image of Visnu and partakes of Naivedya, certainly attains liberation.

## \|\| 2.67.41-42 \|\|

*naivedyaṃ bhakṣayeccāpi sa muktiṃ labhate dhruvam \|*  
*etāḥ pañca śilāḥ puṇyā viśālāyāṃ vyavasthitāḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*āsāṃ madhye tu naivedyaṃ devānāṃ durlabhaṃ hareḥ \|*  
*kiṃ punarmānuṣādīnāṃ bhakṣitaṃ mokṣasādhanam \|\| 42 \|\|*

41b-42. These five holy rocky slabs are thus situated in ViSala (Badarika). The Naivedya offered to Hari in these places is inaccessible even to Devas. What then to the human beings? If it is partaken of, it is a means to salvation.

## \|\| 2.67.43 \|\|

*badaryā viṣṇunaivedyaṃ sikthamātraṃ ca bhakṣitam \|*  
*śodhayeddehagaṃ pāpaṃ dīptāgniriva kāñcanam \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Even if the boiled rice offered as Naivedya to Visshu at Badari is partaken of, it shall purify sins in the body like the blazing fire that purifies the dross in gold.

## \|\| 2.67.44 \|\|

*kapālamocanaṃ hyetattīrthaṃ pāpaviśodhanam \|*  
*yanmadhye tu śilāḥ pañca santi pāpavimocikāḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Thus this is the holy spot of Kapalamocana1 which dispels sins. In its midst too, there are five rocky slabs that dispel sins.

## \|\| 2.67.45 \|\|

*athāparaṃ mahattīrthamatraiva śṛṇu mohini \|*  
*yatra snāto naro bhaktyā vedānāṃ pārago bhavet \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. О Mohinl, listen to another great holy pool here itself. By taking a holy dip here with devotion, the man becomes master of the Vedas.

## \|\| 2.67.46 \|\|

*suptasya brahmaṇo vaktrānnirgatānasuro'harat \|*  
*vedānhayaśirā nāma devādīnāṃ bhayāvahaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The Asura named HayaSiras, a terror to Devas and others, snatched away Vedas coming out of the mouth of god Brahma.

## \|\| 2.67.47 \|\|

*tatastu brahmaṇā viṣṇuḥ prārthitaḥ prakaṭo'bhavat \|*  
*matsyarūpeṇa taṃ hatvā vedānpratyarpayadvidheḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Thereupon, prayed to by Brahma, Visnu manifested himself in the form of a divine Fish. The lord killed the demon and handed over the Vedas to Brahma.

## \|\| 2.67.48 \|\|

*tacca tīrthaṃ mahatpuṇyaṃ sarvavidyāprakāśakam \|*  
*taimiṅgilaṃ mahābhāge darśanātpāpanāśanam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. That Tirtha is highly meritorious. It illuminates all lores. О blessed lady, it is called Taimingila Tirtha. By its mere vision it is destructive of sins.

## \|\| 2.67.49-50 \|\|

*hayagrīvasvarūpeṇa bhagavānviṣṇuravyayaḥ \|*  
*punaśca hatvā mattau dvāvasurau madhukaiṭabhau \|\| 49 \|\|*

*vedāpahāriṇau bhūyo vedānvai brahmaṇe hyadāt \|*  
*tattīrthaṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ snānamātreṇa vaidhasi \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. Once again, the unchanging lord Visnu in the form of the horse-necked being, killed the arrogant Asuras, Madhu and Kaitabha who stole the Vedas from god Brahma. He handed the Vedas back to Brahma. О daughter of Brahma that Tirtha dispels sins by a mere holy dip.

## \|\| 2.67.51 \|\|

*mātsye cāpi hayagrīve vedāste dra varūpiṇaḥ \|*  
*vartaṃte sarvadā bhadre tajjalaṃ pāpanāśanam \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. In both Tirthas, Matsya (i.e. Taimingalla)2 as well as Hayagriva, the Vedas exist in the liquid form of water perpetually. О gentle lady, that water is destructive of sins.

## \|\| 2.67.52 \|\|

*tīrthamindra padaṃ tatra vikhyātaṃ vahnikoṇagam \|*  
*tatra snātvā naro devi padamaindra mavāpnuyāt \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. О gentle lady, there is a famous holy centre Indra- pada in the south-east corner. By taking a holy dip therein, a man shall attain the region of Indra (or Indra-hood).

## \|\| 2.67.53 \|\|

*mānasodbhedakaṃ cānyattatra tīrthaṃ manoramam \|*  
*bhinatti hṛdayagranthiṃ chinattyakhilasaṃśayam \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. There is another charming Tirtha there named Manasodbhedaka3 (resolver of the mind.) It splits the knots in the hearts; it dispels all doubts.

## \|\| 2.67.54-55 \|\|

*haratyaṃhaśca sakalaṃ mānasodbhedakaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*kāmākāmābhidhaṃ cānyattīrthaṃ tatra varānane \|\| 54 \|\|*

*kāmapradaṃ kāmavatāmakāmānāṃ tu mokṣadam \|*  
*tataḥ paścimato bhadre vasudhāreti tīrthakam \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. It despels all sins also. Hence, it is called Manasodbhedaka. О fair-faced lady, there is another Tirtha there called Kamakama. It bestows the desired objects on those who have a desire for it and confers salvation on those who have no desires. О gentle lady, to the west of it is the Tirtha called Vasudhara.1

## \|\| 2.67.56-57 \|\|

*tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā labhate vāñchitaṃ phalam \|*  
*atra puṇyavato yānti dṛśyate jalamadhyagam \|\| 56 \|\|*

*yaddṛṣṭvā na punarjanturgarbhavāsaṃ prapadyate \|*  
*tato nairṛtidigbhāge pañca dhārāḥ patantyadhaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

56-57. By taking a holy bath therein with devotion, a man obtains the desired benefit (Defective Text). The meritorious persons see the deity, stationed in the middle of waters On seeing it, the creature does not have the compulsion to stay in the womb (i.e. is not reborn). Thereafter, in the south-western direction five currents flow down.

## \|\| 2.67.58 \|\|

*prabhāsapuṣkaragayānaimiṣāraṇyasaṃjñakāḥ \|*  
*tāsu snātvā pṛthaṅmartyastattattīrthaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Their names are Prabhasa, Puskara, Gaya, Naimisa- ranya and Kurukshetra. By taking a holy dip in every one of them separately, the man obtains the benefit of respective Tirtha.

## \|\| 2.67.59-63 \|\|

*tato'nyadvimalaṃ tīrthaṃ somakuṇḍāparāhvayam \|*  
*yatra taptvā tapastīvraṃ somaḥ kheṭādyadhīśvaraḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

*tatra snātvā naro bhadre gatadoṣaḥ prajāyate \|*  
*tatrānyaddvādaśādityaṃ tīrthaṃ pāpaharaṃ param \|\| 60 \|\|*

*snātvā yatra naro bhūtvā tejasā bhāskaropamaḥ \|*  
*catuḥsroto'paraṃ tatra tīrthaṃ tatrāpluto naraḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

*dharmārthakāmamokṣāṃśca labhate yaṃ yamicchati \|*  
*atha saptapadaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ tatra manoharam \|\| 62 \|\|*

*darśanādyasya tīrthasya pātakāni mahāntyapi \|*  
*naśyanti niyataṃ tasya kiṃ punaḥ snānataḥ sati \|\| 63 \|\|*

59-60a. There is another pure Tirtha, the second name of which is Somakumja, By performing severe penance here, Soma (the moon god) became the over-lord of planets and luminaries that move about in the firmament). О gentle lady, by taking a holy bath, a man becomes free from defects and sins.

60b-61a. There is another Tirtha there called Dvadasa- ditya, (the sacred pool of the twelve sun-gods). It is excessively destructive of sins. By taking a holy dip in it, a man becomes comparable to the sun by means of his refulgence.

61b-62a. There is another Tirtha there called Catuh- srotas. A man who plunges into it attains whatever he wishes from among the Purusarthas viz. virtue, wealth love and liberation.

62b-63. There is another charming Tirtha there named Saptapada. By the very sight of this Tirtha, even great sins definitely perish. О chaste lady, what then if he takes a holy bath therein?

## \|\| 2.67.64 \|\|

*triṣu lokeṣu kuṇḍasya brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ \|*  
*āsthitāstatra maraṇānnaraḥ satyapadaṃ labhet \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. In the sacred pools called Trilokakundas, Brahma. Visnu and MaheSvara are stationed. By dying therein the man attains the region called Satya-loka.

## \|\| 2.67.65-66 \|\|

*naranārāyaṇāvāse tīrthamastyaparaṃ śubhe \|*  
*urvaśīkuṇḍanāmātra snāto rūpamanoharaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

*nārāyaṇapriyo'tyarthaṃ bhavedviśvavaśaṅkaraḥ \|*  
*tato dakṣiṇadigbhāge tīrthamastrābhidhaṃ param \|\| 66 \|\|*

65-66a. О auspicious lady, there is another Tirtha in the residence of Naranarayana. Its name is Urvaslkunda.1 One who takes bath here becomes endowed with handsome features. He shall be a great favourite of Narayana. He will captivate the universe.

66b. Then to the south of it there is the great Tirtha called Astra.

## \|\| 2.67.67-68 \|\|

*naranārāyaṇau yatra śastraṃ nyasya tapaḥsthitau \|*  
*āyudhāni tu divyāni śaṅkhacakrādikāni ca \|\| 67 \|\|*

*mūrtimanti mahābhāge dṛśyante kṛtibhiryataḥ \|*  
*tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā na śatrorbhayamāpnuyāt \|\| 68 \|\|*

67-68. It was here that Nara and Narayana deposited their weapons and engaged themselves in the penance. (It is true) О highly blessed lady, since the divine weapons (such as) the conch, discus etc are seen in embodied form by meritorious persons. A man who takes a holy bath there with devotion shall never be afraid of an enemy.

## \|\| 2.67.69 \|\|

*merutīrthaṃ ca tatrāsti yatra dṛṣṭvā dhanurddharam \|*  
*snātvā ca labhate so'pi śubhe sarvānmanorathān \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. There is the holy centre called Merutirtha there. By visiting the bowbearing deity after the holy dip, О auspicious lady, the devotee realises all desires.

## \|\| 2.67.70-71 \|\|

*lokapālāhvayaṃ nāma tatrānyattīrthamuttamam \|*  
*lokapālaistapastaptaṃ yatra tatrāpluto naraḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

*sarvatīrthāplutiphalaṃ labhate devi mānavaḥ \|*  
*daṇḍenāhatya hariṇā yatastīrthaṃ vinirmitam \|\| 71 \|\|*

70-71 A. There is another Tirtha named after the guardians of quarters. It is an excellent holy centre. It is here that the guardians of quarters performed penance. О gentle lady, the man who performs ablution into the Tirtha attains the benefit of plunging into all Tirthas.

## \|\| 2.67.71-75 \|\|

*sarvatīrthāplutiphalaṃ labhate devi mānavaḥ \|*  
*daṇḍenāhatya hariṇā yatastīrthaṃ vinirmitam \|\| 71 \|\|*

*daṇḍapuṣkariṇītyetattato lokaprasaukhyadam \|*  
*bhāgīrathī yatra yogaṃ prāptā hyalakanandayā \|\| 72 \|\|*

*tattīrthaṃ sarvataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ puṇye badarikāśrame \|*  
*tatra snātvā pitṝndevānsantarpyābhyarcya bhaktitaḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

*labhate vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ \|*  
*saṅgamāddakṣiṇe bhāge dharmakṣetraṃ śubhānane \|\| 74 \|\|*

*tatkṣetraṃ pāvanaṃ manye sarvatīrthottamottamam \|*  
*tatra snātvā naro bhadre sādhyasannidhibhāgbhavet \|\| 75 \|\|*

71b-72a. Since it was by striking with his staff that the Tirtha was created by Hari, it has come to be called Dandapus- karini. It yields happiness to the protectors of the worlds (i.e. the guardians of quarters.)

72b-74a. That Tirtha where the Bhagirathi is joined by Alakananda is the most excellent of all holy spots in the sacred Badarikashrama. By takihg a holy bath and devoutly performing the Tarpana rites to the Pitrs and Devas and by worshipping them with devotion, the devotee attains the abod of Visnu. He is bowed to by all Devas.

74b-75. О splendid-faced lady, there is Dharmaksetra(the sacred place called Dharma) to the south of the confluence. I consider that holy centre as the most sacred. It is the most excellent of all TIrthas. О gentle lady, by taking a holy bath there, the man becomes one who has reached the vicinity of that which should be accomplished (viz Moksa).

## \|\| 2.67.76 \|\|

*urvaśīsaṅgamaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ nṛṇām \|*  
*karmoddharāhvayaṃ cānyaddharibhaktyekasādhanam \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. The Tlrtha called UrvaSisangama, is the dispeller of all sins of man. There is another holy centre called Karmod- dhara. It is the sole means to attain Hari’s devotion.

## \|\| 2.67.77 \|\|

*brahmāvartāhvayaṃ tīrthaṃ brahmalokaikakāraṇam \|*  
*gaṅgāśritāni caitāni tīrthāni kathitāni te \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. The Tirtha called Brahmavarta is the sole cause of attaining the world of Brahma. These Tirthas based on the Ganga have been recounted to you.

## \|\| 2.67.78-80 \|\|

*brahmāpi kārtsnyato vaktuṃ tatrasthāni na vai prabhuḥ \|*  
*ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ śrāvayedvā samāhitaḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

*sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ so'pi viṣṇupadaṃ labhet \|*  
*māsamātraṃ naro bhaktyā yo'tra tiṣṭheddhṛtavrataḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*sa sākṣādeva paśyettu naranārāyaṇaṃ harim \|*  
*yatraitallikhitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ badarībhavam \|\| 80 \|\|*

78-79a. Even god Brahma is not competent to describe entirely the Tirthas stationed there. He who listens to this and he who narrates this with concentration shall be liberated from all sins. He shall attain the world of Visnu.

79b-80a. The man who stays here for a month and observes holy rites with devotion, will visualize lord Hari, Nara and Narayana directly.

80b. Premature death, mental anguish, physical ailments and fear of serpents shall not befall the abode, О gentle lady, where the greatness of Badarikasrama has been written and preserved. Thanks to Hari’s favour, happiness always abides there. The riches flourish, thanks to the favour of Visnu.

## Chapter 68. The Legend of Kdmodd

## \|\| 2.68.1 \|\|

*mohinyuvāca- kāmodāyāstu māhātmtyaṃ brūhi me dvijasattama \|*  
*yacchrutvāhaṃ tava mukhātprasannā syāṃ kṛtārthavat \|\| 1 \|\|*

Mohini said:

1\. О excellent Brahmana, recount to me the greatness of Kamoda.1 On hearing it directly from your mouth, I shall feel contented and delighted. Vasu said:

## \|\| 2.68.2 \|\|

*vasuruvāca- śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi kāmodākhyānakaṃ śubham \|*  
*yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. О gentle lady, listen, I shall narrate to you the auspicious details of Kamoda. О hearing it, one is released from all sins. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 2.68.3 \|\|

*kāmodākhyaṃ puraṃ devi gaṅgātīre vyavasthitam \|*  
*kāmodā yatra vartaṃte sārddhaṃ devairharipriyāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. О gentle lady, the city Kamoda is situated on the banks of Ganga. It is here that Kamoda, the beloved of Hari, resides along with Devas.

## \|\| 2.68.4 \|\|

*yadā surāsurairdaivi mathitaḥ kṣīrasāgaraḥ \|*  
*kāmodā sā tadotpannā kanyāratnacatuṣṭaye \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. О gentle lady, it was when the milk-ocean was churned that Kamoda was born among the four jewels of Virgins.

## \|\| 2.68.5 \|\|

*kanyā ramākhyā prathamā dvitīyā vāruṇī smṛtā \|*  
*kāmodākhyā tṛtīyā tu caturthī tu varābhidhā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The virgin Rama was the first and the second was Varum. The girl Kamoda was the third; the fourth was Vara. The printed Text of the N. P. has this following introductory remark. Thus the greatness of Badarikshshrama has been recounted. Henceforth, the greatness of Kamoda is being recounted.

## \|\| 2.68.6 \|\|

*tatra kanyātrayaṃ prāptaṃ viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā \|*  
*vāruṇī tvasurairnītā viṣṇudevājñayā sati \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Among them three girls were obtained by the powerful Visnu. О chaste lady, Varum was taken away by the Asuras at the behest of Lord Visnu.

## \|\| 2.68.7 \|\|
