## \|\| 2.81.7 \|\|

*bhūyo mamājñayā vatsa tvayā sā jīvitādhunā \|*  
*nītā kṛtārthatāṃ tasmātko'nyastvatto'dhikaḥ kṛtī \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Again, at my behest О dear one, she had been resuscitated to life by you now. She had been thus made contented and blessed. Hence who else can be more virtuous and fortunate than you?

## \|\| 2.81.8 \|\|

*yattvayā mahyamākhyātaṃ mohinīvṛttamuttamam \|*  
*prasannastena dāsyāmi brūhi tubhyaṃ varaṃ dvija \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The excellent news about MohinI has been conveyed to me by you. Delighted thereby, О Brahmana, I shall grant you a boon. Tell me what you wish to have.”

## \|\| 2.81.9 \|\|

*ityuktaḥ sa dvijastena brahmaṇā lokabhāvinā \|*  
*praṇamya vavre sa varaṃ vṛndāraṇyanivāsanam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. On being thus asked by Brahma, the creator of the worlds, that Brahmana bowed to him and chose as boon (the facility) to reside in Vrndavana.

## \|\| 2.81.10 \|\|

*tacchrutvā jagatāṃ dhātā smayamānacaturmukhaḥ \|*  
*prāha prapannārtiharastathāstviti munīśvarāḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. О leading sages, on hearing these words, the creator of the worlds, the remover of the anguish of those who seek refuge in him, spoke with smiles in all his four faces, ‘so be it’.

## \|\| 2.81.11 \|\|

*sa praṇamya vidhātāraṃ vasurthṛṣṭamanāstataḥ \|*  
*vṛndāvanamupāvrajya tapaścakre samāhitaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Delighted in his mind, Vasu bowed down to Brahma, came to Vrndavana and performed penance with concentration and mental purity.

## \|\| 2.81.12 \|\|

*tapatastasya tu vasoḥ saṃvatsaragaṇā dvijāḥ \|*  
*vyatīyuḥ pañcasāhasrāstatastuṣṭo hariḥ svayam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. О Brahmanas, even as Vasu performed the penance, many years — More than five thousand years passed by. Thereafter Hari was delighted with it.

## \|\| 2.81.13 \|\|

*gopaiḥ priyasakhairdvitrairyuto'bhyāha dvijottamam \|*  
*brūhi kiṃ vṛṇuṣe vipra tuṣṭo'ha tapasā tava \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Accompanied by two or three of his most beloved cowherd friends he appeared before the excellent Brahmana and said — ’’Tell me, О Brahmana, what do you wish to choose? I am satisfied with your penance.

## \|\| 2.81.14 \|\|

*tataḥ sa vasurutthāya aṣṭāṅgāliṅgitāvaniḥ \|*  
*prāha vṛndāvane deva vāsamicchāmi sarvadā \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Thereafter, Vasu (prostrated himself before him) touching the ground with eight of his limbs. He got up subsequently and said — “O lord, I wish to stay in Vrndavana for ever’.

## \|\| 2.81.15 \|\|

*atha viṣṇurdvijaśreṣṭhā varaṃ tadvāñchitaṃ dadau \|*  
*tenābhivandito bhūyo hyantardhānamupāgataḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. О excellent Brahmanas, Visnu granted him his desire. Saluted by him again, the lord vanished.

## \|\| 2.81.16 \|\|

*sa dvijastatprabhṛtyevaṃ svecchārūpadharaḥ sthitaḥ \|*  
*cintayansatataṃ devaṃ vṛndāraṇyakutūhalam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Ever since that day the Brahmana stayed there assuming the forms he pleased. He pondered perpetually over the lord who was enthusiastic over the forest Vrndavana.

## \|\| 2.81.17 \|\|

*kadācidyamunātīre niviṣṭastaṃ vicintayan \|*  
*dadarśa nāradaṃ prāptaṃ vṛndāraṇyaṃ vidheḥ sutam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. On one occasion, as he was seated on the banks of Yamuna, thinking about him (the lord), he saw Narada. the son of Brahma, who came to Vrndavana.

## \|\| 2.81.18 \|\|

*sa taṃ dṛṣṭvā namaskṛtya paramaṃ gurumātmanaḥ \|*  
*prapaccha vividhāndharmān bhagavadbhaktivarddhanān \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. On seeing his grand preceptor (preceptor's preceptor) he bowed to him and asked him about the holy rites that were conducive to the increase of devotion to the lord.

## \|\| 2.81.19 \|\|

*sa tenaivaṃ susampṛṣṭo nārado'dhyātmadarśanaḥ \|*  
*tasmai provāca nikhilaṃ bhaviṣyaccaritaṃ hareḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. On being earnestly asked by him thus, Narada who had visualized the Self recounted to him the entire future deeds of Hari.

## \|\| 2.81.20 \|\|

*ekadāhaṃ gato vipra devaṃ kailāsavāsinam \|*  
*dra ṣṭuṃ praṣṭuṃ bhaviṣyacca vṛndāvanarahasyakam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. “O Brahmana, once I went to lord (Siva) residing on the Kailasa mountain; to visit him as well as to ask him about the future secret of Vrndavana.

## \|\| 2.81.21 \|\|

*tataḥ praṇamya deveśaṃ tataḥ siddhaiḥ samāvṛtam \|*  
*maheśaṃ svamahivyāptasarvabrahmāṇḍagolakam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Afterwards I bowed down to the lord of Devas surrounded by Siddhas. I bowed down to MaheSa whose greatness pervaded the entire sphere of the cosmic egg.

## \|\| 2.81.12-23 \|\|

*tapatastasya tu vasoḥ saṃvatsaragaṇā dvijāḥ \|*  
*vyatīyuḥ pañcasāhasrāstatastuṣṭo hariḥ svayam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*gopaiḥ priyasakhairdvitrairyuto'bhyāha dvijottamam \|*  
*brūhi kiṃ vṛṇuṣe vipra tuṣṭo'ha tapasā tava \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tataḥ sa vasurutthāya aṣṭāṅgāliṅgitāvaniḥ \|*  
*prāha vṛndāvane deva vāsamicchāmi sarvadā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*atha viṣṇurdvijaśreṣṭhā varaṃ tadvāñchitaṃ dadau \|*  
*tenābhivandito bhūyo hyantardhānamupāgataḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*sa dvijastatprabhṛtyevaṃ svecchārūpadharaḥ sthitaḥ \|*  
*cintayansatataṃ devaṃ vṛndāraṇyakutūhalam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*kadācidyamunātīre niviṣṭastaṃ vicintayan \|*  
*dadarśa nāradaṃ prāptaṃ vṛndāraṇyaṃ vidheḥ sutam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*sa taṃ dṛṣṭvā namaskṛtya paramaṃ gurumātmanaḥ \|*  
*prapaccha vividhāndharmān bhagavadbhaktivarddhanān \|\| 18 \|\|*

*sa tenaivaṃ susampṛṣṭo nārado'dhyātmadarśanaḥ \|*  
*tasmai provāca nikhilaṃ bhaviṣyaccaritaṃ hareḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*ekadāhaṃ gato vipra devaṃ kailāsavāsinam \|*  
*dra ṣṭuṃ praṣṭuṃ bhaviṣyacca vṛndāvanarahasyakam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*tataḥ praṇamya deveśaṃ tataḥ siddhaiḥ samāvṛtam \|*  
*maheśaṃ svamahivyāptasarvabrahmāṇḍagolakam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*apṛcchamīpsitaṃ bhadraṃ sa māṃ prāha smayanharaḥ \|*  
*vaidhātra yattvayā pṛṣṭaṃ harervṛttamanāgatam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*tatte vrabīmi yatpūrvaṃ śrutaṃ surabhivaktrataḥ \|*  
*ekadā surabhirdṛṣṭā mayā golokamadhyagā \|\| 23 \|\|*

12-23. I asked him about the desired welfare. Lord Нага smilingly spoke to him — “O son of Brahma, I shall tell you what has been formerly heard from the tongue of Surabhi (the divine cow) in regard to the future activities of Hari about which you have asked. Once Surabhi was seen by me staying in the middle of the world, Goloka.

## \|\| 2.81.24 \|\|

*svasantānasamāyuktā suprītā snigdhamānasā \|*  
*tataḥ pṛṣṭā bhaviṣyārthe gavāṃ mātā payasvinī \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. She was accompanied by her progeny. She was delighted and affable mentally. Thereafter, the mother of cows, rich in milk was asked about the future events.

## \|\| 2.81.25-26 \|\|

*mahyaṃ provāca devarṣe bhaviṣyaccaritaṃ hareḥ \|*  
*sukhamāste'dhunā devaḥ kṛṣṇo rādhāsamanvitaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*goloke'sminmaheśāna gopagopīsukhāvahaḥ \|*  
*sa kadāciddharāloke māthure maṇḍale śiva \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. О divine sage, she told me the future history of Hari — “Now Lord Krsna is seated comfortably in the Goloka accompanied by Radha.

## \|\| 2.81.27-28 \|\|

*āvirbhūyādbhutāṃ krīḍāṃ vṛndāraṇye kariṣyati \|*  
*vṛṣabhānusutā rādhā śrīdāmānaṃ hareḥ priyam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*sakhāyaṃ virajāgehadvāḥsthaṃ kruddhā śapiṣyati \|*  
*tataḥ so'pi mahābhāga rādhāṃ prati śapiṣyati \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. О MaheSana, he accords happiness to the cowherds and cowherdesses, О Siva, once (sometime in future) he will appear on the world of earth, in the region of Mathura and will display wonderful sport in Vrndavana. Rad ha the daughter of Vrsabhanu will angrily curse Sridaman who will be a great favourite of Hari and his friend, and who will be stationed at the threshold ofViraja’s house (?) О blessed one, he too will curse Radha in return.

## \|\| 2.81.29-30 \|\|

*yāhi tvaṃ mānuṣaṃ lokaṃ mithaḥ śāpāddharāṃ tataḥ \|*  
*prāpsyatyatha hariḥ paścādbrahmaṇā prārthitaḥ kṣitau \|\| 29 \|\|*

*bhūbhāraharaṇāyaiva vāsudevo bhaviṣyati \|*  
*vasudevagṛhe janma prāpya yādavanandanaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. He will curse thus: “Go down to the mortal world”. And thanks to this mutual course — afterwards requested Brahma, Hari will attain earth for removing the burden of the earth. He will take birth in the house of Vasudeva and he will be called Vasudeva. He will be the delighter of the Yadavas.

## \|\| 2.81.31 \|\|

*kaṃsāsurabhiyā paścādvrajaṃ nandasya yāsyati \|*  
*tatra yāto hariḥ prāptāṃ pūtanāṃ bālaghātinīm \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Afterwards due to the fear of Kamsa, he will go to the cowherds colony of Nanda. After going there he will kill Piitana, the murderess of infants.

## \|\| 2.81.32 \|\|

*viyojayiṣyati prāṇaiścakravātaṃ ca dānavam \|*  
*vatsāsuraṃ mahākāyaṃ haniṣyati surārddanam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. He will also kill the Danava Cakravata (the Cyclone) and the Asura Vatsa of huge body who will harass Devas.

## \|\| 2.81.33 \|\|

*damitvā kāliyaṃ nāgaṃ yamyā uccāṭayiṣyati \|*  
*duḥsahaṃ dhenukaṃ hatvā bakaṃ tadvadaghāsuram \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. He will subdue Kaliya, the serpent, and expel him out of Yamuna. He will kill Dhenuka of unbeareable prowess, Baka (crane) and also the demon asura Agha.

## \|\| 2.81.34-40 \|\|

*dāvaṃ pradāvaṃ ca tathā pralambaṃ ca haniṣyati \|*  
*brahmāṇamindraṃ varuṇaṃ pramattau dhanadātmajau \|\| 34 \|\|*

*vimadānsa vidhāyeśo haniṣyati vṛṣāsuram \|*  
*śaṅkhacūḍaṃ keśinaṃ ca vyomaṃ hatvā vraje vasan \|\| 35 \|\|*

*ekādaśa samāstatra gopībhiḥ krīḍayiṣyati \|*  
*tataśca mathurāṃ prāpya rajakaṃ sannihatya ca \|\| 36 \|\|*

*kubjāmṛjvīṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dhanurbhaṅktvā gajottamam \|*  
*hatvā kuvalayāpīḍaṃ mallāṃścāṇūrakādikān \|\| 37 \|\|*

*kaṃsaṃ svamātulaṃ kṛṣṇo haniṣyati tataḥ param \|*  
*vimucya pitarau baddhau yavaneśaṃ nihatya ca \|\| 38 \|\|*

*jarāsandhabhayātkṛṣṇo dvārakāyāṃ samuṣyati \|*  
*rukmiṇīṃ satyabhāmāṃ ca satyāṃ jāmbavatīṃ tathā \|\| 39 \|\|*

*kaikeyīṃ lakṣmaṇāṃ mitravindāṃ kālindikāṃ vibhuḥ \|*  
*dārānṣoḍaśasāhasrānbhaumaṃ hatvodvahiṣyati \|\| 40 \|\|*

34-36a. He will kill Dava, Pradava as well as Pralamba. He will remove the pride and arrogance of Brahma, Indra, Varuna and the erring sons of Dhanada (Kubera). The lord will kill the Asuras, Vrsa, Sankhacuda, Kerin and Vyoma. Staying in Vraj a (cowherd’s colony) for eleven years, he will sport with the cowherd esses.

36b-38a. Going to Mathura, he will kill the washerman and straighten the humpbacked lady. He will break the bow and kill Kuvalayapida, the excellent elephant and the wrestlers Canura and others. Thereafter, Krsna will kill Kamsa, his own maternal uncle.

38b-39a. He will release his imprisoned parents. After killing the king of Yavanas, and due to his fear of Jarasandha, Krsna will go to Dvaraka.

39b-40. The lord will then marry Rukmini, SatyabhamS, Satya, Jambavatl, Kaikeyi, Laksmana, Mitravinda and Kalindika After killing Bhauma (i.e. the asura Naraka) he will marry sixteen thousand wives.

## \|\| 2.81.41 \|\|

*pauṇḍrakaṃ śiśupālaṃ ca dantavaktraṃ vidūratham \|*  
*śālvaṃ ca hatvā dvividaṃ balvalaṃ ghātayiṣyati \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. After killing Pauntfaka (the pretender Vasudeva), Sisupala, Dantavaktra, Viduratha, Salva and Dvivida, he will kill Balvala.

## \|\| 2.81.42 \|\|

*vajranābhaṃ sunābhaṃ ca sārddhaṃ vai ṣaṭpurālayaiḥ \|*  
*triśarīraṃ tato daityaṃ haniṣyati varorjjitam \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Then he will kill, Vajranabha, Sunabha along with (the demons) the residents of Satpuras (six cities), and the Daitya Trigarlra who will be powerful, thanks to the boons.

## \|\| 2.81.43 \|\|

*kauravānpāṇḍavāṃścāpi nimittamitaretaram \|*  
*kṛtvā haniṣyati śiva bhūbhāraharaṇotsukaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. О Siva, eager to remove the burden of the earth he will create causes for mutual quarrel and kill Kauravas and Pandavas.

## \|\| 2.81.44 \|\|

*yadūnyadubhiranyonyaṃ saṃhṛtya svakulaṃ hariḥ \|*  
*punaretannijaṃ dhāma sameṣyati ca sānugaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. He will make Yadus, members of his own family, quarrel and destroy one another and then will come back to his own abode accompanied by his followers.

## \|\| 2.81.45 \|\|

*etatte'bhihitaṃ śambho bhaviṣyaccaritaṃ hareḥ \|*  
*gaccha dra kṣyasi tatsarvaṃ jagatītalage harau \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. О Sambhu, thus the future story of Hari has been recounted to you. Go, when Hari comes down to the surface of the world of mortals you will see everything”.

## \|\| 2.81.46 \|\|

*tacchrutvā surabhervākyaṃ bhṛśaṃ prīto vidhātṛja \|*  
*svasthānaṃ punarāyātastubhyaṃ cāpi mayoditam \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. О son of Brahma, on hearing the words of Surabhi, I was much delighted and I came back to my own abode. This has now been mentioned to you by me”.

## \|\| 2.81.47 \|\|

*tvaṃ ca dra kṣyasi kālena caritaṃ gokuleśituḥ \|*  
*tacchrutvā śūlino vākyaṃ vasurthṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. On hearing the wotds of the trident-bearing lord conveyed by Narada, Vasu was delighted much. He felt his hairs standing on their ends due to delight.

## \|\| 2.81.48 \|\|

*gāyanmādyan vibhuṃ tantr! yā ramayāmyāturaṃ jagat \|*  
*etadbhaviṣyatkathitaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ dvijottama \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. О excellent Brahmana, I sing about the lord. I am elated. With the string of the lute, I divert the dejected universe. This future story has thus been narrated to you by me.

## \|\| 2.81.49-51 \|\|

*yathā tu gautamastadvadahaṃ cāpi hite rataḥ \|*  
*sūta uvāca- ityuktvā nāradastasmai vasave sa dvijanmane \|\| 49 \|\|*

*jagāma vīṇāṃ raṇayaṃścintayanyadunandanam \|*  
*sa vasustadvacaḥ śrutvā vraje suprītamānasaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*uvāsa sarvadā viprāḥ kṛṣṇakrīḍekṣaṇotsukaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

49a. Just as Gautama, I too am engaged in the welfare of the worlds”. Suta said:

49b-50a. Narada said this to Vasu, the Brahmana, and went away sounding his lute and pondering over the scion of the family ofYadu (i.e. Lord Krsna).

50b-51. On hearing his words, Vasu was delighted in his mind. О Brahmana, he permanently stayed in the Cowherds colony, Vraja.

## Chapter 82. The Benefit of Listening to the Narada Purana

## \|\| 2.82.1 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ - sūta sādho tvayākhyātaṃ śrīkṛṣṇacaritāmṛtam \|*  
*śrutaṃ kṛtārthāstena smo vayaṃ bhavadanugrahāt \|\| 1 \|\|*

The sages said:

1\. О Suta, О virtuous saint, the nectar-like story of Sri Krsna recounted by you has been heard. We are blessed thereby, thanks to your favour.

## \|\| 2.82.2 \|\|

*gate vasau brahmalokaṃ mohinī vidhinandinī \|*  
*kiṃ cakāra tataḥ paścāttanno vyākhyātumarhasi \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. What did Mohini, the daughter of Brahma do after Vasu had departed to the world of Brahma. It behoves you to narrate it to us. Suta said:

## \|\| 2.82.3 \|\|

*sūta uvāca- śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ sarve mohinyāścaritaṃ śubham \|*  
*yaccakāra vasoḥ paścāttīrthānāṃ parisevanam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. О sages, hear ye all, the auspicious story of Mohini, the pilgrimage she undertook afterwards to the holy centres.

## \|\| 2.82.4 \|\|

*yathānuśiṣṭā vasunā mohinī sā vidheḥ sutā \|*  
*jagāma vidhinā tīrthayātrārthaṃ svarṇadītaṭam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. In the manner indicated by Vasu, Mohini, the daughter of Brahma went to the banks of the celestial river (the Ganga) in accordance with the injunctions for the pilgrimage.

## \|\| 2.82.5 \|\|

*tatra gatvā samāplutya gaṅgādīni tu vaidhasī \|*  
*cacāra vidhivaddhṛṣṭā brāhmaṇaiḥ saha saṅgatā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. After going there, the daughter of Vedhas (god Brahma) took a holy bath therein and journeyed over the Ganga and other holy rivers) with a delighted mind, in the company of Brahmanas.

## \|\| 2.82.6 \|\|

*purohitena vasunā yasya tīrthasya yo vidhiḥ \|*  
*kathitastatprakāreṇa sevamānā cacāra ha \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. She resorted to each of the holy centres in the manner laid down by her preceptor Vasu and took the journey of pilgrimage.

## \|\| 2.82.7 \|\|

*teṣu tīrtheṣu devāṃśca viṣṇvādīnpūjayantyatha \|*  
*samarpayantī viprebhyo dānāni vividhāni ca \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. In those Tlrthas she worshipped Visnu and other deities. She offered different charitable gifts to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 2.82.8 \|\|

*gayāyāṃ vidhivadbhartuḥ piṇḍadānaṃ cakāra ha \|*  
*kāśyāṃ viśveśvaraṃ prārcya samprāptā puruṣottamam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. At Gaya, she duly offered Pincja to her husband. After worshipping Visvesvara at Kasi she went over to the holy centre Purusottama(Jagannatha of Purl).

## \|\| 2.82.9 \|\|

*tasmin kṣetre tu naivedyaṃ bhuktvā sā jagadīśituḥ \|*  
*śuddhadehā tataḥ paścātsamprāptā lakṣmaṇācalam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. At that holy centre she partook of Naivedya of the lord of the universe and purified her body. She then reached the mountain Laksmanacnla.

## \|\| 2.82.10 \|\|

*taṃ samabhyarcya vidhivadgatvā setuṃ samarcya ca \|*  
*rāmeśvaraṃ mahendrā driṃ bhārgavaṃ samavandata \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. After duly worshipping at the shrine there, she went to Setu and worshipped Ramesvara. At Mali end ra mountain, she paid obeisance to Bhargava Parasurama.

## \|\| 2.82.11 \|\|

*gokarṇaṃ ca śivakṣetraṃ gatvābhyarcya tamīśvaram \|*  
*prabhāsaṃ prayayau viprāḥ sārddhaṃ tairdvijasattamaiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. О Brahmana, she went to the holy centre of Siva, viz: Gokarna and worshipped Isvara. Then along with those excellent Brahmanas, she went to Prabhasa.

## \|\| 2.82.12 \|\|

*snātvā santarpya devādīṃstasya yātrāṃ vidhāya ca \|*  
*dvārakāyāṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā kurukṣetraṃ jagāma sā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. She took a holy dip and performed Tarpana rites for the Devas and others. After completing the pilgrimage, she visited Hari at Dvaraka and went to Kurukshetra.

## \|\| 2.82.13 \|\|

*tatrāpi vidhivadyātrāṃ saṃvidhāya nareśvarī \|*  
*gaṅgādvāramupeyāya tatra sasnau vidhānataḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. There also the queen of men duly fulfilled the prescribed rites of pilgrimage and came to Gangadvara where she took holy bath in accordance with injunctions.

## \|\| 2.82.14-15 \|\|

*tatastu dṛṣṭvā kāmodāṃ namaskṛtya mudānvitā \|*  
*badaryāśramamāsādya naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī \|\| 14 \|\|*

*samabhyarcyātha kāmākṣīṃ yayau dra ṣṭuṃ tvarānvitā \|*  
*siddhanāthaṃ namaskṛtya tato'yodhyāmupāgatā \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. After visiting and joyously bowing to Kamoda, she reached Badaryasrama and worshipped the sages Nara and Narayana. She then hastened to visit Kamaksl. After bowing to Siddhanatha, she went to Ayodhya.

## \|\| 2.82.16 \|\|

*snātvā sarayvāṃ vidhivatprārcya sītāpatiṃ tataḥ \|*  
*madhyayātrāmupāśritya yayāvamarakaṇṭakam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. After duly taking a holy dip in the Sarayu and after worshipping the lord of Sita, she resorted to the pilgrimage of middle centres, she then went to Amarakantaka.

## \|\| 2.82.17 \|\|

*maheśaṃ tatra sampūjya pratisrotastunarmadām \|*  
*saṃsevyoṅkāramīśānaṃ dṛṣṭvā māhiṣmatīṃ yayau \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. After worshipping Mahesa there, she went up the current of the Narmada. After serving Omkara arid visiting Isana she went to Mahismatl.

## \|\| 2.82.18-21 \|\|

*tr! yambakeśaṃ tataḥ prārcya samprāptā sā tripuṣkaram \|*  
*puṣkareṣu vidhānena datvā dānānyanekaśaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*samprāptā sā tu mathurāṃ sarvatīrthottamottamām \|*  
*vidhāyābhyantarīṃ yātrāṃ yojanānāṃ tu viṃśatim \|\| 19 \|\|*

*parikramya purīṃ paścāccaturvyūhaṃ dadarśa sā \|*  
*snātvā viṃśatitīrthe tu samāpyātha pradakṣiṇām \|\| 20 \|\|*

*dhenūnāmayutaṃ prādānmāthurebhyo hyalaṅkṛtam \|*  
*sambhojya tānvarānnena bhaktiklinnena cetasā \|\| 21 \|\|*

18-19a. After worshipping Tryambakesa, she reached Tripuskara. After giving many charitable gifts at the Puskara. in accordance with the injunctions, she reached Mathura, the most excellent of all excellent Tirthas.

19b-21. She performed the inner pilgrimage (Abhyantari Yatra) upto twenty Yojanas. (240 KMs.). After going all over the city, she visited Gaturvyuha (the fourfold incarnation of the lord). After taking a holy dip in the VimSati Tirtha, she concluded the circumambulation. To the citizens of Mathura, she gifted ten thousand cows, all richly adorned after feeding them with excellent cooked rice and with her mind melting with devout feelings.

## \|\| 2.82.22 \|\|

*namaskṛtya visṛjyaitānkālindīṃ samupāviśat \|*  
*tataḥ praviṣṭā sā devīṃ kālindīmaghanāśinīm \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. She bowed to them and bade farewell to them. She entered Kalindl the divine river that destroys sins.

## \|\| 2.82.23-28 \|\|

*nādyāpi nirgatā bhūyo yamatithyantamāsthitā \|*  
*smārtānsūryodayaṃ prāpya śrautānapyaruṇodayam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*niśīthaṃ vaiṣṇavānviprāḥ prāpya dūṣayate vratān \|*  
*mohinīvedharahitāmupoṣyaikādaśīṃ naraḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*dvādaśyāṃ viṣṇumabhyarcya vaikuṇṭhaṃ yātyasaṃśayam \|*  
*mohinī vidhijā devī viṣṇujaikādaśī dvijāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*viṣṇujāsparddhayā dhātrā mohinī sā vinirmitā \|*  
*rukmāṅgadastu rājarṣirviṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*na tu vārayituṃ śaktā sā tamekādaśīvratāt \|*  
*viṣṇulokaṃ gate tasminsabhārye sasute nṛpe \|\| 27 \|\|*

*sparddhantyaikādaśīṃ siddhiṃ yamānte mohinī sthitā \|*  
*ityetaduktaṃ viprendrā mohinīcaritaṃ mayā \|\| 28 \|\|*

23-25a. Therein she stabilised herself in the end of Yama’s Tithi. She has not emerged out of it till today. When Mohini attains the point of sunrise she defiles all Smarta rites (rites laid down in Srnrtis). When Mohini attains the point of Arunodaya (predawn), she defiles the Srauta rites (those laid down in Srutis) and when she attains the midnight point, she defiles Vaishnava (pertaining to the followers of Visnu) rites. The man must observe fast on the Ekadasi day when there is no Vedha (overlapping ofTithi) of Mohini and worship Visnu on the DvadasI day. Thereby undoubtedly he goes to Vaikuntha.

25b-26a. О Brahmanas, goddess Mohini was born of god Brahma and Ekadasi was born of Visnu. It was due to a spirit of rivalry against Visnuja, the daughter of Visnu that Mohini was created by Brahma.

26b-28. The saintly king Rukmangada was devoted to Visnu’s loyal devotion. She was not competent enough to prevent him from the holy vow of Ekadasi. When the king went to the world of Visnu accompanied by his wife and son, Mohini stationed at the end of Yama’s Tithi, vies with Ekadasi Tithi. Thus, О leading Brahmana, the story of Mohini has been recounted by me.

## \|\| 2.82.29 \|\|

*yadarthaṃ nirmitā dhātrā tathā cātra vyavasthitā \|*  
*nāradīyottaraṃ hyetatproktaṃ vo bhuktimuktidam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. I have told you this also viz, Why she was created by Brahma and how she stationed herself there. Thus the latter half of the Naradlya Puranais recounted. It yields worldly pleasures and salvation.

## \|\| 2.82.30 \|\|

*atra samyaggharerbhaktiḥ sādhyate'nupadaṃ nṛṇām \|*  
*nāradīyaṃ purāṇaṃ tu lakṣaṇairddaśabhiryutam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. In this work, Hari’s devotion is achieved at every step of men. The Naradlya Purana is endowed with all the ten characteristics.

## \|\| 2.82.31 \|\|

*yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā sa gacchedvaiṣṇavaṃ padam \|*  
*dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ caturṇṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ param \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. It is the effective cau^e of the four aims viz. virtue, wealth, love and liberation. The man who listens devoutly to this shall attain the region of Visnu.

## \|\| 2.82.32-33 \|\|

*sarveṣāṃ ca purāṇānāmidaṃ bījaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*pravṛttaṃ ca nivṛttaṃ ca purāṇe'smindvijottamāḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*vistarāduditaṃ sarvaṃ pārāśaryeṇa dhīmatā \|*  
*alaukikacaritrāḍhyaṃ purāṇaṃ nāradīyakam \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. This is the eternal seed of all other Puranas. О excellent Brahmanas, everything, viz.: Pravrtta and Nivrtta (the worldly activities and their renunciation) j has been mentioned in detail by the intelligent son of Parasara. Naradiya Purana is full of superhuman stories.

## \|\| 2.82.34 \|\|

*yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ mahyaṃ vyāsena kīrtitam \|*  
*hitvā svaśiṣyānpailādīnmahyaṃ nāradasaṃhitām \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. It should not be imparted to anyone and everyone indiscriminately. It has been recounted to me by Vyasa overlooking Paila and other disciples. He recounted this Narada- sarhhita to me and not to them.

## \|\| 2.82.35-38 \|\|

*yo vyācakre namastasmai vedavyāsāya viṣṇave \|*  
*purāṇasaṃhitāmetāṃ nāradāya vipaścite \|\| 35 \|\|*

*sanakādyā mahābhāgā munayaḥ pracakāśire \|*  
*haṃsasvarūpī bhagavānyadā taṃ brahma śāśvatam \|\| 36 \|\|*

*tadupādiśadetebhyo vijñānena vijṛmbhitam \|*  
*tadidaṃ bhagavānsākṣānnārado'dhyātmadarśanaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*vedavyāsāya munaye rahasyaṃ nirdideśa ha \|*  
*mayā prakāśitaṃ hyetadra hasyaṃ bhuvi durlabham \|\| 38 \|\|*

35-36a. Obeisance to that Vedavyasa who is identical with Visnu, and who expounded the Narada Samhita i.e. the Narada Purana to me. It was Sanaka and other highly blessed sages who revealed this Purana Samhita to Narada, the learned.

36b-38. The lord in the form of a swan had instructed the eternal Brahman enhanced by perfect knowledge to these sages. The same thing, Narada of spiritual vision, revealed to sage Veda-Vyasa. He told him the esoteric secret. This is difficult to be obtained in the world and it has been revealed by me.

## \|\| 2.82.39 \|\|

*caturvargapradaṃ nṝṇāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāṃ sadā \|*  
*vipro vedanidhirbhūyātkṣatriyo jayate mahīm \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. To men who listen and narrate it is conducive to the fulfilment of fourfold aims of life. A Brahmana shall become the storehouse of the Vedas, a Ksatriya will conquer the Earth.

## \|\| 2.82.40 \|\|

*vaiśyo dhanasamṛddhaḥ syācchūdro mucyeta duḥkhataḥ \|*  
*pañcaviṃśatisāhasrī saṃhiteyaṃ prakīrtitā \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. A Vaisya shall be richly endowed with wealth, a Sudra shall be liberated from misery. This Samhita is glorified as containing twenty-five thousand verses (?).

## \|\| 2.82.41 \|\|

*pañcapādasamāyuktā kṛṣṇadvaipāyanena ha \|*  
*asyāṃ vai śrūyamāṇāyāṃ sarvasandehabhañjanam \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. It consists of five Padas (sections) as mentioned by Krsna Dvaipayana. When this is being heard, all doubts of men who are devotees with some specific desires are cleared.

## \|\| 2.82.42-44 \|\|

*puṃsāṃ sakāmabhaktānāṃ niṣkāmānāṃ vimokṣaṇam \|*  
*puṇyatīrthaṃ samāsādya naimiṣaṃ puṣkaraṃ gayām \|\| 42 \|\|*

*mathurāṃ dvārakāṃ viprā naranārāyaṇāśramam \|*  
*kurukṣetraṃ narmadāṃ ca kṣetraṃ śrīpuruṣottamam \|\| 43 \|\|*

*haviṣyāśī dharāśāyī niḥsaṅgo vijitendri yaḥ \|*  
*paṭhitvā saṃhitāmenāṃ mucyate bhavasāgarāt \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. Those men who are devoid of desires, are liberated. The devotees shall visit holy Tirthas such as Naimisa, Puskara, Gaya, Mathura, Dvaraka, the hermitage of Nara and Narayana, Kurukshetra, Narmada and the holy centre Sri Purusottama. He should then confine himself to a diet of Havisya (cooked rice soaked in ghee), should lie (sleep) on the bare ground. He should avoid sexual intercourse. He should conquer all the sense-organs. Thereafter, if he reads this Samhita, he is liberated from the ocean of worldly

## \|\| 2.82.45-46 \|\|

*ekādaśī vratānāṃ ca saritāṃ jāhnavī yathā \|*  
*vṛndāvanamaraṇyānāṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ kauravaṃ yathā \|\| 45 \|\|*

*yathā kāśī purīṇāṃ ca tīrthānāṃ mathurā yathā \|*  
*sarasāṃ puṣkaraṃ viprāḥ purāṇānāmidaṃ tathā \|\| 46 \|\|*

45-46. Just as Ekada^I is the most excellent of all holy vows, just as the Ganges is the holiest of all rivers, just as Vrndavana is the most excellent of all forests, just as Kurukshetra is the most excellent of all holy centres, just as Kasi is tbe most excellent of all cities, just as Mathura is the best of all holy Tirthas, and just as Puskara is the holiest of all lakes, so also, О Brahmanas, this is the best of all Puranas.

## \|\| 2.82.47 \|\|

*gaṇeśabhaktāḥ saurāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ śāktaśāmbhavāḥ \|*  
*sarve'dhikāriṇo hyatra sakāmāścāpyakāmakāḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Devotees of Ganesa, Surya, Visnu, Sakti and Sambhu — all these are authorized in this Purana whether they have any desire to fulfil or not.

## \|\| 2.82.48 \|\|

*yaṃ yaṃ kāmamabhidhyāyannaro nāryathavādarāt \|*  
*śṛṇoti śrāvayedvāpi taṃ taṃ prāpnoti niścitam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Whether a man or a woman listens to this or narrates this with a specific desire in the mind, he or she shall certainly attain that-

## \|\| 2.82.49 \|\|

*rogārto mucyate rogādbhayārto nirbhayo bhavet \|*  
*jayakāmo jayecchatrūnnāradīyānuśīlanāt \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. By regularly reading the Naradlya Purana, one who is dejected due to ailments, shall be liberated from ailments. One who is overwhelmed by fear, shall become fearless. He who is desirous of victory shall be victorious over the enemies.

## \|\| 2.82.50 \|\|

*sṛṣṭyādau rajasā viśvaṃ madhye sattvena pāti yaḥ \|*  
*tamasāṃ'te grasedetattasmai sarvātmane namaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Obeisance to that lord identical with all, the Atman of all, who creates the universe in the beginning by the attribute of Rajas, who maintains it in the middle by the quality of Sattva and who swallows it in the end by the quality of Tamas.

## \|\| 2.82.51 \|\|

*ṛṣayo manavaḥ siddhā lokapālāḥ prajeśvarāḥ \|*  
*brahmādyā racitā yena tasmai brahmātmane namaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Obeisance to that Brahmatman by whom the sages, Manus, Siddhas, guardians of the quarters and Prajapatis, Brahma etc., have been created.

## \|\| 2.82.52 \|\|

*yato vāco nivartante na mano yatra saṃviśet \|*  
*tadvidyādātmano rūpaṃ hyarūpasya cidātmanaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. One shall know that to be the real form of Atman that is formless and identical with knowledge that form from which words recede and in whom the mind does not penetrate.

## \|\| 2.82.53 \|\|

*yasya satyatayā satyaṃ jagadetadvikāśate \|*  
*vicitrarūpaṃ vande taṃ nirguṇaṃ tamasaḥ param \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. I salute that attributeless Being beyond darkness which has a wonderful form and by the truth of which this universe evolves and develops truly.

## \|\| 2.82.54 \|\|

*ādau madhye cāpyajanaścānte caikākṣaro vibhuḥ \|*  
*vibhāti nānārūpeṇa taṃ vande'ha nirañjanam \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. The lord is birthless, single and imperishable in the beginning, in the middle and in the end. He shines in different forms. I salute that unsullied Being.

## \|\| 2.82.55 \|\|

*nirañjanātsamutpannaṃ jagadetaccarācaram \|*  
*tiṣṭhatyapyeti vā yasmiṃstatsatyaṃ jñānamadvayam \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. This universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings is born of the unsullied Being. That is the truth, knowledge and non dualistic entity, that in which the world stands and is dissolved.

## \|\| 2.82.56-57 \|\|

*śivaṃ śaivā vadantyenaṃ pradhānaṃ sāṅkhyavedinaḥ \|*  
*yoginaḥ puruṣaṃ viprāḥ karma mīmāṃsakā janāḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*vibhuṃ vaiśeṣikādyāśca cicchaktiṃ śakticintakāḥ \|*  
*brahmādvitīyaṃ tadvande nānārūpakriyāspadam \|\| 57 \|\|*

56-57. The followers of Siva call that supreme Being Siva, the knowers ol the Sankhya call him Pradhana. О Brahmanas, the Yogins call that Purusa, and the people who follow Mlmamsa call him Karman. The Vaiscsikas and others call him Vibhu, those who ponder over Sakti call him Cicchakti. I salute that non-dualistic Brahman that is the cause of different forms and activities?

## \|\| 2.82.58 \|\|

*bhaktirbhagavataḥ puṃsāṃ bhagavadrrūpakāriṇī \|*  
*tāṃ labdhvā cāparaṃ lābhaṃ ko vāñchati vinā paśum \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Devotion of men to the lord facilitates the assumption of the lord’s form. Who except a brute desires for other benefits after attaining that devotion.

## \|\| 2.82.59 \|\|

*bhagavadvimukhā ye tu narāḥ saṃsāriṇo dvijāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ muktirbhavāṭavyā nāsti satsaṅgamantarā \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. О Brahmanas, except through the association with the good, those worldly men who are averse to the lord cannot hope to gain liberation from the forest of worldly existence.

## \|\| 2.82.60 \|\|

*sādhavaḥ samudācārāḥ sarvalokahitāvahāḥ \|*  
*dīnānukampino viprāḥ prapannāstārayanti hi \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Virtuous men of good conduct are always conducive to the welfare of the worlds. О Brfihmanas, they are sympathetic towards the wretched ones. Indeed, they redeem those who seek refuge in them.

## \|\| 2.82.61 \|\|

*yūyaṃ dhanyatamā loke munayaḥ sādhusammatāḥ \|*  
*yanmuhurvāsudevasya kīrtiṃ pallavanūtanām \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. You arc the most blessed sages in this world. You have gained approbation of the iighteous ones since you glorify the renown of Vasudeva, fresh at every time like the fresh tender sprouts.

## \|\| 2.82.62 \|\|

*dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi bhavadbhirlokamaṅgalam \|*  
*yatsmārito hariḥ sākṣātsarvakāraṇakāraṇam \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. I am lucky and blessed. I have been obliged by you all, since you have reminded me of I lari, the auspiciousness of the world, who is the cause of all causes.
